"Nice restaurant you got there:  it'd be a shame if it were to be beleaguered by a spate of awful reviews that have a mysteriously prominent place on your business listing.  I'm sorry, were we talking about the advertising you were about to buy on this site?"

Anyway, let me bring The Serious for a second.

This really is an exceptional McDonald's.  When I last went in there and asked for an iced coffee, the teenager who took my order acted as if I had just fallen into cardiac arrest and he was racing against time to save my life.  He wasn't going to mess up my order and he damn sure wasn't going to waste my time.  Seriously, Mr. McDonald's Manager:  whatever you're paying that kid, double it.  Chop-chop, motherfucker.

Did I mention that the place was also clean, calm, and orderly?

This is the worst McDonald's in the known universe.

Number one, it's dirty. Number two, it's staffed by the most incompetent McTards you'll ever meet. For example, I once tried to order a double quarter pounder with cheese. I was told that menu item was unavailable. As a joke, I asked for a single quarter pounder with cheese, which apparantly was available.

Then my head exploded.

Don't go. Not worth the headache you'll get afterwords.
Terrible store, even though they moved to a new building, they brought the same lazy slobs with them. This place is ALWAYS a filthy dump with terrible service. Go to lebanon instead.

Woah.  Stepped into this McDonalds looking for breakfast and it was hands down one of the most unpleasant chain location I've ever entered.  Broken seats were taped with "under construction" tape, the people hanging out there weren't even eating, and it almost felt unsafe at 10:00 in the morning.  (And as a St. Louis city resident, I feel like I'm allowed to say that.)

Must avoid unless you really want those hash browns.  And don't get your hopes up, the one down the street's even worse.

P.S.: The ATM was broken.  (Why I tried to get money here, I don't really know.)
Outdoor playground, so at least the sun sanitizes it a bit.  Other parents hanging tend to be pretty friendly.  Food and cleanliness here is better than average.  So, recommended.

Location was not as clean as it should be and flies were buzzing around our table. For some reason, this location is always a mess. It has a very small dinning room, so there should be no reason for it to be so dirty. The tables are dirty, the trash cans are always overflowing or even have the doors left open. I just don't get it. The one positive is that everytime I go there, the staff is always suprisingly nice. I once saw the young female manager notice an elderly man getting out of his car and leaving his wife in the car and the manager quickly grabbed what the man normally ordered and ran it out to him so that he wouldn't have to leave his elderly wife in the car. This appeared to be a dailing thing for them and the manager apparently did not charge the gentleman. It was a very sweet thing to see. Very nice people, just clean up the darn place.

This is a very busy and popular McDonald's. They recently remodeled the building. They completely tore it down to build a new one. They did it quickly, but now the store seems cramped.

They do have two drive-thrus now and so they get more people through faster. And they are extremely fast. Very impressive. 

Food quality is good for McDonald's. The owner is also extremely nice and is a good member of the community. He allows kids to use their water for car washes and donates things like cups to events around the community.
Drunk chicky nug eating is sometimes my favorite kind of eating. Stumble here after a perfect night at Johnny Brenda's, and finish your night right.

My experience with Mc Donalds in the past was that you can go to one anywhere in the world and it's always the same. Same food, same decor, same standard of cleanliness. While the decor at this particular McD's is nice, the place is filthy. Went with hubby today just to get something to drink. The self-serve drink station was filthy. Straw wrappers everywhere. The little white cups you put ketchup in were wet with old soda. None of the tables were clean. The bathroom wasn't much better. Plus, they seemed to be very short handed. It took about five minutes for the cashier to come and take our order, because she had to fill the previous customer's order all by herself. Didn't look like she had any back up at all. I think I'll skip this one next time.

Like many McDonalds, this one was redecorated to have an upscale decor when they got a McCafe, however it's literally falling down from the ceiling.  While they don't have flies like most McDonalds in town, a one star offense, they do manage to screw up about 50% of our orders.  The latest was a missing cheesburger and no straw for my daughters happy meal.  This is one of the highest volum McDonalds in Indy and they just do a terrible job with quality standards.
Slow!!!!!! They almost always screw up my order. One of of five times they get it right.

This place is the worst McDonalds in the world. I know that sounds hard but this place is run by total morons, it is disgustingly dirty, the wait times are atrocious and the food (which should be exactly the same as any other McDonalds) is untasty and tossed in the bag like it was made by mentally deranged criminals.
The interior inside is really fancy and original. Employies are attendive and fast!
Meh, getting my iced tea again.  The service was ok, I don't eat pseudo-beef so I didn't eat here.

worst mcdonalds ever. 

Not only is the area around this McDonald's gross, the clientele even more icky, and the employees seriously unfriendly, they don't even take coupons. I mean, all I wanted was my free smoothie and they can't even honor my coupon. Boo. I typically don't find myself wanting McDonald's, but in the event that the craving overtakes me, I will leave my office (located above the concourse) and head to Broad and Arch.

I brought the boys here for an ice cream cone and we all were pleasantly surprised with their large, 3-tier play gym.

What was supposed to be a 15 minute visit turned into a 60 minute visit.

The place was clean, service was fast and the cones were OK.  

One negative: Maybe I'm used to how they do it in Las Vegas, but the ice cream on the ice cream cones were weak and pretty short.  We're all used to the ice cream being applied to at least x2 the height of the actual cone.

I went here with a few co-workers after work for breakfast (Working third shift yay..not). Friends hot 2 breakfast platters, seemed like they enjoyed it. Myself, I got a sausage egg and cheese andd a few strands of hair hanging out of my sandwich. I asked for another one, and literally they came back out with a sandwich in 20 seconds. Not sure if it was the same one or new one. I didn't eat it. Other then that, location isn't a bad area, They open at 5:30am for breakfast for you early guys.

Went for lunch today. All the under construction stuff was gone. Actually for an inner city establishment it was very nice and tastefully decorated. Every worker i met was nice to me. 

My chicken nugget meal was popping hot and fresh.  No complaints about this visit.   I don't give chain restaurants 5 stars out of principal

These people never get my order right....literally never, there's always long lines but not because their a good restaurant but because people 5 cars ahead of you have been there for 15 minutes waiting

This McDonalds rates high on my list because it has recently been rebuilt/remodeled, there is a children's play area and the staff members are wonderful! There is a woman who walks around cleaning off the tables, she stops and greets everyone and treats them well. I feel like a welcome guest when I visit this location!

Dear McDonalds,

We've known each other since we were youngsters and I've always been fond of you. We grew up together. We played together. Your gifts of free plastic toys captured my American heart before the days those same toys were made entirely of lead, and before those same hearts were made entirely of fats so fatty they have their own scooters reserved at Walmart.

And yet despite all the years we've known each other, to this day your golden arching curves beckon me forth on occasion, to slip inside you, and leave just as quickly. You and I both know what this relationship is. We don't kid ourselves and we keep it professional. We are what we are and we'll never be more than that. That much has always fortunately been clear.

So when I learned of something new a couple of years ago, I knew it would be something I couldn't try with anyone else but you. But I was afraid to try it. Perhaps afraid of what you'd think of me after. Perhaps afraid of the permanent damage it could do to my insides. But today as they say, was a good day for a McGangBang. We've known each other long enough for me to feel comfortable with this kind of wild experimentation. So today was the day I let you have your way with me and now I'm left pondering what it is I've done. The subsequent crying in the shower didn't cleanse me enough, and the Fiona Apple music has only heightened my emotional state. Consequently I've turned to my friend Yelp for some catharsis, that is if any is to be found.

I wasn't sure I could fit something so large inside me, but that's just part of the experience I suppose, the fear and the dread of shoving something so large in something so narrow an opening. An entire Spicy McChicken sandwiched inside a McDouble... wrapped up of course! You only charged me $2.00 + tax for the experience, which I know is a great deal and all, but now I just feel cheap and used. I don't know if I can ever look at either sandwich separately the same way again. And what if they tell Big Mac I cheated, or if it gets back to the little McNuggets? Oh my, what have I done?

I just feel so dirty. That homeless woman going through the ordering line one by one begging for spare dollar bills from everyone didn't help, nor did the used syringe I sidestepped in the parking lot. I hadn't known you started using again. It was Lindsay Lohan wasn't it? You saw her again didn't you?

Oh McDonalds, one day, this will all end, and you'll never see me again. Every time I see you, I say it's the last, but I just can't quit you. I wish I knew how to quit you.

But one day McDonalds, one day...

I have been here twice. The first time I would give it five stars but then after my recent second visit I give it one star, thus three in the end. 

The first time we went here for lunch and it was really busy inside and the drive thru. We went in and expected bad lines and prepared for bad service. To my pleasant surprise the staff were very organized, fast and still managed to be friendly. In fact, I was so impressed I went up to the manager and thanked him for running such a smooth show. I vowed to come to this location if I could in the future. 

I changed my mind today and will not come here if I can help it. They got our simple order wrong and then looked at me like it was my fault. I wasn't the only one because the guy next to me cane back with his incorrect order too. The staff did a lot of eye rolling and "are you sure?". Spare me, I know what I ordered. I wish people who didn't like their jobs didn't show it. 

Anyway, I would cone here again for lunch but not breakfast or you will face hung over, grumpy servers.

Bought my Child a kids meal, ordered the apple dippers, which have 2 important parts, apples and carmel dipping sauce. When I got home and started to take the food out of the bag for my child there was no dipping sauce. I called the store to ask if they were out and the guy that answered the phone said he would check. After being gone about a minute someone hung up the phone. I went to the store to get the dipping sauce(which I am very sure cost me more in gas then the whole meal) and walked up to the counter. The guy asked if he could help me. I stated that I needed carmel to which he responded, "this is the guy that called in about the carmel" and looked at the manager on duty who turned only her head still with her back to me and said "we're out" then went back to what she was doing. I was said "it would have been nice if someone would have told me that when I placed my order". She looked at me again then yelled in back give me a box or something. I Just stood there and watched while she argued with some guy on the line then got a 4 piece nugget box and pumped some carmel in it and set it on the counter in front of me and turned her back again. 

It was SUPER poor customer service. I have placed a call to the owner of the store and we will see how responsive he is, but this store is like this ALL the time. I know that the same owner owns at least 4-5 more stores and none of those have ever been a problem that I have seen but this one I would AVOID at all costs!!!

This has got to be the worst McD's I've ever seen. First, I just LOVED the urine smell when I walked in. Now, I'm not 100% sure if it was from the store itself, or from the kind of people that frequent this location. This place was just dirty inside and out, and since it's in the ghetto, the people in line looked like walking Post Office mugshots. 

Service? If you mean when they ask you what you want and then walk to the rear of the store where the rest of the employees gathered to do nothing, then yeah, they were awesome at that. 10 minutes for a cheese burger? Wow. Well stay hot McGhetto's. I wish I could give this store negatice stars, or drop NAPALM on the store and start over. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE! ugh

Below it's asking me: 'Good For:" How come "nothing" isn't an option?

The worst McDonald's ever when it comes to service.  I live in Troy and am ashamed of this McDonalds.   They can never get an order right.  I've complained several times only to get free meal but it doesn't change things at all.   If I want McDonalds, I will now drive to Edwardsville or Collinsville to ensure my order is correct.
Quick service. Smelly entrance-yuck!

McDonald's has great Breakfasts, and their coffee is way better than it used to be.  I like that they're adding healthier options for dinner too.  NOTE:  Breakfast is served here till 11:00 AM EVERYDAY;-)

Obviously, there is nothing fresh about a fast food joint. You can say what you like about the salads and such but its hard to be that fast and maintain the proper level of nutrition. On that note, I love to bring my girls to their favorite hot spot. McDonald's is traditional. Kids love it. This particular location is truly unacceptable. It is dirty, it reeks of day old mop water being used over and over. The service is horrible. I have never had one employee of this McDonald's smile at me as I placed an order. I would never eat here and refuse even let my kids enjoy the occasional happy meal. This location is a direct reflection of poor management, lazy employees and packaged food. Yuck.

We stopped in because we had 2 free drink coupons.
The, all I can call her is crazy, Manager Lady wouldn't take 2 coupons at the same time even though there were 3 of us and I was ordering other items.  She made me go into another line with one of the coupons.
I have no idea what planet she lives on, but every other McDonalds we have been in with these free coupons hasn't had a problem with taking them.
Needless to say, we won't be slumming it to this McDonalds ever in the future.  We will stick to the ones in the nicer areas of the City.

This McDonald's is on US-13 northbound. This is an entrance from the highway but you have to approach slowly or you may miss it. The restaurant has its own lot and parking area. I only got takeout on this visit so I didn't use the dining area or restroom, but the order area looked decently clean.  Service was okay and speed of food preparation was what you'd expect for a fast food restaurant. I would note though that food from this place was a possible cause of the problem I had later that night, although I can't prove it conclusively.
So close to wawa & i ate @ mc d's. Wtf was i thinking. Just as i am getting into better shape i go & do this.

I have actually eaten here.

Yes.

Gasp.

So shocking - seeing as I usually don't even consider fast food - but I have a weakness.  Every once in a business-trippy-blue moon, I grab an egg McMuffin here on my way to catch the AMTRAK train.

300 calories.
$2.99 (sometimes they have a buy 2 for $3 deal - but who can eat 2 of them?)

Egg Mc Muff.

What evs,

Oh - and believe it or not the Muslim ladies who run the place (at least on the morning weekday shift) are pretty darned pleasant. I was so shocked!

Update- Haven't been inside since my review in '08 but do use the drive thru.   It's always a pleasure because the staff is super friendly.     I don't know if there has been new management or better training since '08 when I gave it a poor review.   But no complaints about the drive thru service.

HAHA! You know, if I were rating on comedy, this McDonalds would be a 4 star but for customer service, it translates to 2 stars on Yelp!

This McDonalds is conveniently located on Canal street adjacent to Bourbon St. That's probably all it has going for it. As I walk in the store, I already feel unsafe. The lady at the cash register takes my order and suddenly she just utters Powerade. I am like what are you talking about? She was just mumbling CO2, CO2.....then I had to ask her again.......what are you asking me? She said the carbonation was out and the people behind me even understood that. HAHA! It helps to speak in complete sentences. It helps comprehension. I ordered a Big Mac combo with no salt on the fries.

Of course they forgot the no salt on the fries. OMG. The lady at the cash register told the fries lady, told you so. LOL. I felt like I walked into a dysfunctional family restaurant. Also, some one asked for no cheese on their burger but the guy making the sandwiches was raising hell to the cash register lady. I feel these employees are probably not communicating to each other. I bet the guy assembling the sandwiches probably did something to that person's sandwich. 

Let's just say I was entertained....but I was looking forward to a refreshing Coke. Instead I got a diluted Powerade that tastes like water.
I know it's fast food but I rarely expect my counter person to snag some of my fries on the way to the counter or to have meeting with co-workers when asked for no pickles.

The only place (at least that i know of) you can get $0.99 Big Macs and $0.25 Chicken Nuggets ALL THE TIME 24/7!  

Cons: Shady Area    
Pros: Two All-Beef Patties Special Sauce Lettuce Cheese Pickles Onion on a Sesame Seed Bun.  YUMMM!

If you're partying in the area or here after-hours, this McDonald's is one of your fine dining choices. Heck, even if you're shopping and have the urge to eat a McChicken, here you go.

It's cheap, and if all you want is Chicken McNuggets to slow the effects of booze on your bloodstream, there you go.

If only they had booze.

I couldn't avoid the big golden arches I saw while waiting across the street at the Acura dealership. On top of that, it was Monopoly season. So naturally, I HAD to go. 

I wanted to like this place when I walked in. It was fairly empty (it was about 10:15AM), clean, it looked festive with decorations on each table, and there was a promise of free WiFi. And then I got to the counter and my dreams were shattered.

The cashier was very brusque and rude. I politely inquired as to which breakfast items would yield Monopoly stickers and the conversation went like this:

Cashier: "Just the medium coffee cup."
Me: "And the hash browns, right?"
Cashier: "Yeah and the hash browns."
Me: "And the McGriddles..."
Cashier: "Yeah, just the medium coffee cup, hash browns, and the McGriddles, that's it."

Ummmm, okay. So maybe I shouldn't have asked if I already knew, but don't give me attitude if you don't even know what you're talking about, and then act like you knew the whole time. Please.

Also, they stared my friend down when she went up to refill her water cup like she was going to steal soda or something. They basically stared at us the whole time. It was very uncomfortable and annoying.

Food-wise, the fries didn't seem fresh considering they should have come from the first batch of the day. Instead, they came brown and soggy. The only positive thing from the purchase of my meal were two winning Monopoly pieces for medium fries that I will NOT be redeeming here. The Big Mac was fine.

And to further my disappointment, there was no WiFi, as promised. I got rolled on all counts,

I will try to keep this one as gentle as possible.

This place sucks.

This location is probably the most inconsistent one out there. Nothing is ever made on a good standard level that I know McDonald's can deliver. 

Sometimes you get a sweet tea, it's great. Sometimes, it's bland. Sometimes, it's like drinking sugar. This goes for everything else on the menu. It's like gambling to go here.

Also, they do not like to give you your change (1 - 4 cents) back. I thought it was standard? I only had this problem on drive-thru though.

It is not "24/7 drive-thru" either. I went by around 4 in the morning, and was told they were closed. I guess they make their own rules! Oh, I love the Girard and Broad intersection.
Not the worst ever. Just a normal but usually very busy place. My orders have been right and the fries are hot. No play place for the wee ones.

i would never go into a mcdonalds...except that at 9pm i was walking by and really wanted some soft serve (and a small fry). 

once i got over the diaper smell in there, i had an amusing time. 

i asked if they only had vanilla soft serve. 
mcdonalds staff stared at me. 
okay, do you have chocolate ice cream? 
no. 
do you have vanilla? 
yes. 
okay can i have a vanilla soft serve cone.
what?
you know, soft serve (pointing)
oh a cone. yah. that'll be $1..
wait, and a small fry (and whatever he's getting). also do you have sprinkles?
we got dem (points to m&m's) and oreos mashed up.
oh, so no sprinkles? can you put the m&m's on the cone?
i not gonna try. 
wait, why'd you tell me then?.... huh? okay just a plain vanilla softserve then.
a what?
a vanilla cone. 
oh.

jeez. was seriously difficult to order one cone here. but, i was laughing most of the time, so i got a little chuckle with my vanilla soft serve. 

still unsure as to why it smelled diapers. there was a very large fan blowing on the floor- not sure about that either.

I just cannot do fast food.  Blame it on the hippy upbringing.. the fresh from the garden veggies, the homemade tofu, the pasta off the press, the fresh ground venison...... whatever... everything just smells and tastes like grease in this place.  And the service...... it horrifies... I know people hate their jobs... but it's a job.  And damnit I know you're lieing to me when you tell me the milkshake machine is broken.   I just want a freaking vanilla milkshake.

I want to give a shout out to retiring  Betty and her amazing window service after all the years of serving me coffee and taco his burgers with a smile and caring attitude.  this store has been operating for 55 years and truly the best guest experience ever for fast food.

I love McDonald's Monopoly.  More specifically, I love peeling off the game pieces from the packaging.  As a kid and throughout high-school, I'd skip out on the school cafeteria for a Micky D and purchase any number of items that contain the pieces.  I liken it to the thrill of scratch-off lottery tickets.  Maybe it's the anticipation of what property or prize I'm going to get, or maybe it's the fun of filling out a piece of paper to create a game board.  Alas, as I graduated college I stopped going to McDonald's completely, for reasons I don't even have to explain for you to know why.

One morning in October that just past, I found out MacDougle's Monopoly game was happening again.  The promotion had been going on for a few weeks with two more to go.  I thought about it.  I kinda wanted to peel the pieces once more.  I saw that the pieces are on the hash browns; one of the few items McDonald's serves that won't make me vomit.  When I arrived back at my office, I opened the bag and saw no game pieces.  Thanks McDonald's Family Restaurant of Temple, for reminding me never to visit again and that the Monopoly fun will always be a fond memory.

They have the McRib!

Not sure if this McDonald's is exactly new, but it sports new stylings like deco walls and drop lighting in a mix of subdued color patterned in McDonald's livery. This McDonald's location lies along a large traffic circle, which can complicate things for those unfamiliar with navigating them. During the lunch rush, park and head inside for sanity's sake; last I was there, apparently everyone and their mother decided to use the drive thru.

The highlight of my visit was the McRib sandwich (limited time offering). It was as mysterious as I remembered, neon green pickles and onion slices atop a McRib patty. Not sure if the McRib is pork or not, but the odd-textured sandwich went into my gullet without a fight. For a drink, I had a McCafe mocha flurry (or whatever it's called) which mercifully kept me awake when I needed to be.

Great job here and run just like its supposed to be. I popped in while I was waiting for some automotive work to be finished across the street and they were right in the middle of switching from breakfast to lunch. 

No wait at all. I ordered the meal and they had the food on the tray in less than a two minutes. Kinda caught me off guard. I'm impressed.

I'm not going to waste my time typing up all the bad experiences that I have had at this location.  I live within 1 mile of this place, but I choose to drive 5+ miles in order to get my Micky D's fix.

Avoid if possible...

I only ever order plain ice cream sundaes at McDonald's, so I can only attest that this was one of the most enjoyable times I've had.

After a long bike ride on a cold winter's day, I bought me a sundae and sat outside in their lovely, sunny outdoor seating area.  The air was brisk, the tables clean, completely quiet and wonderfully sunny!  It was nice to be able to eat a sundae at McDonald's in the hot sun, alone and with lots of quiet.

Although I am not a big McDonalds eater I do get a craving once in a while and although I have tried several in the area this particular Mickey D's is by far the best.  The place is clean, the service is good (both the Drive Thru and inside) and the food is always hot and fresh.

This location can never seem to get it's shit together. Everytime I've gone there, they've messed up my order whether it be wrong items, missed items, or hard burger buns, they always disappoint. Needless to say, I won't be returning at this location.

Not the greatest fast food place to hit at night.

I was driving through one night and had to stop and use the restroom and get some food. The employees looked at me with almost disqust that I was in there. Not that I'm one of those people but maybe I was the wrong white girl in the wrong neighborhood at the wrong time? Not really sure. It's pretty much almost downtown past the arch right off 70 so it was convenient. It was pretty clean for the most part as well. Just didn't like the whole vibe going on inside.

My biggest complaint about this location?

Outright blatant Racism from the employees.

If you're Asian, Hispanic or White, don't even bother stepping foot in here.

The exact same thing can also be said for the location on Lafitte Highway.

After experiencing numerous situations of Racism at these locations, my family and I refuse to step foot in ANY McDonalds ever again. 

Even complained to them directly via their main website, and received a form letter response. 

Then again, what would you expect from a company that created and runs a website called 365black.com ?

I travel often, and no matter how hungry I may be while on the road, I will NEVER step foot in another McDonalds for as long as I live.
Since I stopped smoking a couple months ago, everything tastes better, including McDonalds.  When I went to this location today they gave me the freshest fries, they were hot but ohhh so good.  :)

If I could give it no stars I would.  EVERY time I go here, and its not often but only for absolute dire need to because the WAWA across the street looks full, and im late, or tired and just want something quick, but everytime I come here, theres something wrong. This time I decided to take the time and write something about it.

Waited in the drive thru for about 5 minutes, no answer. That should have been my sign to just say no.

I decided to park and go inside of course there were 2 smoking employees at the entrance so i almost had to excuse myself past them just to get in past the cloud of smoke too. But finally made it in where there were 2 employees at the drive-thru window chatting and touching and playing around, with the one girl throwing around her headphones "listen to this"  Another girl hiding in the corner on her phone decides to end her phone call and helps me out.  

She apologizes for the wait in the drive-thru (not her fault since shes not working drivethru) and tells the drivethru guy to check his mic or something. He obviously replies "yeah, its working".  The car that was behind me waiting in the drivethru earlier, a while BMW X5 pulls up about a minute after the drivethru guy was told to check his mic. Draw your own conclusions.

Then I watched the "cook" just use his bare hands, no gloves just splat together whatever was on his screen and throw the food on the pick up counter.  

Keep in mind the girls that was telling her co-workers to "listen to this" was still getting in the way of the others possibly trying to their job. 

So here I am now, writing this review after having thrown out my food once arriving home. 

Why didn't I ask for a manager?  Look, if you saw what was going down, the manager definitely knows or is a part of it too.

DONT GO HERE, this is your first and last warning.

This McDonald's restaurant is in its own lot on US-40 in Woodstown. The restroom looks okay. The dining area has rather worn furniture but otherwise, looks clean enough. Service, however, was rather slow for the low volume of customers they were getting this weekday evening. I'd hate to think about the wait when this restaurant is actually busy. Food is about average for McDonald's.

This McDonalds has the ruddest staff.  I think they put the ruddest person of the day at the second window.  I have been glared at several times.  I only need two happy meals and a diet coke.  It is not that hard.

I'm not hear to review mcdonalds in general, I think most people have their own opinion. As someone who has gone to quite a few Tucson locations this one is pretty good. They keep it clean, the overnight staff isn't pissed off that ur there at 3 am. Access is ok, u can only get to it from west bound on speedway but it's a nice place all in all.

Worst Md's in a long while.  I just wanted a diet coke.  No one greeted me, and no one tried to take my order.  I waited for a few minutes to let them work and maybe notice me.  So, no one did and I got their attention and finally got the drink.  I was so annoyed.

Wow surprised! Your coffee is terrific! I would feel like a schmuck going back to Starbucks and paying what I used to for my jolt of java.
It has been sometime since I visited this MCD.
What I remembered was kids never wanting to leave play area and a couple of odd ball employees , older ladies who would eye my MCD coupons like they could be counterfeit bills. If it's been a while go through the drive through and get a highly recommended brew.

Mocha means hot. Unless of course you order an iced mocha which I did not. Please don't make me feel bad because you did not have your listening ears on. that is all.
But you did fix it so you get an extra star. Yes, I am being stingy with my stars today.

Generally if I see someone review a super chain on Yelp, it seems pointless. Aren't they all the same? For the most part, yes, they are. The menu items are made to be homogeneous and are generally not healthy. What differentiates some chain locations from the others is the service. 

I've frequented the McDonald's on Jefferson Ave (near 44) for several years now and I consistently get terrible service. Obviously it's a ghetto Mickey D's and I should know better, but there aren't a ton of fast food options in Benton Park. Especially in the evening. And I'll be honest - I like cheeseburgers and fries. A lot. Generally speaking, they don't screw up the burger part at this location so bad. It's just everything else that just plain sucks.

The handful of times that I have ordered nuggets, either the person behind the window fails to ask if you want sauce or when I do ask for it, they tell me they're out of it. Without even looking first. Really? Do I need to get out of my car and come look for myself? Or sometimes, I've pulled up to the Drive Thru and no one takes my order. No one. The lights are on, they're supposedly open, just the person who's on drive thru duty that night just doesn't want to do his/her job. 

Am I sad that I won't be living near a McDonald's anymore? Sort of. Will I miss this McDonald's? Not at all!

This McDonald is poorly run around 6:00 am. They always mess up my order. This time I was missing two has brown and my sweet ice tea was regular ice tea without any straw. I hate this McDonald but it is the nearest one by work

Decided to give this location a second chance, and what do you know! Horrible service once again! Got 20 piece chicken nugget meal, they forgot the sauce that we asked for, so I waited at the drive thru window until they saw me. Gave us 1 honey mustard for 20 pieces so I went inside to get another pack, and this overweight white girl who's always rude to us saw me walk in and said "I already gave her sauce" to another coworker and gave me a dirty look. I looked at her and said "yeah, 1 tiny pack of sauce and we ordered a 20 piece." then I was given hot mustard instead of the honey mustard I originally ordered. Horrible horrible horrible customer service. I forgot to mention how they gave us medium drinks in a small MCCafe cup. Awesome customer service! Keep up the good work!

It's McDonalds....what can really be reviewed? It's the same as everywhere else in the entire world. Literally. Same food, same decor, same crappy everything. Still, nothing better than a Big Mac for lunch after a long night of boozin....

This was the McDonalds that started it all for me.  The first McDonals I ever went to as a child and I blame it for starting the love affair.  As a child I craved this place more than any other food.  I grew up and I'm still guiltily enjoying their food.  

Shame on McDonalds for marketing unhealthy and addicting food to children!  I am another victim.

Visited again this week on a trip home for Xmas and was pleased to see it still was serving good McDonalds food.  Kinda slow through the drive thru, so I gave it only four stars.

I had a double quarter pounder and my brother had a Big Mac.  He claims it was the best Big Mac he's had in years.  There you have it.

Looking for a decent place to eat in downtown Reno can be quite a challenge when you decide to opt out of eating the nasty buffet inside the casinos. What makes it even harder is looking for a place to eat on Christmas day. After some Yelping on the mobile app we came across 3 places that were within walking distance from our hotel, Pho Country 2 (which we went already for lunch), the Mexican place next door or McDonalds. After walking past the first two places in the order listed above and the first two being extremely packed, we opted to have our Christmas dinner at McDonalds.

Upon walking in, there was a long line too but nothing too crazy since it was fast food. It was old and run down. We waited in line for around 15 minutes before we were helped. We ordered 4 McChicken, 1 Double Cheeseburger and 20 piece nuggets. $10.76. We paid and asked for a receipt, she said they need it for processing our order, we then asked for a number, she said she didn't have one and we will be called by the food we ordered...um...okay.

We stood there waiting another 15 minutes and was wondering where our food was...since everyone after us seemed to be getting their food. We walked up nicely and asked the status of our order. The employee looked at us confused. She said she didn't take our order? WHAT?!?! You're the only FB behind the counter and there is only 2 of you taking orders! She then said she gave the order to another employee to pull who said she didn't and she was working the fries. 

By then there was a frenzy and a manager came over and tried to sort out the situation. She then asked what we ordered, grabbed our food and sent us on our way. The burgers were barely wrapped, totally half-assed. And the nuggets were cold, she even gave us the wrong sauce! Oh yeah they limit 3 packages for 20 piece nuggets and $0.11 for every additional packet.

Overall, my "fast food" experience at McDonald's was the worst of all my fast food experiences! Although this place is convenient it is slow and definitely not "FAST" AVOID this LOCATION!!!

I'm not sure how this place has avoided new ownership or management coming in and taking over. I always assumed that the McDonald's empire had some sort of review process or QC department to keep their restaurants running efficiently and effectively.  This has been our local McD's for about 4 years but we've learned to drive 3 miles out of our way for our Big Mac cravings.  Unless I was alone getting just a single burger, I avoided this place.  The ability to correctly fulfill and order for 2 adults and 2 children completely eludes this establishment.  My wife and I were trying to remember a time when we went here and they got everything right, we couldn't think of any, seriously.  
Last time I was there (about a month ago) I ordered $6 worth of food and they asked me to pull up because they had a problem with they're fryers and it would be a couple of minutes on the fries. No problem.  I turned the game on and waited... 25 min.  I know I should have went in after just 10 min, but I'm a pretty patient person and they started bringing food out to all of the other cars that were waiting (about 7 of them) so I figured it wouldn't be too much longer.  When I finally started to get out of the car the empty handed manager was knocking on my window.  He explained that they lost my order and needed it again.
I'll refrain from detailing my "conversation" with this man, but suffice to say it was my last visit until I see "New Management" on their reader board.
Reviewing a fast food joint always seemed silly to me, low priced food = low wages = lack of interest in getting your order right.  It's a risk we all take every time we buy food from the front seat of our cars.  I just wish someone would have warned me how consistently bad this place was.  Screaming kids in a long drive-thru is bad enough, but seeing their disappointment when their nuggets aren't in the bag time and time again is too much.  Lesson learned, albeit a little late.

The McD's at Elm and 370 is much faster and the one on 5th street seems OK but it's kind of a pain to get in and out of.

For people visiting New Orleans this McDonalds is SAD!!  The people working there don't want to be there.  The girl's working the register's are rude and don't listen.  They ask you VERY rude like "What do you want."  Then after repeating your order, they still screw it up.  But before finding out they screwed the order up you'll wait in line for 20 minutes.  Ray Crock is turning in his grave at this location.   Nobody working there deserves a job serving the public.  To better this McDonalds I would start with firing every single person there and start fresh.  Plus I would enforce some security because of the people that just hang out in there.  You can tell they are regular's and it's like their hangout, and the racial slurs are ridiculous!!  I had my 5yr. old daughter in there and the words that I heard OUT LOUD I couldn't believe.

Fast food seems like it would be tough to mess up and a lot of places manage to do it consistently. It's also tough for fast food to be outstanding -- this place manages to be outstanding. They pay attention to details and do simple things like making sure not to give you fries until your sandwich is ready.

The modern décor makes it an appealing hangout with a group of friends.

This review is for this location and may not necessarily reflect my view of the McDonalds company. 

I like this place and this is my usual goto location because it's close to my girlfriends house. I have had great experiences with the people here 99% of the time, the other 1% I attribute to one of us having a bad day. 

I have yet to go inside but they do have an indoor play place for kids.

The drive though service is usually quite fast. In the AM 8-10:20 there could be a couple cars in the line but they move em through quick.

Did you know mickey ds sells bags of ice too?
Speed and smiling is not their strong point, but it is clean in here during dinner time.

There have been very few times in my life where I have felt as annoyed as I did at this fast food restaurant.

I ordered a double hamburger, which was clearly old because of all the grease on the wrapper. When I bit into it, there were so many onions! The burger was practically drowning in onions. I was so confused, as I clearly remembered not wanting extra onions. The receipt did not even show anything other than an ordinary double hamburger.

Also, there was too little ketchup and only one pickle. I didn't particularly mind fewer pickles, but the lack of ketchup was unforgivable!

Typical fast food restaurant! Quick, easy, and pretty good too. 

Playground is outdoors so it's not much fun for the kids in the winter.

They do have a Redbox inside & Free Wi-Fi.

Am I really reviewing McDonald's?  The inside is like a Holiday Inn with desert paintings and a fireplace.  This location is definitely a nice location; there is a play gym and plenty of booths to sit and relax to some soothing music.  I like to get a Diet Coke, iced coffee with soy, and a hashbrown here and do some work.  I mean, I have been to the designer two-floor McDonald's, and this is almost as good!

I have read all the reviews for this McDonalds and I totally agree. I was out shopping and my kids wanted McNuggets so I stopped. I was so amazed when my order was taken quickly and politely. I got my happy meals and......no toys. What is the point of a Happy Meal if you don't get the toys? It is not like I am buying them for their great nutritional value. I parked and went in to get them and they did give them to me but as I was leaving the manager ran and checked my story with the drive through person. I guess this visit is on par with the other reviews. 

On a side note, I once heard the workers screaming at a person inside through the drive thru speaker. I guess it was turned on. I finally had to drive to the first window to place my order. The cops pulled up as I was going into Marshall's. I did get a pretty good laugh at the one
I was in the mood for a Filet-O-McSquid. No McSquid to be found here and no ODB either.
Decent for a McDonalds...nice kids area that doesn't look like a cest pool.

The worst McDonald's in the city!! 

Service here sucks. Want to stop in for breakfast before heading to work? Chances are you'll be late for work due to waiting in a long line for an overcooked biscuit. There's also no guarantee your food will be good quality. Just don't do it unless you're really desperate.

I accidentally made the following review for the 30th and Market location. It was intended for the 40th and Walnut location:

Awful, one of the worst McDonalds I've been to in recent history. Sure, it's clean and has a convenient location, but that's all this place has going for it.

The people who work there are generally incompetent and the food is way below par, even for McDonalds.

Several times I have had problems with being served inedible food, most recently I received a quarter pounder that must have been sitting in the back of the tray for days: it was hard as a rock, and the entire sandwich was stuck together as if it had been prepared ages ago and left to solidify. Let me elaborate...if I dropped it on the counter top it mimicked a cinder block. If i held the top bun, everything stayed together.

Yeah. No thanks.

If you are a college student looking for late night grub on the cheap, I would suggest you head up the street to DP Dough Philly for a cheap calzone.

It's a McDonald's. Not much to see here kids. The positives to this particular Mickey D's is that it's open 24hrs (well occasionally 23.5 hrs), it's close to work for me, it has free Wifi, and it's clean a majority of the time. Like any other McDonald's, there are the occasional mishaps: like you order a bacon, egg and cheese biscuit; they repeat back to you that you ordered a chicken sandwich with BBQ sauce; and you end up with hot cakes and a sausage biscuit, but hey, these things happen. If you're cruising around Gretna at 3am (I'm not here to judge) or you're headed into work, head to the golden arches because there is nothing else open that doesn't require you to leave your vehicle.

Today if a negative star were possible I would give it. A little more work and a little less conversation is in order. Cashiers must make eye contact with CUSTOMER not jabber with friends. Sad and my last stop there.

McDonald's is a classic fast food stop.  It's great for a quick stop or a meal with friends.  I love the soft serve cones.  Big Mac Mondays for $1.50 are a decent deal.  Watch out for the calories...they add up fast!  The prices range from cheap on the $1 menu to moderate.  Service is always fast and friendly.

THIS IS THE BEST McDONALDS NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, OR WEST OF THE PECOS!!!!  *Yosemite Sam Voice*  

Great customer service and the food is always hot when served.  

Also, they have a room set aside that can be reserved for meetings, and no it's not a playground.  Very unique Micky D's.

This mcdonalds gets PACKED around lunch time but they handle business at a decent pace. The drive thru line usually wraps around the building and sometimes into the street. It's nice to sit outside at the concrete tables during nice days. You get a variety of people from the city's homeless to business professionals to students to local residents to the medical crowd. People pretty much all mind their own business.

Drive-thru wasn't that efficient, we probably would've fared better running in for our order. Just an FYI, but my friend is a big fat liar... shamrock shakes are not good for hangovers. When the first gulp of peppermint marshmallow-y cream hits your belly, you'll feel your stomach roll. Plus that cherry's impossible to fish out without popping the cap off. Not that those artificial preservatives are doing you any good either.
This is really a typical McDonald's with the dollar menu and sweet tea's.

Oh the memories
The birthday parties and merry go round
Now the food is mixed
Chicken nuggets yea
Mcrib yea yea
Cleanliness is very good
Not as clean as the red lion bustleton location

Wow they are fast! Okay the food's not five star, but everyone knows what to expect from McDonalds. The five stars is because I've gone by just to get a quick drink and I was thrilled with their double lanes. Seriously they were so fast they were waiting on me to pay and then drive up an pick up my order. The staff there is doing there job very very well and should be proud.
It's a McDonalds. They have an outdoor playland for the kiddos. Customer service is normal. What else is their to say really?
This location is always busy, fries are always hot, there are huge flat screens inside, free wifi and a redbox. Perfect.
Getting your order wrong seems a normal occurrence.  I always regret my trip here.

I can not believe I am eating here!

It is 1am and there is no food anywhere.  It is times like this I miss home.  The kid at the drive thru was a little jerky to me at 1am but at this hour he has to deal with drunk people...I was just exhausted after working all day and did not need attitude.  I ordered a burger and he said, "Medium or Large?". I then said, "I don't understand?". And he kept saying, "Medium or Large?". After 4 times you might want to create a new sentence.  He was referring to a Value Meal...which I did not want.  I only wanted a burger.  McDonald's just doesn't get it that I don't need any more fat for 85 cents...just give me a burger.  

I then had to wait 7 painful minutes at the window while my burger was being cooked.  Longest I've ever waited for McDonald food. On the flip side it was the first time I ever had a steaming meat patty from McDonald's.  I had to let it cool down.  I got the Angus burger and was not really impressed.  Sorry I wasted my money.  I thought the onion would be fantastic but it was way to over powering to be enjoyable.

The burger and Service were complete unacceptable. I will never come here again...because I do not live in this city.  If I did live here, then I would move because of this place.  But I wouldn't have to move far because there were like 2 more up the road.

I enjoy McD's once a year. Why? Shamrock Shake.

Of course, it took almost 5 minutes for them to make the Shamrock Shake at this location. Sorry, but 5 minutes for one item at a fast food restaurant results in 1 star.

I've been to this McDonald's.
The Big Macs taste the same as any other McDonald's.
The fries are a little bit better though.
Oh, and BTW no ODB.

I was looking for some cheap fast food and remembered that I had a coupon for Mc D's. Buy a 1/3 lb Angus burger and get a medium fry and drink for free. When I arrived I saw they still had the sign that for any sized soft drink was $1. I went inside and ordered the Bacon and cheese Angus burger. The cashier asked me what number. I said just the burger because I have this coupon. She still insisted on me telling her the meal number. I did. Then I asked if I could upgrade to a large drink, since it was the same price. She did not know how to ring in the coupon or the answer to my question so she called the manager. The manager arrived, and spoke with the cashier in Spanish about what I wanted. I was then told NO I could not upgrade, even though the drinks are the same price. When my food was finished the girl giving food out could not tell 12 from 13 tried to give my food away, not once, not twice, but about 4 times. The cashier even had to ell her 2 times that was my order #12 not #13. 

When I finally convinced her that it was my food and I got to eat the fries were still OK, but the burger was just OK, the bun was a little stale. 

Over all this was the worst experience I have ever had at a Mc D's 

This location does have a play area outside, so it would be good for children. The restaurant is also clean. Just poor customer service on this trip..

No Drive-Thru. Not open late. Not much of a McDonald's if you ask me.  The one thing this McDonald's has going for it is its location.  It's walking distance for many of us in the Chestnut Hill area and is one of the more attractive McDonald's I've seen.  Other than that, it falls short.  The service is very slow and any time I use a coupon they have to have a team meeting to figure it out.  Not a huge Mickie D's guy, but I, like most my age, appreciate a nice fast food drive-thru late at night.  Come on.
Boo! Worst. McDonalds. EVER! I do not have high expectations when I go to McDonalds but this place fails EVERY time!

I try not to review fast food places based on the chain as a whole, but more one the individual establishment compared to others in the chain. This McDonald's was neither better or worse than the average MacD's (which would get 3 stars). But, I bumped this place up a star for having the old school architecture with the building sitting within two big golden arches.

As far as McDonald's go, this one is a-ok. The service is smooth, efficient, and friendly and they never mess up my order. Food is always properly prepared, as ordered. Restaurant itself is clean and tidy. 4 stars on the fast food scale.
Its a McDonald's - the food is consistent, the service less so - but this drive thru tends to crank it. Typical.

Hell you've got to be crazy to eat at this McDonalds. I have never seen such lewd behavior. I was trying to enjoy my meal, and 5 employees were hanging out making lewd comments about a customer that they knew saying that he smells like horse piss. I have never witnessed such disgusting behavior. I asked the employees to please stop making those comments because I was trying to enjoy my meal then one of the managers that was part of that group started making threats to me saying things like who are you getting loud with, and asking me for a fight. I was trying to explain that I am not getting loud, but I just didn't want to hear those comments. I really don't want to fight when I tried to walk away he pretended like he was about to run after him, and that's when the corporate manager got ready to run from around the desk. Unfortunately, a dollar to late, and one happy meal to late. I've already been insulted, and threatened I thought about going to the cops, but instead decided to complain to the corporate manager, which he wrote down on a piece of paper, and probably filed it under t for trash, so if you want to go to where you can hear a bunch of lewd comments from employees there, and be threatened just come to the McDonald's on Walnut Street.

This isn't one of those "Wah, wah, McD's sucks, factory farming, HFCS, blah blah" reviews. This is a "Wow, this particular location really SUCKS, here let me tell you about it..." review. 

Wow, this particular location really SUCKS, here let me tell you about it...

I had some time to kill in the area on St. Patrick's Day and decided to do something random and slightly unpredictable: try a Shamrock Shake. It's one of those things I feel like I should try once so I can bond with other people about how good/bad/awful they are. 

This location of McD's is always bustling so I was ready for that. 
I wasn't ready for their absolutely inability to match product to order. Case in point: I ordered a Shamrock Shake. Solo. I was handed a Shamrock Shake and fries. Umm, what? I double-checked the number on my receipt with the number the employee was calling out, and they matched...but I didn't order (or pay for) fries. I would appreciate the lagniappe, but McD's fries aren't veg*n so it doesn't much matter. (And I didn't want fries.) I handed the bag back and wandered off with my shake. 

This is an over-worked fast food chain staffed by people who are run down by their really crappy job and work environments. I was ready for subpar just about everything, but I wasn't ready for completely inedible. 
Case in point: I popped the lid off my shake to see what sort of crazy thing I was ingesting. I'm a curious sort, really. What greeted me was not what I was expecting. Instead of the synthetic green goo, I found synthetic green goo with hairs in it. How you manage to get multiple hairs in a milkshake, I have NO CLUE. But brava! This McD's location did! 

When I returned to the counter to fork over my hair shake and ask for my money back, the manager I finally talked to stared at me for a long minute then told me I put those hairs in my shake. Seems reasonable until I mention that my hair is pink. Like, screaming pink. Highlighter pink. Glow in the dark pink. My real, growing on my head hair, too. No wigs for me today. I smiled and tried to say in the most polite way possible that my hair is pink so that could not, actually, be my hair. What followed was a conversation about wigs and an accusation that I was wearing one. The only way to counter that (and get my money back) was to let the manager tug on my hair. To say it was humiliating was to high-ball it. 

So that is now I spent my St. Patrick's Day and why I have not had a Shamrock Shake yet. 

Accessibility notes: No automatic doors. Very loud for hard of hearing customers. No braille menu; some braille signage. Open and spacious for customers with mobility devices.
ok a little.... the cashier had a bit of a tude nothing special

A big no thank you to this McDonalds. I don't usually bothering writing reviews about fast food places cause you usually know what you're getting before you even walk in the door. I suppose some are better than others but this one is an avoid if at all possible. They sort of have the fast food market cornered in this stretch of 309 and their lack of any concern for customer service shines right on through. Today I went in there are there were about 4 people behind the counter, 1 at the counter, 1 at the drive thru and 2 doing God knows what. It took me at least 5 mins to get my big mac value meal and there was only one other person in front of me. There was a stink bug that landed on the counter which all the workers made the eeww gross face and noise and then one just swept it on to the floor behind the counter. I asked for lemon for my iced tea and watched the girl who was just handling the money reach into the bucket and pull out 2 pieces of lemon with her ungloved hand, bleh! 

They just don't seem to care and I just don't know what it stems from, I know its not the worlds best job but at least act like you care a little. They move like molasses and I don't know what it is, but each time (unfortunately I work nearby and sometime its my only quick option) I go there I swear I'll never go back.

Most incompetent, absent-minded employees i've ever encountered. I don't go to McDonalds often, but everytime I have gone here they messed up my order. Talking to an employee is like talking to an automated telephone system, but it is McDonalds so I suppose you can't expect much.

Those cooks at Mcdonalds sure can cook a mean Fillet o Fish. It was cooked to perfection with just the right amount of crunch. Now stay with me here, they paired it with a side of fries. It doesn't seem like it would go together but the salt on the fries worked effortlessly with the tangyness of the tartar sauce. 
All that and a small coke, How can you go wrong?

If you are looking for a cozy place to grow old, then your car in the drive-thru at this McDonald's may be for you.  There are glacially slow and have been on every occasion.  Food is as you'd expect, it isn't any better with the wait.

Nice to know that nearly 99% of McDonald's have free wi-fi. This location is maller than most but nice enough. They have display cases with almost a history of Happy Meal toys in them. Nice people and fast service.

This is a 24 hour location (the only kind I ever seem to make it to) 

I have only been inside once, meh. 

The late night staff is good, and fairly friendly for Micky-Ds

Im not going to review the kind of food mcdonalds has... I think everyone knows what they serve, but this location serves the standard quality you expect.

It's a McDonalds, it's going to be the same everywhere you go... that's why they stay in business.
Well I'm not reviewing the food, only the fact that their parking lot was empty and located right next to the freeway. Their bathroom was located away from the cashier so you don't have to feel guilty for pissing in their bathroom but not buying anything!
Yay McDonalds!

This is one of the worst McDonald's I have ever been in. They are always slow at the drive-thru and inside. The drink  and condiment station is often a mess and in disarray. The outdoor play are isn't too great either. It is small and not in the best condition. It's disappointing that with our limited fast food options in Belle Chasse, we have such a lousy place that I avoid at all costs.

The beautiful wife will yell at me for reviewing a McDonald's, _but_, some things do need to be said about this location:

1) No free refills like many other McDonald's.  Which is too bad, because they heavily salt their fries.

2) No pump squirty ketchup thingie.  You have to ask for packets, which are distributed on a quite stingy basis.

Beyond that, it's a McDonald's -- same old shit as every other place.

This place takes FOR-EV-ER.
All I ordered was a small chocolate shake and it took like 15 min...and there was no one in front of me in line and 2 people still waiting on food. The main problem was the slow moving people behind the counter and all the people they decided to chat with in the middle of finishing an order....
When I ordered my shake however, I asked for extra chocolate. The cashier looked at me like I became an alien in just that moment. So I said, "LOOK, I'm not an alien; all I want is an actual chocolate shake-not a "chocolate" "shake"...they never have enough chocolate in the them" ... She pretty much said she has no control over it, but when I got my shake, it was actually a chocolate shake even though the ones that came out before mine were not. I win.

There was a long wait while we were ordering at the drive thru. When we got to the pickup window, the girl handed us two bags of the breakfast food and 3 coffees and closed the window. We still needed cream and sugar for our coffees, ketchup for the hash browns, and my hot chocolate! We waited for a few minutes while she was brewing new coffee, debating whether we should knock on the drive thru window. When she came to the window, we asked for what we needed. This girl was frowning as she got what we needed so I told her to "please be more patient next time" in a forceful voice. And that was the end of it-- or so we thought. We parked and as we looked through the food, there was no plasticware for the hotcakes! My friend and I went in to speak to the manager that day, who took care of what we needed and apologized. I would have given one star if it weren't for the manager's good attitude and awareness of what good customer service is. I still like McDonald's, just not that branch!
The frys weren't ready so I might as well have gone inside...

I know I shouldn't expect much from a McDonald's, but this is quite possibly the worst I've ever been to. I like the fact that it has a Playplace, which is wonderful for the kids in the winter. However, they rarely clean the tables in there. Every time I go, I have to ask somebody to clean off a table for us. The service is sloooooooooooow, and it isn't uncommon to see 7 or 8 people standing in the back waiting on their food after ordering. I have also been wondering lately how sanitary their Playplace is. It smells like an old gym in there. If you want a McDonald's in Avon, drive towards Indy and go to the one near Raceway Rd. If you want a Playplace, go to the one in Plainfield.

This is a weekly visit for me and the kids in the winter to give my wife some time to herself. The Playplace is probably the best in the area. It has stairs, which is helpful for the littlest ones to navigate up and down to play. Sometimes they could heat the place a little better, but that is to be expected with the big windows. I also like the fact that they have a bathroom in the Playplace so it's close when the kids need to go (also a changing table in there). The service isn't usually that great, but it's McDonald's, so you get what you pay for. There is a female manager who appears to be Samoan that you don't want to upset, because I've seen her scream at customers before. Otherwise, the Playplace is the biggest draw here for our family.

Ordered some sausage egg Mcmuffins to go. 
The muffin bread was tough, stale and overcooked. Note to chef: Bread is typically cooked at the bakery. There's no legitimate reason to burn it. 
Very sad, considering this McD's was owned by the guy who INVENTED the egg Mcmuffin. Carl's Jr. copied the concept and they do a much better job. You can actually taste the english muffin.

McDonald's tastes the same everywhere and if you are forced to live near one that has crap food I feel for you. The best thing about this location, is that it is so fast! I have to rush just to keep up. Careful to check your order before you leave. Occasionally a salad dressing, spoon or sauce can be forgotten.

Ok, I realize I'm reviewing the Chain of chains, a complete anti-Yelp establishment, but I'd still like to give credit where it is due.  This McD is usually very efficient.  The double drivethrough handles the lunchtime rush with relative efficiency and has always gotten my order right.  Want to go inside?  Plenty of parking outside, and plenty of clean interior...inside.  I think it would be silly to review the food, so I'll just leave it at that.

This McDonald's Opened a little Less than 2 years ago and has been great ever sense. 

I remember that when they first opened my wife and I ordered and I didn't even slide my card through the card reader on the counter and everything was on the tray for my order. Ever since it has become a little relax on service, but that is expected with a fast food restaurant. 

Food is good and what is expected with any McDonald's. I would say it is still better than the location down the road in both directions on Lindbergh. 

The dinning area is always clean and the new interiors they are putting in new McDonald's are very nice and functional.

When I visited New Orleans, I have been here a couple times for a light eat. Located at the border of the French Quarter on Canal Street and Royal Street it has been very crowded on my visits. There is plenty of seating so I've never had to wait. 
  In my opinion it is an OK McDonald's. I've been in better and worst McDonalds.
  The inside is roomy, so I never felt crammed in.
   This McDonald's feels on the touristy side. The dining room celebrates New Orleans with a Jazz motif.
One of the worst McDonald's in the city. Service is slow and orders are always wrong, especially if you get big orders.

Great Service. Very fast. Dual drive thru 24/7.

But, it is McDs. So only gets 3 out of 5.  Good value tho.

Ordered two cheeseburgers and got them with no meat. Seriously. No patties in either burger and this is the 2nd time it happened. I didn't notice until I was on the road so I couldn't turn around. Major league FAIL. How do you forget the hamburger patty in a hamburger? This McDonald's always sucks and ruins my food. I don't know why I go to it and probably never will again.

This sport memorabilia themed Mickie D's is not the most convenient but boy are they fast.

Why review a McDonald's? I'm right there with you. They're all the same. Right? For the most part I'll totally agree with you and from my writing history, you can read I'm not into the fast food but everyone needs a fry now and again.

The biggest difference to this location is no drive through. They actually expect you to use your legs? I don't think Ray Kroc would be impressed with the antiquated delivery system of high carb, high sugar, non nutritious food. Now it's time to find a parking space.

The over crowded parking lot begs you to drive across the street to Jack n the Box and finding a space anywhere near can be a challenge on the weekends. Once inside it's bight, airy packed with sports crap. I don't normally think of athleticism then the Golden Arches are at play.

Up to the front the line moves quickly and then, DING. Fries are done. This must be one of the fastest location. It begs to wonder if the food was intended for me or another customer who's still parking. Maybe it's a new study on mind control. Ronald knows what he wants me to eat and the Dude abides.

If you must visit McDonald's this is a good one to hit.
Free WiFi is also offered.
Nothing crazy, has a kiddie area, they usually get your order right, food is not cold, etc.

Now look, I agree that it's doubtful anyone will read this review because heading through a McDonald's drive-through is pretty much an instinct thing.  But, ladies and gentlemen, if I can't vent here, where the hell can I?

***SHORT VERSION: THIS WAS, HANDS DOWN, THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE FROM THE MANAGER AND STAFF I HAVE EVER, EVER, EVER RECEIVED!!!!***

Okay, when I was a teenager, my brother and I did our obligatory stint flipping burgers at Mickey D's, so I roughly know the standards.  I know that part of the reason service usually sucks at fast food joints is because all the kids are goofing off in the back.  I  *hope* you're not shocked by this revelation.  When I head toward the golden arches, I'm bracing for the worst.  Boy, did I need to brace harder this time!

All my best friend and I wanted were a couple of smoothies.  After struggling through the muddy reception from the speakers, we finally logged in our order and pulled up to the payment window, dollar bills in tow.  Now, you would think this would be the easiest part of our transaction.  You would be so wrong.  

Apparently, these morons dropped a bucket full of change all over the floor.  Ok, shit happens.  A little comical, but not a real biggie.  We can wait.  However, not once--NOT ONCE!!!!--did any of the two chicks or the middle aged manager actually glance at us as they were quarreling about the incident and we were sitting in a car literally a foot and a half away from them.  Come to think of it, it must have taken some effort on their part to pull this off.  Not a slightest movement of their well-fed bodies, not a nod, not a fleeting look in our direction.  They were in crisis mode.  Because apparently, it was critical to figure out--right there and then--who was to take the blame.  At first, it was simply frustrating.  Then it became unbelievable.  We purposefully did not say anything, because come on, this wasn't really happening, was it?  Did they ACTUALLY not see us?  Well, I got my answer as I peeled off to the next window to pick up our smoothies and drop off the cash.  One of the geniuses actually managed to stuff herself through the little window and shout at me "You have to pay for those, you know!"  You mean to tell me you knew all along how this works and yet NOW you wanna tango????  We were stunned.

So yeah, this was my experience at a McDonald's in Nashville, TN where all we wanted was something to sip on as we drove back to Chattanooga.  Lots of laughs on the way home, that's for sure!  Shaking my head even now....

As a lifelong local resident, I've been visiting this McDonald's for as long as I can remember. For the most part I've had positive experiences, but the last three visits have really soured me on this store. 

If you're visiting this McDonald's, especially if you're going through the drive-thru, check your order BEFORE you leave. On my last three orders I was charged for items I did not receive. (Large fries three times, apple pies twice.) When I brought these errors to the attention of the manager, I was accused of lying and the manager did nothing to make things right. This is a shame because in the past I've gotten nothing but friendly, courteous service.

Hey McDonald's, I'm going to give you an idea that can really make McDonald's a "happy place". It will also increase your demographics with the 21+ age group. 

Yesterday after a horrific day at work, I wanted a refreshing drink for the drive home. So I took a detour thru your drive-thru to experience your new Frozen Strawberry Lemonade. Ugh, more horror to my day, the $1 try me promo was over and I had to pay regular retail price. 

Any way, back to my fantastic idea. Your Frozen Strawberry Lemonade was good and had a great presentation with the two colors swirled together in a clear plastic recyclable glass. To be totally honest, for my taste it was to sweet, I like mine more tart. Make those lips pucker. Gotta get back to the idea. 

Here it goes, it will knock those big clown shoes Right off of Ronald's feet. You need to sell miniature bottles of booze to accompany the frozen lemonade. You know what I'm talking about, those cute little bottles you get on the airplane. Just offer a few, I'd recommend Citron & Strawberry Vodka or perhaps a Captain Morgans Rum. Now these will make that frozen lemonade sell. 

Of course if you do offer these, picking them up at the drive-thru may endorse drinking and driving. So only make them available at the counter so your employees can ask if we want fries with that. 

Side note - This McDonald's has the most normal and polite staff I've seen at a Mickie D's.

I have been there 3 times in the last 2 months and they haven't got an order correct. I ask for hamburgers and I get cheeseburgers in hamburger wrappers. I ask for diet coke and I get regular coke. I ask for a chicken sandwich with no mayo and I get a mayo sandwich with some chicken on it. Who runs that place?

Incredibly slow and only one person running the front counter, despite many people standing around in the back, and all I ordered was a salad that was pre-made. The salad that I received contained about half as much as I usually get. 

What's the deal, Mickey D's?

Come on, everyone secrelty love mcD's.  I love the mcdouble and the new chicken sandwiches.  I am also addicted to the ice coffee.  However all the MCd's in this area are slow and packed with people.  This one has a drive through

Quite possibly the worst fastfood restaurant I've ever been to, even the parking lot did a number on my shocks and gave my sister minor whiplash. The service was terrible and the staff seemed slow to understand what food items I was requesting when I spoke in slow, steady English. Then they were slow and no one was there for several minutes when we arrived at the window. I chose to buy nothing after my sister was served so poorly. You can't even get into the drive-thru legally from 2 entrances.
Last time I was there, they forgot some of my food, but I was willing to try again, you shouldn't try at all.

Four stars for MCD?  I think not.  This location, never, I repeat never, gets any order right.  Don't want onions? You're gonna get 'em.  Wanna ask them for a couple extra barbecue sauce?  They forgot ALL the sauces.  And just try, just try, to save them money by asking for apple dippers WITHOUT the caramel... guarantee you're gonna get it.  This place is a waste of brain power.

The only redeeming quality at this place is the food is always super hot.  However, my stomach, and my health, can only tolerate MCD fries and their ice cream cones anymore.  Plus, there are MUCH BETTER OPTIONS in Brownsburg for a "quick bite from the road or after a game."

Decent McDonald's.  Great location right next to the Summit Park Community,  Hours are better than some other McDonald's locations near by, but they're still not great.  The inside is pretty clean for a McDonald's, but its certainly not immaculate.  Services is kind of on the slow side.  It is what it is,  McDonald's.  Tasty food, not too healthy, poor service.
People work there are oh ok, but they get the orders worng sometimes. They need better and heathly food.

2:30am on an early Thursday morning 5/19/11.  I was really just hungry for something hot that needed no prep.  I drove to McDonald's around the corner.  

Pulled-up in line behind a youngish chick in a red Monte at 2:32am.  There were no other vehicles there.  I didn't hear if she had already had a conversation with the box because I had my music up loud.  She looked at me.  We heard nothing.  I waited 2 minutes until 2:32am and drove to the Walgreen's across Chippewa.  

At 2:42am, I left the store and she was juuuuuuuuust pulling up to the drive-thru window. 

First, who waits 10+ minutes for fast food?  She could have driven to the next closest McD's (or even the one past that one) and gotten an order in within that 10 minutes...

Second, who is "working" there?  Shift change?? I certainly could go on about this, but won't.  If you are the franchisee and this was NOT a shift change, you'd better start making some changes.

So now I sit here with my wonderfully "healthy" Vitamin Water and Popcorn, Indiana Movie Theater Popcorn.  At least it's not the double-Royale with cheese meal I was planning on ordering...

So timely! I tried to quickly find this McDonald's the other day so I could write a quick review. I didn't find it fast enough and didn't care enough to keep looking so I abandoned my plan. And then this shows up....so now I get to award this fine establishment......1 star!

I do not eat meat. Since I do not eat meat, I do not eat at McDonald's. However, my work friemd told me how good the sw chicken salad was so I ordered that, minus the chicken. She ordered the same thing at the next counter over. She got hers and went and sat down. And I waited and waited and waited. I saw my salad sitting on the back counter. I waited. I heard one of the guys prepping food ask the manager if he should throw away the salad, she looked at the order screen and nodded and PLOOP! There went my salad in the trash. 

I got the attention of the girl who took my order and asked if my order had been lost. She mumbled something to the manager about my salad and then went back to taking more orders. No sorry, no smile, nothing. I was finally given my salad by the manager. 

My friend and I were about 2/3 through our salads (which were nothing special, btw, AT ALL) when she said, "hmmm...they forgot the tortilla strips." 

Lame food, lame service, good reminder why I don't eat there.

Better coffee than Cafe DuMonde, and its only ONE DOLLAR for a 12 oz cup.

I loved how the entrance is disguised from Royal Street, you need to enter through a "Secret Passageway" to get into this McD's.

Breakfast is the only meal I can tolerate at McD's -- and this one has the "Steak McBagel" (currently not sold in California).  

I love the Steak McBagel.....its one of my guilty pleasures on the entire planet.....and my wife loves the Sausage Burritos.  

Cheap prices and a friendly staff makes this a must-visit place in the French Quarter when you need a refuge from Tourist Traps and shitty coffee.

I know its strange to write a review of a MDonalds since we've all been to one and they are all pretty much the same.

However this one has something special.  In the mornings they have the sweetest old lady working the drive-thru who is an absolute delight.  She's energetic, happy, engaging, focused... All the things you wouldn't expect from a fast food diner.

The food is McDonalds and I don't think I need to review that part, but its so great to get terrific service from a drivethru.

Southwest Philly isn't really known for their restaurants.  Not even for their fast food restaurants because that's pretty much all they have.  All the fast food places I've been in the area have had absolutely atrocious service and haven't been the most sanitary places either.  This McDonald's is actually a pleasant surprise.  The service is really quick.  Most the employees seem to be in good spirits.  The restaurant is clean and the food orders aren't all mixed up like other locations.  No problem coming back here again.
The food is always good here....but some of the employess here are just flat out rude and lazy. There are other McD in this area......so I just stay clear of this one!

Have been going to this location since 1994 when I joined the police force. I must say without a question this is the best McDonalds anywhere around Indianapolis.....and I have eaten at them all.
Bob is the manager here and does a wonderful job running the place, Always maintains great employees...all with positive attitudes. 
Thank you for supporting your local law enforcement :)
