Horrible place, went here for breakfast, placed order and waited, waited, waited.  Six other people were served and received items before the person who took my order looked at me, with a blank look and asked if I was waiting.  Ok I know its Mcky D's but geez, you just waited on me six minutes ago.  She asked what I ordered, again I'm thinking you can't remember?  Produced my receipt, she  turned around, picks up my now cold sandwich off the stainless steel counter, places a hash brown in it and hands the bag to me.  I asked her if the store was a corporate owned or a franchise.  She turns the bag around and points to a 1-800 number.  I state that this was the worst service ever, she stares back at me blankly.  This place is a hell hole, crew members are yelling and laughing, TV is really loud, totally ghetto!
I come here religiously. Not for the food but for their coffee. They adhere by my rules for on the go coffee: cheap, consistent, and close by!

I may be going to Yelp Hell for reviewing this but I don't care. I checked in (it's an addiction! I can't stop!) and if I don't review it, it will haunt me in the sidebar for all eternity.

Nothing to really complain about. I wish my burger was a little fresher today (I think it may have been sitting out, it was kinda chewy). But my fries were so piping hot I think the oil may have still been sizzling on them, so that's awesome. I realize this is all a matter of circumstance, and if I get there when they've made a new batch of fries, burgers, etc. Not much you can do about that.

They have the two lanes of drive throughs, which I like. In and out, bada bing bada boom.

Workers have always been friendly and efficient. I appreciate your "how are you today?" and "thank you, have a nice day" even if it's totally robotically insincere. I'll take it over nothing at all, which too many establishments are too comfortable doing nowadays.

They have a RedBox, and they serve breakfast until 11! Most do 10 or 10:30, so that is awesomesauce.

Okay, so not only am I going to Yelp Hell, but I'm going to Healthy Eating Hell, and taking my not-yet-born first born child with me.

I went to McDonalds again today. Earlier was by the boyfriend, this one by me. It's 2:40am. Look, I'm a night shifter, cut me some slack. I bypassed the Steak and Shake because a wild berry smoothie sounded much healthier than a milkshake and would make me feel marginally less guilty about hitting up this shithole excuse for a restaurant twice in 12 hours.

When I got there, there were already FOUR cars in line. When I pulled up, immediately another car pulled behind me. That makes a total of six cars, children. I thought, "Damn, it's hoppin' tonight." But really I'm pretty sure all those people had just been sitting there accumulating for God knows how long.

Waited, waited, waited, waited. The guy at the front was just staring at the order box like if he stared into its soul a voice would appear. It never did.

I gave it maybe about 3 or 4 minutes and drove away. 

But not before the kid in front of me hit on me. No, really. He starts waving frantically out the window at me like my car was on fire or something, so, concerned, I rolled down my window and stuck out my head. He stuck his out and turned to me. In a ghettofied Joey from  Friends voice: "How you doin'?" I said, "Oh for fuck's sake!" and as I rolled the window up I heard an embarassed "Sorry!" 

Don't hit on me at 3am in a McDonalds drive through. It's creepy. Especially when I'm preoccupied and pissed that it's taking much longer to stuff my face than anticipated.

Anyway, so I pulled around and saw a guy walking around inside, so I promptly got outside and knocked on the window, to be like, "Dude, there were SIX CARS lined up out there just now! What the actual fuck!" But he didn't hear me/didn't care to hear me.

As I pulled back around, THREE more cars pulled up. Those same four cars were still there! Hells to the no. 

So the one star is for the fast food joint, but equally for all those schmucks that sat actually there waiting like turkeys staring up at the sky in a rainstorm. Faith in humanity, I loses it. Kid that hit on me? You get no stars. Your baller game is full of fail.

NASTY NASTY NASTY!!!!!! Steer clear.  I've been told they've had trouble with the Board of Health on several separate occasions.  I live very near here and I won't even get a cup of coffee from here (I drive to the one on Elysian Flds & I-610).  

The last time I visited this restaurant was in 2006 and the staff were rude, incompetent, impatient & unprofessional.  I don't get anything from here.  I ignore this place and avoid it like the plague!

all mcdonalds are not equal! 

there are a few problems with this one that make me hesitant to come here. first, there is always a funky stench immediately when you walk into this location.  its not the smell of fried food, but almost like the smell of a bus on a rainy day, which is NOT what you want your local mcd to smell like.  next, the ice cream machine is consistently out of service or down for cleaning.  i am not kidding, one out of every two times i try to come here for a cone i am turned away because the machine isnt working.  lastly, the fries here aren't fried as well, sometimes they are undercooked. i love mcd french fries, so it makes me sad that the ones here are inconsistent with that of other mcdonalds. 

i feel a little bad leaving a bad review for mcdonalds, because the people who work here are generally nice, but this mcd has to step it up!

This was a cool little McDonalds with the antenna on top and "WMAC" call letters. Inside there's a pretty nice sized dining area with some original radio equipment on display. One of the walls has a mural featuring some of the original Opry stars. I had a salad and sat near the TV; there was an old Doris Day - James Garner movie on.

24 hours.

Busy corner.

McDonald's.

The good? 24 hours.

The bad: Can be the slowest service ever.
Seems like they never have the fries ready....this time we couldn't even get drink cups until we asked a 4th time. Even the manager ignored our request. The store score was 95. Food was average

I ordered the McLobster Thermidor, McFilet Mignon, a bottle of McRed McWine, grilled Asparagus, Alaskan Salmon stuffed with chicken McNuggets, French Fries w/Foie McGras, and Citrus Honey Chile Pepper braised McDuck.  It was simply incredible.

The wait staff was unbelievable.  My waitress was a beauty whose seductive dress, million dollar smile, eye catching shoes, and super nice demeanor made the whole experience world class.  She opened the bottle of wine, lit candles, brought fresh baked McBread and - get this - even danced to show me the song playing was her favorite.   It was incredible service. (My only qualm was she brought olive oil to dip the bread in but it appeared to be 2 year old fry oil, you know, the kind you deep fry things in.)  

The restaurant itself is magnificent.  Thick plush carpet.  Rich mahogany tables, comfy chairs, dark wood paneling.  I loved the expressionist paintings on the walls.

The only downer was the clown.  There was an actual clown walking around, going table to table periodically making annoying conversation and trying  to hit on the vivacious waitresses.  He called himself Ronald.  By his 4th visit to my table I told him to get lost.  At one point he rubbed the back side of my waitress and she punched him in the face. He said "hey tough crowd, no literally,get it? (making a muscle) tough crowd."  Ridiculous blemish on a fine evening of solo dining.

This is more or less an average McDonald's.  However, they recently eliminated free refills for coffee.  I find this very customer unfriendly, as almost every other fast food restaurant gives free coffee refills.  I won't bother going there for breakfast.
Food not only APPEARED hot and fresh but they also gave me NAPKINS (without me asking for them)! wow!

So, it's McDonald's - there's nothing special about this one over the rest.  (Well, this one does have a large indoor Playland, but I don't have any little ones to entertain, so that's not of interest to me.)

I rarely eat McDonald's, but one of my co-workers likes to come here once every three months or so for lunch.  

In any case, the only reason I'm writing this review is so that you can all see how silly I really am . . . 

On the day in question, I had seventy (70)  nuggets for lunch. For those keeping score at home, that's just under 2.5 lbs of nuggets, packing a hefty 3,220 calories (numbers calculated from the information provided by McDonald's), with a whopping 203 grams of fat (that's 3 days worth of the government recommend daily allowance for fat). 

This all started due to a random conversation with my coworkers, where I mentioned that some friends of mine had had a nugget eating contest a while ago, and they had 64 and 32 respectively. One thing lead to another, and I was saying that 64 was nothing, that it'd be a piece of cake . . . at which point one of the coworkers was offering to pay for the nuggets if I could do it. I originally stopped at 65 (having to one-up the previous "record"), but then had the last 5 on the way back to the office to get to an even 70.

The first 50 or so were easy, but I definitely started slowing down, and not enjoying the nuggets after that. They became dry, tasteless hunks, and I struggled a bit to get them down.

One of the guys at the office who later heard about this said "Why would you do that? You're not 25 anymore . . . " While technically true, I think I still behave like a guy in his twenties, still enjoying time at the bar, playing blackjack, and doing silly/stupid things just because I can. 

I did end up feeling like Morgan Spurlock in Super Size Me, where he talks about how crappy the food is making him feel. I would say though that by 4 PM or so, I was reasonably recovered, and had half of a Capriotti's cold turkey sub at 5 for dinner.

i have a special nickname for this place: McAttytood's 

whenever i am too broke to catch a bite at the Fresh Grocer or other better-heeled local establishments, i go in here..and remember why i dont visit that often.

at least they renovated the interior, it was really kinda grody for years. but even with the upgrade in appearance, the service is poorer than that of the Mickey D's by the Broad and Olney SEPTA station (and that is some kind of achievement in itself).

even if all i want is a couple items off the dollar menu, it takes FOREVER...and then i have to deal with the banter of the employees bitching about their job and about each other, when they arent dealing with customers they obviously cant stand. and then since the place is 24/7 - you get a nice mix of college students/homeless/crazy/west philly locals that always provide unintentional street theater.

if you HAVE to get mickey d's or dont have a lot of money to hit up the much better options in the area, just get your McKibbles N Bits and clear out - its not worth the aggravation of even sit down snacking.

but you know what, Crown Fried Chicken is RIGHT next to the El Stop at 40th and market...you can get the same quality food and there's an ATM!

i call this place - Ghetto Ass Mickey D's

why? well...to start you can count on the employees to give you ghettofabulous customer service. and while being served a few years ago by a young man working there with very manicured two inch long nails complete with rhinestones and multi-colored nail polish was amusing - its not even the most outrageous thing that has happened there.

it shares bathroom facilities with the BP gas/quick stop store sharing the building and good god those bathrooms are atrocious and me thinks they hired one of the ne'er do wells hanging out around Norris Beer and Deli (emphasis on the beer) to paint the doors and trimmings of the stalls - it is the cheapest paint of the whorish colors they could find and you can still read the graffiti on them.

you can expect to be panhandled on occasion, you can expect flies buzzing around the soda machine, you can expect to WAIT for your order cause the employees are too busy gossiping about each other and talking to their friends cause god forbid if YOU don't have other places to be! you can expect their registers to be down or not take credit cards. you can expect to have someone's unsupervised brats to be running underfoot.

the worst time to be there is early morning...notoriously slow and for people who might have a bus or train to catch nearby, this is not good at all! it wasnt always that bad, the one worker that did do her job and got people their McBreakfast out on pace, was a lovely woman..who unfortunately passed away due to complications of pnuemonia a few years ago.

of course being there late at night before they close the restaurant is no treat either(i should say that this place is 24 hours, but only drive through after the inside facilities close and no they wont serve you without a car - unless you are a crackhead who regularly panhandles and they like you.)

one of the most infuriating experiences i had there was one Saturday evening a few years ago, a friend and i went to mickey d's to have cups of hot tea and chat before going to our respective homes. it was a downer time for each of us and we just wanted some respite from shitty life situations.

first of all they looked at us like we were nuts because we ordered hot TEA as opposed to the coffee most people get...its on the menu and its frickin TEA....so that took a minute for them to get for us. then we sat down and had what was a good chat until...some asshole who'd wandered in and could smell the alcohol on his breath before he spoke started bothering us for money so he could visit the Beer Deli i mentioned before....he wouldn't take no for an answer (shit, we were drinking cheap ass tea, if we could afford beer we wouldn't have been there!) and then when he knew he wasn't getting anything out of us started hustling some of the employees cleaning the tables off.

but what should i expect from mcdonalds? of course i still go in there, 
but only because the other fast food places nearby are bad or worse.

however, there is a big statue of good Ol Ronald McDonald sitting crosslegged and in a casual pose on one of the benches - its a good prank photo op for either sitting in his lap or any other goofy poses you can think of.

Well hey, this is your run of the mill McDonalds. Perfect for when Shamrock Shakes are in season, or you just have a craving for a 50 piece chicken McNugget deal for $9.99 (not that I ever have - promise!)

Like the other reviewer noted, my rating is also based on what you expect from a fast food place.

Service is fairly quick, staff are mostly polite and prices are moderate (though for McD's - prices have gone up compared to other fast food places.)

The only bummer about this place is that they close pretty early during the week, but are now open 24 hours on Friday/Saturday. Exciting!

Purchased carmel frap. Tasted like iced coffee. Called & sup advised to bring it back. Advised I couldn't return today. He said save it and bring it back when I come. SAVE IT! I turned the car around I had to see this guy. He looked at the frap and asked if it was this watery when I purchased it. I said no but  I've been driving around with it for about 25 mins. Why make it difficult for a customer?

This McDonald's has the most fancy interior of all the McDonald's I've visited recently. I guess they have finished remodeling for the McCafe concept. Too bad they didn't do anything about the food. I thought the service was okay. The food is about what you can expect from a fast food joint. As a plus, this restaurant is open 24-hours, not just the drive-thru but also the dining area.

This McDonald's is in a strip mall but they have their own section of parking area. Service was actually above average at this place. The manager is a helpful fellow who you can just talk to, even if you're asking for directions to town. The only real downside I can see is the beverage bar is behind the counter so you have to ask for soda refills.

This McDonald's is right next to Staybridge Suites which is very convenient if you are staying there.   Be careful driving in as there is a large family of ducks (right now many babies) crossing back and forth from a small pond through the McDonalds parking lot.

It might seem strange to write a review about a McDonalds since they are all supposed to be the same, but this location is so bad it deserves note. Not sure who runs this location now, I know it was family owned in the 1960's and 70's when we would come here as kids. Now the restaurant is filthy, food on the ground, ketchup and soda on the counters.
     There is frequently a soda or ice machine not working. Chairs are broken and they are often out of lids, cups for kechup, napkins etc. The general filth of the store is amazing. Why would a franchisee not protect their investment and let it get this bad?
     It has always been a great location, but I wouldnt be surprised if it goes out of business-- things are that bad. 
    Haven't even touched on the staff. We came into the dine-in area because the orders in the drive-in are always wrong. (Somehow the other fast food places like Chick Fil A manage to always get our orders right so we know it is possible.) Here they are never right. At least inside you can eventually get the order straightened out. The staff seems indifferent and it seems like many do not speak English.

It's McDs....you can't expect gourmet food! They make the sandwiches and fill the orders as you order. The problem is that it takes FOREVER to get your food. It doesn't matter if it's the drive-thru or you go inside, it always takes 15-20 min....you're better off going and sitting down somewhere. The store seems clean enough for a fast food joint. The employees are generally abrasive but there are a few young kids that are really nice.
SLOW and not so friendly drive thru service

I hate to admit it... I hate coming here to this McDonalds, but I do it anyways! This place is home to many bums, college drunks, and raucus! However, I can't always turn down a McFlurry at midnight. 

I do love their McGriddles in the morning, and occasionally an Asian salad for lunch. However, I've learned my lessons over the years and will not touch a McD's burger, no matter my wallet situation.

I know its Mc Donald's! But, when its so bad one needs to share... Did not go through the drive through because of the wise words of Joe Pecsi in Lethal Weapon. But, any how still couldn't get the order right missing hash browns and then got a sausage on a muffin instead of an egg mc muffin. Is a sausage muffin an actual item on the menu? Its pretty nasty muffin and just a sausage?? Plus the over microwave part sure didn't help the matter hard in some spots gooey in others. 

There was an email on the receipt so I of course shot off a quick email, but alas it didn't work.
Nice location. In and out.  Sometimes they're very busy as a result.

When I lived in Seminole Heights, this was one of the few 24 hr choices - and given its location on a sketchy run of Hillsborough, -always- entertaining.

The food is the usual fare, the employees at night the usual questionable types, and the parking lot a hoot at 4 am.

Daytime is pretty standard, and they do a bang up breakfast biz. Daytime staff was above average for a MickeyDs.
We stopped here on our way back from Philly.  The restaurant has a nostalgic look.  We went through the drive-thru and the food was hot and good for breakfast.

I asked for a large coffee.  I got a large coffee.  I didn't ask for a smile, small-talk, offer to donate to the Ronald McDonald House, or anything else.  I didn't get anything else.  This was expected behavior, and for that, I am grateful.

And the coffee beats anything in 30th Street Station.

I'm writing a review on this place simply because of a bad experience. It was late last night and we were looking for a place to eat and since we ate at this place before and hey its McDonald's its known for their fries and burgers. The fries were very suggy and look like they've been drench in oil and it look like they were old. We asked the cashier to exchange them and they did but before doing so they had mention that the reason the fries looked old and suggy was because their oil was OLD. It was the same for the chicken nuggets they were so tough. This McDonald's shouldn't represent this kind of food chain becuase it gives it a bad name and reputation.
Constantly getting incorrect orders. Takes too long to get food. I won't be back. There is a parking area for SEMI's

Typical McDonald's.

Open late - and thats a win when you need a burger at 1 am.

I went back today and guess what.........my order was completely incorrect.  I received someone else's order and they probably received mine.  I drove back and went inside to speak with the manager.  The response I got?  Sorry.  That's it!
The food was good with exception of the salad, which was awful!  1 star for the food after seeing the dirty ice machine and lost my appetite.

For a McDonalds, it's great. Fast, freindly and clean. As a longtime customer who visits every day, I can say with expertise, this staff works their tails off. At times it can be slow because the shear volume of people who go here to eat... especially after soccer and baseball games. I really like how they work in the community by sponsoring fundraising nights for local schools and organizations. Laura, Russ, Kristen, Jennifer, Mark and the rest of the crew do an amazing job!

They have to buzz you into their bathroom.  You wait by the door and then, if you're lucky, they decide you're good-looking enough to get into their special club.  

After entering the locked door, you walk up a set of secret back stairs to "Club McDonalds"-- the after hours bathroom club, with the hottest music and a huge disco ball.  All of the toilets are studded with swarovski crystals and the bathroom is lit in with a blacklight.  When you flush, it sets off a strobe light and everyone goes crazy dancing.   The floors are lit from below; colored lights flash as you wash your hands-- nodding your head in time with the music.  You walk back downstairs and open the door back to the regular McDonalds; blinded by the fluorescent light.  You shudder as you sit down with your fast food; saddened to be back with the McDonald's "regular people."


That is all a lie, but they do have to buzz you into their upstairs bathroom and it is weird and sometimes it takes a while and you're just standing there like "Im sad can you let me in please"

Pricing is higher than a regular McDonald's.  Do not have dollar menu.

Smaller than normal McD's.  Has outdoor seating.  Right across from the beach on Beach Walk.

Staff talks among themselves too much, could provide more attention to customer, but were not rude.

Charge extra for sauces.

ATM machine inside.

Food, prices and facilities: All standard McDonald's.

Service: Though occasionally friendly and quick, more often I find it lackluster and slow.  Order fulfillment is hit-or-miss.  The drive-through experience is similar, but more than once has involved missing major items, such as coffees, etc., as well as smaller items like straws, jelly for bagels, etc.

The parking lot itself is not bad, but through-traffic can be downright scary.

Normally McDonalds is McDonalds, but this place always seems to taste better than the others.  I don't know if they have the ability to upgrade their beef or what the deal is.  The quarter pounder always taste better here so I give it 4 stars even though it's a McDonalds.  They also 90% of the time have a smiling face working the drive through.

i go to the restaurant often and the breakfast is really good, very fresh. but the dinner was not at all they same. i contact the manger several different times the manger mike. mike was very nice he apologized and since then i have had no problems thanks mike

How can you screw up a fast food restaurant besides actually opening one? 
1) You put one in the center of Rittenhouse shopping district.
2) Employ people from south and north Philadelphia, 
3) Undertrain and underpay them so they will give two sheets about your food or customer service and while the waiting time on the cash register might say 20 seconds in reality it's more like 4-5 minutes because the employees have to discuss the hierarchy of the word "Son" and how it should be used, I mean where is the fast in fast food? Maybe Merriam-Webster should consider employing them...
4) Close the upper floor so people will cram into the "roomy" first floor and oh, don't forget to systematically limit the amount of "free" things such as ketchup, knives ad forks, and now even straws.

*A special ode to their white unicorn that goes under the name of Mayonnaise: Captain Ahab  had more chances of catching Moby-Dick than you getting mayonnaise in this Mickey'D...they either don't have it or they have it and feel like it's their teenage daughter who is about to go to prom and you are her date who is also a future Ted Bundy. One of the employees even tried to charge me a dollar once. L A U G H A B L E

This place once was my "woke up late starving to death got to get food near work and for some reason SubWay is inaccessible" joint, for various reasons this has been my breakfast for a few days.  Well, a partial breakfast of an egg and cheese biscuit - cheap, gets me to lunch, I have the vague feeling it might not be killing me.

The place is insane in the mornings, cars stretched out of the parking lot to hit the drive-through. I found if you park and walk in you can be out before most of the cars have moved out of your sight.

I noticed today an employee walking along the line of cars with a PDA of some sort taking orders, so perhaps the insane backup is being addressed.

It's a McDonalds, the parking lot seems to be designed to bottom your car out and then filter you into traffic that can't let you merge, but it's ok.

I forget why we were here, but the short of it was a drink and some food were quickly required before a show and the eating and such were to be on foot.

I pulled to the ordering box, sat for a bit, realized this box had been vandalized severely and pulled to the next unmarked box, same deal, could not see the order and it was supposed to have a check your order screen.

Noted that the outside of this place was really not in good shape considering the area, basically it appeared this McDonalds was classing down the region.  Got to the first window, waited for a minute to pay - there were no cars around, perhaps 2 in the parking lot, in broad daylight I decided to figure out quick exit strategies. Do not recall why.

Went to the second window, they had a completely wrong order - not even close - person seemed quite set back that we didn't want this other food and wanted ours.

I think they came back to the window 4 times in all each time with one more piece of the order, it was by no means the longest wait or something I would freak out about but it was quite long for nobody being there and a simple order.

Not sure what is wrong with this place, but it does feel wrong.  The kind of wrong that makes you make up stories about it being haunted by someone who got stabbed there with an over-done french fry (and that wasn't Fancy Ketchup - it ... was.... his.... blooooood)

Basically it was odd, other than the messed up order they did nothing horribly wrong, but the place is run down and vandalized in a neighborhood that really isn't.

As far as the food goes, it's McDonalds - it should taste the same here as it does everywhere else. 

My beef with this McDs is that their ice cream/milkshake machine is consistently broken. Seriously I think my kids and I have tried a few dozen times and it's always broken (just tried today).  Now we just drive to the McDs in Damonte Ranch and skip this one altogether.
 
Grrr!
Stale, old food...SO gross!!!!  Buns are bricks and apple dippers with expired dates.
They sell cheeseburgers, fries, and shakes here. Try the big mac, its fantastic.
Forty nine cent ice cream cones need I say more?

It's McDonalds, yo. 

Least mean of them all in Philly (notice I didn't say nicest; truly the glass is half-empty and not half full). And least dirty. 

You can see it when you spot out the singular golden arches. 

No Reese's McFlurries, yo.

They charged me 50 cents extra for making me a half-Reeses-half-Oreo McFlurry! Ack! 

Make sure to only tell the person making it. And not the surprisingly attentive cashier at the front. 

Don't worry; the manager, who is sitting out with the customers, chillin', will scream out from time to time, "WHY ANT ANYBUDDY WORKIN'?!" 

This place gets the job done, dime and all.

I tried to avoid this McDonalds like the plague.  Service I'd mediocre on the best day so if I must have a Big Mac I find another spot.  This place was beyond yuck I am so happy they tore the place down, now maybe they will rebuild it into a proper food establishment.

Dirt McGirt? Dirt McGirt? Dirt McGirt?

Oh, no, it's only you, Ron McDon.

If ODB were still with us today, after a shopping excursion to these cultural nether regions, he'd be sittin' here, clownin', jokin', chowin' down alongside the hungry masses of weary, trendy shoppers or whoever it is that really dines here at this McDonald's location. McSpicy Paneer? Yeah! I think he'd like some of that. Maybe a McRib as well. And an apple pie for dessert. Yeah, Dawg.

I must admit I only come to McDonald's for their $1 any sized iced coffee (caramel) all summer long and the occasional egg mcmuffin.  I'm pretty thrifty when it comes to McD and only come when I have a coupon. 

The reason I'm taking the time to review this location is because they are always pleasant and efficient. On numerous occasions when I have come through the drive thru and used a coupon the lady behind the till has cheered, "woo hoo!" and they have let me keep my coupon to be reused on several occasions.

I don't go often, but it seems that every other time I go through the drive-thru, they screw my order up. Soooo, I'll start keeping tabs on what happens each time. IT'S FAST FOOD, it shouldn't be too complicated or too much to ask for a correct order.
This morning they did not put the hashbrowns in with my order. Knowing them, I checked my order before I left the parking lot; I then turned around and had to retrieve my hasbrowns by going back through the drive-thru.
I just realized, after saving one of the two breakfast sandwiches I ordered and actually unwrapping it, that they also gave me the WRONG sandwich.  What a joke this place is.

This is the most disgusting McDonalds I have ever been to. Dirty, dirty, dirty. Bathrooms were gross on steroids. Trash cans overflowing, yellow wet floor signs all over like an obstacle course. Dirty behind the counter. Tables dirty. I refused to eat there. McDonalds corporate should either shut this one down or take it over.

This is our neighborhood Mickey D's and we love it.  The one time we had a big issue, the Manager got in touch with me personally and worked very hard to correct the problem.   We use the drive through and the folks there are polite and the service is usually pretty quick.

Definitely the worst McDonald's I've been yet.

Growing up, I loved McDonald's even McDonald's himself had always looked creepy to me. (I've always been a fan of the Hamburglar but never mind that) I adored their food and remember how big and plump the Big Mac seemed and not this mushed together thing that we've come to known. Up until recently that I realized how bad fast food actually is and I've swore off it for years. That is until now that my job has brought me to an area of culinary desert, we got nothing but fast food, fried chicken and a deli around the 4 blocks area. It's a dead zone.

So I've retreated to fast food, a man's got to eat. Especially when the man is forgetful when he gets home and too lazy sometimes to plan his own lunch ahead.

I've been to this McDonald's 3 times for breakfast and lunch alike. While in surface, everything taste the same. This McDonald's is the most ghettlest of them all. Their cashiers have the nastiest attitude even I try to use thank you and please to force some customer service out of them.

The juice is half filled. When there is no ice in the ice machine, they just stand there and say they will refill it soon but they don't. They give you one napkin for your whole meal and there's no additional napkins to be found. They don't give you any ketchup or peanut or spoons for your sundae. They give you 1/3 of the normal amount of chocolate sauce for your sundae. Just a little on top like a suggestion that it is a chocolate sundae. The ice cream is also half-full (half-empty if you're a pessimist) and half-melted (half-solid if you're an optimist). It's not like I know them so I wonder why they act like I'm the asshole who's bothering them by making them go get my food. No smile and full of 'tude. Is there no quality control?

Well, it'll just make me want to bring my lunch more and hopefully keep me from being supersized
The only reason this Mickie D's rates a review is because it is truly a horrible one.

Can't say much about this particular location. Service is fine, food is okay, regular McDonalds food. Complaint-The card reader or something is down constantly at this one so they can only accept cash.This has happened 3 out of the last 5 times. It wouldn't be so bad if they had a sign or something outside letting you know but after you sit through the forever long line and then they tell you that, its incredibly annoying. And who has cash nowadays? Fix the problem!
Quick, which is what you want from a fast food joint like McDonalds. The only complaint I have is that they messed up my kids plain cheese buger by putting ketchup on it :(
becuase who reviews a mcdonalds. You should try the french fries here, you can't get fries like these anywhere else (except any other mcdonalds)... haha. love mcyD's

Until we're settled in, it'll be fast food for the time being.

I had intended to go to Hog Heaven, but since they don't open on Sundays, I went next door to McD's, instead.

I liked the place. It was very clean, the cashiers were friendly, and there were plenty of seating.

Standard McDonald's fare. Which is what I like about chains -- you know what you're getting.

this place is a complete dump. the staff are loud and act like idiots. 2 out of 5 of them actually work. u always have someone begging for change or smokes or whatever off of you. i would rather sleep under a bridge in kensington then eat here

This place was ridiculously packed when I arrived.  I had to stalk people as they ate so that I could slip in their booth when they left.  If I didn't there were 4 or 5 other parties waiting to do the same.  The staff is so busy and this place is so loud they yell at each other AND the customers!  I will list the things I found frustrating and troublesome at this McDonald's:

You have to ask for napkins. Really? Is there a napkin shortage in SB?
The bathroom is pay per use (25 cents).  What a joke!
The tables are sticky and dirty. I know this is a McDonald's but can someone please clean the tables once or twice a day please?

If you find yourself in Santa Barbara and in need for a McDonald's fix, drive about 2 miles north to the OTHER McDonald's and save yourself some frustration.
Awful awful service!! But what do you expect when grown folks work at mcdonalds?? I guess if I were 40 and worked here I wouldn't give a shit either.

This ol raggedy McDonalds didn't even have Sweet and Sour Sauce for ma nuggets.  Bastards.  Unfortunately when everything is closed by 9 p.m. midweek in downtown Philly . . . you end up getting stuck with this crap.  Sweet Tea and the Nuggets I ended up getting weren't bad . . . . but fa real how you not gonna have Sweet n Sour sauce?

I'm reviewing this particular McDonald's because we wanted a cheap lunch nearby rather than a $14.99/person at the hotels. This place is literally across the street from Silver Legacy, park at the hotels instead. It's diverse here. The city is sketchy itself.

PROS:
*opens late
*$1 any size soda! instead of $2 vending machine drinks
*$1 hamburger

Take it in context, giving Micky D's (or any fast food chain) 4 stars. This is one of only a handful on fast food places in Sahuarita/Green Valley area and the ONLY one with a playplace. This is the desert people! Parks are too hot to visit for several months of the year. The town has about 20k population, tons of young families, and it is along I19 where shoppers from Sonora are driving past it all weekend long and no one else thought to put in a indoor playground? This restaurant was built new in 2009 (?) and it is still clean and maintained well. The main dining room is nicer than the older McD's and the playland area has lots of seating, including several wheelchair/highchair accessible tables. The playplace also has a little area for toddlers with cushy climbing toys and a tree slide made of foam. The staff is generally nice and efficient although there have been a couple of visits that they seemed understaffed. They never seem to mind looking for the exact happy meal toy that my 5 yr old has to have. Food is typical McD's. I have to admit that if a Carl's or BK opened up with a playground inside I'd probably be hitting those up instead. But I will forever be grateful to the McD's for keeping my children entertained on many hot summer days in the A/C.
Tables never cleaned and ice machine handle filthy.

I don't think you can go wrong with McD's. I come here a lot to order chicken nuggets or iced coffee to go and they've always been quick and precise.

The service is way better than that of other McD's I've been (ex. the one on University Ave in Riverside = epic fail). The women working here are friendly and not snappy, too.

I'm always in and out within 5 mins.

Worst McDonald's I've ever been too! It was late at night and nothing in Carp is open after 10 o'clock so I decided to give good ol mickey d's a shot. They are right next to the freeway and there's no drive thru! The customer service is poor and the place doesn't look like it is sanitized and needs the health board to pay a visit. So sad and is a poor reflection of all McDonalds.

Usually when I don't feel like cooking or gorging on food, I stop by McDonalds for their two minute serve time and adequete portion size.

I often opt for the tried and true Big Mac, McChicken, or the Quarter Pounder dressed like a Big Mac. A burger, regular fries and regular drink usually fills me up. McDonald's also has the solution for those late night baked cravings and I usually go for two apple pies near midnight.
Let's be honest, it gets the job done and I don't eat it on a day to day basis so I have no complaints about the nutritional value.

However, my last experience will probably be the last time I ever eat at this location.
While finishing up my meal at around 20:30, I see a mouse scamper back and forth from the dining area into the closed Kid's Playground area.
I was in utter shock.

If all the McDonald's suffer from this problem, I'm going to start to learn how to cook inexpensive meals!

I just discovered that McDonald's adds cream to their iced coffee by default. I usually get my iced coffee elsewhere. Fail. 

Otherwise very McDonald's-like in all other aspects. 

Oh, an obnoxiously loud pre-recorded message plays at the drive-thru speaker prior to you being connected to the employee.

Ah yes, the old stomping ground for us Bloomingdale High schoolers. I have seen this store go through a lot of changes and every time it gets bigger and better. I'm really glad that they got rid of the play place and expanded the inside instead. No one really likes their kids to play in filth anyways and they can't sanitize a play area every day like they should. So that was a grand idea for sure! McDonalds food has never really changed so there's no point in commenting on the food. It's still good. But I wonder...do people REALLY win prizes when they have Monopoly going on?? Things that make you go hmmm...! 
Although, I'm happy to see that McDs finally has healthier food options for the kids Happy Meals. Their grilled chicken salad is pretty good too, but if I'm going to McDs, I'm getting a cheese-burger and I'll have fries with that!!
they don't give free water here!!! it's supposed to be a flippin mcdonalds for crying out loud
Horrible service. The "crispy" chicken in my ranch wrap was cold, they replaced after putting it in the microwave. I could hardly touch it.

I wouldn't say this is the best McDonalds in town, but it's not the worst either. I generally don't have issues with the service here and the restaurant is usually clean and presentable. 

Though our house is closer to this location, if we're planning to go in, sit down and eat especially with our kids in tow (and really, do you go to McDonalds without kids in tow?), we always go to the Lemmon Valley location. It's a larger restaurant, for one. 

Still, this location has a more than adequate drive thru for those quick stops and take out opportunities. I've never had trouble with my order or with the employees understanding me (and vice versa). 

My biggest caveat may be the traffic flow here. It is confused at best and downright dangerous at worst. Trying to turn left out of the lot onto Silver Lake can at some times be downright impossible.

This is a fun McDonalds because it is clean and has a great play area for kids.I don't know what Jack H is talking about but everything seemed brand new to me and i am very picky. This is a nice McDonalds!

As far as McDonalds go, the food is pretty much the same in every one.  However, I had the opportunity to go to this location on Saturday morning to pick up some breakfast sandwiches for the workers at my house.

Upon entering I observed an unhappy customer who was tring to get his order corrected.  He was confused about his receipt and IMHO had ordered incorrectly.  However, when he came inside, to straighten it out, things only got worse.  The casheir needlessly entered into a verbal altercation with him.  The customer was a little confused about his order and a little upset at the price of orange juice.  Perhaps he should have stayed home to eat.  Nevertheless, all the cashier had to do was refund his money as the customer had requested.  Instead, she began to speak in a loud tone so that everyone could hear her complain about the customer.

The icing on the cake was that the manager was standing right next to her the entire time and did NOTHING to de-escalate the situation or to try and satisfy the customer.  This was the worse case of restaurant management I have ever experienced.

Well...it's Mickey D's...not a five star restaurant.  With that said, I typically have a good experience with this particular location.  I'm normally a drive thru customer in the mornings.  Typically for an iced coffee. So, because of that I don't have problems with getting the wrong order usually, but I do have a problem with the inconsistency with the way the iced coffees are made.  To avoid this, I've started telling them how many squirts if cream and syrup I want...this is a bit annoying ;(

Overall though...the food is typical McD food and the staff is normally friendly, and as with any business with such a large percentage if high school student employees... the service is mediocre...all predictable and expected.

It is also clean and recently remodeled so the atmosphere is very modern and sleek.

Waited 15 minutes for my order of 1 oatmeal. Given to me without a bag. Got home, opened it up......half a cup, very dry, no apples. With about 7 people working in the back, this is unacceptable. Phone number mentioned in yelp is not in service. Drive past this location!!

So, this is a McDonald's. However, the morning staff that run the drive through are way above average for fast food. They are always smiling, upbeat, and remind me of Starbucks Baristas, only for McDonald's. I gave this location 4 stars based solely on service.

This McDonalds is by far the WORST that I have ever had the displeasure to go to for any type of food and or service. The staff by far is the most incompetent staff that I have ever seen, and I have been in customer service for over 25 years. 

Every single time that I have stopped at this McDonalds after any period of time of say 6:00pm on, the service is horrendous...bad times in drive through.....bad orders mixed up...what is so difficult of an order of a #11 Large with Sweet Tea and an extra sandwich by itself...12 minutes plus at 9:00pm to get order and the SWEET TEA...well is was ICED COFFEE GROUNDS....if there were anything other than a Subway, this restaurant would be out of business...totally pathetic staff/services provided!!!

I WILL NEVER GO AGAIN NO MATTER HOW HUNGRY I MAY BE...I WILL STOP AT VALENCIA FROM NOW ON!!!

This place should be closed down!!!

We stopped here in a hurry to feed the kids.   Problem was we were in a hurry...  The service was pretty slow and it took them FOREVER to actually take our order.    Despite how big it looks on the outside its pretty small on the inside with 75% of the resturant being the play place.   It is also EXTREMELY COLD if you sit anywhere near that playplace.  Food wise - it's a McDonalds so the factory created food all tastes the same.

This is the cleanest & most friendliest McDonald's I've ever been in. Everyone seems genuinely happy to be working here. I don't think one person didn't eagerly welcome me without a smile & really mean it. I don't think I want to leave here. & the food was hot and fresh. *** Free pie with any large value meal!!!!    *Free*

I know just about every restaurant, fast food joint and greasy spoon has some kind of pest problem; mice, roaches, something. But a CLEAN establishment does what it can to get rid of them. And most of the time you don't see them in the dining area. 

I was doing some work here on my laptop one afternoon and saw roaches crawling on the wall IN BROAD DAYLIGHT. When I said something to the management, they didn't seem concerned. When I tweeted it out and hashtagged McDonald's so that they'd see it, someone from the company sent me a direct message asking me which McDonald's it was. Alright, so we're getting somewhere, right?  Nope. He wanted to send me some coupons for free food at that McDonalds. 

DUDE, I JUST SAW ROACHES ON THE WALL, I AM NOT EATING THERE!

I MAY BE FAT BUT I DON'T CARE IF IT'S FREE, THERE ARE ROACHES ON THE WALL!!!

Be afraid. Be VERY afraid!!!!!! Ugh!

I've been to the drive thru several times on our trip down here and I can honestly say this is one of the best McDonalds I've been to. The food has always been piping and they have managed to not screw up our multiple orders for the same car.
For a fast food restaurant, it is not so fast. I will drive to the Downingtown McDonalds before going to this one.  The wait is just too long.

How do you order one combo meal at the drive thru on a seemingly slow night and get home without fries...twice? Shame on me for not checking twice but seriously?? Get your act together.  Angus burger was also pretty dry. I've never had bad service or experiences at this McDonald's until the last few months so maybe there's been a management change or something. Who knows, but I really hate to pay for food that I don't get. You know?
Best McDonald's around! Clean store, fast and friendly service, fries are always hot and delicious. I'm loving' it!

Reviewing a McDonald's....yes, it's silly, but the public needs to be warned to never visit this one.

2 stars: I can't knock this place for being unhealthy. When you intentionally visit a McDonald's establishment, you go knowing full well the consequences. So 2 stars for the food and impending heartburn. 

3 stars: The French Fries. Not going to lie. I would eat them right now if presented with those delicious golden bitches.

0 Stars: The unbelievably terrible service. Now I know I'm not going to receive a 5-star experience, but come on. One time my bf ordered a double cheeseburger and received it sans burger patties (only buns, lettuce, onions, ketchup), another time we ordered TWO STRAWBERRY milkshakes and received THREE VANILLA milkshakes. How is that even possible? 0 stars for incompetency. Don't even THINK about specializing your order.

Somehow it also takes them forever and a half to get your order to you. So not only is it incorrect, but it is also delivered to your car just seconds before you decide to eat your shoes.

0 stars: For only having meals after 10 o'clock.

Grand Total of 1 star...and that's a generous gift.

This place is near my home, so my family has been patronizing this location for years.

We've finally given up on them!! The problems have gotten pretty bad. Last week they double charged our debit card.  The girl who did the transaction knew something messed up and she claimed she canceled the first transaction, but she didn't. We had to make an extra trip back with the bank records and our receipt to have a manager correct it.

Coffee through the drive through has been bad on many occasions. It is so weak it taste like hot water, not coffee. One time I took it in and the manager said they must have 'forgot' to put new coffee in when brewing (using old grounds instead) and the coffee he got out of the urn used for inside service was ok. The weak coffee has been given to me so many times through the drive through that it couldn't be an accident - I think they are too cheap to brew real coffee for the drive through, knowing everyone will be long gone before they taste it.

Oh - and I can't tell you how many times we've not gotten sausage in our hotcakes and sausage. Just hotcakes.

There is another McDonalds just north on St. Albert trail a couple of kilometres that doesn't have these problems.

Found this McDonalds busy but very adequate.  Clean, with plenty of seating.  The only negatives were the $ menu was very small and placed in the far left of non-lit area and there was no calories listed for any items, and they failed to ask if we wanted the apple pie.  Aside from that 3 stars is appropriate.

Hmmmm ... John H. is finally running out of $, you say. Too much travelin' and eatin' for his own good, you say.  Actually, my trip to McDonald's is the benign consequence of my good fortune. At a summer charity auction, I was the successful bidder on a basket of restaurant gift cards and certificates. Since I'm currently working all hours of the day and pressed for time, it seemed a good opportunity to use some McDonald's meal money.  This location is at the NW corner of a major intersection, easy to enter and exit. I arrived during the evening rush, and the drive-through line moved quickly. Burger and fries looked and tasted like they were produced to corporate specifications, and the flavor was fine. The bacon-ranch salad had moist grilled chicken. The lettuce had the dry look that lettuce does when I've refrigerated a salad several hours, so I imagine that it's prepared hours in advance. But it was certainly acceptable for fast food.
i feel that this is probably one of the McDonald's in town. the nuggets are always good.
being broke is no joke but as long as there is 99 cent double cheeseburgers you will never go hungry, i mean really 99 cent double cheeseburgers, nothing more needs to be said

Meh, at least it was better than Taco Bell.  

So picture it.  It was 2 am.  I was sick, I was hungry, and Taco Bell had already screwed up my order.  So I came to McD's.

The food was fine...when I actually got it.  I sat in the drive thru for a good 20 minutes.  After 10 minutes I started timing it.

I thought fast food was supposed to be...well...fast...?
Seriously, Rebecca is right. This is the worst McD's ever. It's dirty and the staff is rude and slow.

It's a shame that the customer service has gone down at Olivette McDonald's.  They very rarely get an order right and the customer is always wrong.  Heaven forbid they actually cook the burgers...notice they usually look a grayish-brown and not anything like the pictures that are displayed.  I realize they are photos but even still, the meat should be cooked. Also, when they pour salt on the fries they forget to mix them, they just pour the salt on and then scoop the fries.  This is why the fries are too salty.  It seems the more efficient they have become, the lazier they are.  I worked at this location years ago and if we ever talked to or treated a customer with disrespect, we would have been suspended without pay or would no longer have a job.  Some of the managers don't even care about how the customer is treated by a crew member because they think it's a joke.  The truth is they are the joke.
Not the nicest McDonald's around, but they do have a ton of business to deal with. Food is fine.

At least a dozen cars were in front of me when I pulled in during the lunch rush @ 12:31 PM. A cashier was working the line with a mobile ordering device, seemingly alternating cars with the regular wired ordering station. There was a five-second pause at the pickup window while the employee looked over my order. I was asked to pull forward to position #1, where, less than a minute later, my order was delivered w/ a smile and an apology for the delay. At 12:42 PM, I was pulling out with a timestamped grilled chicken salad, a well-proportioned hamburger, and a neatly packed small bag of golden fries. It's only a dollar, but I think they could afford to dress the burger with more than a single pickle chip, 1/2 teaspoon of onion, and a dash of condiments. Still, I am impressed with the communication, coordination, and efficiency. Even w/ the long line, I was in and out in about 11 minutes.

This is a "new" McDonald's, although I guess it's been a decade or more that it has been here.  It's small and a little difficult to get to . . . at least from the direction we approach.  This location shares property with the CVS.

Food was fine, but service was slow.

This is the first time I have been here in years.  We only used the drive-thru this trip.

We needed a place to get a quick bite and ended up here; we couldn't find a Checkers, which is what we were looking for.

This is a very small McDonald's.  It did have clean bathrooms, which we appreciated.  We got our food and dined outside at the playground.  It seemed like a better playground than the standard ones back home.  The children were appreciated.  

There was a tarp of some sort overhead to keep the son from baking the adults.  There were also overhead fans to help cool us off.  Again, they were appreciated.
Horrible always tales way to long for a drive in n CAUTION the soda here sucks! The dr pepper never has enough carbonation or syrup I'm not sure I just know it's horrible!

I've never, ever witnessed an event in a restaurant like I did at the Broad Ripple McDonald's last week. I'd gone to a movie and stopped by for a quick snack afterwards since they were one of the few places still open. Upon walking in, there was a heavy set man behind the counter (whom I later discovered was a MANAGER) in a shouting match with an inebriated customer who was standing by the door. 

Wait, what?

Yeah. Two grown men, in a restaurant (kinda...if a grease joint coated in styrofoam counts as a restaurant) yelling at the top of their lungs and dropping the F-bomb back and forth about how they're going to F each other up.

At first, I chuckled. This is ridiculous. Either put up or shut up, fellas. Don't talk about it, do it or don't, but either way, all the chest puffing and shouting isn't doing anything except making you both look like four year olds in the sand box with extremely vulgar mouths. 

Then, I looked around. THERE WERE KIDS IN THERE. Not many, just a small family; mom, dad and their 2.2 kids choking down their heart blocker combos. 

Wait, what? Seriously? 

This is stupid. I had to say something. Why is it the most reasonable person in this dump was a customer who had just walked in?  The employees were letting their fearless leader continue to shout vulgarities across the room, the manager didn't have the balls to come out from behind the counter or call the cops to get the guy out of there, and the parents didn't have the stones to say something themselves. 

Are you kidding me? 

I decided it was time to end this "Alice in Wonderland" moment, no matter how much I enjoy a sudden side trip into the surreal. I spoke up and said, "Guys, there are kids here, please watch your language!" With that, the drunk guy got one last jab in to the portly manager with yet another empty threat and walked out. 

Okay, so this is done now, right? Now, back to my order.....

No, wait....the manager wasn't done spouting off about how he was about to.....dude, you weren't about to do nothing but embarrass yourself even further, shut up. Geez, when I was a bouncer and worked security for parties/concerts I got so tired of these guys, yap yap yap. Like little freakin' lap dogs, only this one was 350 pounds of pure lard. 

And he's their role model? Yeah, seriously. 

I got two drinks to go and walked out. I haven't been back to this location and see no reason to do so. 

--John Cannon
www.MyCarDoc.com

The drive through takes forever and a day more times than not even when there are only two cars ahead of you. Going inside to order is a pain sometimes because they usually only have one cashier and the floor is always sticky.  My main complaint is service is usually slow and it seems like this place is understaffed most of the time for the volume of customers that use it.

I've only ever gone through the Drive Thru at this location and I've never had any problems.  They're super fast, even with a long line.  The McD's on Olive does it better though with the dual ordering windows.  I've never had problems with them getting the order right or overcharging me.

I have been going to McDonald's since I was 5 years old. I remember my mom always getting me happy meals and I loved playing with the toys. McDonald's is still a place that I love to eat at, occasionally. It has the best french fries I have ever tasted! I eat them with ranch sauce, and sometimes I even dip them in my shakes! They also have really yummy chicken nuggets that I always get to eat. My ultimate favorite thing from McDonald's is the sweet tea. I have never tasted tea so good, but also so fattening in my life! It has so much sugar that I can only rarely drink it. I think it is very interesting that McDonald's is everywhere in the world, and it is the same quality at each restaurant. In high school, I had to watch Super Size Me and I did not eat McDonald's for a whole month. I found it very repulsing that someone got so sick off of eating the food, but at the same time eating it only occasionally is okay for me. The service is usually always good and they have only messed up my order a few times. I would say that McDonald's is one of my favorite fast food restaurants and will probably continue to be for a very long time. They are even growing with new smoothies, sundaes, and other foods and beverages that will make them prosper even more then they already have. I love Micky D's and will probably eat there very soon!
Friendliest McDonalds staff I've ever encountered! Didn't expect that!

I love Mickey D's for a variety of things that are offered on their menu. This place has an outdoor play facility to allow the kids to play and eat. We came around lunch time and the drive thru can be quite busy for which I observed from sitting outside, however the inside dining, lines weren't so long and seating was plentiful. I was a little bugged out by the fact that they have a huge sweet tea on the menu for 1.00 but when I ordered a value meal I discovered that they charge more for that size and I asked the manager of what sense that made and he responded that the value meals are already discounted so the price is different. This makes completely no sense to me so I was definitely "NOT Loving it!!!" Overall service was ok. I probably would revisit this establishment.
this is the worst mcdonalds i have ever been to! my order is never right. they are rude. when i finally complained to the manager, he didn't try to fix my problems or make amends. No Way!

Wrong order completely even though the receipt in the bag and on the screen were correct.  Judging from other yelpers there is a lot of inattentiveness by the staff.  I was one of two cars in line and no one was behind me so I'm not sure how they got my order wrong.  Oh well, I'll avoid it and go to Penn Station or somewhere else.

The truth is that McDonald's should be ashamed of the fact the service is as bad at it is.  I get that McDonald's in general is not going to be the most accurate restaurant: the teenagers who usually work at these places are going to get these things wrong, but to get away with it they generally have to at least pretend to care when it's wrong, and when the McDonald's here gets my orders wrong, they make it clear they're going to ignore you.

I waited for several minutes, before anyone even acknowledged me, there was no apology, no warmth, just what I originally wanted and a very cold shoulder.

This is the McDonald's right off the interstate at the Downtown exit.  It's the representative not only of the McDonald's corporation in Nashville, but of the city itself: and they are shamefully bad.   This should be the showcase store, where McDonald's shows off all the best Nashville has to offer.  It's just the opposite here.  For all the advantages of location and convenience, it's just one of the most horrible experiences in Nashville.

Stay away.

Truly the most insane place I have ever been to eat. Huge line while four employees sit a a table taking a break. People coming in from the drive in with wrong orders. Had to scream to get someone on the counter since they were all trying to get some kind of mix into a machine. the absolute worst( almost funny it was so bad). And yes my order was wrong. I had my first job at a Casper's McDonald's but I never saw anything so messed up as this joint.

This is one of the best Mcdonalds. period.
Let me say - 'bon appetit!' - its time for the mcnuggets (w/ honey mustard for sure, wild card sauce after that).
The furnishing were amazing, felt like a furniture store, everything was so new.
Great customer service, plenty of parking, did I mention they serve mcnuggets??

this place rocks!

I only felt the need to write a review to offset the one 1-star review that someone left. I've been to hundreds of McDonald's retaurants in my life and I take the kids to this one quite often because it has an indoor playground. As far as McDonald's go, I would put this one in the 95th percentile. It's always as clean as you can reasonably expect and the food is fresh. I'm sure the other reviewer just happened by on a bad day or something. As McDonald's go....this is a good one.
They knocked down the old and built a brand spankin new mc D's with 2 count em 2 drive thrus.  I hope the newly reconfigured one runs smoother than the old location!

Since walking to the bus stop, taking the bus, and then walking a few miles to and from work takes me an hour and a half, I can get quite hungry at the end of a workday. And if I miss either bus 7 or bus 2, then it's another half hour to my commute.

McD's is within walking distance to both bus stops. And cheap eats.

Some people get offended if workers speak Spanish; I didn't give it a second thought. They do take your order in English. The Spanish-speaking staff actually reminds me of California. And in California, I've heard McD's staff in many locations speak in many different languages.

I'm in and out of here in minutes, so I never really get a chance to comment on the decor. I think there is a fish tank (with plastic fish?) to amuse the little ones. I believe (but I"m not sure) that there is also a kid's play area at this location.
Its a Mickey D's. Same as most of the rest of them... This one does a good job usually.

At the end of September 2011, my son and I visited a McDonald's location in Wesley Chapel on State Route 54 (Store #7530).  The day of the week just happened to be Thursday and we all know what that means... $1.99 Happy Meals! So... they would lead you to believe. 

After receiving our food, we both sat down at the table and the receipt just happened to be in front of me, so I decided to have a look. Well, after trying to decipher the damn thing, I realized that we did not receive the Happy Meal for $1.99, so I went back to the same teller to advise her that I was overcharged $1.39 but she explained to me that the breakdown of charges was not accurate. However, I got home and broke down the receipt and still came up with the same conclusion.... I was overcharged $1.39.

Even though this was not a huge deal, I decided to write a letter to the McDonald's Corporation. Much to my surprise, I heard back immediately from the store manager "Jason" who offered us a free meal for the inconvenience. Last week we were able to visit the same store and meet Jason since he was on duty. He was super accommodating this time and handled the situation like a complete professional. He really helped change my perception of McDonalds and the many corporations out there that overcharge customers without them even knowing it but actually doing something about it other than saying "SORRY." 

Although things turned out for me this time around and the management was very accommodating, my true recommendation to everyone is to Always Be Checking (ABCs), as a dollar here and a dollar there overcharged... adds up quickly. Thanks McDonalds (Jason) for handling my problem and please don't deal this deck of cards to others!

Keep up the good work and I will continue to recommend your organization to others throughout the area. Best Regards,

This McDonald's is a treat. Everyone has been to one, so I'm not really commenting on the food.  Their food is fine... when you can get it.  Twice now, I've been over to get a meal around 5AM (I work nights at the hospital across the street) to be turned away with the comment "sorry we are switching from dinner to breakfast"  When asked how long it will take, "I don't know."  Can I get anything that was left over? Nope.   Since this is a 24 hour McDonald's, I imagine this process happens EVERY DAY.  Surely you have seen it happen before. Surely you can guess how long it might take?  Instead I just get a blank stare and quietly walk out. 
Don't advertise 24 hours, if you are only open 22.5 hours a day...  A coworker also had this happen and being a bit more upset, she emailed the store manager who later replied, "Sorry. God Bless."  I suppose since this location is almost always busy, what is one disgruntled patron?  To be fair, I have been around lunch time, and for as packed as it looks, you can still get your food in a decent amount of time. Just don't expect to get the right sauces for your chicken nuggets. Ever.
It's McDonalds! This one's not too bad for my occasional MickyD's.  I usually go for their breakfasts and this one was no different.  Seemed clean, well lit and pretty friendly.
food that is inexpensive and satisfies hunger... I'll return like a dog does to his vomit. food is Good if there is nothing else to eat...

ohhhh maaaaa gaaaaaaahhhhh

SERIOUSLY.  believe the other 2 reviews here.  this is literally the WORST McDonald's EVER. i wish i would've read the reviews on this mcdonalds before i went there, but who ever thinks of reading reviews for a MCDONALDs!?!?!?  you know what you're going to get at every mcdonald's, right?? no.  not this one.

pleeease, if you happen to be reading this, DO NOT GO HERE.

like David T- i went during monopoly season- 2nd to last day of it.  the mcrib was also back!  so instead of going to the Bryn Mawr mcdonalds, i went to this one because it was on my way back home.  WOW.  ok so no monopoly pieces came on the mcrib, so i chose to get the mcrib meal and made it LARGE so that i'd at least get monopoly pieces with my large fries.  well, first all of my food came shoved recklessly into the bag.  my straw was bent underneath the mcrib box, the fries were too pale to have been cooked fully.  whatever, i didn't want to make an issue out of it, but i did ask for a new straw.  when i did, the girl at the drive-thru window was so rude, like i was troubling her so much because SHE bent my straw.  then when she handed me the new straw she slammed the window closed.  wow.

best part- i get home, and there are no monopoly pieces on my large fries :(

you'd better believe i plan on calling the manager of this store to either get  the extra cost of my large value meal refunded or to get some game pieces.  horrible.

A smaller-sized McDonalds that is also attached to a gas station. I had gotten the gas next door, so this was my stop to log onto the free wi-fi while making the minimum possible purchase (a bottle of water) and using the restroom. The restroom was only reasonably clean, but that's why it's good to be a dude - we don't have to touch anything!

Wifi worked well, parking lot was easy to depart and get back onto the Interstate. Goodbye, Lebanon, TN!

McRib, y'all.

That's right, because nothing sates my hunger after a hard day's search for ODB like a combination of boneless pork, fresh-slivered onions, dill pickle slices and McDonald's signature McRib sauce on a toasted, golden-brown home-style bun.

Get it while it's hot, dawg. (Limited availability, yo.)

McDonald's food is the same everywhere, so there's no issue with that (aside from the fact that I eat it at all, that is).

The restaurant itself is awkward and disgustingly poorly maintained. I still shudder at the thought that my kid actually played in that Playland out front (the one with the Alcatraz bars and the lovely view/sounds/aroma of West Chester Pike) when she was younger.

But the main issue with Havertown's McDonald's is the sheer incompetence of the staff. We generally try to avoid McDonald'ses, but every once in awhile the day gets away from us, it's late, and we're too tired and/or lazy to prepare actual FOOD and too hungry to wait for delivery of anything decent. So, despite knowing better, we find ourselves making the short trip to this McDonald's.

I'd conservatively estimate that about 60%-70% of our visits to this McDonald's involve at least one (and often all three) of the following:

(1) Employees getting order wrong
(2) Getting to the second window of the drive-through and being told to "just pull up there while we finish your order..." (the "there" in question is just ahead of the drive-through lane, immediately to the right of the squalid Playland [circa 1970--uncleaned and unupdated since 1970], and perilously close to any traffic leaving the back parking lot and/or the drive-through)
(3) Employees giving wrong change

For the most part, the employees seem to be high school kids--some of them are friendly, at least, and a good deal more of them have the smart-ass, can't-be-bothered thing going on (which is fine--we've all been there). But, seriously, even given that this is a McDonald's we're talking about, the level of incompetence is startling. Really, it's almost IMPRESSIVE how consistently awful the service here is. You'd think that random chance alone would let these guys achieve a higher rate of getting orders right...

Not fittting with typical McDonald's standards. 

1/2 the seats were busted. no ice in the machines, no straws or napkins in the machine. Service stunk.

But they had the occasional Diet Coke on the stroll back to the hotel- I'll take that.

It's mcdonalds...

But hey this one consistently makes the items well, the fries are usually well salted, and aside from the frequent hobo's it's pretty nice inside. 

It's right out the gate so it's close and if I feel like a mcdouble or 1/4 pounder with cheese I stop in here.

As far as McDonalds go this one is good so I can't gripe too much.

I wish all McDonald's were run like this.  This place was great and the employees were great too.  Now McDonald's food is realatively the same and what sets each location apart are the employees.  These guys got it down!

The LA folk can learn from them!

The particular McDonald's tends to be a bit hit and miss.  I usually patronize the location on Vista & Kootenai, but sometimes I'll go to this one.   Lately it seems to be improving. There are some nice people working the drive thru, and our orders have been correct the last couple of times.   The one thing that is really a hassle is trying to get back out on onto Orchard to turn left.  Busy traffic, no traffic signal.  But you can't really blame the McFolks for that.

We had a late doctor appointment, so we decided to grab some quick food at McD's for dinner afterwards.  And what better time than when the McRib is available?!  Personally, I don't like that sandwich, but my husband does, and they offer a second sandwich for just $1.00 when you buy a meal.  Good deal, if you want that much food.  The fries were good as usual, and they put just a bit of extra sauce on my Big Mac, just like I asked for.  Everything was served to us hot.  Overall, the food is what you would expect from McD's.  Not the best food in the world, but consistent.

The service was friendly, chatty, and pleasant.  This location has a kids' PlayPlace, and it was very busy when we were there, but the restaurant was still clean and orderly.  The also have free Wi-Fi, which is nice.  While we don't want to eat here for dinner very often, my husband and I both agree that this turned out to be a quick, cheap, and peaceful dinner.  It's not a 4 star restaurant, but compared to other McD's and fast food like it, it was a better experience.

Only good late night, and then still terrible. Sadly had to wait almost 10 minutes for three dollar menu items at 10:30pm and we were the only ones in the drive through. I cant bitch too much cause my frys were scalding hot; thus the wait. Mmmmm mcdonalds frys rule!  I hate them soooo much.

Everyone's always friendly here but this is the slowest McD's in Tucson.  No matter the time of day - breakfast, second breakfast, elevenses, lunch, tea, dinner, supper - this place is SLOOOOOOOOOOOW.  We skip this place altogether in the mornings if we're craving a quick breakfast on the way to work.  There is nothing quick about their drive-through, sorry.

Other than that - the food is tasty in a it's-bad-for-you-but-so-delicious-way.  Can't really review the inside as I've never been inside it.

I mean, you can't expect much from a McDonald's, but when the manager (Beth) tells you the MACHINE chooses whether you can swipe credit card or ATM and then tells you there's no other option to pay??  I mean, are there any intelligence standards or education requirements to work here?
Then my filet-o-fish tasted stale.  Nothing worse than stale Mickey D's.

The employees at this particular McDonald's seem to have trouble filling orders correctly and the place is often filled with flies. 

Also, don't count on having breakfast here if you need to get to work early, as they rarely manage to open on time -- often far from it. On many mornings, I've found the "golden arches" to be lit, with the doors locked, the drive-through dark and not an employee in sight (although their cars are in the lot).

During my childhood summers on Friday afternoons, my mom and I would stop at either the Haddon Township McDonalds or this one before we embarked on our journey to the shore. Fond memories and I recall the food from this location was always good. I've gone back a few times as an adult and was pleased. As a child I always enjoyed McDonalds and was so excited when my mom would agree to get it for me. As an adult though, I now view things differently. I would never take my hypothetical children to a McDonalds, feed them this poison and get them on track for an unhealthy life. McDonalds got me when I was young.  Don't make the same mistake with your children. Have them drink water or milk, not soda, regular or diet. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go get a Big Mac.

Yep, it is your standard McDonalds and so you can imagine the rest of the review....everyone outside of cave-dwellers have eaten at one, and there is little variation.  The good/bad news is that you pretty much know what you will get in terms of food and service/cleanliness will vary.  I personally am not a big McD fan and prefer non-chain places, even for burgers, but needed to note that West Tampa supports several standard fast food places, even if there is better food at better prices within a block......and that is the case with this one located across from Fiesta Plaza Shopping Center that houses several good eating places.  But McD survives & thrives and has earned a place on the comprehensive listing of West Florida eating places.

This McDonalds can get sketchy at times, customer-wise.  The service is quick but not served with a smile as their slogan states.  But they're really quick with your order and it's typical McDonald's food.
All I can say is don't leave without checking your order. They rarely get it right the first time around. And be ready to wait, not very fast for being a fast food restaurant!

Be careful with this location. I've been short changed several times and had to wait while the drawer was counted down to get my correct change. I've also been given the wrong items several times and had to waste time getting the correct items.

This place may be busy, but they lack the ability to make sure the orders are right the first time around.

Awwwwy yeah mothafuckas be so fast that your food's ready before you even swipe your damn credit card. 
more sauce you want? these motherfuckers aren't stingy they'll pile your shit up.
pretty clean for a mcderp's too.

It's McDonald's. I mean, you can't expect much from them, but the one thing I expect is to get my order right. Am I really asking for too much?

Gone here many times. Seems like they can never get my order right. One McDouble with extra onions and no mustard. Is that really too complicated that you can never get that right? Obviously, to them it is. The staff here are okay. Not friendly, but not rude. The service sucks since they never seem to get my order right. My fries are always stale and dried. Every once in a while my fries would be good though, but not very often. I wish they're consistency would be getting my order right and good fries! But instead it's getting my order wrong and stale, dried fries :(

One thing I do like though is that they stay open late. 

*Sighh* maybe one day they can get it right.

Only reason why I like this Mc Donalds so much is because there is a drive thru. But I don't know how I feel about them not being able to split more than 2 orders.

But they never fail on making good iced coffee!

If I could give a negative star I would. The only nice thing to say is that the place is clean. The staff is rude and disorganized. I am sorry that the staff hate their jobs so much that they are so bitter--no one is making them work there. They make fun of customers and use racial slurs.  They yell at the customers, mumble when speaking, never thank them, and never apologize when it takes over 20 minutes to serve breakfast--and we still got the wrong order. This is not fast food. This is the worst McDonalds that I have ever been in. STAY AWAY unless you are dying from hunger. The manager and the whole franchise should be ashamed.
