Ordered an Egg McMuffin sans meat.  Showed up correctly on the screen.  Showed up in the bag with a sausage pattie . . . . WTF?  Hash browns actually had a hair on them - serious sanitary issues here along with poor attention to detail.  Never again.

We were directed to this location as their hours were late and when we arrived they were closing. The manager allowed us to come in and order and everyone was very friendly! Great place to grab something quick.

I went in here purely on a whim because I wanted to try the McRib. This McDonald's has its own lot even though it is next to a shopping area. The interior has been updated to McCafe standards. Service was okay and the McRib was... well, a McRib.

Hey its a Mcdonalds what more do you want. They have the regular menu and an indoor kids play area just realize that it gets real busy with everyone getting coffee in the morning and then look out for all of the soccer moms in the afternoon who have forgotten how to cook. Overall its a clean decent Mcdonald's so the words status quo definitely come into play.
I asked for lite ice for $1 sweet tea and it was still cold. Good job.

So for the first time ever, I didn't have a horrible experience at this McDonald's. I live pretty close by and come in once every month or two (usually for take-out), and usually there is a combination of some really sketchy people (talking to themselves/possibly high on drugs) and old people (getting free tea refills), coupled with a long line served by young cashiers. Here's a sampling of things that have happened to me in the past: given me medium fries instead of a large and charging me for the large, forgetting to give me the muffin I ordered, didn't give me ANY sauces for my McNuggets (where are you, my sweet and sour??), couldn't count and didn't give me back the correct change, and the worst one - sometime last year, on a busy Saturday around lunchtime, we waited in line for about 10 minutes before overhearing the cashier tell the people in front of us that they had run out of fries. RUN OUT OF FRIES!!! How could they have let that happen?? 
Anyway, this time went as smoothly as it could have gone: no line, I used a coupon without any problem, cashier charged me the right amount, and my food was ready about 1 minute later. Of course, my fries were a little stale, and my Big Mac was, as usual, haphazardly slapped together, but all in all, an acceptable experience.
Oh and in case you ever need a late-night McDonald's fix, this one is open 24/7. Just beware of the people in there at that hour...

I have never been disappointed during normal business hours. It's a little annoying when people are asking you for money inside the McDonald's though. I agree with the guy who said something about going there between the hours of 2am and 5am. The people who work overnight are pretty damn lazy and will tell you that they're "cleaning" or whatever so that you go away.

I only go here for the kids most of the time(since reading Fast Food Nation 10 years ago) and all I can say is WTF is up with this Mcdonalds? Sometimes their service great and sometimes its downright awful! The double drive-through is hit or miss and today I had to ask the person behind me to back out from behind me so I could LEAVE. Three cars ordered and went thought on the outside lane while the car in front of me and I waited and waited. After five minutes of this, I left. Another thing that they used to be really bad about was not putting everything in your order. 

On the + side, the staff is usually very friendly.
slowest Mcdonalds ever!  Never fails every time we go we wait forever for our food and it's not even fresh!

Regular McDonald's food. It is located within 2 minutes of Nashville International airport.

+1 for cleanliness, spacious seating area. Wi-fi very reliable. Funny incident - by the restroom, there was a guy sleeping on his laptop. Apparently he was working and decided it was nap time.

The drive-thru times are embarrassing.  It doesn't matter if you're there for breakfast, lunch, or dinner (or any time in between), you're going to always wait at least 15 minutes in line... And it can be much much longer than that.  The other night we waited 15 minutes from the time we placed the order to the time we made it to the window, and that's not counting the 10 minutes it took to get to the speaker box.  That's way too long for fast food.

This is the worst McDonald's I've ever visited.  We ordered the mushroom angus burger,   gourmet 3 piece chicken pieces,  large coke & large order of fries........All the food was cold.  Should have brought it back to the manager and complained, but we wanted to eat and get out of there.  Wonder if it had to do with it being a 
a Sunday , around 7pm.
I have been to this mcdonalds a number of times. The drive thru is easy to get to. They are very fast at the drive thru. It's also neat and clean. I don't think you can ask much more from mcdonalds.

NOTHING good to say about this place. The place was sprinkled with people that looked like they were there for some place to sleep. I ordered 2 Frappe's well, I waited I know 15 minutes ... There were 2 people ahead of me, they got their orders pretty quickly (how long they had been there before I got there the Good Lord ONLY knows!) ... During the 15 min wait I had two people  come up to me and try to con me out of money (which is very refreshing .... NOT!!)
    The people that worked there were NOT helpful at all, they were not friendly one bit! Never said thank you... have a good nite ... come back again ....nothing....   I should have turned around and left as soon as I saw the questionable mechanisms on the bathroom doors! Needless to say ... Do not go in this Mickey D's unless you CANNOT make it another 10 ft dying of hunger!
Waited 15 min for my order got home it was wrong went back and waited another 20. Will never go back to this location. This was ridiculous wish I could do no stars

I've never actually bought the food here but they have a pretty nice play area outside that my daughter really enjoyed crawling around in. This location is extremely busy. Good for their business, but bad for the noise levels.
This location is consistently the slowest "fast food" place I've been to in town. I only ever go here because it's so close to home.

OK, so this has got to be the worst Mc Donalds ever.  It's a shame because it s a nice new facility, but every single time we have tried it, they manage to make it the worst experience ever.  Horrible service, long waits for ill prepared foods.  I know, it's Mc Donalds, but come on.  This is ridiculous!!!  Whoever is in charge needs to take notice and shape up!!!!
Quick, easy access, friendly staff. Volatile mix for a successful McDonalds.

I normally have no complaints about McDonald's, but this location was absolutely disgusting!! I landed in NOLA, checked into my hotel and went here for a quick dinner. I got a grilled chicken bacon ranch salad and an oatmeal and both were Gross!! My salad was so brown it was slimy, the chicken was a weird color and cold, and my oatmeal was cold and matted. Oh, the employees were both on cell phones talking to people - terrible food, terrible service. Do not eat here. Waste of money and you'll be hoping you don't get sick!!

they shouldn't be open 24/7.. it's a waste of electricity! once it hits midnight, you'll start hearing excuses like "we don't have that", "we don't have food right now because we're getting ready for breakfast"... what the hell?! boooooo, what a waste of time.

Put the  pitchforks and torches away (and the hot oil!). I'm not saying that McDonald's is a 5 star restaurant. I'm just saying that of all the McDonald's I've eaten at, this one is run the best! Seriously, If there was a "Yelp- McDonald's" site, 5 stars would make more sense. I live in a town where the McDonald's are usually lacking in cleanliness, friendliness, and speed of service. This one in Wood River is the way all Mickey D's should be run. Very fast (go through the drive thru and they will have your food in a flash!), very friendly, and they don't get the orders wrong. Food is always hot and fresh. 
If you've not eaten at a well run McDonald's, don't visit this one unless you live nearby. It will spoil you.

This McDonald's is in a lot by itself on eastbound Ridge Pike. From all appearances, the interior design looked up to date for this chain. The food was... well, McDonald's. However, at the time of my visit, I thought the service was above average.

I am a huge fan of McDonald's! Usually great service, great food, great time. Not at this locale. I would not recommend this McDonald's to anyone. It was last Saturday, Dec. 10, at 10:25 in the morning. I just met the 10:30 deadline for breakfast. I was relieved! One small orange juice and an egg and cheese bagel were coming my way. I opened wallet and noticed that I had two $20 bills. I would usually just use my debit card, but I thought, "I should probably use up this cash first." When I pulled up to the cashier window, I handed the young woman one $20 bill. It took an unusually long time for Cashier #14 to get me my change. When she finally handed me change, I noticed that it was $4.30 - change for a $10 bill. I normally don't even look at the change, but after noticing only $4 in one-dollar bills, I was perplexed. I asked the cashier about the change. She looked horrified! She was caught. Instead of stating that she made a mistake, she told me that I handed her a $10 bill - not a $20. I told her, "no, I handed you a $20. I had two in my purse, and now I have one." When I wouldn't give up, she told me she'd get her manager. Mind you, it's now 10:28 a.m. The manager (Mary Kay) came to the window and told me that 1. This was not a good time to have an altercation and 2. That it would take her a few minutes to count the drawer - and stop the line of hungry passengers behind me. Oh, and again, that this was a seriously bad time. I told Mary Kay, I would be happy to wait, but that I was 99% positive that I handed her cashier a $20 bill. The manager looked annoyed and asked me to pull forward so they could take care of the other customers. I was fine with that. I just wanted my $10 back. Mary Kay came out to tell me that she'd rather call me than have me wait. "Fine," I said. "Here is my business card and my cell phone number. Please call anytime!" Ten minutes into my drive home, Mary Kay called to tell me that 1. The drawer was not $10 over - only $1.25 and that another woman claimed to have the same issue, but that they were able to figure it out. My first thought was, there is no way the money would be in the drawer, because the cashier pocketed it. My second thought was, if you've had these issues in the same morning with the same cashier- what the heck is the common denominator???!! Mary Kay apologized but told me that she couldn't do anything about it. I told her "happy holidays!" but that I wanted her to be aware of that cashier and the fact that she seems to be stealing from customers. I also told her that I would be back later in the afternoon to claim my receipt. When I walked back into the store, Mary Kay didn't recognize me after taking a shower and fixing myself up, but gladly gave my receipt back. I told her again, that I would love nothing more for her to prove me wrong- but that she couldn't at this point. Oh, and on my receipt, it shows the cash tendered as $5.70- the amount of my order and the change as $0.00. I told her that she should teach her cashiers to input the correct amount of money into the system. Mary Kay told me that the cashier "normally did" but accidentally entered the wrong amount, cleared it out and entered the order total in place of the amount I gave her- proof again, that they have no record of me handing them a $10 or a $20 bill. Normally, I would just let something like this go, but I've experienced these type of occurrences way too many times lately. Customers need to be aware and alert when dealing with drive-through folk so that issues like this don't happen. It's more than just the $10- in fact, I spent more in gas to drive back up to Whitestown to get my receipt. It's about doing what is honorable and good. It's not OK for kids to steal EVER. If people let things like this happen, people will continue to take advantage. Which is again, NOT OK.
It's McDonald's.  They are open late and have tasty ice cream.  The staff seems friendly enough.  The inside is clean.  Okay by me.

I don't really eat at fast food spots that much, but when i don i tend to go to the obvious and it is McDonalds, Some of the people here are rude,  the service with no smile, and it took for ever to get my food. Whatever happened to fast food served with a smile?

I'll never forget the time during the morning rush when the delivery truck hadt parked in the at the ordering speaker and blocked the drive-thru.  Duh.  

I asked if coffee came with breakfast combo and the woman said yes.  I was then charged for coffee.  If all coffee is .89 or whatever, all coffee in the combo should be that much, no?  Bad coffee anyway. DD does it better.

Avoid this McDonalds at all costs, they always screw you on drive through with their stale food because they don't think you'll come back.  They take their location for granted.   It's a shame because 12+ months ago they were awesome.  I live 2 minutes from this McD, but I drive 15 minutes in the other direction to 5 Points because the food (in Deptford) is consistently cold. They make SO MANY fries in advance that it is impossible for you get a fresh order without demanding and actually watching make it.  And YES, you have to watch them.  So basically, their best selling item's grease is getting cold before it ever makes to your bag.  I don't know how many times they billed me for a double quarter only to give me a single.  Once I got a rock hard stale Quarter Pounder that must have been sitting under the heat lamp for HOURS.  They move so slow there, that sometimes they appear to be moving backwards.  Don't even get me started on breakfast.  

Also, this McDonald's has been open longer than I can remember...I wonder why here in Dec 2011 I had to be the one to add it.
Its ok for a mcdonald's. when I was in here had to listen to a woman tell me about how her purse was stolen here, and one thing led to another in conversation. I do take out here but that's it.
Just a regular Mickey Dee's.  Someetimes its fast, sometimes its slow: welcome to the fast food world!  still cheap & decent food for on the go.  Toatlly addicted to their fries since I was like 3.
Sometimes all I really need in a meal is just a McChicken, French Fries, & Sweet Tea. :) Only problem is that there is no drive thru window here which is very crucial to me.
This McDonald's service has improved recently... Maybe it's due to the renovations nearing completion? Love the 2-lane drive thru & super nice service!

Drive thru wise; The drive thru lane is generally quite clear of debris and snow.  The person taking your order is generally quite polite although there has been multiple occasions where they forget to give you an item which can sometimes be a hassle especially when they sometimes forget to also give you your reciept.

Dining in wise; The place is always tidy and clean. The person taking your order is generally polite and prompt in getting your order together and correct.  They have quite spacious seating. They have free wifi available.  They have an indoor children's playground so your kids can blow off some energy while you relax. 

This location is open 24 hours which is convenient for the night owls.

This McDonalds is awful!  The inside is nice but you have to survive the parking lot first.  The lot is tiny and poorly designed.  When I went to leave I was trapped by the drive thru line for a good 5 minutes.  That line was already backed up into the street, so there was no way for anyone to let me out.  To top it off, I realized that they'd charged me for adding Big Mac sauce to my McDouble.  How is that any more expensive than the ketchup and mustard I took off?!  Ridiculous.  I've ordered the same thing from at *least* two dozen different McDonalds across the US and I've never been charged.  30 cents on a $1 burger is ridiculous!!!  Do yourself a favor and pass by this McDonalds.  If you're on 70 driving through Indy there are much better McD's on other exits.

One star because of the two ladies with pleasant attitudes at midnight  this past weekend.  This place is less than a mile from my home, but at this point, I'm willing to travel to a different McDonald's or a different spot for my late night crave...downtown.  It took me over 30 minutes to get fish and fries.  My friend made it from midtown St. Louis to Fairview Heights, drove through Taco Bell and was done eating before I got my food.

The owner needs to spent a little cash and hire another person for the late nights on the weekends.  I went back...one cash register open on a Saturday morning?!  Ridiculous!!!!!

I'll admit that I enjoy "slumming" it at McDonalds from time to time and this one's the closest to my work.  There is no shame in it.  I've been there about a hundred times in the last few years.  Why do I keep going back you ask?  The convenience.  And I also get off on torturing myself with the bad service.  In the end, it can be therapeutic to atone for one's many past culinary sins and this McDonald's is a good place for that.  

Let's be honest.  Fast food has it's place, and within that place its capable of reaching five stars.  But this McDonald's is far from it.  I can't say how many times they have totally screwed up my order.  But I refuse to be one of those people that takes forever in line after they give me my food to check it prior to driving off while everyone behind you is cursing your existence!  The line is slow enough (by McDonald's standards) already.  

The french fry quality is somewhat below average.  Probably a 2 out of 5 stars with the occasional 3 star job.  I know of a number of other McDonalds that consistently hit 4 or 5 star french fries.  And YES!  5 star fries (though rare) are possible in a fast food restaurant.

One last comment.  The thing this McDonalds screws up most often is the coffee.  When I order coffee I am always sure to ask that they ADD cream and splenda TOO the coffee.  They get this right about 3 out of 5 times with the other 2 just giving me the creams and splendas separately in a bag.  I have given up asking them to add 2-3 ice cubes to the coffee so that it's a "drinkable" temperature.  They almost always just shovel a load of ice into the cup making it luke warm or even cold.  

Conclusion
The other day I went through for breakfast and was pleased to actually see the manager for once.  I get the feeling that management knows there is a problem, but it may take some time to get things right here.  This McDonalds could be improved to a solid three star rating by simply getting their ordering correct 90% of the time.  Right now they get something wrong about 60-70% of the time.  If you order anything more complicated than a meal with a  coke, you dramatically increase your chances of getting something screwed up.  Another star could be added by changing out the french fry oil more frequently and  doing a better job of serving fresher fries.  I don't think they will ever get the 2 lane ordering system perfected no matter how hard management tries but that one would get them half a star, and the other half star would come from cleaning the inside more regularly.

This Location Really is Uber Baddd !!! Its totallly Unorganized and the Service to their customers is non existant.  The one rhing that they have going in their direction is that they are consistantly in the same mess. Wait times for regular menu items are Loooooooong !! 20 minutes for a #2 is not worth the wait. Sorry Ronald , can't  come back !!

1. They only have sweet tea, apple juice, and milk. But not chocolate milk. 
2. The drive through is 24 hours but you'll have to drive all the way to the front or else you'll interrupt the conversation of the girl who really doesn't mind that you bothered her...but stop bothering her, drive up. 

Uhm. Ok. McDonald's, if this is your best I'm going to Rally's. 
Oh. Wait. 
There's a disgruntled employee yelling in the background. Oh, that's the manager? My bad...I just expected it to be a tad more professional.

The playplace smells like it hasn't been cleaned since it opened, I walked in there and started gagging. And it seem liked a junior high group was in there and taking up all the play space from the younger kids. But not a lot of room in the actual eating area so maybe blame that.

its Mcdonalds.....the staff was friendly and the order was correct, thats about all you could review at McD's.
Note: This is in a part of town where low lifes hang out during the day so expect some panhandeling dirtbag to hit you up for some change.
McDonalds food is what it is, but this location has an awesome indoor play space including some free video games.  Great for a rainy day with kids.

It's a Mc Donald's located inside the Daily's Convenience store on the corner of Old Hickory and Edmondson. It's cheap, it's quick, and most importantly, it's on my way to work. When I'm running late or haven't had the time to make myself something at home; I find myself running in here for a quick burger. The fact it's located in the convenience store is really the selling point for me. If I need to stop for gas or sundries, the smell of the fries when I come inside to pay usually can tempt me.
Service was slow at 2:30pm. Waited for nearly 10 min. dine in. Finally received order and both where wrong. Order was corrected but my angus burger was lukewarm at best. Would not suggest this place.

Your run of the mill Mickey D's. The construction made it difficult to get into this place, so for breakfast and lunch hours the drive thru line is really long.
The food is what is expected if a McD, and I've never had an order messed up here.

For some reason, eating fast food while home in Brentwood doesn't gross me out the way it does when in San Francisco.

Anyway, my dad and I came in last week and it was a nice experience.  Friendly employees, fast food, clean dining room, what more would you want?  Sure, the decor is outdated, but it's not in bad condition.
This is the slowest, rudest Mickey D's in town. Its also the only one close enough to walk to, so...I will be back.
This particular location charged me more for iced coffee than any other place. I told them they were wrong but the drive thru kid had no clue!

Best McDonald's with a play place in Reno. Pretty good wifi and the regular coffee is pretty good here at the McCafe. All the standard McD's fare. Great place to take your kids on an icy cold day where they can play indoors while you sip hot coffee, cruise the internet and eat mcnuggets for $4.99 a 20 piece (that's just dangerous).

Sadly, I go to this McDonald's a LOT, and I love going through the drive-thru.  Every single time I go, whether it's breakfast rush or at 4 pm on a Tuesday, the drive thru staff is so cheerful and polite.  I don't know whether they actually do enjoy their jobs, but they sure act like they do.  It really is what keeps me coming back- they always grin and thank me and tell me to have a great day, no matter whether I've seen them before or not.  The very few mistakes I've received with an order were quickly corrected and apologized for.

First off, I am not a fan of McD's at all. But I was really bummed when it was closed New Year's Day. I was tired from the night before and just wanted to grab an Egg McMuffin. I have rarely known a McD's to close and rarer yet without any signs posted ANYWHERE! Ridiculous. 

I felt so bad there were people waiting in the drive through, including myself. A simple LED message on the drive-through screen would have been helpful "Sorry We're Closed New Year's Day" and I would have thought that perfectly acceptable. I even got out to look on the doors of the establishment and no signs were posted there either. Very disappointing experience and it makes me like McDonald's even less.

Yikes, the morale at this location is horrible.

Stopping here at 12:30am after getting in from the airport, I thought "let's pick up a few things off the $1 menu. Ordering 4 things, the total was $4.40. The person was wearing a button down white shirt so I'm guessing he's the night shift manager.

I am disappointed that he rounded to the nearest nickel so that he did not have to deal with the pennies.

Food: Burger was fine. Fries were cold like they had been sitting out.

Hands down best McDonald's experience ever. We were in and out in no time even-though I had no clue what I wanted because I haven't seen a McDonald's menu in years. Well almost in and out in no time. I had to order the chocolate shake just when the machine decided to run out of chocolate. The reason for the 5 stars is the cashier apologizing over and over. Give the "man" a raise.

Typical McDonalds service and quality of food.

Lunch time service seems to be there best time to go here since the morning service has been slow and anytime of 6PM the quality of food goes down a lot. Specifically the oil used seems to not be changed at all and the fries are ice cold. Additionally after 6PM the orders are hit or miss if you want something extra on your sandwich or if you want a plain burger, etc. 

Go to the one over on Trooper Rd. or better yet go to WaWa across the street. 
I wish they had better service and more consistent quality of food especially since they are so close, such a waste. I prefer Chik-fil-a for breakfast and most other meals anyway especially since they actually give you your food fast and hot as well as it being correct.

How did I become the Duchess of a McDonalds?! This is almost embarrassing...

The three stars I gave in this review is in comparison to other McDonalds locations and does indicate that I think this is somehow a "exceptional" restaurant in any way.

Every time I have been here, they do exactly what you expect from McDonalds: fast and friendly service, clean tables, mediocre food and long lines at noon hour. Vegetarian options are limited as at any McDonalds and since their salads are premade, even those can't be made without the meat.

Biggest issue? No matter who helps me, they rarely seem to understand what I want when I ask for mayo for my fries. It's not THAT weird a request.

You would think McD's would have a "standard" in all their restaurants.  CLEARLY they do NOT here!

Came in here for a quick breakfast because, hey, it's a McDonald's, right?  They have fresh brewed, corporate-provided coffee, right? They have an Egg McMuffin that taste's the same here as the one in Miami, in Chicago, in Po'dunk, Iowa, RIGHT??? 

W R O N G ! ! !

If there was a one-QUARTER star to rate this place, I think THAT would be too high.

The coffee was (diplomatically) one step up above POND SLUDGE!  It was disgusting!  The egg in the Egg McMuffin was so dry it was reverting back to it's POWDER form!  And, cheese is NOT suppose to "snap" when you bite into it.  I showed this to the lady at the counter and she said, "we make all these fresh every morning."  Okay, WHICH morning two weeks ago did you make this one???

The orange juice was no better.  If you took a tablespoon of Tang and put it in a QUART of water.....yeah, that would be close to it.

I'm sorry.  I don't mean to bash a place in one of my favorite cities on Earth but I just want to warn everybody what they can expect (unless, of course, "corporate" sees this and other reviews and does something about it).

I'll never know because I'll never go back.

This is one of the cleanest and friendliest McDonald's I've ever been to.  They are always fast and friendly.  Although, McDonalds food is subpar and a guilty habit I like to indulge in occasionally this is one of the best restaurants to go to for it.   

Friendly, clean, and prompt....I really like this one!

Wow, this is the NASTIEST restroom that i have ever seen. I picture that ones in jail are cleaner than this. Graffitti everyone and floor was sticky and there was &^$( on the floor.  Took one look and made a bolt for the door.
The completely remodeled nature of this location is the reason for 3 stars. If you insist on eating Mickey D's, eat at this location.

Went to this Mickey D's for the second or third time today with my gf. It's a decent place as fast food chains go.. but for some reason.. they don't have water at their drink stations.. Is water now too fuckin expensive to where people have to buy the bottles?? I do not understand that.. Every other drink is one dollar.. but water.. water is two dollars... MIND FUCKED

Oh my gosh...avoid this mcdonald's if you can. That's what I have always tried to do, but since it's the closest one to me, sometimes I have no choice. Today's experience was by far the worst. So, about half the times when I order a non-fat caramel mocha (the warm drink, NOT the frappe), I end up getting the frappe. I thought, oh maybe since the caramel mocha hasn't been on the menu as long as the frappe, people automatically think frappe. So, the last few times, I decided to specifiy WARM caramel mocha, and they usually get it right then. But today, I decided to be brave and just ask for the non-fat caramel mocha (w/o saying warm), and instead I got something way worse than a frappe. When she was making it, I noticed that it was in a frappe container. But was fine with this b/c I like the frappes anyway too, and didn't want to hold up the line b/c it was lunchtime and busy. So, then she handed me the frappe, and I noticed that it was liquid. So, I thought to myself, maybe they just switched to having the warm caramel mochas to the frappe containers. Boy was I wrong! When I took a sip, it was not warm. Sooooo, it was supposed to be a frappe. But there was no frappe consistency at all. It was just a watered caramel frappe. No ice consistency, but just pure liquid. I was astonished that this was served! 

You never know what you're gonna get with this McDonald's. The worst McDonalds experiences always come from here.

Let's be for-real-real, not for-play-play. One McDonald's is like another. I hadn't been to one in over a year because I like to avoid fast food if I can. If I were to find something to rank about McDoo it's the surliness of the employees. Thus said, this place is a pretty average ranking. The girl who helped me was unpleasant but not out-right unkind.

It is what it is what it is.

I'm not proud of the fact I hit the occasional drive thru. It's just too darn quick and easy. The next time I'm tempted to stop in, I'll try to remember the wave of nausea and gastric distress my wife and I both experienced shortly after eating a burger from this McDonald's.

If I could give less then one star I would. I stopped here on my way home last night, to pick up all of 4 items. There were two people ahead of me, so I thought it would go quick... I was wrong.
The first car went threw quick enough, but the car just a head was just sitting there for almost an hour.
Two cars behind me left while waiting, and if I hadn't been with someone else I would have left too.
After the hella long wait, the only explanation they had was "we ran out of meat, and had to have someone drive to the other location, to pick some up".

We didn't get a sorry, or even offered something for our wait, just the lame excuse.
I will never ever come back to this location again.

This is one of the "retro" McDonald's and it's one of the better ones in New Orleans East.  The place is always clean, always busy, and the employees are friendly.  The orders also are filled quickly, always a plus especially in the mornings.

This location is inconsistent.  Sometimes it bats it out of the park, and then there are times that the batter must be blind because of the misses.

This location has a dual drive thru and that does cause some confusion when you get to the first window.  Don't bother coming here in the mornings, because the lines will be long (both inside and out) and the service inside is slow.

I frequent here only because of location convenience. A lot of times i been here you end up waiting typically longer than usual for fastfood, i mean.... It is FASTFOOD but apparantly they dont live up to that quality.

Wish I never had to easy at Mcdonalds. But it seems sometime you have to do what you have to do when you are hungry. As far as a fast food restaurant is concerned this one is nice, and they really are fast!

Ok first, I don't think this place deserves just one star. It's not THAT bad, even though there are people who love to shit on this location. But it also certainly doesn't deserve more than 2 stars.

You may be asking yourself why the heck this guy is reviewing a McDonald's. It's mainly to point out how bad this place is compared to other McD I've been to.

First, the environment is pretty smelly upon entering. Seriously. There's some perpetual stink to the place that I can't (and don't want) put a finger on. 

Environment: 1/5

The food is pretty typical except that there's some feel of dirtiness because the air is kinda stinky. Also, one time I ordered two salads with chicken, and I literally got the amount of lettuce of 1 salad, split into two bowls and with an extra piece of chicken. 

Food: 2/5

Good for late-night snacking as always, however, as would be expected of any Mcd.

Go to Jimmy John's instead, unless you're craving something super oily at night.

This has become quite possibly the worst McDonald's in Northern Delaware. Let's start with the layout. Either the drive-thru is too short or service is too slow at peak hours, so the drive-thru line regularly goes back out to US-202, blocking highway traffic. The parking area is small, tight, and possibly inadequate, although there is the option of parking at their management building next door.

When I got there, someone was sweeping dirt from the front step. I have no idea why he scowled when he had to stop sweeping so I could enter the restaurant.

The cashier is probably hard of hearing. I had to repeat my order 4 times before she got it right and she clearly was distracted the second time I said my order.

And finally, the menu board pricing is not accurate. I ordered just one item and it rang up on the register 10 cents higher than the menu price. This is not excusable.

For the antisocial person who wants greasy food - this is the drive through for you! Every delicious burger and fry is almost exactly the same due to ample preservatives in every bite. From ordering to food delivery it only took 2 minutes - with only 30 seconds of actual human contact. Its not fancy and certainly not healthy - but damn is it tasty and consistent.

This McDonald's is in a strip mall off Scarlett Road in Kennett Square. This is a pretty standard McDonald's with an up-to-date look. Service was a bit slipshod. They gave me a sauce different from what I requested for the McBites, but that is minor.

This is our neighborhood McDonald's.

They recently tore down the entire building and built a new McDonald's where the old one stood. That's pretty badass. Double drive-through and everything. There are multiple plasma televisions on the inside, although I'm not sure why that is necessary in a fast-food joint. 

The drive-through is open 24 hours. 

The food is still overall pretty shitty, but cheap. The fries are great, as usual, and my wife likes their coffee.

Not my favorite Mickey Ds, but it's close by and sometimes that's the most important thing.  Food quality is hit and miss. Service is spotty at best.  A few times, they couldn't take a credit card.

It's ok in a pinch. Oh, and it's open 24 hrs.

The closest location to me that offers several burgers and sandwiches for $1.  While the food is your typical McDonalds fare, the service tends to be on the poor side at times.  Too often the cashiers are in the drive-thru window area yacking with each other while lines form waiting for service.

My daughter loves McD's, so I take her every now and then for her happy meal, and most importantly(in her little mind), her toy! 
The food is like any other McD, good. The fries and my daughters chicken nuggets are always fresh and hot. 
The only reason why I'm giving them 3 stars is because of the bad service. I was the only one in line, waiting to order a simple 4 piece chicken nugget happy meal. Their was a girl at one register, two other employees(one fixing a machine and the other trying to refill the ice cream machine), and a MANAGER!! 
The manager was teaching the employee how to refill the machine in a very mean way, then stood behind a cash register. They were all standing behind the counter, and nobody bothered to take my order. I did notice that the guy fixing the machine wanted to say something to either the manager or the girl at the register, but didn't. I stood there for about ten minutes, until finally the girl said,"have you been helped?" I said no, and ordered. 
I've witnessed other occasions, where the manager is screaming at an employee for not mopping the correct way or taking the wrong order. I honestly think this should be done in an office and not in front of customers. Very unprofessional.
Other than that, this is your typical McD's with a dinosaur theme!!

Don't be fooled...this place is only a McDonald's.  The decor may be nicer than the usual that is found at the Golden Arches, but the food is the same.  The service is what you would expect from a busy, fast-food restaurant.

Of course, I only go to this McDonald's later in the evening for vanilla soft serve and coffee.

This is a typical McDonald's.  The drive-thru is fairly fast although sometimes a particular customer will back it up and cause a problem.  One day particularly, I was in the drive-thru almost ten minutes before finally getting to the window.  When I got to the window (breakfast time), the cashier told me they were out of hash browns and it would be another 3-4 minutes.  Luckily they let me swap it out for something else since I wasn't going to wait that long, but it was just an annoying experience.

Most of the time the food I receive is cold as though it's been sitting under not-very-effective heat lamps for a while.  I even have had two experiences where I received the wrong order.  The second time this happened I had driven off with it before I realized the mistake so it was too late to go back and get it corrected.

Some of their prices are ridiculous, but I guess that goes for all McDonald's and not just this location.  But for example, a regular single patty hamburger costs the same amount as a McDouble, and a regular single patty cheeseburger costs -more- than a McDouble.  Also most of the regular lunch combos are getting really expensive, so I stick to the dollar menu unless I'm there for breakfast.

Reviewing McDonald's is kind of a cheat, since everyone knows what McDonald's is and what they have to offer. The food is pretty much the same everywhere you go. 

That being said, I hardly ever go there. Last night, I did go by this local McDonald's after a meeting and I had a Quarter Pounder with Cheese meal. These things are made all the time by millions of McDonald's around the world.

As I checked in, I saw that the other reviews were both one star, and I thought that might be kind of harsh...but really, that turned out not to be the case. My fellow Yelpers had it right...this is a one-star restaurant, in a chain that spends so much time and effort on training and inspection that it has no excuse for being a one-star restaurant.

I was there at about 8:30, and there weren't many other people there. I was one of two cars in the drive-thru. The car in front of me ended up having to park in the "parking for drive-thru only" spot to wait for their stuff. I ordered, paid, and received my meal - and they were still sitting there. What did they order that was was complicated that it took an entire restaurant full of workers who were focused on just their order - and they still couldn't get it out fast? 

They did manage to get mine out fast, but everything was cold...and I mean cold, cold, not just lukewarm. How disappointing. I didn't check my bag at the window (I was just happy to have a bag, unlike the car in front of me!), but I found out when I dipped my hand in to grab a few fries on the way home. 

If you are in that area and are in the mood for McDonald's, I recommend Cave Springs, Fifth Street, or Zumbehl.

Quickest service McD I've ever seen. I eat lunch here regularly. However they are still working on the parking lot so traffic around the building is a pain unless you are doing the drivethru lane - its pretty good.

This is the WORST McDonalds I've ever eaten at, and it's only a mile away from my house. They routinely put pepper on their hamburgers but don't warn you - YUCK! And they CHARGE now for adding mayo, but don't give you a break for keeping the lettuce or pickles.

They told me their Peppermint Mochas can be made in sugarfree, then the person making it told me no, only vanilla and caramel are in sugarfree.  THE WORST THING?  When I told her I am diabetic, she actually told me it "will be ok, my aunt is diabetic and she drinks them all the time."  CAN YOU BELIEVE THAT?  She could kill somebody!

I don't usually go to mcdonalds. Honestly, I stopped here to use the restroom and bought some fries. The manager was so professional and constantly moving and checking on things, I had to write a review. Very clean, well-managed store.

I may be dating myself with this, but what the hell. 

How many of you remember the song, "McDonald's is my kind of place, (clap, clap) It's such a happy place" Will let me tell, you the reason they stopped using that song is because of the customer service at this location. Not only are the cashiers and staff rude, but so are the managers. I guess they lead by example. 

What makes this sad is the fact that for a McDonald's the food is better then most. I live in between two McDonald's both on Hampton and this one has the better Egg McMuffins and Sausage Biscuits when we have the morning craving.  I have also, stopped by when the Cheeseburger craving hits too.  I hate to admit it, I put up with the poor attitude, to get the better food. 

I never use their drive-thru, it is to slow. I have always found it faster if I park and go inside. When I am exiting with my food, most of the cars in line have made little or no progress at all. 

The ambiance is more upscale then those with attached Playlands, and as previously stated the food is better then other McDonald's. If they could improve the attitude of the entire staff, believe it or not this would be a 4 star McDonald's.

This place used to mess up orders all the time. Not for a long while, now.

The drive-through moves quickly. I've ordered inside for carryout once or twice . . . mostly drive-through. And I've noticed when it's not moving, it's because of the orderer . . . not because of McDonald's.

I loved this quick opportunity for a cheap beverage when they had extra-large beverages, and I could get a diet Coke for about $1. Sadly, they're gone now.

The egg-cheese-Canadian bacon muffin sandwich is a reasonable breakfast option at about 300 calories. And I ditch the top muffin half to get down to 17 carbs. Ditch the entire muffin, and you've got 4 carbs.

And they've got free wifi.

The order-taker, the money-taker and the food-giver are always friendly and smiling!

I've been many times. Inside a couple times. Mostly drive-through.

They've got a double drive-through, which always makes me nervous that I'm either going to pay for the other guy's food or GET the other guy's food. But it's never happened.

The order-takers, money-takers (particularly when I'm counting out change to give them) and food-givers are always friendly and smiling.

I like to get the McDouble when it's $1. I get two, ditch both buns and have a meal for 10 carbs. Ditch the ketchup on both, and carbs are down to 6 with 460 calories. This is not something you eat in public!

They've got free wifi.

DISGUSTING. The floor is covered in spilled stains, the smell of this place is revolting.

Went in to use the Wi-Fi and had to leave.

HELLA SLOW ASS SERVICE!

Maybe in the bay area we move too fast and our life style is VERY FAST. 

But i mean WTH! REALLY! i left my room at the Silver Legacy at 9:00 pm on the dot and got back in my room at 9:45! 

REALLY!? UGH! 

Oh and no dollar menu! BoOoOoOooOooOoooo! 

lets not forget the fact that it was DIRTY AS F*CK! Fries, Cups and crap EVERYWHERE and on the floors.

I understand its a freakin` mickey deez but REALLY! IT SHOULD BE FAST FOOD! AND THESE LADIES WERE MOVING HELLA SLOW! UGH!

I never expect much from McDonald's in the first place, but this place sinks below even their standard. It is routinely dirty, and the staff is quite rude, even in the presence of the morning manager who does little to correct the problems. For a great breakfast sandwich go two blocks south on 10th St to Sam's Fresh Spot. The owners are a very nice, polite couple who use quality ingredients and cook things up fresh when you order. It takes a little more time, but the wait is well worth it. Avoid this McDonald's at all costs!

This McDonalds rocks. I've never encountered friendlier employees and customers of any fast food restaurant in St. Louis! I walked in the other day for some oatmeal and a coffee and everyone was nodding, smiling, tipping their hat at me -- this place deserves to be next to a Home Depot. I'm going to make it a point to come back next time I'm hungry on Hanley.

Lots of parking, too, and easy on/off access to the road. Just a good setup in general, here.
I am only giving 5 stars because the Shamrock Shake is back and delicious!! Too bad it's around only once a year ;(

It's cheap. Sometimes it's tasty. Most of the time the food is old. But you get what you pay for. Childhood staple. 

Soft serve ice cream is pretty killer

Meh, It's a McDonald's.  It lives up to their corporate standards.  The free Wi-Fi seemed very fast.  Very convenient to I-70, Holt Road exit.  Take Holt  Road just 1 block south of the Interstate, and you can't miss it, on the corner of Holt and Morris.
Quick fast service and Great food in a hurry! Great Customer service!

Every time my family and I go to this restaurant, I always have some issues. From taking my order completely wrong to having their credit card machine down, this restaurant will not provide you a issue free meal. Even though this location is closer to home, we have decided to travel a little bit longer in order to enjoy a good meal. I strongly DO NOT recommend this place to anyone.

Went in because I needed to sit down on my laptop for 20 minutes and they have WiFi. The ING Direct and Starbucks nearby were packed. I ordered a large unsweetened iced tea. The menu said "Iced Tea $1.00" and underneath that "Sweet Tea" with no additional price, so I presumed both were $1.00. In fact I was charged $1.08.

Then AFTER I paid the cashier informed me that the unsweetened iced tea was actually around $3.00, so I would be getting sweet tea; "That' ok?" No, it's not ok. I'm diabetic. After much reluctance and a healthy side of 'tude I was given what I originally ordered, and I'm glad I could see it being poured because I wouldn't have been surprised if it was otherwise spat in.

I had hoped to go to their upstairs seating area to avoid the riff-raff of drug addicts, sleeping homeless people and general obnoxious ghetto folk, only to attempt the door and discover it was locked. So I sat in the window as far away from everyone as possible, did my internetting and got the hell out of dodge.

The two stars is because the internet connection was fast and reliable.

The wife and I stopped here to grab a quick bite to eat before going to a movie saturday night;  what should have been a simple meal and quick turned into me returning my hamburger twice becuz it was made wrong and then they rang us up with the wrong amount.. After everything else the guy behind the counter had an attitude when he obviously wasn't listen when we placed our order. We will not be making the mistake of coming here again  poor show!

This mcdonalds has screwed up my drive through order way too many times to count.....I just stay away now! I once gave the kid working the counter my money and he shorted me $4.00..... I pointed it out and he didn't ask for a receipt......just opened the draw and gave me the difference.....REALLY? If you choose to frequent this store make sure you check your order REAL GOOD

ZERO stars if I could!!!

Completely disgusting! These people have no idea how to run a fast food restaurant or even how to interact with the public. The worst McDonalds in the Country!

I had my order screwed up beyond words and I was treated with no respect or consideration. Oh heaven forbid I interrupted a conversation about someone's nails or hair extensions for them to pay attention long enough to help customers standing in line.
I go here weekly for a breakfast with a bunch of guys.  I NEVER notice things like cleanliness, but this place is clean.  Staff friendly.  It even has a somewhat cozy atmosphere.   Free WiFi.

I've returned on several occasions at different times and, with the exception of one time forgetting to open the fry box all the way which gave me a skimpy order (they also corrected the issue), they have done a pretty good job with their orders and service.

I stopped here because it is within walking distance form where I work.  I was craving ice cream and decided to get a McFlurry.  It's clean and I was waited on promptly.  I try to avoid McDonalds, but they are OK for ice cream.

It's McDonalds.....  What more can you really say in a review?

Ok, so this Mcdonalds is a little on the ghetto side.  This does not really bother me because one thing you learn quickly in this city is that the richer they are the snobbier and unwelcoming they become. So, go in, smile, be nice and you will surely be encountered with a little staring (which is normal) and a prompt smile back at you.

Service is quick and the staff is as friendly as working in a St Charles fast food joint at 4:00am can get. Place could be cleaner, but that just adds to the experience. My only gripe with this place is that your can't order from the outside if you don't have a car. I know its called a "drive trough" but dammit can't you just sell me the nuggets when I most need them!

They do have some shortages of food once in a while (they were missing nuggets one very very late nigh of January) but, in general, they have all the artery clogging goodness we have all come to know, and love.

Don't be scared to go in!

Enjoy!!

Reviewing a lookup restaurant, c'mon I can't be serious. Well, actually I am.

First, what the heck is a lookup restaurant? This is the type of restaurant that when you walk in, you have to stand in line and look up to see the menu.

Now, back to McDonalds. This isn'tnecessarily specific to this location, it is a one size fits all kind of comment.

They have really decent coffee! Now there are a lot of coffee snobs out there who won't agree, but if all you want is a decent cup of coffee and maybe a breakfast sandwich to go with it, McDonalds should be a place to consider.

I am all for the coffee house, but don't overlook some of our other slightly less obvious options.

So, I never EVER eat at McDonalds. 
But, today, I've eaten there twice and it's only noon (we needed lots of grease today to soak-up the excessive amount of St. Paddy's day beverages that we quaffed yesterday.) 
Anyway, I've only gone through the drive-up window, but each time the service was super duper fast, the orders weren't screwed up, the food was hot and the servers were actually really pleasant. 
I don't like McDonald's burgers but I do love me a filet-o-fish sandwich with copious amounts of tartar sauce on it. 
So, just rating this McDonalds location, I give it 4 stars. EE-I-EE-I-O.

I still dont know how this place stays in business. The employees are all kids and talk to customers like crap. I've actually heard a manager yell at a cashier and told her to "get her ass out of there and go home." Never ever go there with your kids. Constant cursing rom the Levittown rats in there.

They never get the order right.  Some of the employees are very rude.  One manager actually asked the kitchen if they had put two patties on my burger as if to say I had stolen a patty off the sandwich.  The owner seemed very responsive to me, but the employee continues to work there and be rude to more customers.  Stay away from Amy on the night shift here.
Nothing special waited 5 minutes for 2 cars before me in the drive thru on around 8 o'clock which I think is a long time to wait

Avoid this POS place.

The fries were old and brown, not golden. My very pregnant and very thirsty wife asked for a cup of water at the drive through window and was told she would have to pull up and they would bring it out to her.

F off.

I have the misfortune of having this MCDs being closest to our home and the Dance school my daughter goes to, the onyl thing consistant about this MCD is that they consistantly suck. Over the last year or so you would see Corp looking MCD people with their little clip boards walking around the rest and you think, oh boy! they are going to get this place running the way it should! Literally one of the worst experiences dealing with incompetence in my life. I had the best date here the other night. I highly recommend getting the apple pie. 2 for $1?? The prices can't be beat. The place is really clean too. So clean that in the middle of our meal one of the staff was actually mopping the floor around us as we ate! Now that's what I call keeping things up to snuff. We will definitely be coming here again.

As McDonalds restaurants go, this seems to be well run.  The food came out quickly and we were on our way.  

The restaurant was clean, and even the bathrooms were well stocked.  Every worker was engaged and I was pleasantly surprised.

After watching a documentary about Mc Donald's Corporation (not supersize me) This Mc Donald's has the worse service I've ever experienced.  The word fast  does not go along with the food.  In the morning before 6am on a Wednesday  only 2 cars in front of me in the drive thru and my wait was 15 minutes.  They are either very under staffed or can not multi-task .  This establishment is always my last resort.  In the 6 years I've worked next to Mc Donald's it has always had the same problem.  It's frustrating and loses my service.  It appears upper management doesn't seem to care since no changes have been made.
Not very clean, The food was hot & my order was right! This Mcdonalds normally gets your order wrong, if you special order sandwiches.

I went in here for an egg mcmuffin, and it was made with the wrong kind of egg! It's not often I make in time for mcdonnalds breakfast, and I was really disappointed. They could have told me! Next ill go to another location...

Worst McDonald's I have ever eaten at.
Poor customer service, and slow; really slow, cold food. The sign outside says McDonlads, but the quality of service and food does not measure up to the standards of this company.

snarky treatment over wrong order....
I've been going to this location for a few months now and there's a consistent lack of organization. When you first walk in, customers are all standing around asking: "are you next?" "are you in line" "where's the line". I try to give the benefit of the doubt, so I've attempted many time slots, different shifts, etc. I've even tried when it's dead. There can be 2 people in the place, and nobody at the drive-through... yet it takes 5 minutes and 3 people to make a 'large iced coffee'. Today was the worst ever!
It was mid-morning with very little business. When the standing customers agreed it was my turn (a line would help), I stepped up, ordered my usual large iced coffee. Plain, no syrup. When my number was called.. I picked up my coffee and there was some sort of brown goopy stuff on the inside rim under the lid. I can have NO Gluten, and was unsure of the 'syrups', so I went back up to the front. It became a confrontation. And actual confrontation. I was told it's normal; it's syrup. i asked for no syrup, no it's liquid sugar. I asked if there was gluten in the syrup. With a snippy attitude he looked at the label and proclaimed it fine. OK.. the observed 'liquid sugar' was clear. NOT Brown! So what is the brown stuff? The guy huffed, puffed, rolled his eyes and said," I don't have time for this" and left. WHAT???? Another guy just stared at me like I had 3 eyes. i finally said, "I'm not comfortable with a mystery ingredient, and with GREAT snark, my large iced coffee was replaced. 
OK, it's a little example. BUT, while I was waiting, a string of people came in with wrong orders received from the drive-through. One guy had a substandard burrito. The item was examined and debated. Another lady brought in a completely wrong order, and it ALSO was inspected.. at LENGTH, and finally replaced. 
I was hopeful I'd be able to eventually discuss gluten with the manager and possibly feel safe eating SOMETHING... ANYTHING at this location. That's looking like a long shot. On the up side... The employees seem to be nice to each other.

Had a Big Mac from here and the bun was burnt. Had a salad and the lettuce was old and soggy. The salad was so old the cheese on it had melted from the room temperature surrounding wherever they store them. Smh. It never crowded at the location, but they always take long. It's just a sucky place in general.
Der schlimmste Laden, den man sich vorstellen kann. Alles verdreckt und die Sanitäranlagen sind das blanke Grauen.

Don't judge me. 

The only thing this place has going for it... it's 24 hours. So on the rare chance I need to fuel up after hours (I get the irony here, food is fuel, McDonald's is not food...) this is one of the few spots on Campbell that's got the goods. But they're bads. Real bads. I had to pull back into the drive through to hand back cold fries and a burger that was done up incorrectly. They swapped the burger but felt the fries were fine I guess, because I'm certain they were the same. The burger sucked. It didn't taste like anything, just weird textural sensation that had no flavor. I'll add it's been MONTHS since I've had fast food, maybe my body doesn't know what to do with it?

If you're a fan of going through the drive-thru, then going inside because your order is all jacked up, then stop on in to this McDonald's. This happens every other time I stop by. 

Not lovin it.

If I could give 0 stars I would. The staff is not motivated at all an move slower than turtles. I'm trying to refrain from swearing as well. Incompetent for sure. I only order nuggets from here cuz they ALWAYS get the order wrong, ALWAYS!  I just left this McDonald's and set my timer web I got in.  15 EFIN MINUTES! Are you kidding me? One register open? Why do the make 4 of them?! Boycot this place and maybe we'll get a Sonic here instead! Screw this place!

This Mc Donald's has terrible service and cold food. Mc Donald's as a brand has really lost sight of what's important. I almost always encounter some problem at every Mc Donald's I go to. It may be crappy service, long waits, or old food. And sometimes, it's all 3. Not sure why I continue to go back.

I'll admit it... I am a bit addicted to McDonald's french fries... Ok, more than a little addicted. This location is very effectively helping me kick the habit.  Every single time I visit this location my potato item is cold and stale.  If I go for breakfast, my hash brown is cold and clammy.  If I go for lunch or dinner, cold, stiff, nasty french fries is what I get.  

The sandwiches always seem to be fresh and the drinks are always as I order them, it's just the potatoes they can't seem to get right... and I'm a potato kind of girl, so that's a problem.

The service is always acceptable from what I can tell, but I have only gone through the drive-thru.  There are only 4 or 5 parking spots at this location, so that makes it kinda difficult unless you feel like trekking from the parking lot way behind the building.  Uhh... no thanks for me.

It's a McDonald's, nothing crazy, I think you know what to expect. If you have kids, it is one with the play area.

They usually get the order right, the workers are fine, etc. The prices seem a little cheaper here than some of the other locations for some items.

Probably the nicest thing is the location. On a good spring/summer day, you can get a snack and head across the street to the park (a little far to the benches though) and sit outside. Not quiet "a jug of wine a loaf of bread and thou", but not too shabby either.

I just witnessed the most unsanitary and grossest event.

I came here through the drive through to grab some dinner for my kids on the way home.  I ordered them some burgers and fries.   After it taking forever to get through the line I got my food.   I pulled forward and decided to check the bags to make sure I'd received my order.

What I did see were 3 large fry containers that were less than 50% full.    Frustrating so I park and walk into the McDonalds.   I walked to the counter and explained the problem.  Staff was pleasant and they said they would take care of it.

The employee then took my 3 fry containers and DUMPED THEM BACK INTO THE FRYER.    Now, I would have been ok with two things:  1) add extra fries to the existing containers or 2) throw away the original fries and give new ones.   

What if someone had put something in those fries?  What if someone had put their hands in there and started eating the fries?   Why would you ever put those fries back into general population?

Next time my family requests McDonalds I'll be going to the one on Steamboat/Damonte Ranch and NOT this one.

arrived at Mcdonalds to purchase "chicken bites" and was told they no longer offer chicken bites. booo Mcdonalds!! I was told they will have a "spicy" version soon, however my children do not like spicy food.
One of the nicest McDonalds I've ever been to. Staff is polite and efficient. Despite the location, nobody seemed even particularly sketch.

I don't go here often since it's out of my way, but, it's a decent McDonald's.  I sometimes like it better than the one on Oregon for being quieter at times. Nothing particularly special about it otherwise.
Closest McDonald's to my house and for some reason their McRibs outdo other locations. No complaints whatsoever.

This McDonald's is a sewer.  My God, it's dark on the inside, the staff is a bunch of nasty looking people, most of them are tattoed all over their faces, necks, arms, and chests, They speak ignorantly, and are animals.  

Ewwwww, I feel dirty just thinking about there.  I'd rather drive extra miles to go to a nicer, CLEANER McDonald's

Efficient morning drive through.   

My kids enjoy looking at all the old toys and swearing they use to have the same toys.  I gave this a 3 because the workers seem to hate their jobs.

I typically don't expect a high level of service when I visit a place like McDonald's.  I do, however, expect some decent treatment from the manager or shift supervisor.  Don't expect that here.

Make sure you ask for straws at the drive thru and double check your order before pulling away.  Check for not only accuracy, but also that hot items are actually hot.  And cooked through.
It's McDonald's - what can you say. Fries are yummy and everything else is the same from store to store.
It's Mc Donald's and if that blows your skirt up you will be happy you went here.  Fairly good drive thru service here haven't ever been inside to see the cleanliness

Let's face it... we don't go to McDonald's for culinary excitement. We go because it's cheap, it's convenient or someone in your family (probably a small child) has succumbed to whatever mind-controlling substance they put in their chicken McNuggets and clamors for them.

What McDonald's does better than any other fast food chain, IMO, is get cars through the drive through. You know that feeling when you pull up, see the line of cars and immediately question the decision to come here. You are about to leave and... there's a car behind you and you are stuck in the line. Then the line starts moving and cars whiz past the final window as bags of McFood are snatched from the arm that appears.

McDonald's is the epitome of a chain. They are not a charming mom and pop business. The food is not exciting or nutritious. Yet... every time you pass the Golden Arches cars are lined up like ants. They probably got stuck in line.
They have a very nice play ground.  The drink area could stand to be a little cleaner and the restrooms are usually dirty.  The service is pretty quick most times.

Rejoice Mt. Julieters, the new McDonald's has opened.  No more will your requests for Hot Chocolate result in a cup of Coffee.

This is the latest generation of McDonald's with high tech digital menus and a huge playplace.  

It has just recently open so everyone was stopping in, so the dining room was a bit crazy, but I have faith that it will improve over time.

One of the FEW clean and well run McD's that I have visited and would patronize again. Great place for a noon lunchtime stop during the workday weekday. Clean tables and fast service. Friendly people. Traffic and parking can be a bit tricky as high volume drive-thru at this location and people speed so use care when your backing-up out of the parking space to leave.

Nothing worse than having to repeat your order 5 times and then its still wrong, you go in for an ice coffee and it looks like milk...and it has no ice. Dont ever go on a saturday or sunday and don't go inside, they dont speaky no english.

Worst McDonald's ever.

I've lived near this McDonald's for all of my life and can look back fondly on visits, but since Katrina I've regretted every visit. Here's why:

1. An employee named Tony used to always flirt with me. Super annoying when I'm in a rush to get somewhere.

2. Drive through at night is always shitty. The drive through is never open when it's supposed to be, and you always have to wait forever for food/service when it is open. After waiting over 30 mins for my 20 piece McNuggets, I asked for extra sauce. I figured it's the least they could do. Dude at the window said I'd have to pay. GTF...

3. It's always ALWAYS dirty. Tables, floors, drink machines especially. The bathrooms are always clean though, which is a shock. There are also flies and writing on the booths and cuts in the upholstery.

4. Free wifi (employees don't know what that is) but the outlets are covered.

5. There was a nice young man who used to work there (fair skinned with dreads) but he's gone. There's another nice lady manager, but that's it. Actually, all the managers I've seen are kind. Too bad their employees suck.

Worst. Coffee. Ever.

In desperate times....people make desperate decisions.

Blinding headache from lack of caffiene...please guide me to at least a Starbucks next time.

A-1. They will cater to you if you just poured a beer on your head. The staff was very professional. This is a great place to come if you have been drinking at any of the terrible and mind numbingly stupid bars in Apollo Beach, FL.

Haven't had McDonald's breakfast in forever! Food was ... Um... McDonald's-ish.

The girl taking my order was training which was slightly painful.

I will not be flexing my 'i can write a super awesome review' muscles here.

Just wanted to let people know their is nothing wildly right or wrong with this place.

I like mcdonald's and this one has basically a new playplace. It is a good place to go an study during the day while picking up a snack. The playplace is not for children with weak upper body strength, because they have to pull themselves all the way up.

Not my favorite Mcdonald's, because they tend to mess up my order. I also encountered an employee that must have hated children. She was really rude to my two year old son because he handed her a free ice cream coupon before she rang us up, and I felt it was out of place. There are better Mcdonald's around and the foods the same at all of them so go somewhere else.

Orders are always made wrong. I have tried 3 times to get an Egg McMuffin from them and every time they were inedible. The bread was way to hard and stale. The last time, the muffin was burnt. Will not be ordering from this location again.

This is for another Location , however the Issue I assume is corporate. 
The other Location is also a Caspers store @ 5001 Tamiani Trail in Ruskin, Also in this review is the Store on MLK Near 301.
