Now Today in Ruskin. I got a BIG BREAKFAST!  The sign said "Add a sm OJ for $1 to any meal.  When I was charged $1.79  ( 180% of listed price) I was told a BIG BREAKFAST IS NOT A MEAL.   Then what pray tell is it. I fact it is the most expensive item on the breakfast menu.  

Knowing McDonalds did not get as big and profitable as it is using BAIT and SWITCH , and false misleading marketing??   or did it?

Ok, so no review is going to get you to NOT go to a McDonalds if that's what you want, but I figure it's worth reviewing.

No one speaks English.  It's pretty ridiculous.  And if they do, they must not be working the register.  

The fries are not always fresh so I have repeatedly asked for fresh hot fries after getting old ones in my order.

I have to say I like that I can walk here for lunch if I want, but I typically avoid it unless I'm having a terrible craving for the McD's food coma.

Computers were down so had to pay cash and the drive thru attendant took a really long time to place my order. Fries were delicious, burgers were A-OK. They lose a star because I wanted a Shamrock Shake and it was May so they wouldn't make me one.

Clean.  Updated.  Friendly.  No complaints.

In general it is quite small for most McDonalds I've been to.  The parking lot however is quite large.  We like to stop here for a quick meal, snack, drink and a restroom break on our way through Indy.  There aren't big restrooms and there aren't a ton of places to sit, but we've never seemed to have much issues.

Overall, an a-ok place to stop on 74 north or south.

To add to the other review. Also limit on napkins and and likely limited toilet paper.  lol.  Every place like this in high crime areas or low income areas are like this.  Too many people walking home with anything they can carry.  Has to be expected.

Considering the location not too bad.

Conveniently placed McDonald's close to the highway and largely sized in & outside.  We used the drive-thru and were served in ample time and our breakfast.sandwiches and iced coffees were nicely prepared.  Only problem we found was that we had asked for ketchup and didn't find any in our take-out bags, so we had to drive around and walk in to get some...no packets available at the condiment/utensil area, had to wait behind ordering customers for an available employee to reach below the counter and hand me some.
I am also giving this McD's two stars because there is no drive through. I'm sorry but the point of being a McD's is to have a drive through so lazy people like me don't have to get out of our car.

as an avid fan of fast food, I have been to many of the different restaurants and chains the city has to offer, Mcdonald's has been in my eating habits for more years than I care to say. While each location is run differently, this location is also run badly. 

the service is slow, the employees rude,and consistently the food is bad. on many occasions  I have stated I wasn't going to return. but only do because of hoping it getting better, but it never does.  I think this location needs to do us all a favor and close. 

Do yourself a favor, don't use this location, you will only leave  aggravated..

Yes I know. McDonald's is McDonald's. All the same where you go. This one in Tarpon Springs always does it right. I order a bacon egg biscuit, bacon well done . Its perfect every time. The staff is always very up beat. Some restaurants need to have there employees go here for training. They treat their customers like gold. Thanks Mickey D.

There has been a McDonalds at this location for quite a while, but it has recently gotten a nice face-lift both inside and out. Complete with high tech LCD menu screens and a dual drive through (how do they know who is who?!).  In my most recent visit, I was there for lunch and they moved it all along pretty well. I can't say I have any complaints, but I still wonder how they know who is who at the two drive thrus!

Just plain ewww... This has to be the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The fries are beyond greasy they taste like they were made the night before. Dirty tables, floors, just plain yuck. Stay away!

Mmmmmm good!  Something's are just too reliable to take for granted, like an ol' fashion Big Mac Value meal!

Book an appointment for a cholesterol check up but enjoy nevertheless.
The best fries!! Day or night! Open late night too! Good for the soul man!

Just saw worker wipe his nose on his hand & sleeve, show his results to a co-worker, wipe it off with a napkin, and go back to work. 

I threw my food away.

Go to ANY other location than this one. The *manager* working the drive-thru window just shorted me almost a dollar in change. 

They're always slow, they hold the food in warmers until it's long past edible, then serve it anyway. 

This franchisee should be forced to eat his own store's food for a month.

I know I shouldn't expect much but everything I asked for that was on the drive thru menu was not available. I was actually afraid of what I was going to get once I did get it. I saw the movie "waiting".  Word of advice stay clear of this arch. Just so you know I was only trying to order a beverage how pathetic is that.

Ho.  Lee.  Crap.  Slowest, most inattentive service I've ever gotten.  And don't start with that whole, 'Well, heh, you went to McDonald's, so what did you expect?'  Bullship.  I've been to my fare share of McDonny's in my time and on average, the service is just fine -- quick and efficient -- especially the drive-thru.  No no, not this one.

First of all, a few factors weighing into this situation but not necessarily  the review rating:

1)  You know how they have one of those split drive-thru ordering thingamabobs?  One of them was coned off.

2)  Their order screens were down and were doing some Matrix-y type number sequence.  Kept wanting to pick up a phone and Dial in ala' Keanu but I was busy being super pissed off because I was speaking with  a moron... which leads to...

3)  The moron taking my order.  The car line was from the pick-up window through the one semi-working order screen out through the parking lot.  I'm three cars back and I look ahead to see what the hold up is.  You know when you make those late night food runs and there's always the perpetual car full of college kids who just had their first beer trying to order one of everything?  Yeah.  I'm like, 'WTF IS GOING ON.  JUST ORDER YOUR GOD DAMNED HAPPY MEALS AND GTFO OF THE WAY, KIDS.'  I felt like yelling it out but I'm glad I didn't... cause it wasn't their fault.  It was the jackoff working the drive-thru.  When it was my turn, I spent ten minutes reading my order to him repeatedly (two #3, regular size, one with no pickles or mustard, the other with no onions, and two regular cheeseburgers).  Finally we go for the finish:

He goes, 'Does your order appear correctly on the screen?'
Me:  'The screen's not working..'
Him:  'Huhhuh, oh yeah.  That'll be $9.37 at the first window.'
Me:  'So can you read my order back to me?'
Him:  'Yeah, one second.  (long pause)  I have a number three and three Diet Cokes, and that's all I got.'

That's the problem with these drive-thrus:  you're trapped.  Nothing you can do.  You're stuck at the mercy of this dipstick and his ADD.  Another couple of minutes working out the order, I get my food -- my burgers are cold.

I thought nothing could make my sleep deprived, two hour drive back to Sacramento from Reno at 11:30 PM more enjoyable, but boy was I wrong.  When I took my first bite of the first of the two lukewarm cheeseburgers made sloppily and without care, I realized that my night was complete.  Thank you, halftard, for driving up my cholesterol and my stress level.
Sketchtastic patrons.  Occasionally argumentative staff who don't always seem to know what they're doing.  Meh.
Acceptable for a McDonald's.  Friendly staff.  Tiny (and I mean tiny) dining room.  Consider yourself warned if you fail to find an open table.

I usually don't hit this location but I was in the area and decided to pop in, and within 5 minutes I was reminded of just why I don't frequent this location.  OK McDonalds in general has gone down the tubes at a rapid rate over the past 20 years, however this location is just as bad as the Jefferson and 44 location. 

The employees are rude, they spend more time talking to their friends that come to visit than they do working.  I ordered a quarter pounder with no cheese meal, the burger was dry, and really tasteless, and the fries were not of this universe.  do yourself a favor, if your looking for the golden arches please go that extra distance to a different location, you will be so glad you did..

Picture yourself 5 years out of college, on a college campus, after a 3 hour open bar happy hour. You are going to be starving. It is 10:30, sorority girls doing their grocery shopping, and you are salivating at the thought of Bobby's Burger Palace. But it is closed. That's fine, Chipotle is next door. But that is closed too. Fine fine, we will get Jimmy John's. Wait, they don't toast their subs, don't want it. Finally, we see a golden arch peaking out around the corner. What is it? What is it? It is the one and only Mickey D's!

This McDonalds is bringing in 4 stars for a few reasons. Reliability. It is open when I want it. Cleanliness. Beer goggles didn't prevent me from noticing this city McDonalds was recently cleaned. Personality. There were 3 ladies working behind the counter that either loved picking on drunk guys or just had good personality. Overall, the two cheeseburger meal saved the night!

Ronald McDonald greater than Bobby Flay

Summary: really, you need a summary of McDonalds?

Same old menu as the nationwide chain, but the upside is with the 6 checkout counters that help to reduce the wait-times for customers. Still, you'l usually find yourself in line for 2-3 minutes, but the food is prepared quick and is good as usual.

Note (6/2/12): this location has been closed by McDonalds corporate for renovations indefinitely.

They don't really mess up your order that much, but they are ALWAYS out of something, and often more than one thing. And don't be surprised if they tell you the computers are down after 3pm, even though the sign says 24 hour

as far as MacDonalds go this one gets a good rave, just because of the service and the cleanliness of the store. This is one of the busier "highway locations" since it's right off the highway and generates a good deal of traffic, and I have been to this location at some of it's busier times and let me tell you, they really keep the line moving quickly and efficiently. 

now if they can just improve the quality of the food we would have a decent chain back, but I really don't see that happening anytime  soon.

I've been here several times. The last time they were completely out of ketchup and when I asked they had to go into the back to the cooks and squirt a few drop into a tiny cup for me. Needless to say I refuse to rate this place higher. I had complained online through the McDonalds website and it seems they got their act together this time around. Ordered grilled chicken sandwich. It was very good and their was ample amounts of ketchup this time.

This particular McDonalds management and staff are terrible, often serving old food (luke warm fries that taste stale, and bacon that has sat too long, ...once causing food poisoning) , and more often we receive menu items that are not full (half filled large fries, 3/4 filled cherry berry chiller). The staff is unprofessional, never smiling, never courteous, and always unhelpful (dropped the drink container and bag on the counter in front of me and made me pack my own to go order with one arm while i held my son).  The staff also makes frozen drinks ordered before they have begun the food, resulting in the drink sitting there melting while you wait for your food, instead of making the frozen drinks last so they're still frozen & slushy while you eat.

I'm actually very shocked by the review before me. We have been patronizing this McDonald's for 5 years at all hours. Staffing is definitely an issue at this location. However, our problems have always been with the breakfast staff. Stale, burnt English Muffins, hash browns cooked in old oil, rude service, etc. So bad that we go to another location for breakfast foods. Whenever we have gotten food at night, it's been great. Piping hot fresh fries, burgers and chicken nuggets. The bacon has always been fresh and crispy. The shakes and smoothies are always great. No it isn't ideal food, but sometimes we have to give in to the kids.  I feel really bad for the previous person and urge calling/e-mailing the corporate office.

I really enjoy being cut off in the drive through line every single time I go here, no really, it's an awesome set up they have. Go check it out! You'll get to wait ten minutes behind other cars and then have the joy of some jerk coming in the side entrence and straight into the drive through line ahead of you. Yea McDonalds!!!! Yea Fat People!!!

Another freebie...YaY!

I found a coupon in the Parade Magazine in Sunday's Post for a free 12oz. Berry Chiller. I have been craving one with so many advertisments about them. Quite tasty, light and refreshing.

I stopped in this McDonald's as they have a Red Box and I had 2 free credits for 2 free movies. 

Let's recap: Free lunch at Noodles, free Berry Chiller at McDonald's and 2 free movies from Red Box.

Sheen eat your heart out..........winning!

Updated Note (6/16/12): this location has been sold off and will soon become a part Jersey Mike's Subs and part Wendy's.

RIP McDonalds, many a Big Mac was served in this location, and you will not be forgotten by the tens of thousands of Amtrak Keystone passengers who rushed into your lobby during their 18-minute layover.

I live and work near this McDonalds and so I'm sorry to say I go there frequently.  Never again though.  I've become accustomed to having my order messed up and being greeted by a moody teenager at the drive through window.  However after my last visit, I won't be back. Ever since the Philly Police installed a mini-station next to the serving counter, this McDonalds really cleaned up its act.  Sure, the dining room and parking swarm with those huddled masses that didn't so much fall as joyously leapt off the wagon a long time past and retain little intention of climbing back aboard.  So, you're still in fine company.  In a corner booth sits Schizo engaged in lively conversation with his empty coffe cup.  In a middle booth you'll find Shakey aiming that McDouble for her mouth but hitting her cbheek.  Along side her, witness her buddy, Sleepy, nodding off and sweating, the poor fellow! 

But, the old gang aside, in comes the law and out goes the riff-raff.  You won't be hassled for change while you eat, and the cleanliness no longer approximates an old movie house.  Your feet no longer stick to the floor after you sit up from a booth.  Each booth contains at least two fully sit-able seats.  Granted, the food still retains its urban McDonalds "flavor" and the atmosphere may be characterized as "questionable".

In 1999, the Ol' Dirty Bastard, ever the rascal, escaped from court-ordered drug rehabilitation and fled as a fugitive from the law.  An always vigilant Philly police officer recognized him, ran the license of his Jersey car idling at the drive-through window, and the rest is, as they say, history.  Let's have a mural!

Drunk, craving food, cab drives past McDonalds, I'm game. Now if only they could get my Cheeseburger No Meat order right....

Bad service.
Slow service, even for lunch rush.
Snarky and rude cashiers with major attitudes.

Order was wrong. That in itself does not necessitate an issue. I am a picky eater and am accustomed to my order not always being correct, especially during lunch or dinner rush. Places have been so busy before that I have just taken the food and scraped off the ketchup and mustard, no harm no foul. But I do not eat fries with salt, I do not cook or season with salt at home. Even those I know who love salt say Mickey D's uses a lot of salt, but they like it. I had also ordered a Frappe with no whipped cream. I was given my receipt, which showed medium fry, no salt. Large Mocha Frappe No whipped cream and extra drizzle. Now I can live without the extra drizzle, even thought it costs 40 cents more. MY issue arose when I took my fries to the counter and said I had ordered no salt and showed the manager my receipt. She noticed the Frappe was ordered sans whip and said she'd fix that as well, I told her no worries that I could scrape it off. I showed her the receipt, kind of snarled and snatched the Frap from my hand along with the fries and said she'd fix them. I again told her not worry about the Frap that I could scrape the whip off and there was no sense in wasting a drink. She dumped the damn thing! I knew I'd have to wait a couple minutes for the fries. The Frap, sans whip was up in about 2 minutes and by up I mean the cashier practically slammed it in the counter. She had noticed the extra drizzle missing from the original and she put probably 5 tablespoons extra chocolate drizzle in my drink. The fries came up and she pulled mine before the salt was put on and when she came up she tossed the bag across the counter towards me but it hit a guy next to me. I asked her what her problem was and she said people like you who complain about their order. As I walked off I rolled my eyes and I heard her telling me to come back and do that to her face.

Worst McDonalds Ever!!  Not kidding every time I am asked to pull forward and I don't even ask for special orders

When I receive a rude employee working customer service who doesn't even speak my language, I get right pissed off. Overall, still a terrible experience and I'll look to avoid your location in the future.

Hey, I just came here for the coffee on my way back home!  The service was cool and the place was clean!

I can't speak on the food but the coffee was good and the cashier was nice!

Racist employees HATE white people! I have visited this place twice in the last six months, and I will never go back. Best in the city. Food is always the appropriate temperature. And the taste is classic McDonald's.

We stopped here on the way to a football game and found it a very pleasant and relaxing place to hang out for a while.

If you eat at this location make sure you check your food before you eat it. I purchased a chicken club sandwich and after my second bite I notice the bottom bun was molded!!! YUCK! I wont eat here or at any other McDonalds again!
This location has a boat dock in Madeira Beach area.
One of my favorite McDonalds!!! Open 24/7 clerks are always nice here. Even remember my name!!!!!

I can honestly say I have never had one order that was correct from this McDonalds. Not One! I mean I'm not ordering replacement parts with exacting specifications for the space shuttle, I'm ordering a burger and fries. 

By the way, have a little training on treating your customers with a little bit of respect. I am not your Bro, Dude or Man. I don't expect to be called sir at McDonalds but none of these terms ever convey respect.

This McDonald's the worst I have ever been to. It is McDonalds, that and well dining there isn't too bad, I'm not too picky with that.

I usually go drive thru & at any time during the evening, and this has got to be the slowest drive-thru I've ever been in. No matter if there is no one in front of you or a lineup of cars, the drive-thru is CONSISTENTLY slow. The last time my bf & I were here, with maybe only 2 cars ahead of us we waited 6-8 mins before they would take our order at the intercom, then we waited at the window where we pay for a good 10-12 mins. SERIOUSLY? That's ridiculous!! And it seems to be the same guy at the window who takes your order and then grabs your cash, but this time he was nowhere to be found.

We drove around the corner to park the car and go in, and there wasn't any sign stating the hours. We go in, the lights are all on and there is one female manager and the same slow worker at the window. She quickly stated "WE'RE CLOSED!! DINING ROOM IS CLOSED!!". I asked her "I'm sorry, I thought it was open, but my issue is why was it taking us so long to pay? No one was at the window?" 

She looked mean and quickly retorted "WE ARE VERY BUSY, THERE ARE ONLY THE TWO OF US!!!" Even though this is the closest McD's to us, we will never go here again. My bf & I have been going here for years putting up with this kind of service and we have had it. With all of this happening both my bf & I noticed the guy taking payment at the SECOND window, when he clearly stated for us to go to the first window to pay. If we were waiting there for a long time, why couldn't he stick his head out and signal us to move forward?? We felt like idiots when in actuality for a long time coming, we knew something like this would happen again.

This location is famous for messing up special orders and even handing out full on sugared beverages instead of diet.  My best friend is diabetic and is very cautious when ordering beverages, on more than one occasion, include one with a flavored latte that had a STICKER on it stating how it was to be made, she has been given regular beverages.  She uses me as a taster when she is leery.  

Personally I hate it that McDonald's ever went to taking special orders, they should have left that to Burger King.. but seriously.. if you're GOING to take special orders, the least you can do is be 100% sure that they honor it. 

Repeated phone conversations have merited little to no change at this location.  Having been a McDonald's manager myself many years ago, I know that it IS possible to fix such things, someone just seems to be lazy at this location.
It was just like another Mc Donald's!  The environment was just clean. It wasn't that busy at that time I visit and the cashier was very welcoming me as a valued customer!

An average (maybe below average) McDonald's but the manager that works dinner time is very nice and helpful with kid related issues (clean ups, extra happy meal toys, etc).  I say below average because the food is sometimes cold, or the buns are stale, or the soda mix is off on the self-serve fountain.  It's also not the cleanest McDonald's I've seen.

McD is one of my favorite places for fries and Big Mac. I love that service is fast and accurate; however, this place gets packed at night & weekends. This is on Broad St. near Temple University corridor so expect the college students to be hanging around and enjoying the free wifi.

My kids love McDonald's.  I end up going at least twice a month to this location through the drive though because it close by. Almost, like 80% of the time, they get the order wrong.  If you want some quick food and hungry for mcdonalds and heading down to the shore do yourself a favor and wait till you get to Malaga, there's a better McDonald's there.
It's always a little groady and a little slow.  You're lucky if you can get a seat in there or your food.  I somehow get skipped often at this place for simple things like a McDouble.  Murrr.

Ok, it's McDonald's ya'll so I feel funny giving it more than three stars? Am I crazy? Anywho, this is for the drive thru. There are two lines which gets TWO THUMBS UP from me! The line went relatively quickly which is great bc I was on the way to pick up my Mom from work and she was dragging me to Oakwood Mall. I figured I would get a Kids Meal (cheeseburger with Big Mac sauce-they charge you $.25 and it is SO worth it), no pickles, girl toy (for the nieces), and diet coke bc that cancels all the fat!) and not be hungry in case she took a while. She wanted to go to Dillard's and get perfume but who knows where else she would drag me.

Plus if you know me I love shopping but I HATE crowds. I especially hate going to the mall during busy times like Black Friday, Christmas etc. it's just not worth it to me. It's just stuff and I can order things online. I am impatient, and I don't like people bumping into me, ramming my cart, etc.  anywho, I digress. My point was I am not a pleasant person to be around when I'm hungry and tired so Mickey D's was my saving grace last night. 

Turns out I was dragging my Mom around bc it took an hour to get my stuff engraved. But my Mom and I found great sales on shoes in our various sizes so it was a win-win situation!

Plus, I DID see "Supersize Me" and although it thoroughly repulsed me to see the changes in the guy's body, I still occasionally indulge in Mickey D's. hey, what can I say, they got me when I was young. Had so many damned birthday parties at the one on Dowman and Morrison.

I remember the play area, back when they fried the apple pies. My parents let me have a happy meal but no cold drink, only milk (later discovered I was lactose intolerant). Mickey D's was a treat and not a regular occurrence. It's my go-to comfort food in a pinch. Especially the ones opened 24 hours when back in the day I would be out past 10 pm! Hehe now I just start yawning am under the covers by then!

I really enjoy Big Mac sauce, Filet-o-Fish with extra tartar sauce (I just love tartar sauce in general), chicken nuggets, cheeseburgers, their French fries, apple pies, their sausage/egg/cheese biscuit, hashbrowns. Ok, I've said too much.

Btw, I don't get the McRib, now I know I'm gonna get hurt for that comment but for real, it's not a real rib? Ok, I'm done!

Happy Fast Food Eating!

Went in at 8pm. Workers were telling each other stories about their school experience, cursing and calling each other names. Asked for a courtesy cup of water. 
"We don't do courtesy cups no more." 

"That doesn't sound right. Is there someone I can speak to about this?" I ask them.

"Yo. Can you tell him?" The teen call to her friend, who she was telling the story to. "You heard her. We don't do give out cups anymore."
The food is on par with other McDonald's, however the decor is fairly dated and the restaurant isn't particularly clean

I occasionally hit up this McDonald's in the middle of the night because it is 24/7 and close to my work. The food is normally decent (as decent as McDonald's food can be). Save yourself some frustration and visit the 24/7 one on East Bay near Starkey.

Tonight was such a disappointing experience. I have had similar service before, but tonight tops it and I left feedback for them on their corp website for complaints. I told them I was posting this as well and am being very transparent. I am more than happy to send them pictures from my phone. I really love camera phones, and I am going to actually do this more.

Long story short, 5 things messed up with a very simple order.
1) Large Latte was only 3/4 full, took a picture.
2) Large fries, only about 2/3rds full, took picture.
3) They gave me sweet tea, I ordered unsweetened, it was correct on the receipt, I have a picture. I don't like sweet tea, so I threw it out.
4) They didn't give ketchup, again they asked me, and even put it on the receipt
5) No straw for above tea

Then when I am about to give feedback, I look at the receipt and it says "How we doing? email us!" You guessed it, NO EMAIL address! I have to google how to even get them my feedback.  Put it on the receipt please if you genuinely want feedback. Clearly no one in management is spot checking things.

On the Latte, it felt light as the nice lady handed it to me, so I pulled the top and yes, it was basically a regular coffee in a large cup.  The other lady that actually filled the order seems put out to have to add more.

Then my wife pulls out the fries from the bag and is so disgusted at getting a medium fry in a large container, I handed them that as well which they take back and fill up properly.  I also tell them there is no ketchup, which they fix, but I shouldn't have to be the second check.

I remember years ago this got so bad they put stickers on the bags saying "Double Checked" meaning they forced a second person to verify it, well, they need to do it again, because I am not getting paid to do it, but I have to do it each time. About 50% of the time they are missing something lately. 50% is about the number, I have been keeping track mentally for a while now.

Anyway, by this time 5 min is past, and there is a line behind us and we drive away to find out the balance of the tea, straws issue!  So upsetting.  It is really bad when we have to actually ask for more straws, spoons, forks, napkins and stash them away like a chipmunk storing up for winter to smooth out the errors each time.  It is simply sad.

They spend all this money on nice ads showing hot coffees full, and Large red fry boxes brimming over the top. But tonight was so bad that there is no way any employee wouldn't have known it was a problem.  It is clearly a management issue more than anything.

So anyway, this is my first Yelp review, I hope to give better and more positive ones, because I have eaten at many places that really have good customer service and train their folks obviously well. I love to patronize them, but I will just have to eat at Taco Bell more often across the street when we are in a hurry then going to McDonald as frequently.  I will be honest and say that I will still go there, but not as much when I have time to think about it and consider my options. I will be spending less money with McDonalds that is a fact.

I can't believe I just made a Yelp account to give vent to this, but this is really intended to get to McDonald's to have them actually check this stuff themselves and do some secret shopping at their stores and start replacing management.  Give them a real scorecard by doing about 10 drive thru's a month at various times and they will see this stuff. Maybe they will see it when their monthly revenue as that store starts slipping by 5, 10 or 15% and they start wondering why and start investigating and run across this review finally.

Sigh.

While I try to avoid the McDonald's that are run by Caspar's Company, sometimes its not possible. This McDonald's is by far the worst!

My first one star review ever!

We are in Gretna visiting the in-laws. Every time I come to the New Orleans area, I am reminded of why I moved to Texas in the first place. Today's reminder came from this McDonald's. I have come to expect a certain standard of service at fast food places in this area, namely the employees are generally insulted by the fact that you are placing an order, and don't take kindly to "Whitey."

This place went well above and beyond to make sure today's visit was miserable. My 5 yo daughter insisted on eating at "Old McDonald's" and I was unable to dissuade her. We started the visit by using the restroom. Big mistake. Totally filthy.

Then we placed our order. Or at least we tried to. We were eventually noticed by an employee who was delighted to tell us that they were out of chicken nuggets and would not be getting any for about an hour. Thankfully my daughter did not flip out. we changed our order and took our ticket, as the employee glared at us with obvious hatred in her eyes. If you are thinking, "Well, he must have said something or done something to set her off," then you obviously are not a New Orleans native and are not used to being treated like a subhuman.

I stood there for twenty minutes as all of the other customers were served, including those who came in ten minutes after we did. Many of them had ordered similar things. 

I followed the first rule of New Orleans fast food dining: "DO NOT COMPLAIN"

Violating this rule has been known to result in food with "Special Sauce" added, as well as physical violence and even armed confrontation. 

Instead I just stood there with my daughter in my arms until another employee (who actually was not overtly hostile) noticed us and took pity. She took my ticket and personally saw that it was filled. I have noticed that even in the worst situation, there is always at least one person who reminds me that not all people are scum. 

Ironically, by the time we got our food, the expected chicken nuggets had arrived, but they were now out of all of the soft drinks except for "orange drink" and iced tea. I took a water even though I paid for a fountain drink and kept my mouth shut (see rule 1 above). 

Oh yeah, and the fries were stale and the burgers were slimy.

I expected a sub-par experience by normal standards, but this place sucked by NEW ORLEANS standards! That is tough to achieve.
This has to be the slowest mcdonalds in the world. My orderis always wrong. Check your food at the window.

Never had my order screwed up here. Drive by a lot for breakfast, sometimes late night dinner. Always fast and everything is fresh. On several occasions, Ive gotten through a seemingly busy drive thru line in 3 minutes for breakfast. Not too bad.

One register open and a restaurant full of people and full kitchen staff makes for the opportunity for better service.

Speedy service, beautiful and clean building.

I just discovered on our last trip that they have dipped cones, which I will be trying on my next visit. 

When we want a quick ice cream snack this location is super convenient and the employees are generally pretty friendly and competent.
My favorite breakfast burrito. I stop every morning to get a breakfast burrito. I love it and it is great for the protein..I feel like my day is NOT complete without one!
Great customer service and quick drive thru-they definitely cater to the local neighborhood crowd and want to make it "your" McDonald's.

What can I say.  McDonalds is pretty standard wherever you go.  I found this one in-between cycling class and work.  It was clean and the staff quick and friendly.  The McMuffin was the perfect mix of carbs and protein I needed to refuel.

For a place that is such a major chain and that we have all tried dozens of locations in our lives I think this review has to be based on service.  For me, I've had better. They have a maintenance tech cleaning tables and sweeping constantly and the bathrooms are clean each time I've checked. There isn't a lot of yelling or anything coming from behind the counter which is nice.

The big drive thru also has always been efficient, even though there's usually 10 or so cars in queue.

the service is really good here and the inside is really clean.

This particular mcdonalds while convenient always seems to mess our orders up. One time they kept giving us cold stale fries and all the while pretending they were fine and getting annoyed while we complained, I am pretty sure the lead was fired for it later.
It's ok. We've had a few problems out of this "McDonald's" but nothing to deter our business. It's usually pretty quick and "sometimes" fresh!

Considering its McDonald's and I try to avoid this place like the plague, I can't argue with the 24-hour drive thru and $1 large coke. Decent size Play Place - Not the biggest in the city but at least they have it!  Inside was pretty clean and the staff were friendly.  I had brought  a group of three 4 year olds after a date at the Jube for Strawberry Shortcake and the DoodleBops.  It truly was the perfect way to end their special day out.

I am thankful for FREE indoor playgrounds like this one, especially in the dead of winter!

I agree with the previous reviewer: this is probably one of the worst McDonald's locations ever. Great service, fast food and all the employees are nice. The burgers seem to keep getting smaller and smaller though...

I am not a fan of the new coffee service.  They never get the right amount of sugar and cream in my coffee.  I prefer to do it myself, but this week they did away with the diy option.  I'm going to bk where I can have it my way.

The problem with this location is that they are SLOW and the service is complacent on a good day. Every time, drive thru or inside, they are slow and rude.  Especially slow with the McCafe!

Worst McDonald's ever!
