Perhaps it takes me back to birthday parties in the play area as a wee pup or my New Music Tuesday/McDonald's runs of my teenage years.  Nonetheless, I still get the urge for their French fries and burgers on occasion.

Usually, I don't have a problem at any location.  If there's one thing that I'm used to when dining here, it's quick service.  Not necessarily friendly but quick.  However, I recently started patronizing the S. Jefferson location instead of S. Broadway, and I've regretted it almost every time.

The parking lot is a nightmare.  It's narrow.  If you pull through the lot at the wrong angle, you might get stuck dangling in moving traffic.  If you go to the next entrace, you face having people whip through the first entrance and cut in front of you.

Today I went inside, my first time.  All that I wanted was a couple of plain McChickens.  As I walked to the counter, there was four young ladies standing around, none of them concerned with serving me.  A manager walked by them and casually mentioned that I needed help.  No one moved.  The manager stopped in her tracks and told someone to take my order.  They looked at me; I glared at them.  One finally came over and very haphazardly gave me service.

It might be time to go back to S. Broadway.

Sometimes you need food, fast. Thus we have Fast Food. McDonald's, a one time treat for me as a young boy craving transformer Happy Meal toys, has now become an occasional shameful meal due to pure laziness. Some McDonald's manage to produce food I can enjoy in a nostalgic way. This is not one of those McDonald's. The chicken McNuggets are stale every time, the fries are always limp and lukewarm. The employees are generally... unpleasant at worst, apathetic at best. What do I expect? Not a lot. Hot fries, fresh nuggets, people who speak in an intelligible manner through the drive through speaker, a flashback to my playing with a French Fry transformer. Is that so much to ask?

This McDonald's is fine.  We went, and it's clean, comfortable seating, etc.

We had Chicken McNuggets and a McFlurry for the kids.  All fine.

The one disappointing thing about this place is that is didn't have a play area.  Although the McDonald's website lists that this place has a playground, it doesn't.

Ok, I give this 3 stars as a McDonald's compared to other McDonald's. I eat at McDonald's once in a blue moon - every few months or so - and I always end up feeling guilty about it. I tend to avoid meat, so when I do go I get something like the Egg McMuffin with no Canadian Bacon. The last time I got coffee I was surprised - it was better than I remembered. Still not very good, but quaffable in a pinch.

This particular location has some pros and cons - they have extremely slow service and more often than not mess up my order. The people are friendly though, and it is clean inside - it's a nicer McDonald's than others I've been too.

Dirty! The employes are rude and disgusting! Seen one woman licking her fingers after handing a customer their food and to make it worse did not wash her hands and just continued working! Place should be shut down and quickly!
Free wifi. Small seating area. Closest McDonalds to my area.

What else do you want from a McDonald's? I don't think anything else is fair to ask for from the giant corporation who runs thousands of stores.

It's clean-ish, the atmosphere is nice-ish, and the food tastes like what you would expect from a McDonald's. 

I have read the previous reviews about the filth that the restaurant harbors, and agree that in the past the store has been quite dirty. But I think they got their act together and learned how to use a mop and rag. 

This is arguably one of the better McDonald's that I've encountered in the past months, mostly because I don't become enraged by the clientele or servers when I eat at this location.

Rudest Mcdonalds Staff ever. Check out the proof
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BJlkdCbysYw

This location is one of only two McDonald's in the downtown/Quarter area. It is the bigger and busier McD's of the two. 

This McD's for years was run-down, had poor customer service, and long wait times. Within the past two months it got renovated and now it is totally updated. It isn't a complete eyesore anymore. The employees seem to be happier and friendly. The lines move more quickly. The seating is more comfortable and even the lighting has been changed. Vast improvement over what it used to be like.

The food, however, is still the same. Nothing new. Nothing amazing.

This is my favorite McD's followed closely by the one at four corners! What makes this one special is the fact they have the nicest employees of any McDonald's I've been in. They always make me fresh coffee!!! I tried the new Fish McBites and they are AWESOME!!! If you buy them Feb 12-14 the snack size I had for $2.29 will be a dollar :)

I've been here several times and usually it's ok. But 2 different times (with 2 different people) they've cut me off while ordering, assuming I'm only ordering that one thing. I got what my boyfriend wanted but went somewhere else to get my food.
Service was terrible on this Monday morning. Waited 10 minutes for a sausage burrito and an oatmeal and the food was subpar when I finally received it.

While I don't eat fast food often I do occasionally get a craving for terrible but tasty fries. I have also taken ppl here late night after a night at the bars. 

They are not friendly, are always out of something we are ordering, stop serving night food at random times, and only accept cash at some unknown time of day. Shady shady...
Very fancy branch. Has a lounge and a fireplace.

Great customer service so far. The playground door is finally child friendly!!! no more worrying about your children opening that heavy door that is between the lobby and kids play area they finally installed electric doors!!! Plug ins for laptops are installed for wifi! 2 big screen tv's.  I'm very very pleased with this remodel.

Came here for the first time since the remodel with my 4 and 1 year olds.

Spotless and modern for sure and the playground is state of the art with a staircase parents can easily walk up within the structure!

My only complaint is the toddler area was not to my 1 year old's liking and my 4 year old wished the slide came down to the floor rather than the 4 thru 2nd level of the play structure.  Pros & Cons but really a lovely remodel!

Another yuck is the parking lot and parking at this location is a little tricky but c'est la vie!

As a random aside, my 4 year old was thrilled with the Hello Kitty Happy Meal you today!  Sometimes the toys are so weird and random but today was right on par!

I so tried to purchase some if the Valentine coupons (like the Halloween ones) but was told they did not get any at this location.

Since the rehab some months ago, the huge glass windows give you a lovely vista of the Gallatin Road.  There is free Wi-Fi and in the early morning it can be quite soothing.  The bright yellow chairs and vinyl booths are sunny and optimistic.  Today we headed in to try the McFishbites that we had seen on the Telly the night before.  Blimey what a winner.  they really did taste like the fish sandwich but in a round bite size form.  soft and fishy and lovely.
Service is A-OK - not as efficient as the Mighty Fesslers Lane branch but we will be back for more mcbites soon

It's a Micky-D's. Not much to say, except this is the only one on Veterans that lives up to the 24 Hour billing. My graveyard shift work schedule sometimes bleeds through to my days off, and I occasionally want to grab a quick bite to eat at 3am without having to cook it myself or grab a shower to go eat at a real restaurant. (Or wait in the block-long line at Taco Bell) This one never tells me "the computers are down" or flat out ignores the drive-through speakers, and my order comes out right.

This McDonalds is a-okay because they have 2--- 24 hour drive up lanes.  I was really impressed with the lady at the other end of the microphone because she was really dang pippy....I had to brace myself because I felt like I was listening to a cheer for a minute....It is really nice to have somebody that is actually pleasant....I didn't take her up on her offer for the fish nuggets they are pushing right now but she did sway me into getting a bigger shake--after all it was 1.00 off for some reason.  

The fries and shake were good but I don't understand why lately I have gotten so many onions on my cheeseburger.  I like all the condiments but they need to simmer down sometimes...I think I'm just going to have to start ordering plain and asking for the ketchup on the side....

I understand that this is just another McDonalds but I wish they would put up some kind of lines so that people are not just waiting every where. and why does it take soooo long just to get a soda? Is it really to much for the kid ringing up the people to get 1 soda?!? and on weekends... why dont you have more people when you know that is your busiest times? Oh and I guess Free smiles are off the menu? because no one had a smile when I was there.

I work locally and used to go every morning for my coffee and oatmeal. I would either get the wrong oatmeal or my coffee made incorrectly. I have called the manager and I was offered free food. I don't want free food I just want my order to be correct. At work we used to order lunch from there at times but always the same issue. The staff talk to each other and hand you a bag and say it's been a pleasure serving you and when you reply the door is already closed. I would rather them say nothing then to be insincere. So for he last 8 months or so we have stayed away.

Maybe it's my digestive system getting older or my tastebuds getting a little more skeptical, but this McDonalds has yet to live up to its counterparts. The McDonalds on Ulmerton is terrible, but I wouldn't completely write off this one. They always give me fresh fries, though their sandwiches actually end up making me feel sick to my stomach. 

Could just be me, but I used to made amazing sandwiches when I worked at McDonalds and they were not this.
Bathrooms smell like the hog barns at the state fair.   And there was a roach in the men's room sink,  not a good roach with 8 legs;  a let's get high today and forget to throw our joint away roach.
McDonalds was crowded today. I guess everyone was trying to take advantage of those two for one deals like myself. The staff worked well, the lines moved fast and everyone seem okay.
For a fast food place, they are really slow. The other night it took about 5 minutes to get a small shamrock shake. If there was another option I'd take it but in new hope, pa there is nothing.

It's a McD's.  Double drive-through makes for an expedient experience.  The big downfall for this is it's placement.  It is in literally inside a parking lot, making it a little difficult to locate during the busiest times of the day.  Other than that, once again, it's a McD's.
Yes, everyone now likes McDonald's, but we only ordered 4 Shakes and had to wait over 20 minutes.  They finally started working on them when I mentioned we were waiting over 20 minutes.

McDonald's Fries are not vegetarian, are not free from Dairy or Wheat. 

They also contain hydrogenated oils. Blah. 

Its just odd that french fried potatoes contain wheat, dairy, and beef  "products"
Still making use of my two for one coupon before the end of the month.

Kom her for at prøve de nye fisk McBites, men i sidste ende var for bekymret for mine kviksølv niveauer. Så jeg gik. Fries var helt velsmagende, som sædvanlig.

Også, som sædvanlig, kiggede for ODB. Nowhere.

was in this location today at 4:40. I ordered two (2) angus bacon and cheese burgers. I asked for no onions which I got nothing but the cheese, pickles, bacon and meat on one and NO bacon on the other as well as the lettuce and tomatos on either. I feel completely ripped off. I also tried to order a sweet tea which the girl at the counter told me they had no ice.. Now this is the 3rd time I've been told that by this location, that is completely ridiculous. You serve drinks you should have ice. This location is a very poor excuse for a restaurant! 
If I could give this place a ZERO star I would.

By far worst location my family has ever visited.  We lived near this location for about 7 years and my husband grew up near this location and he said it's always been teh same.  The service here has been BEYOND slow for many, many years.  Even with two cars ahead of you - you could be in the drive thru for 10 minutes just to get a happy meal for your toddler or an ice cream cone.  

On the plus, it has been recently renovated but that seems to be the norm right now amongst the change over to McCafe.

This was a pretty big McDonald's just a short block from the infamous Bourbon Street. I'm not sure if it was because it was located in a touristy area, but they didn't have a value menu or any deals when I ate here. The food was what you would come to expect from any McDonald's and my order was brought out promptly. There was plenty of seating, but I took my food to-go so that I could eat it while watching TV back at my hotel room.

Went to this McDonalds today around 12 Noon,through the drive thru.I ordered two(2) sweet teas with lemon,and a SouthWest Salad.

Drove around to pick up my order,and I was told that I only ordered the SouthWest Salad.Wow.

The manager informs me that I had to drive back through the drive thru,in order to re order the teas,but I refused.

The young lady that took my order was not attentive at all to my needs,and this was the reason why my two sweet teas,were not included in my order.

Bad attitudes need to stay at home,when you are serving customers,bottom line.

I am a former employee of this location,and it is true that this location is not suitable for human consumption.

Most of the employees are teenagers,that are spoiled brats,and the managers are no better.Everyone is not only in a hurry to leave,but their attitudes are so terrible.

It would seem that with all the complaints that Chris the owner has received;that he would make some drastic changes,nevertheless,he is just another owner,that cares more about quantity than quality.

This ship is headed for dry dock fast.

Good looking newly reconstructed building.

While the chain is undergoing a complete overhaul that makes them look very nice. They have had this design in Europe for quite a while. Many TV's, power stations for people with electronic devices and free wifi.... yea!

This location has a staff that is currently doing a decent job. Fast food places typically have a pretty high turn over, so if the management keeps up the expectations from their staff, this location will remain to be better than the typical standards for this chain.
Service was okay and food was what one might expect for McDonald's. However, a lot of the furniture was scratched, chipped, or ripped, so they are due for a remodel there.

This Mickey-D's has been on Sugan road for years and years.  I rarely stop in (I don;t "do" fast food) unless dragged in by a friend or relative.  But - they have clean (relatively) bathrooms and that has saved us on occaision.

Here's a little tip...

A Big Mac is now $4.00, just for the sandwich. 

Try this...order a McDouble with no ketchup and no mustard. Ask them to add mac sauce and shredded lettuce and voila, you have an almost Big Mac for $1.19. All that's missing is the middle bun and the sesame seeds.

You're welcome.

It's been at least seven years since I have willingly and purposely dined at a McDonald's. However, when it's five whiskeys 'til midnight and I need food, sometimes you have to go with what's close. 

Since I will never eat McD's fish, beef, or pork and I didn't want gallons of grease sitting in me gut causing a night of stomach pain the only safe choice seemed to be a Chicken Nugget Happy Meal. The Nuggets were cooked crispy, the fries were not soggy, and the apples were not brown. By the way, when did Happy Meals start including fruit?

Best of all though, Zeke the manager/cashier was incredibly friendly despite the onslaught of intoxicated salesmen that inundated his dining establishment. If I ever have to go back to a McDonald's, I hope it is this one.

Almost forgot - my Blue Power Ranger kicks ass!

I wanted to like this place.  The interior was done very nicely, and they had real TV (basketball) on not some canned McD network.  

However, the wait times are about the worst I've ever seen...and I was the only customer in line.
Had to kill time before a concert at Ruth Eckerd. Clean bathrooms and quick service. What else is there to judge a McDonald's on?

I drive by all the time on the way to work- I stop once or twice a month and always have a good experience. 

The drive through staff is LOVELY. They clearly communicate and it always sounds like they're following corporate chatter by offering me the lastest and greatest deal. 

They're fast and efficient when I'm on the road. 

However- any time I dine in...it takes forrrreveerrrrr. 

So- five stars for drive through, three for eat in.

It is a smaller, more recently renovated McDonald's. While like some of the reviews mention there are some homeless people inside or outside, it isn't too bad, you also have professionals from the university, students, people from nearby hotels, etc.

There was a very nice young lady who worked the register in the morning, and for the most part they were pretty quick, and my order was always correct. Good to have a known quantity when you're traveling....

They have a TV with the audio on in the dining room, which is a little different, but helpful. They also situated at least a couple of the booths to be near an outlet for charging your electronic gear. I would imagine in the summer this is a good place to grab a bite and walk around in the nearby park?

I could just say "DITTO" on the other review but I will expand a bit. Hit and miss is the real story with this local for sure. Sometimes good but it seems like when you need a MickeyDees fix the worse is when they let you down the most.

Ordered for the first time in many years a Big Mac, my wife ordered a Angus cheeseburger and we planned to split a large order of fries. 

One of the biggest anticipations about McD's is to sneak a few fries on the way home, which we tried and was immediatley disappointed.  Only luke warm and oooooold and rubbery assailed our tastebuds and senses. Those things had to have spent several hours under the infra reds!

My Big Mac... gssssh! It also was infra baked but I think to lessen the dryness they did a double dip of special sauce which made the burgers squirm and squirt all over the place and down my shirt. The lettuce was well aged and sported a great deal of brown on the edges. My wife's Angus was much the same story as my Big Mac. I really do think that our order was on the way to the dumpster but was waylayed into our bag instead. 3/4s of the meals ended up where they should've been to start with... IN THE TRASH!!

  We won't patronize this branch again since quality would seem to be way down the list by this management.
I was at this location this morning along with my wife,and the service as "Fantastic".The young lady at the drive thru was very very,wonderful and so nice.The food was awesome.
They have Milk Bones at the drive thru for dogs! This is a well-maintained McDonald's at a busy intersection with standard McDonald's fare. They do have a double drive-thru (with 2 places to order).
Food is good at McDonalds standards but service is extremely slow at all times.

I work in Greenfield (exciting I know).  I do hit this McD's up on the way home or when heading into work to get a soda. 
I don't know what they do to their soda, but the Diet Coke is freaking delicious. It's always crisp and fresh tasting (I'm having withdrawals just thinking about it).  
The drive-thru is super fast and they have yet to screw up an order. I honestly haven't been inside the actual place, so I can't speak to the service inside.
When comparing to other McD's, this one is higher on my list, so I recommend.

We are all familiar with McDonalds, it's menu and what it consist of so I'll skip through that all. The only area I feel left to critique is it's service and staff.  Well me being a local I've gone a number of times and the service is VERY inconsistent, often forgetting cheese, sauce etc. Again it's McDonalds and it's a part of who we are so I'll continue to go back, but is it just me who believes the constant forgetfulness of condiments is only a way for them to cash in?  Next time forget to give me an extra burger or order of fries

It's a Mcdonalds so you know what you are getting food wise.  What I like about this location is how clean they keep the common areas and the bathrooms.  The staff is also generally more pleasant and helpful than at some McD's locations.

This McDonalds was surprisingly clean, and the staff was very friendly. I stopped to get a Shamrock shake for the first time, and although it has a million ingredients, it definitely got me in the St. Patty's spirit.  

Usually the McDonalds is the eye sore of the neighborhood with their cheap food bringing out some of the most interesting people of Philadelphia, but this one was dare I say, "classy."
It's not every day that the McDonalds is cleaner and classier than the neighborhood.

I don't usually go in so this review is all about the drive through. 

The food is good, the people are polite- it's McDonalds- all about the same. BUT...the drive through seems to take SO MUCH LONGER than most other locations. 

I can't figure it out- the line is often two or three deep BEFORE the menu. Maybe it's the time of day I come- usually between 9 and 10 and it's everyone's break time after the breakfast rush...but it's quiet a wait!

I wouldn't normally write a review for McDonald's.  I mean, if you've been in one, you've been in them all, right?  However, this location currently has a one-star rating, so I felt compelled.  I don't go to McDonald's often, but , but I came here in reponse to a co-worker telling me I had to try the Shamrock Shake (which lived up to her reviews).  I have been in this one a couple times, and the inside is very nice - as you would expect in Des Peres!  There's a fireplace and some little couches where you can eat your meal in addition to the normal tables and booths.  The staff seems nice, and if you go through the drive thru around lunchtime, they definitely know what they're doing.  An employee is out way before you get to the normal ordering booth, and he/she has an electronic gadget to take your order.  By the time you get to the window, it's ready.

Was there this afternoon. As usual the waiting line is disorganized, not sure if I'm in line or not. So their drive-up line is hopping, so what.  Just asked for a senior decaf, yet I get a lukewarm cup of coffee with no coffee smell or taste.  Customer service not a priority, I guess.
It's McDonald's what is there to say. I got all the food I ordered. It was hot. The service was fast and friendly!!

Faith and Blessed my eye. This place tore out the TV. They also force you to ask for salt and sugar and other condiments (not ketchup) because they live in fear of being "ripped off" by their customers.

Worst McDonald's I have been to. Worth the expense of going up to the one at 71st and Keystone.
Great McDonald's. Fast.. Courteous. Clean. All you would expect and more. They removed the "play area" which is fine with me. It's a restaurant not a day care.

OK, I admit it, I'm an Ice'd Coffee addict. My job takes me on the road 6-8 hours a day 5 days a week. So I do stop at McDonalds frequently for Ice Coffee, and that's all (honestly) so my reviews are mainly based on service. In other words do they get it right the first time.

Pretty simple order really......Lg black Ice Coffee, no cream, no sugar, 3 creams on the side, period!

This particular spot gets it right about 60-70% of the time. Not bad for a McDonalds.

So 3 stars for this stop.

Took 3 tries by two different people (one was the shift Supervisor) before they got my order right.

Avoid if you can!
This is a good restaurant. One of the (waiters?) Was talking about his snakes he breeds. I axed him about if he breeds dogs(touchy subject). Overall EXCELLENT stuff!

When in Green Hills and seriously pressed for time to eat, Mickey D's is the old reliable.  You know the food and the prices, so I won't bother with that bit.  Rest assured that even though the drive-through line may be out to the road, it will go FAST.  I rarely have to spend more than a couple of minutes in line before I've got my "food" and waiting the interminable amount of time required to turn left out of this place.
Disgusting. The place is filthy. The employees are rude. The managers should all be fired for incompetence.

While I'm not a fan of McDonald's food, my kids do like it, so we'll stop in here from time to time. This is a new McDonald's that's been built within the past year so it has the look and feel of the newer revamped McDonald's, which means a more upscale look and no kids play area. This location does have a double drive-thru and free WiFi. You'll find the typical teenagers behind the counter, so service is never overly friendly, but at least my food orders have always come out correct. All in all, an OK McDonalds.

I don't really eat at fast food chains much, but when on the hi and need a quick meal, I normally would choose a McDonald's chain. I have been to a couple of McDonald's and I would have some ok or bad experiences. This McDonald chain is one of the best. The employees here are very courteous to me from beginning to when I exit their establishment. The employees were well dressed and groomed. They had smiles on their faces like they really enjoy the job they are doing. These are the attributes that many consumers such as myself love to see when eating at a chain establishment and also this would make it worth going back to give them more of our business.
This is your typical McDonald's.  They do have a play area.  The service and food is as you would expect for McDonald's.

Not too bad water always tastes nasty.it is fast food u
You get what you pay for

I seriously hate this McDonald's.

I honestly don't know how to properly express the amount of hatred I have for this specific McDonald's. I hate them so much that I will get the fuck up out of my car and get my own food, rather than having to deal with the frustration of order in that 'disgusting drive-thu ever again. Obviously I'm not asking for five star service, but I am expecting a bit more professionalism from an employee of a multi-billion dollar corporation. Especially when you have only ONE customer. 
Not only did the woman on the receiving side of my order take her precious time to greet me and ask for my order, but I had to repeat myself several times on pretty much everything I ordered. It was so bad that I waited to get to the window to order my drink and I still had to repeat myself with that. TWICE. Now, I'm not bitching about some fast food drive-thru manager's apparent hearing/ attention deficiency, that was not the tip of the iceberg. This much hatred fueled somewhere between ordering food from someone with an attitude problem and spending money on an order that was 100% screwed up and cold. I was their only customer, how could two people fuck up one single order so hard and have an attitude problem towards me? I even gave the lady 75 cents because she couldn't just give me two extra ranches. 

Every single time I have ever gone through this drive-thru I have been sorely disappointed. 

I wish I could give negative stars.
This place is great, although I eat here way too much because it is by work, the staff does an amazing job.

The food is always fresh at this one. Buns toasted, fries fried, cheese melted - even when you order something special (like 'w/o mustard'). Workers seem well trained and pleasant. Inside is clean, drive-thru pretty quick.

Customer Service: The customer service here is terrible. 

Presentation: Dirty. Long Lines. 

Price: Not worth it! Why spend the $5-10 on junk! 

Food: Well some it may taste good going in but I can't say the same for going out.  

Me: Do your best to avoid the homeless guy outside the door.

First, a note on what five stars means.

This isn't a fancy steakhouse. It's fast food. So my rating is based on how this McDonalds compares to other fast food places.

Second - why review McDonalds?
Because this place deserves some kudos.

This particular location is a training site for area McDonalds. As such, the service is better than I've ever had in a fast food restaurant (including the always chipper  Chik Fil A). When a friend commented to the management about a problem, it was fixed. And that's really all you want much of the time. We're not measured by the mistakes as much as how we resolve them. 

This McDonalds more than exceeds any standard you can put on a fast food chain restaurant.

I go to this McDonalds all the time. Although Ive never experienced bad customer service they are a horrible McDonalds. They ALWAYS forget something in your order or run out of food. If they weren't so close I would never go there again. I feel like they hire people who don't know what their doing. They need to be shut down.
Horribly slow.  Not fast food!  Quote from my seven year old; "my wrapper says I'm love'n it, but we aren't."

This is the place to go when you're drunk out of your mind. The service, cleanliness, and food is far below even the most  sub-par of places to eat in west philly. However, it does the trick if you're drunk and in need of a quick hunger fix. Otherwise, avoid this pile like the plague. Penn should try harder to get rid of this place.

Why did I go here?  Oh I remember because I was late for work and felt desperate!  I really regret it.  I can occasionally enjoy McDonald's like when wondering the streets of Milan feeling a little homesick or when a once a year Mcstalgia hits and I want a nugget but this experience really let me down.

Cons

Super Dirty!  Filthy!  Spilled drinks on the floors, fingerprint smudges all over the glass, sticky stuff at the drink station, trash spilling out...ewwwww

Not Fast Food.  It took 25 minutes to get my meal = no joke.

After waiting 25 minutes I got my burger with cold hard patty and a stale bun.  

Just stay away.  

Pros

There is a strange plastic man in a box.  (see pictures)

Even though I am deathly afraid of clowns, I have always had a deep love for Ronald McDonald and his golden arches. Some of my finest memories took place at McDonald's, from frolicking in the ball pits at childhood birthday parties, to drunken drive-thru visits after a night out at the bars in college. No matter what, Ronald is always there for me. So one day when I found myself in Plant City, I was feeling a bit parched. I decided to swing my trusty '89 Volvo 740GL Station Wagon into the drive-thru line and take advantage of their $1 drinks. I entered the drive-thru line (which is a double line, by the way) at approximately 3:30 P.M., and I left the drive-thru line at 3:50 P.M. Yes, it took me over 20 minutes to inch my way toward the ordering screen, place my order for a single diet coke, inch my way toward window one to pay and ultimately end my drive-thru journey at window two to retrieve my drink. If I wasn't suffering from such a severe case of dry mouth, I would have given up after five minutes. This was actually my second time visiting this McDonald's, and the first time had a long wait as well....but not 20 minutes long. This McDonald's has some serious work to do to speed up their service. If it was this bad at 3:30, I can't imagine what the line is like at noon. And I don't plan on finding out.

The food is delicious. As always. But the managers attitude is rude and ridiculous. I'm surprised she's a manager with an attitude like hers. There have been times where I've come in and she's yelling at all the employees when it looks like they are trying as hard as they can. And she has a nasty tone towards customers as well. The  other staff are always a pleasure and nice but the manager is rude.
Actually this is a nice McDonald's and the closest to me. The staff and managers are great and they get your orders right :) no electric for wifi so come fully charged!!! Food is standard Mcds :)

Okay.... am I really giving McD's five stars?

Yes. Yes I am. So sue me. I'm a yelper, not a food critic.

First of all, no line. Yay! Anyways, upon their personal suggestion, I tried the McWrap. It is not the same as the snack wrap. It's healthier(ish) for it's size, which is HUGE. Try it. You will not be disappointed!

On another note, the money taker in the drive thru window was nice/funny and that made my day. As someone who works in a similar drive thru situation (FML) I appreciate a little humor and personality. Thank you, person in the first window!

McD's doesn't have to be a bad experience.... if you go to this one. I will be back.
I know it is McDonalds but this place is staffed by idiots... They also give you attitude when they make mistakes...

Terrible service. Waited 15 minutes for my food. Then, the quarter pounder was cold and the cheese was hard and brownish.  The fries were cold and tasted like the fryer grease hadn't been changed in awhile.  Very bad after taste of old grease.  2 thumbs down on this sad Mickey d's    : (
Slowest service ever! Only waited because my grandma really wanted mcdonalds :(

I would have given it five stars but it's McDonalds as far as fast food goes this is a good one. Staff was efficient and courteous and my order was well put together and fresh. What more could you want from a fast food chain? The old school look of the McD's adds to the experience as well. Kids seem to enjoy the retro atmosphere.

on the way to snowboarding we hit up this McDonalds and it was really good, we had to wait for them to bring out our food since we had a big order of "Fishy Fishy" :) but it was well worth it, they are pretty good, and the shamrock shake i had was really good as well, Still its McDonalds so same thing different McDonalds but i would give this one a 4 star, it looked fairly clean from the outside looking in :)

We have been here a few times now.

Today was much like the past visits, aggravating.

Put our order in and misunderstanding on the order takers part would have given us the wrong thing, but we told them to just go with what they imputed to the register.

After we ordered three others ordered much larger orders.

My order came out.

Three other orders came out but not my sisters.

I got hot under the collar and went up to find out why she as usual did not get her order. It was not a hard order, but a simple cheeseburger... nothing else. 

A cheeseburger was handed to me with no delay or explanation or a simple sorry.

This is the norm for this store, each time we have gone we have experienced a variation of the story.
The worst McDonalds I've ever been to. Can't even refill your own soda!! No plugs for Wifi!!!

Yeah, this place is all kinds of awful. YELP REVIEWS DO NOT LIE.

Avoid like the plague, unless you want to unnecessarily wait in line for 15 minutes then get served something other than what you ordered. As I sat in my car, I checked the reviews here and thought to myself "well duh, I'm an idiot, I should have known." Luckily this isn't my local McD's, so I probably won't ever have to go back unless I'm in the area and desperate for some unhealthy food again.

They get an extra star because I think they said "bye" to me on my way out.

This McDonald's isn't in the worst shape as far as aesthetic and design. It looks nice from the outside and the drive thru allows for two vehicles to order at the same time.

The problem is the service. It has to be a management issue. This McDonald's is always busy which isn't an excuse. You only have to travel one block away to find a Chick-Fil-A that is even busier but providing excellent service.

I'm giving it one star because there have been several incidents. One time I waited 25 minutes in the drive-thru and once you're in line, you can't get out. I have received poor service on a couple of occasions. I have also had an incorrect order once before at this location. I have called the customer service line for this location and left a detailed message about my experience and didn't receive any feedback. To contrast that, I once received cold fried at a Chick-Fil-A and left a note on the comment card. That same week I received a phone call from the manager himself apologizing and offering to make it right by giving me a coupon for my next fry purchase.

Anyways, it's not all McDonald's locations. I am not anti-McDonald's. I admire the success they enjoy and the inexpensive quick food they serve. This location, however, is falling far too short in terms of customer service.

This is a mcdonald's so there's not too much to say. If you live under a rock and you've never been then you must try their french fries, nuggets, big macs, and fish filets (not the bites). What's nice about this location is it's open until 4am on the weekends. It's the perfect place to go after a night of drinking, especially because you won't be judged. Not one person even batted an eye as my friends and I sat there stuffing ourselves with nuggets while singing part of your world from the little mermaid.

Don't go here.  You are broke and hungry.  I get it.  Just don't go here.

Grab a slice at Hot Box or Za.  Hell, go up the way to Kroger or Subway.

At least you know that your order won't get screwed up when they make it in front of you.  You won't have to wait forever either.  Nor will you have the regretful feeling after eating an overly greazy "burger." 

If you really want a burger, go up the street to Boogie Burger.

You can do a whole lot better.  Get out of the line now.  They will not give you your money back if they screw it up either.  Run!

Now this goes against all my Yelp principals, but when I'm on my way to a Pacers game, I have to stop here.  Why?  Superstition.  If I'm wearing a Pacer jersey, Pacer warm-up, Nike Air Jordan's and follow the same route and go to this McDonald's, we always win!  If I deviate, we lose, so we are talking about the balance of the universe here!

Okay maybe not.  But this MCD, at least in the drive thru, has been flawless!  I have never had a single mistake here, and I am very picky with what I do not want on my sandwich.  In addition, they are amazingly fast.  I realize that the food was cooked before I got here, but you put together my sandwich that fast?!?!?  Craziness.  Plus I ordered for other people one time, who also had special requests and it was still super fast.  In addition, it is a hot as it could ever be.  Don't understand why all MCD's cannot work this way.

Never again.  Not only will they not give you your money back, but they manage to burn the food at this location.  Yuck.  They still owe me for giving me sausage on my sandwiches instead of no meat.  I could not eat them since I was fasting.  A waste of seven bucks.  Of course that same manager who I talked to has been fired long ago and they refuse to honor what he gave me.  Shame.  They also charge you a dollar for ice water too.  Ridiculous.  This is what they call hospitality?

McDonald's is McDonald's nothing to rave about, a tip would be to make sure you tell them you want your food fresh! if not you will get whats been sitting under the heat lamp for God knows how long...

What can I say, its McDonalds. They are pretty much the same where ever you go. I will admit though that out of the several dozen or so times that I have been to this particular location they only messed my order up one time. But that is pretty good compared to other McD's across the nation.

In short don't expect anything like Dantes Kitchen or Commanders Palace, its just fast food Ya Dig!

It's McDonald's so the food is well...McDonald's food.  The service here is great, though, and the cashiers are friendly, FAST, and accurate with the orders.  The interior is also very clean, spacious, and well-organized despite the fact that it is perpetually busy here.  The parking lot is a bit treacherous but that's not really an issue.

Went through the drive thru. The one time I really considered eating McDonalds, would be awful. My sons food was cold. I ordered the wrap. The veggies were soggy, not to mention it was dripping sauce all over me and of course they gave me no napkins. The only "good" thing about that place is the staff was friendly.

I don't expect much from a fast food restaurant, but I do expect two important things: customer service and speed. Yes, I expect staff at a McDonald's to put on a smile and at least pretend they are happy to serve me food. It's customer service. I didn't always enjoy my time in retail but I never let the customer think that. So lay off the surly attitude and learn to interact with customers.

Second, I expect the FAST portion of fast food. Double when it's something that is mass produced and under a heat lamp. It should not take 10 minutes to get a McGriddle.

What ever happened to customer service.  Drove through kinda late (11pm) and was charged three times for a 4.39 meal.  "Oh sorry Sir, we are training a new employee and didn't realize I swiped your card three times.  Can I get you a free apple pie for your troubles?"  HMM 14.25 Charge and they are offering a free dollar product.  Yeah I think not.  still have not received a refund to date.  What ever happened to customer service?
Ordered breakfast burrito and coffee took 5 minutes to get after ordered, then opened the bag and it was a parfait. WTF sugg. just ordering drinks.

This McDonald's has gotten my order wrong EVERY SINGLE TIME I have been here. My order isn't even difficult, I get the same thing every time. Mcdouble plain, medium fries, & a large sweet tea/dr pepper. They ALWAYS get some part of it wrong whether its the not plain burger, the not fresh fries, or the sour sweet tea. DO NOT GET THEIR SWEET TEA. I swear it is ALWAYS sour. It's ridiculous. & apart from everything, the service is horrible too. These people need to be properly trained to do their jobs because they don't even act like they know what they're doing! I've gone many different times a day & it's always the same. Not just one shift! I hate this McDonald's & I would rather drive all the way to the one on hickory hollow lane that is amazing then waste my time here in the drive thru for 2 hours.

I've eaten inside this McDonalds on many occasions and I agree with the poster from CT...definitely one of the cleanest, most comfortable McDonalds in the area. Nice employees, nice space to settle down, clean bathroom.

On a side note, it's irritating that Burger King blocks wifi users from using Facebook in-store and I would end up defaulting to McDonalds when I needed to check FB emails, etc. And then, just last week at this McDonalds, when I was surfing around reading things online while I ate, I discovered that McDonalds blocks Yelp. Hey, I was going to say something nice. It's Nineteen-Eighty-Four, Fast Food Version! Are the crummy stores hoping that, by blocking Yelpers in-store, they'd forget about posting once they got home?

-Thought Criminal
the good thing about this location is that  thedining room is open 24 hours. the bad thing is that it is still a McDonalds. did i use the word "dining" to descibe McD's?

If you like weird chicken nugget shapes and high calorie food and drinks... then hit this place up. I will say that sometimes you cant go wrong with a sausage biscuit with cheese and hot mustard combo. Especially before a sunrise hike. Other than that I stay away.
I know it's bad, but I can't help it. I feel like the food has improved in the past few years. It's comfort food really... Big Mac, Fries, Coke and an Apple pie... I'm definitely a fan... :)

If I could give this restaurant no stars I would. The service is horrible, the food is not always hot and fresh, & the wait is outrageous. Two cars in the drive thru and they still make me pull up and have some one bring it out to me. Even the supervisor  moves slow and showed no interest in giving me what I want. I actually had to get out my car, go in and get my food. I was late to work fooling with them. Poor service! And the fries here taste like cardboard.

Never, ever, EVER leave the drive-through window without examining the contents of your order THOROUGHLY. 8 times out of 10 the order will be wrong. And if you go inside, forget about getting prompt service. They are only interested in the drive-though. Very disappointing. Sometimes I'll go way out of my way to go to the McDonald's in Southampton instead, just because they are much more accurate and easy to deal with.
This place is confusing. At times it's a fine tuned machine. Other times it is a helter skelter mess. The Ice Coffee taste is consistent anyhow and that's why I'm here.
Love the indoor playground, I would love to play myself. If you don't mind the unattended children, the constant body mishaps, smelly atmosphere, and noise - it's spectacular

This McDonald's is the worst EVER!!!! Once in awhile I have these uncontrollable cravings for McNuggets dipped in honey. Well, I had one of those one night and I was looking forward SOOOO much to my McNugs w/ honey and this McDonald's HAS NO HONEY!!!! I have been to dozens and dozens of McDonald's all over the United States and never ever before have I been to a McDonald's that doesn't have pure honey. I had to end up eating my nugs with honey mustard and bbq. Not the same AT ALL :(

In my rage, I went on google and found that I was not the first to encounter this problem:
http://www.yelp.com/topic/los-angeles-la-mcdonalds-wheres-my-honey

It seems that this McDonald's is a privately owned franchised McDonald's (???), so they don't carry honey. This is outrageous. Would it really cost them that much more to just freaking carry a few honey packets?! I am never going back to this McDonald's!

Oh, the place is the dirtiest McDonalds in the city, and the food is just your average quality, it is by far the best place in the city to witness a brewing race war.  If you like a little theater with your junk food, here is where you can witness an argument where the wittiest insult was "it's a prepay phone"

A lifetime of poor choices has taught me to appreciate the small things in life. I tend to set the bar pretty low and go for the lowest hanging fruit because I usually don't see the point in trying. 

Today was different. A burst of inspiration motivated me to leave the house. Where to go with no destination in mind? I thought for a second and then the lightbulb went off: McDonalds.

McDonalds is a American restaurant that tastes so good. If you have not been to one you have probably at least seen one maybe. I like the tasty fries which go right in my mouth I cannot gobble them fast enough.

On my way home I found a large tooth on the sidewalk outside. It was a really good day.

The weird thing about this McDonald's is they have large signs explaining that you can only use their Internet for 15 minutes or they will kick you out. I'd say either they have a problem with moochers or they are extremely busy. I'd guess the former.  The sweet chili chicken McWrap is pretty tasty...probably not good for you, but tasty.

This McDonald's has the new "upgraded" exterior and the updated drive through lanes where they can service two customers at a time. But with that said, my experience this morning was quite slow. Slow to take my money, slow to get my change and then slow to get my food.

Yes, the food was just the same as it was supposed to be. An Egg McMuffin in Dresher, PA is the same as one in Del Mar CA and one in Delray Beach FL. So they have that part right.

Is it McDonald's policy to not put even one napkin in the bag unless you ask? Because they got that part just right - no napkin.

I would avoid this place during morning rush hour, afternoon rush hour, and late night weekends. Actually... I would just avoid this place in general.

I shouldn't be eating this garbage anyway and the ridiculous wait at EVERY hour of the day makes me ponder why I am doing it even more.

Service is hit or miss. I wish people at McD's would realize that being polite actually makes a difference sometimes. On occasion, they have been friendly but usually not really.

The end.

Well, I'd been here before with no problems, but today...I went there for lunch and I usually do not check my change, but I did today, and I noticed the girl short changed me a dollar, yes, I realize it might not seem like a big deal but if they cannot count correct change for a person then, maybe the should not be working with cash? They did not seem like giving the wrong change to me was even an issue at all either. Not gonna come here again, its just not right

While affectionately called McDeath by many West Philadelphians, this McDonald's might deserve a little more leeway, in my opinion. People that take the time to write reviews on Yelp are not likely to be people that frequent McDonald's (myself included). If you love food enough to write detailed reviews then in all likelihood, you love food too much to settle for a Micky D's cheeseburger. 

Pretension is a vice of the highest order, and I am typically loathe to accept the kind of rhetoric that often gets thrown around art and food culture. There's a season for all things, and while your local art gallery may not have the kind of displays you can find at the Barnes, it doesn't mean it's unworthy of a visit. To my mind, the same is true of restaurants. There's a time and a place for a visit to Qdoba or especially, the local food truck. For a late night McFlurry, what better than the McDonald's on Walnut and 40th? 

Despite certain enjoyable oddities - the Coltrane jazz over the loudspeakers, for instance - this McDonald's location is certainly subpar. As one reviewer stated, it may be in need of a mulligan, or at the very least, an upgrade. Even the usually standardized quality of the food is subpar (allow me a whiny moment: I ordered a Reese's McFlurry and the thing was unmixed, just a sprinkling of peanut butter pieces on top). That's not a McFlurry; that's soft-serve with an accidental spill of crunched-up Reese's. FYI: there's a Ben & Jerry's right around the corner.

If nothing else, they are consistent! Today was one of the rare occasions when I actually got my order without being pulled forward and the food was correct. Of course, even during their prime dinner rush time my fries and my son's nuggets were still cold. I thought that since they were busy the fries wouldn't have had time to sit long enough to be that cold but somehow they found a way. I feel bad writing this but it really is the worst McDonald's in the St. Charles area. This was one of the best visits I've had there and it was still disappointing. Their one redeeming quality is that they have a redbox. My suggestion is, go in and rent a movie before using the drive through so you have something to watch while you wait for your fries to get cold enough for them to serve.

DO NOT GO HERE. Especially at night. besides the drug addicts falling over all of the tables, the employees are RUDE, INCOMPETENT, SLOW and SASSY (not in a good way). the milkshake machine never works and it takes forever to get your food. in addition, the restaurant is very dirty and you typically have to pay extra for many condiments (like honey mustard).

G-H-E-T-T-O!!!!!! They had pricing &my order wrong I went inside to tell the manager his reply "im not about to argue with you. The price that we charged is right and here is your correct order, goodbye."  I asked for his name and he just looked at me and walked away.

Yummmmy... Diet Soda
This is my McDonalds - I live right near the place. What can I say, they have the best Diet Soda in town. I drive thru here daily for my 32oz fix. Service is great, never had problems!

WORST MCDONALD'S EVER!!! It took 10 mins to get my sweet tea! 10 MINUTES!! This isn't my first awful experience at this location! The drive thru is always at least 8-10 cars deep with 2 separate drive ways! TWO!! Twice I have waited in this line and the person in front of me hasn't had enough money and holds up the line! When u finally get passed the pay window, the pickup window almost never has anything ready or correct! Then they tell u to pull fwd and wait in a parking spot! WAIT!!! I don't have time to wait 15mins for one damn cheeseburger!!!! It's ridiculous! My work is close by and that is the ONLY reason I come here, but NOT ANYMORE!! I don't have a problem at any other McDonalds!! Get your sh*t together!!!!

Four stars? That's mighty high praise for a McDonald's there, Todd.  Well, the stars reflect just how outstanding the service is here. Everyone is polite to the point of ridicule. Welcome, how may I help you today is a normal thing for them. Smiles and thank you and please is effortless.  Effervescent attitudes and genuine care abounds. And they get the order right 100% of the time.

Why? What mythical training have these managers unlocked? How can an MCD this great be in the same town as one of the worst of their same brand, much less in the same shopping plaza as the worst Wendy's ever?

The shoes, T-Money! Gotta be the shoes.

The staff are nice, and the service is fast as expected! The food is ok, but its a good choice when I have no time to stop and eat! 
There was a mistake in the order once, they gave me an iced tea instead of coke which was disappointing! Overall, it is an ok drive throu restaurant.

I believe the other review. This is a new location and they mess up frequently. I too like McDonalds, but I have given this location many attempts to get it correct.  They have not made any mistakes money wise but have messed up 75% of my orders. Sparing a lot of.... Blah blah, they can't make their coffee's correctly! And it seems every day is their first day. They are nice buuut can't get it right.  My advice with this franchise is definitely don't make a big order or even a slightly (and I stress slightly) complex order. Hopefully they will get better soon! I love McD's variety of coffee! It's really good when they try a little.

Your best bet here is the drive thru. The walk up is always undermanned and rather on the slow side.

As it is with most fast food places, they're geared for a fast drive thru experience.

Coffee is...OK.

This place has really gone down hill.  I remember when they opened a few years ago---service was great.  Now---SLOW.  Yesterday I sat in the short drive thru line for 25 minutes---including 10 minutes waiting for the one car in front of me to get their food.  I had 2 hamburgers and a bottle of water---and they screwed it up.  The employees are rude and indifferent.  I even called and left a message for a manager---which I never do---and nobody even bothered to call back.   Clearly they need more people working there---but that might cost a few bucks.

Grilled chili chicken wrap is actually pretty healthy.  And its a McDonalds so you get fries and some kind of sandwich.  Or nuggets.

Open till midnight on the weekends.

With a new double-drivethru, your wait time has now increased by 100%!  Maybe I'm exaggerating a bit, but most people go through the drive-thru here, when it's much faster to go inside.

The best part about this particular McDonalds, though, is that while most of the time your order will be correct and reasonably quick, sometimes they screw it up spectacularly.  One night, my dog and I went to get some McDoubles - which were made with only the top parts of buns, and a complete lack of condiments.  No ketchup, mustard, onions, pickles, anything.  Just meat, cheese, and tops of buns.  Meanwhile, another time I bought a cheeseburger, asked for it plain, and it came with tomatoes (of all things!) on it.  Goofy.

This restaurant is understaffed. It is obvious when you spend 25 minutes in the drive thru for breakfast service. Clerks at the window fight with one another and curse under their breath. Orders have been wrong more than they have been right. Dining room is constantly dirty. Am taking my business a little farther away for better service.

This was a pretty modern fancy McDonald's with practically everything computerized. They even had two lanes for drive-thru. However, their machines were malfunctioning when I stopped by for lunch. They could only take cash and had to write down the orders by hand. Not their fault, but boy were there a lot of upset customers. The staff was definitely doing the best they could. I went next door to eat at Wendy's since I didn't have cash on me. I came back later for dinner and the service was fine.

I find it very difficult to rate a McDonald's. Am I comparing it other McDonalds or am I purely speaking of its merit? 

This McDonalds was fine. Granted, eventhough I'm the Duke I probably spent a whole of 8 minutes of my life involved with this McDonalds. 

I think I'm going to have to consider it like this: 

4 Stars as a McDonalds (Fast and didn't taste bad) 

3 Stars as a location in general. In other words they delivered what they're supposed to but nothing amazing.
This place is ridiculous! Understaffed and no training. This place does not represent McDonald's brand well at all. Slow service, no customer service, poor food quality

only three stars here becuase even though they are quick , the food seems rushed and sometimes doesn't come out all the way wrapped - I would rather sit in a long line at the one next to the base and get good quality and drive a bit farther  than go to this one by my house and have to feel jilted .... 3 stars until the food is better qaulity.... (what am i saying this is fast food) until they take their time and not rush the packaging of the mostly processed bad stuff for my body that i shouldn't be eating anyway....

Dirty smelly,the worst mcdonalds ever. The employees are rude no customer service skills at all. I dont even go in there any more. Between the homeless harassing you the drug dealers hanging out in there its just a bad feel.

employees are rude and service is slow. I work around there so I visited a few times but it was bad more times then good! I am just overall disgusted with the service of mcdonalds in general now due to the visits of so many bad service locations.

Very poorly managed... dirty tables, dirty bathrooms, dirty floors, over flowing trash receptacles, unfriendly staff and if you order inside you are going to wait (crowded or not). I suggest skipping this one... if not, you will be disappointed.

One of the cleaniest, well maintained and well managed Mcdonalds in the area. I will travel to go here for the service.
When they did make an error on my order it was quickly addressed and corrected!!
One of the unique McDonald's where service and quality are consistently good. Drive thru is always quick

The "lady" that took my order was upset because I didn't want toppings on my oatmeal.  (I've gotten it without toppings at other locations, and she was very upset that I didn't know I had to request it at this particular location.)  She slammed the one I returned into the trash and loudly complained to her coworker about me.  I feel sorry for anyone pathetic enough that their day is utterly ruined by a customer's oatmeal preference.

I live right down the street from this one so I've ate here several times. Out of 6 different times I think they manage to get the order correct maybe once. If you're going to use the drive thru I suggest you check your bags to make sure they got it all before driving off.
Avoid this McDonalds.  The staff is rude and the place is filthy.  This place is ran by high schools students.  They are more interested in having fun than serving customers.

They do a good job here. The other franchise near the mall is not as good. I've always been impressed with this location, consistent for fast food. My kids, the only reason I go, like this location best too. They are busy and sometimes there is a wait but when we get our orders they are complete. They are also friendly which is a really special feature these days.

24 hour wi-fi access in the lobby with free drink refills makes this a special place in the middle of the night.  

Maybe they can do this because there is no kid area.

There is an outside patio with tables that can still receive the wifi.

It's McDonalds. What can you say? I stop in most every day to grab myself an Iced Tea before work. I get one of two cashiers. One is great, warm and friendly, the other acts as if she's doing me a favour by being there. *shrug* I get it, I did my time too, but c'mon. Enthusiasm for the job, even if it's fake makes the day go by faster.

This is my nearest McDonald's.  We get drive-through lunch OR sit-in breakfast about once a week.  I haven't experienced the slowness or the rudeness that others are reporting.  Being regulars, the staff all know us, talk to our kids and our orders only rarely have had mistakes.  If we do get a mistake, its been fixed promptly without issue.  Miss Victoria at the drive-thru has a dazzling smile that I always appreciate.  Miss Natalie at the front counter is fast, efficient and can handle a lot at a time.  She keeps things moving.  Mr. Joe in the dining area is ALWAYS on top our needs, holding a door open for all the kiddos, bringing a high-chair for the little one, helping a bigger kid to get ice in his cup.  

I do have to say that I've seen the manager get angry with employees if they are new or make a mistake and he's been quite mean to them in front of other employees and customers.  

Other than that, the restaurant is clean, the staff is friendly and the food is hot and good.  I've never gotten cold food or frozen hash-browns.

This is an older McDonalds that hasn't been remodeled to take on their new look and feel. As a result, this location still has the outdoor playground area for the kids, complete with tubes and slides for the little ones to enjoy. Besides that, there aren't a whole lot of other positives to say other than free WiFi is provided. I'm not a fan of McDonalds food. It's not a good thing in my book when you bite into something hard while eating one of their hamburgers. I like their fries and sweet tea, but that's about it. I try to avoid McDonalds as much as possible, but the kids like it, so we do stop in from time to time. This location has a single drive-thru, unlike newer ones which seem to be putting in dual drive-thru lanes. The condiment station is generally clean, so no complaints there.

Their fries are always stale! theyre either hard, not hot, or just dont taste like Mcdonalds fires.  and the drive thru driveway is poorly constructed because getting out is awkward is difficult and awkward.  But I love that they're open 24/7 on the main line... Very rare.  Also, the people who work there are really friendly so that's a major plus! It could be a little better, but it's pretty good.

The family frequents this place and it is always busy.  It's a good place to grab something quickly when on the go.  Saying that this morning I ordered my meal and was several miles down the road when I noticed that there was no hash brown...my favorite part.  Groan, a bad way to start the morning!

This store replaced the one that closed on US -19 and Nursery Rd. It's located on the SE corner of S. Belcher Rd and Nursery Rd.

The staff is very sharp, friendly, and fast. What more can you ask?

One of the better fast food stops, IMHO.

The building and insides are like any others but the help is so inept!   They cant handle basics of getting orders right.  To the right is a trash bin and I watched order after order get dumped in there as lines got longer and longer. Both people in front of me had theirs dumped.  Then mine too was wrong. I gave a coupon for buy one get one FREE breakfast platter. She rings up some kind of sandwich.  The order sits and sits and sits, and nobody calls for the owner. After a long long wait and other customers asking what I was waiting for as I was there so long I said I fear that might be mine but thats not what I ordered.

   The order taker wore a shirt EB Manager. Woo Hoo!  A gal in blue shirt comes and asks what I ordered. I said 2 breakfast platters, and the lady at register  holds a coupon that says so too!  She says no...thats not what I ordered. I said look at the coupon. She goes to the trash and cant find it. So the blue shirt gets it right, thank you. 

  Such a shame to see all this food trashed due to basic carelessness or lack of basic skills. Especially with all these hungry people around here.  Maybe store Manager Joy Barquin will read this and try to get it right!

We needed change for the St. Charles Street car so we went in to grab something off the dollar menu. I was able to get the $1 salad. I was surprised of the size. Yeah, it's more of a snack. I mean it is $1.00 after all. The place is clean.  

I have to say this is a huge McDonald's and I wasn't expecting it to be so big and modern inside! Staff seems standard. The cashier was nice to accommodate my smaller bills request when I got my change.  I didn't have problem with my order. The patrons are interesting. One gentleman really enjoyed his meal as he proclaimed aloud by himself "That meal was slammin'!"  Truly enterntaining and they had some flat screen TVs with the news on.
Yo you know I gots to get me some of dem Big Macs!  Ya heard!!
Okay, was pleasantly surprised (a month after earlier review) to discover that this McDonalds was no longer blocking Yelp. Thank you! Freedom! Whooo!
Your typical service at McD's their drive thru is fast...unless its around lunch time or dinner time.

I don't know why I keep going here other than its about 2 min from my house. About 95% of the time I go through the drive thru, they forget half my order. Tonight my family and I sat in the drive thru for at least 10 minutes waiting to pay and get our food. And true to form, they forgot my hamburger. I got a smug "Sorry" when I was like where the hell is my burger??!! About 50% of the time, the fries are cold. If you go inside, the restaurant is moderately clean. I have better experiences elsewhere. If you go here, MAKE SURE you check your order before you leave the drive thru, cause it probably will not all be there.

I've been to this McDonalds a few times and each time it is extremely slow in drive thru. I'm usually only purchasing a coke or a happy meal and I've had to wait up to 10 mins. For some reason the cokes are always short on ice. Which is a huge no-no since McDs has the best fountain drinks. But usually the fries will be hot if I've waited. 
The worst part is exiting the mcdonalds. You can enter from Keystone but can only pull out right and have to u-turn down the block to get back to Keystone. 
The exit is blocked in building next door so no cut thru to pull out of their driveway.

Just for clarification..it's at OLD route 422 and 29 in Collegeville.  It is not at the bypass, it's a couple miles north.

You've seen one McDonald's, you've seen them all, but this one's OK if you're in the area and have a craving for McD's.  The do have a generous play area so the little ones can enjoy themselves.  There is a shopping center within walking distance, although once the Acme closed a lot of the smaller stores went with it; now it's only half-occupied.  During the spring and summer there is a popular water ice store nearby you can check out for dessert. 

The one fly in the ointment is if you have to turn left onto 29 when you leave, you have to go across the shopping center parking lot to the second stop sign and turn left to use the signal.  That's because the access nearest McDonald's is right-turns only both ways.

What I can't figure out, and this McD's isn't the only one that does it, is why they'll have a two-window drive thru but only use one of the windows.  Does having two open speed things up any?  With my experience, I can't say it does.  They probably should just have one and be done with it.

On a personal note, in my younger days there was a Tracy that worked there that had the most beautiful smile of any female I've ever met.  (Well, almost).  That's why Collegeville McDonald's will always be etched in my memories, as pedestrian as fast food can be.

The drive-thru at this location is ALWAYS busy and service can be a bit slow, but sometimes I crave certain things from this place, so I endure the long wait times. 

I recently tried the egg white delight without the canadian bacon and it was fabulous. The white cheddar was an amazing touch. Today I tried the blueberry pomegranate smoothie which was good, but the my favorite smoothie from here is still the pineapple mango smoothie. If you haven't tried it, this is a must!
I was in the mood to eat a McGriddle Burrito with Sausage only to find out McD's took it off the Menu along with the McGriddle Burrito with Steak. Very sad...

My last trip here the service was terrible! I cannot believe how rude the woman taking our order and greeting us at the window was. I have never experienced anyone that works here with that kind of attitude. Our food took forever to get, and add that with our not so friendly staff makes me question going back.

I have never been more petrified as I was in this McDonald's.  (you can see my last mcdonald's review was scary... but this place SERIOUSLY made the worst Boston McDonald's look like Burlington, VT  Applebee's)
Why was breakfast served until 11am on a weekday?

I was one of maybe 20 people in the place... I would estimate that 4 weren't homeless meth addict hookers.   no joke, it was scary.  i put my hoodie on and started my little twitchy-fake-crazy routine so that people didn't suspect me of having an actual wallet.

Just don't go there... unless you are a meth addict who wants a 10am breakfast.

I only come here for the ice vanilla coffee. For this type of coffee, they usually put 70% of milk + vanilla and the remain 30% is coffee. What I like about the coffee at this place is they give you more coffee, which is perfect for caffeine addicts like myself. The coffee is also very cheap. Medium for $2.19 and Large is for $2.50. 

Occasionally I would get the chicken nuggets. For some reason, they don't taste as good as other McDonald's...they seem drier. Deep fried to death? 

I've never been inside before and not planning to go in anytime soon. This isn't a  very nice neighborhood after all.

2013/#36

This 24 hour McDonald's is a tragedy. I went through the drive-thru, excited , because I thought I had found my breakfast jackpot as it was nearing 4 a.m.

I'm not sure if this is typical of all fast food places that are on the clock all day, but the service was slow, my morning coffee was bitter and my filet o fish sandwich was horrible.

 When I flipped the container open, I could tell by looking at the bread that it was old. 

Before I squeezed the fish with my finger, I knew it was stale, and I proved myself right :( It could hardly bend and took much more effort than it should to tear.

 The taste just flat out made me angry, and the amount of chewing needed to scarf this sandwich down....just beyond disgraceful. 

I hope this was just a bad experience, but I was so irritated I had to say something.

Worst in the country. I've lived a couple blocks from this place for 5 years. Want a McDonald's where they screw up almost every single order? This is it. Want staff that's rude, lazy and ill trained? This is it. And it's been that way the whole time I've lived nearby.

This place needs to be shut down. I initally went in for an iced coffee and was rudely told they don't sell iced coffee, then was offered a sausage burrito,  as if they were similar products.  Then as I was leaving, I saw one of the workers in the kitchen drop a piece of food on the floor and casually pick it up to put on the sandwich he was making. 

Pretty sure you would be risking your life if you choose to eat here.

Extremely nice decor for a McDonalds and clean.

There are a couple seats in the front where you can sit that has an umbrella for shade. I was extremely surprised when I walked in and saw the decor of the place.  I actually commented to a friend that it looked so nice for a McDonalds.  It had a nice hue of browns and looked like a much classier establishment.  

I'm so used to McDonalds always looking the same that this really took me by surprise.  There are tons of tables and the bathrooms are really clean.  

I don't really see the need to review the food since a McDonalds is a McDonalds is a McDonalds, but if you want to feel like you're spending more money than you are for food, come to this McDonalds.

Matt L. has once again gone off track and decided to review a McDonald's.  Every now and then, Matt goes for the extremely lame and reviews a McDonald;s.  I'd say he's hit the bottle, but he doesn't drink.  But then again, if Matt L. doesn't drink, how did he get that way?

I'm actually writing this from another McDonald's that I like, and the contrast is apt.  This McDonald's has comfortable seating, a good number of easily accessible electrical outlets, and parking that makes sense.  None of this is true at the McDonald's in MetroCenter.

The seats are these hard plastic and metal jobs that put your butt to sleep if you've sat there for more than ten minutes.  There's one, ONE, outlet, and it's behind the employment computer.  Stupid.  And the parking is ridiculous.  The parking next to the door is completely blocked off by the drive-thru traffic.  And since it's on a slope, it's ridiculous trying to park if you can get in there.

Someone said that this place is better than the Taco Bell next to it.  Maybe, but if I'm in MetroCenter in the future and need to grab a bite, I'll be getting tacos over burgers.

This McDonalds is new and it looks it.  They went for a very high tech look.

Inside the entire place looks very clean and sharp.  There are huge block letters over the drink station that says refresh, which adds to the look.  

They give you a number and there is a screen that displays it when your food is ready.  This is pretty neat, because it results in less yelling of names.  

I always find it strange that the iced coffee costs different prices at different locations.  Here it is $1.49 for a small.  It was very good, but I wish it was $1.07.

This place is average. There is a ton of seating, which is great, and every time I've been here, it's clean and well kept up. The food is always fresh (or as fresh as McDonald's food can be, anyway), but the service can be really slow. It doesn't seem to matter how many people are in line, what time of day it is, or what the traffic in the drive through is like, the staff is just slow moving. I've also had a few instances where my order has been wrong. I'm a happy meal junkie and always ask for apple slices, but 75% of the time I get fries anyway. They always fix the mistake, but never seem happy that I notice. I'll keep coming here because it's convenient to a lot of my other errands, but they could use some work.

One word... Dirty.  Most of the tables were empty but all were dirty... We had to ask for management to clean them. The play area smelled like dirty stinky feet - I don't think the actual play gym had been wiped down or cleaned for a long time. The bathrooms were filthy - no toilet paper on the holders (thank goodness there was some there) and trash on the floor. The soap dispenser was broken. On a positive note, there was an actual paper towel dispenser which is so unusual for a McDonald's.

The drive-thru speaker is a bit hard to understand.  My McWrap tasted really vinegar-y and the tomatoes had no flavor, keeping in step with most McDonalds' tomatoes. The McFlurry was good. When did ice cream become a beverage option, anyway?

They have a huge playground, which my kids love, but that's really the only reason I ever visit this McDonald's. The service is very hit-or-miss; they frequently get the order wrong, but they're friendly. And the food--it's standard McDonald's food, pretty much the same for the last 30+ years. Great fries, but not much else worth mentioning.

I have to say I was questioning this McDonalds from the looks on the outside, but due to the long drive-thru line we opted to brave it and head in for our sodas. The place was spotless and the service was excellent. Wow! They have Coke Zero now to my husbands delight! A quality McDonalds.

Not a bad McD's, but not a great one, either. Food was as expected, staff was mixed with some not too interested in much of anything and a manager doing her best to take care of everyone. Crowd was a bit sketchy for 2 PM on a Saturday. At 2 AM I expect it, but for the middle of the afternoon it all felt a bit...off.

I give this McDonald's 3 stars just for being across the street from Silver Legacy and you want to pickup something fast and cheap to munch on.  Too bad it's not 24 hours though.  Their $1 any size drinks are the best deal in Downtown Reno area.

Is the Egg White Delight McMuffin, delightfully delicious? Yes, if you add Frank's Hot Sauce. 

When you break down the nutrition facts and compare the new Egg White to the Regular McMuffin, there really isn't that much of a difference. You save 50 calories and 5 grams of fat ordering the EW. Ordering the regular Egg McMuffin you lose 1 gram of fiber and get 20 mg less of Sodium. If you count points on the Weight Watchers program, a regular McMuffin is 8 points and the new Egg White is 7. One point is not that big of a savings. The egg whites and white cheddar is not exclusive to the McMuffin, you can try it on any egg & cheese sandwich. Which means, you can have it your way. Oh wait, that is another burger joints phrase. 

Normally I am not a fan of McDonalds, but this one is close to work and surprisingly is better then any of the ones near my home in Saint Louis. When I am in need of a quick breakfast, this is a great place to stop. The staff is friendly and awake when I stop by at 5:30 AM.

This is the closest McDonalds to my home in Sparks, so I've ordered from the drive thru several times. Almost every other time, they manage to mess up my order. Don't get me wrong, the employees are nice and friendly. However, I honestly think that someone in the back doesn't know how to read (or chooses not to). 

Examples of how they've messed up my orders (each during different occasions):
- I ordered a GRILLED chicken sandwich. They gave me crispy. 
- I ordered fries with NO SALT. They give me extra salty fries
- I ordered a McGriddle, and they give me a McMuffin!! (Grrr) 
- I ordered a low-fat italian dressing for my salad. They gave me caesar dressing.


TIP: If you order from the drive thru, make sure to check your order before you leave.

I live about 3 miles from here and pass it often.....I try to pass it up everytime. Staff could care less and have pretty blah attitudes. If you go there 30 minutes before close to order a Frappe the machine is "broken" then MAGICALLY the VERY NEXT morning it's functioning.....yeah. This has happened to me 3 times. Who ever is closing doesn't want to clean the machine after close....too bad. They are losing my money just from that AND frequently but legitimately their credit card machine IS actually down.
This McDonalds is the worst one in the area. If you go inside you always seem rushed. The drive thru is better to use for better service. Still not good but if your hungry it will work.
