This is, by FAR, the worst Mc Donalds restaurant in town. The fries have, what tastes and feels like, half a container of salt dumped on them. The food is cold and definitely not fresh. It's the closest location to my house so we have tried it probably 7-8 times...each time being disappointed.

Manager named James had me waiting in drive thru while he served 2 intoxicated women who walked up to the drive thru. Making me and other customers IN VEHICLES wait for almost 20 mins while these drunk women held up the drive thru progress counting change and dropping it etc. 
I KNOW FOR A FACT THAT IT IS AGAINST YOUR POLICY TO SERVE ANYONE WHO WALKS UP YOUR DRIVE THRU WINDOWS.

When I mentioned this to James, he said we are done here and slammed the window closed refusing to give me my food. 
THIS WAS VERY RUDE AND NO WAY TO TREAT A PAYING CUSTOMER. 
Calling main office.
JAMES DOES NOT ACT LIKE A MANAGER BUT MORE LIKE A BULLY!
 
Worst McDonald's in the area!
 
 What happened to quality control and pride.

I ordered a small coffee and a cup of fruit oatmeal. After waiting in line for about 10 minutes, I was given the wrong order. I explained what I orders and they have me the coffee and told me to pull forward to wait for the oatmeal.  It then took just under 10 minutes to bring me the oatmeal.  OATMEAL!!!!

Tried the new habanero quarter pounder. The habanero sauce was actually pretty spicy. More than I expected. Very nice McDs. The bacon is much improved putting it close to Wendys bacon. I couldn't taste the white cheddar with the sauce covering it. Maybe it helped cool things off a bit. Unfortunately it's still the same old quarter pounder patty which is really lagging behind in the burger wars. Put a wendys burger on this thing and it would be awesome. So, a great effort from McDs. But they really have to redo their burger patty to be competitive.

The last time I came here, I'm pretty sure they made my iced coffee with sweet tea.  The time before that, they forgot my order for like 15min and then forgot to put sugar in my iced coffee.  The time before THAT, they didn't put cream (or whatever the fake cream is) in it.

I'm not ashamed to admit I visit McD's from time to time and I don't expect fine dining.  But this place is bad even by the chain's standards.  Also, it smells like poo.  There, I said it.
Waited in drive thru for 5 minutes and no one helped me. Went up to window and they ignored me. They definitely lost my business today.

Yep it was pretty quick, but they screwed up my order and gave me hardly any fries. I had ordered the quarter pounder with bacon and cheese, I got a regular. I called the manager, who I could hardly understand, which was very frustrating on top of having my order wrong, which cost $8.15 for burger, small fry and small shake. She wanted to blame the wrong order on the fact that I was asking questions about what the difference was between the different quarter pounders. This made no sense, since my receipt clearly said bacon cheese. She was unhelpful and unapologetic. And what's the point of having four quarter pounders if they're going to give you what they want to anyway. Very bad customer service and a bad value altogether. I'll go the extra distance to In-n-Out. Always good, always right!

This location has recently "upgraded" with a two-lane drive thru -- BAD move, at least late night on weekends.  This morning, I waited in line over *30 minutes* without being able to place an order, stuck in the inside, left-hand lane with 20 minutes of that time spent sitting at the intercom.  Finally I was able to make my escape once the right hand lane cleared enough (mostly because the folks waiting there also abandoned their attempts at late-night Big Macs...)
My advice to the management? Either staff appropriately for the two lanes, or rip out that second lane.

We have tried this McDonalds at least a half dozen times only because it is near where I work. It may be the worst McDonalds on the planet.  Each visit involved a messed up order with either missing items or something inedible like burgers cooked until they were dry as dust in the center, fries tasting of old grease, and even the simple ice cream cone delivered with the cone mostly empty and a wacky looking small blob of ice cream hanging half off... with no offer of napkins. The employees seem as if thy do not want to be bothered by waiting on customers. Inside the store it is small, dirty, and noisy. Most of the noise seems to be coming from the kitchen equipment.
I might roll the dice and try this McDonalds again, but only as a last resort.

Worst McDonalds Ever, You never get what you order, it took 13 times so I could finally get a grilled club, every time I order one I got crispy, I ordered a grill the counter girl put in for a crispy in the receipt and a got a grill, they are backwards. No pickles no onions meas extra to them, I ask for an apple pie I got a cherry pie, I don't get it, why are they so dumb? all they do its yell at each other and talk about other people they are not professional at all and if it wasn't because there is nothing else to eat around on my lunch time I would never go there, actually if I didn't have an hour lunch I wouldn't be able to go there it takes them about 20 to 30 min to give you your food, but they sure take it off the screen on time so they look good If you can avoided go to any other mcdonalds if I was the owner of this place I would start from scratch the managers got no control of anyone of their employees

This is by far the worst McDonald's in the city. It is the only one I've been in that has armed security. There is a foul smell of urine and mop water, to go along with the flies. The service is awful, I had to wait 15 minutes for two cheeseburgers even though there were only two other people in the store who also placed small orders.
Avoid this McDonald's.
Fine. Sometimes good but sometimes, like today, they skimp. There are better McDonald's and worse.
Super nice people working there,. Just couldn't get the ice tea correct. Ordered the fish, there was no tarter sauce on it ??? Slow pace

I'm done with this McDonalds.  Everytime I go there I get frustrated at the unprofessional slobs that work there.  This time, I waited in line for over 5 minutes and there were only 2 people in front of me.  The staff is terrible and care more about preparing their own food, checking their email or texting and complaining to each other about customers.  

Do yourself a favor, go to one of the other fast food restaurants!

This MCD location really sucks!!!

Stopped in for a quick breakfast sandwich and they gave me an Egg McMuffin with a grey egg on it.  No idea how they managed to make the egg look so unappetizing but they did.  I took it back to the counter 100% intact and showed it to the employee so that I could get another one.  He gave it to one of the guys in the kitchen area who slapped a new egg on the exact same sandwich and handed it back, not even wrapped properly.  

I walked back to my table and opened up the mess to discover another grey egg and a thoroughly mangled sandwich from the trauma of the blunt-force remake it had experienced.  I went back to the counter with the 100% intact (albeit roughed-up) sandwich again and asked the manager to simply swap it out for a different sandwich instead...one with a folded egg instead of a round egg.  I received it and walked back to the table again.  The sandwich was basically intact but not giving off enough heat from any of its components to even begin to melt the cheese.  Yuck.  

As if all of this weren't bad enough, I also got to witness the same manager yelling at a customer about having to pay extra for a second thing of syrup with the pancakes she ordered.  Seriously!?!

There are plenty of Golden Arches Supper Club locations nearby...don't make the same mistake I did by stopping at this one.

This location has drive-thru and customer service down pat. I can't believe I haven't reviewed it here before today. It's near my office, and although I'm on a pretty strict eating plan, an occasional visit is OK. I was on my way to a last-minute meeting so I ate on the fly.

The only scary thing about this drive thru is that at around 11:15 a.m., the line starts to back up on to southbound Hanley. But the SPEED! They have a worker stationed outside with a wireless tablet, and she works her way up the line much faster than they could using the traditional method. Add extra points for having a sincere smile on her face! 

The line moves quickly, snaking around the back of the store to the pay window on the other side, also staffed by a friendly, smiling cashier. There's no fumbling with change, and just enough time to compliment her on the speed before the line moves forward again. By the time I got to the pickup window, the person working the window had to wait a good two seconds for ME. Wow. 

Because I was in a hurry, I pulled into a space in the Home Depot parking lot. Everything was fresh, hot, and good tasting. Well made, and the order was correct. 

I really wish other franchisees (I'm looking at YOU, South Kingshighway and Hampton Village) would visit this location and learn what kind of magic they use to train their employees. They're all really wonderful.

My review is strictly for the drive thru of the 111st, 23rd ave McDonald's, as I only stop in the drive thru on my way to work to grab coffee when I am either running late or Starbucks isn't open yet. 

I have always been extremely satisfied with this location. The service is prompt (it's crazy, there are lines at the drive thru even at 5am!), my order has always been correct, the prices cannot be beaten, and the coffee isn't half bad. 

This location has 2 ordering lanes that merge towards the payment window, so when it's busy they can take 2 vehicles orders at a time and get 2 orders ready at a time, making the line move a lot faster.

I hardly ever eat fast food anyway. Coming home from soccer practice and we were starving. So we stopped at the closest place, McDonalds. We stopped in the bathroom, almost cracked my head on the slippery floor. By the way, there was no caution wet floor. Then we got our food. It was ok. I have had better but it wasn't all that bad. All in all, fast food is not for me.

Time to yelp! about this McD's.

So I ride a bud to work most of the time because I'm lacking a car right no and this place is right in front of a bus stop--it just so happens it's the stop just before the one I usually get off on, so it's within walking distance. The first time I went here it was with a couple friends of mine that were dropping me off at work and it was nothing special. I think my order was wrong or something about it was stale or cold. Never a good thing for a place that boasts about fresh, hot food, fast.

I went again and again and each successive time it got better. People know me there now (not sure if that's a good thing or  bad thing, ha ha!). When I go for brekkers (breakfast for those non-nonsense people) the sandwich is hot and delicious. I get the Sausage and Cheese McGriddle, it's kinda like a combination of sausage, eggs, and a pancake bun with syrup baked into it. When I go for lunch its the double quarter pounder with cheese and a drink, also very good.

Most of the time the restaurant is clean, but not all the time, sometimes it's got dirty tables or some such stuff, hence why it was only given four stars. But overall, a good, quick place to stop and eat and enjoy the warmth of some of the workers there.

Thanks again and happy yelping!

I visited the drive thru. The employee didn't greet me, say thank you, or give me my receipt.  If you're going to be the face of the business then at least try to put an effort to be friendly. I hope the service inside is better....

Drive through service was horrible. I had to wait and wait and wait. When I asked why, I was told that the orders were getting mixed up. No apology, no further statements. He just shut the window on me. There are plenty of other choices in the are and I will be choosing them!!

I would avoid this McDonald's at all costs. I ordered a medium fry and a cinnamelt from this location for a quick late breakfast on a weekend morning. It took over 5 minutes to receive my food, the customer service was terrible, they did not have honey for my french fries then they wanted to charge me $0.60 for ranch dressing to dip my fries in, and forgot to include the eating utensils for my cinnamelt.

Except a burger patty in a McChicken they add nothing else except a drop of literally a drop of McChicken sauce and a lettuce leaf. Literally single lettuce leaf. Worst McD ever to go for if you like your McD buger as you see in ads or as you tasted at others places than do go to this place. I will rather say they should close this down if they cant deliver the McDonald's level of quality and quantity.

Slow service. Dirty floors. Dirty tables. Dirty drink bar. Cashiers spend more time fraternizing with friends than attending to the growing line of customers. And if someone doesn't turn off that fry alarm... Great parking lot though. Nice trees.
Nothing I love more than paying $3 for a sausage mcmuffin, a breakfast burrito, and cup of coffee served with a side of attitude. I feel like I got a deal when they threw that in!

wrote this email to corporate about this store a few months ago... 
In ' Star Wars ' Obi Wan Kenobi used a descriptive sentence to describe a spaceport called Mos Eisley.. The descriptive? ' A wretched hive of scum and villainy ' .... I think if Obi Wan lived in the Antioch area, of Nashville TN, he would use the same words to describe the Mcdonalds located at 331 HARDING PL (I-24)
I've gone here for years as it's convenient to my residence, but after the past week. I'm done. The amount of calls or emails I send to discuss the outright horrendous nature of this store, never do anything to help. I've talked to General Manager after General Manager and nothing ever gets resolved. At this point, I'm thinking this Mcdonalds must be built over an Indian Burial ground.... But, not a regular Indiana Burial Ground, where the spirits come back to cause mischief and mayhem. I think this Mcdonalds was built over an Indian Burial ground where the Indians buried their mentally insufficient. Because the amount of outright buffoonery at this store... Well, there's no other logical explanation, than the mentally insufficient spirits of Indians coming to inhabitate the bodies of the workers....
A few weeks ago I went to this store around 10:45 pm.... Wanting to get a late night snack after being out with friends. I approached the drive thru window and immediately I get ' yo.... Systems down, man ' .... At first, I thought maybe the speaker system had inadvertently picked up the radio transmission from the hotel across the street where someone was watching a Sci Fi movie and Marlon Wayans was telling some astronaut about their control panel going haywire... ' Yo, systems down, man '. But alas, this wasn't the case. As I came back with ' what? ' . ' yo, systems down man ' . Either the intercepted radio transmission was on a loop or the person manning the speaker thought I could interpret what this meant.... At Mcdonalds.... Maybe if I pulled into the NASA drive thru, I would know what this means, but at McDonalds? Nope. So, I inquired ' so what does that mean ' . I waited.... Then got shouted at by the man in the speaker ' yo man. It means we closed '. This was shocking, as when most businesses close, they turn off lights, have no customers in the store, the drive thru lights are off... This time though all the lights were on,,,, customers milling about inside the store.... Drive thru station lights were on, menu was lit up, no sign was placed on the speakers, to say ' yo.... Systems down, man... or woman - not to be gender specific ' .... But no.... I had the sneaking suspicion this was code for ' yo, we don't wanna work, man, so we came up with this convenient excuse ' ..... You might be saying to yourself ' wow, that's a mighty big leap in judgment ' .... It is, however, it's grounded in some basis of fact. As my mother has told me a tale of recently going there and being told their entire circuit board was down.... First, why does McDonalds use a circuit board? Secondly, the biggest fast food company in the WORLD has the absolute worst electronics? I mean, where did you guys get your systems from?! ' Eddie's Electronic & Sub Shop ' located in some shanty in between 3rd and 4th avenue?!
Also unacceptable things at this store
- It seems like everytime I go to this store I get a drive thru speaker who can't speak conversation English. I'm not asking for someone to enunciate properly or someone to speak in The Kings English. Just someone I can understand what they're trying to say to me.... That's all I ask.... It seems like a daily meeting is called and the manager goes ' ok, who here communicates in the least intelligible speech?! ' someone raises their hand ' ok. Good, you do the drive thru speaker ' Logic people.logic....
- Sometimes when I pull around to pick up my food, and the person opens the drive thru door to hand me it, a rush of flies will come out and fly around my car, then off into the distance.... This is unsettling.... Shouldn't this be the other way around?! I mean if flies are flying away from the food, it sorta speaks volumes....
- The smell.... There's something weird about the smell inside and outside the store that permeates the air... I can't put my finger on it. My mom swears theres a sewer line that bust somewhere close by... I just tell her that's the smell of laziness and despair that emanates from inside the store.... I'm probably not that far off....

Don't know if under new management or what.  The service is very very slow regarless of whether you drive through or dine in.  This place is not where I would go if in a hurry.  

The food is ok typical McDonald;s food.  So you know what you are goign to get.

"that's not my job" was the phrase of this McDonald's No one in the restaurant wantted to work. The employees were fighting among themselves and screwing up my entire order. Apparently they can not read or do not care. Not one employee was friendly, professional or wantted to do their job. I do not want to hear the cashier complain to me about her co-workers. The entire staff needs to go back to training 101. Beware of the Rock Hill , MO McDonald's!

The guy at the cash register was very nice, but the overall service was okay. Not anything against the business but the people in there were not helpful when my grandma needed help walking to the bathroom. I got lots of stares and no help

This place is a zoo with a 20-minute eating time limit, only understandable once you walk through the door. The only reason we did was because of my 6-year old's meltdown. Chicken nuggets were necessary to calm his stretched temper. Too many guests, not enough seating, and plenty of folks that really look like they would park it if not for the 20-minute limit. We gave the kiddies their Happy Meals and moved on to somewhere else for our meal.

Usually I avoid these places like the black death, but this one is an exception. Good staff who does what they can to help the customers. The menu is tasteful and the location clean. They use a lot of students as help and that is a plus.

This McDonalds is hit or miss. There have been many late nights where I get a craving for a mcdouble. when I get to the mcdonalds there is only one man working and half the time he only takes cash. I don't often carry cash so i have to drive across town to another mcdonalds to satisfy my craving. I once called this mcdonalds just to test their phone service skills. I asked them a question and they hung up on me without answering. This aspect of the business could surely use some improvement. Regardless, I'm going to continue to support their business cause its cheap food and I'm a student with very little money.
They are all confused here. Someone needs to help these employees get it together. The food was cold, bread was stale and it took way too long. We will not be going back.

No wait to order, but the food took a little longer than average for a McDonald's. I asked for my cheeseburgers plain with cheese,  but they came with pickles, onions, mustard, and ketchup. Seating was pleasant for myself and my baby daddy. Overall and okay experience for a McDonald's.

The worst McDonalds I've ever been in. Don't stop here. It smells funny, the service is awful and the drink machine delivers improperly mixed sodas. 

I was first served a chicken sandwich; but ordered a quarter pounder so I took it back. The drive-thru attendant shouted, "You took my sandwich." and took the box from me, closed it and put it in the customer's bag. Are you supposed to re-serve food? I think not!

This is strictly for the girl Heather who waited on me the other night.  The place was full of drunks and losers and she still was the most sweet, pleasant, and helpful person.  I can't say I would have been the same way so kudos to Heather for providing great customer service under crappy working conditions.

Stopped in about 10pm one night. Service took forever. They grilled the chicken for our order of McWraps, so they asked us to pull to a parking spot and they would bring the food to us when it was done. Between the time we sat in the drive-through and in the parking lot, it was at least 30 minutes. I went in to ask how long it would be. They said 2 minutes.

5 minutes later I went back in and asked for a refund for the food we didn't get. I expressed my dissatisfaction with the service and that it's not fast food if they don't make it fast. I said I could have gone to In-And-Out Burger and been in and out by now. The cashier and who I assumed to be the floor manager didn't seem to take me seriously at first, perhaps because I look funny when I'm angry, but they ended up being apologetic about the issue. She tried to explain that things work differently at night because they cook things custom, blah blah blah. I've been to many McDonald's late at night and it has never taken that long. Both McWraps we were waiting for were done by the time our conversation neared the end.

I am giving this place two stars because she gave me a refund for both McWraps, gave us the actual McWraps, and the food was about as good as McDonald's gets. However, I would not return to this establishment unless I was desperately hungry and somehow unable to drive any further.

I know, it is a McDonalds, what should I expect...how about getting our order right?   Ordered a chicken wrap got a chicken sandwich.  No "I'm sorry"?    Fries are the yummy, almost better than in-n-out.   Table was dirty.

They were suuuuper busy. And some people were just *not* having it. The woman in line in front of me was a pill and, though she had already ordered, refused to move to the side to let other's order until she got her food. Chill out woman....you're at a McDonalds at noon...it's gonna be busy. 
Anywhoozle. The food was typical McD's fare. The workers were fairly pleasant.
The faucet in the bathroom seemed to be an automatic one, but it never turned on. So....Purell all the way, please.

This has to be the worst McDonalds I have ever been to in my entire life.  There hasn't been ONE order they literally haven't screwed up (we don't go that often, maybe once a month?)!! And they have an attitude problem. Not only that, my husband was so upset with this last order (among the many) that he went back to replace the food, and they didn't replace our entire order!  So now, they only replaced one sandwich n he had to come back with cold fries n cold sandwiches; all because they messed up. It is a courtesy to make sure when you leave, that food is hot and fresh, and it was not done.  We only go here because its right up the street from our house.  Now, we'd rather drive further for better service. I'm over this dump.  So sad...
Dont even go here. I have waited for 20 minutes in the drive thru many times and they always mess up what you order. These workers don't have one care about customer service.

Traveling today 7/5/13 , stopped here around 6:30 pm. Think my ticket number was 963. Worse meal I have EVER purchases at a Mc Donald's. husband got premium chicken classic, I got quarter pounder delux, daughter got quarter pounder, grand kids got happy meals. Bread was so old and stale that it smelled. Sandwiches and fries were cold and apple juice was fermented. Still gagging from this meal. I paid $25 and some change and it will take me a while to get over this meal.

Since the former manager left last year the cleanliness of the restaurant has definitely gone down a notch...many of the local liveaboards use the men's bathroom for their daily hygiene. As a result,  the cleanliness of the men's room in particular has really been allowed to deteriorate under the new manager, Kim. No hand sanitizer for the last 5 months and management was asked to replace it on several occasions and has not done so. Assistant manager was also advised last week.  The counter is often a long wait as they only have one person working the counter and sometimes 10 or 11 people in line. The view, however is still impeccable! We miss you Jim!

Just.  Don't.  Seriously, if you're looking for breakfast, there's an Ihop down the street.  If you need fast food for lunch, there's a Krystal about a block away.

This is my first 1 star review *ever*, and it's because I witnessed something appalling and a ridiculous response by the staff.  

Is there anything less than 1?

McDonald's a always a good travel stop on the long hauls and I understand that these franchises vary from town to town and city McD's can be very busy.  Noted and expected.

We were just very disappointed with the courtesy (or lack thereof) of the counter staff.  Mumbling, no eye contact, snippy with everyone.

Looooonggg waits by everyone after they ordered seemed to be the norm around here, as everyone just waited in an orderly fashion.  First time I saw the patrons acting right and the staff acting up.

I won't stop there again if I pass through Nashville, but I just hope this location remembers that you should each customer with a smile, cuz you may not get a 2nd chance to undo damage.  And no one wants to be a bad memory.

Good location, though, by Centennial Park.  Convenient.

Open 24 hours, basically a normal McDonald's, staff is mostly young kids/adults. 
But I'm a huge fan of the $1 drink special they have on now!
Sure, the restroom smells like farts.  But it's McDonalds.  The whole place smells like farts.  They sell farts.

Fast, fresh, and accurate. Got my special order right and exceeded my expectations. Night and day difference to the McDonalds further east in pinellas park which was the worst ever. My family was very satisfied.
Decent, love the Philly sports collections around the resturant

July 6, 2013 Saturday - breakfast 6:00 AM
2 adults & kid

Atmosphere - NA
Food - 4 stars
Service - 4 stars

Background - Tried to go to Carl's Jr. just down the street but their breakfast is limited and they were missing items, because of this they had nothing for my daughter.

Atmosphere - No rating as we went through the drive thru.

Food
  Appetizer - none today.

  Drinks - I skipped this as I had some canned Starbucks drinks with me.

  My Main Course - I had two sausage egg mcmuffins.  What you expect in these breakfast sandwiches, but nothing that great.

  Dessert - None today.

Service - The ordering station had a display unit to verify what you ordered. They used two windows first to collect your money and the second to deliver your money.

Future - sure.
For va fast food restaurant, it wasnj't bad. I love the fact that children can sit and eat in the play place. Another thing I like about this McDonald's is that  the staff is always cleaning.

First time I have eaten inside of a McDonalds in many many years. I'm a Drive Thru Chickie Pooh. Clearly, they have modernized the interior. Not bad for a fast food chain.

Ambient lighting with contemporary light fixtures as well as ceiling lights to brighten things up. Both booth seating & high/low tables.

I had a breakfast biscuit with sausage and cheese. It was a 6 in the scale of deliciousness. Sausagae ans cheese were appetizing. Nothing can beat my grandmother's homemade buttermilk biscuits. Nostalgia.

Oh McDonald's why do you screw up so much?

I always have had difficulties with this particular Mcdonald's. The main problems are the fact that they are not consistent with food and they take way longer than they need to prepare the food. Given that fact I usually try to avoid this particular one. I stopped here this morning to get some breakfast. I ordered the sausge egg and cheese mcgriddle. When I got out to my car I noticed that they had given me a sausage egg and cheese biscuit. Since I had to make it to work soon I decided not to go in and complain. But still that really annoyed me. Given my experience with the many other McDonald's restaurants I dealt with in the past I decided not to sweat it.

In Short this is fast food so you can't expect to much.

I am very discontented with the service of this McDonalds,  I don't know how to give no STARS to this Mc Donald's, even I am returning customer I stop to get my breakfast and I did ask for special sandwich by takeoff the sausage and put Canadian bacon and this manager Rodrigo did not let the cashier to change the meat on my sandwich, I am so disappointed about this restaurant, they should have the customers happy and more if they know they are returning customers.....This manager needs to get some management classes!!!
Awful slow for a non peak time.  Customers honking to get service at drive through.  Other than that it was ok.
This McDonalds has recently been rebuilt. Very modern with 2 drive up ordering stations. Of the times I've been here for Ice coffee, it's been fast, efficient , and friendly.

Wow, this is the first time I've visited a McDonalds and I was the only customer in the place! This was at 9:30 in the morning too. I guess this was the morning rush hour lull.

Obviously the service was great. Sadly the only thing I bought, ice coffee, was subpar. Seeing it was Monday, my guess was the coffee was old. When that happens the coffee gets bitter. I actually threw the last half of it away after a few minutes.

I am admittedly an ice coffee addict. Starbucks is way too bitter, also too expensive for my taste. Dunkin Donuts was my favorite. But again too inconsistent from store to store. I do know the good ones to go to though. Surprisingly, McDonalds has much more consistent ice coffee from store to store. 

This one let me down. :-(
Bad, slow service and no mirror in women's bathroom.

This is by far the worst mcds I have EVER been to I go here quite regular with disappointment EVERYTIME they mess up orders over and over and are extremely  bad with customer service ! I have gone there and watched a girl suck on her finger while bagging food ! Do not go here if at all possible ! U will never get fresh fries even if u ask
Not a bad McDonalds. Staff was on their game and my food came out fresh and right on the first try. Sweet tea is like crack though so be forewarned... you might become addicted... I know I am.

Avoid. I wish we had known about the cute retro McD's down the street a few miles instead of going here, but I'm not really familiar with this neighborhood. The cashier messed up my order (go figure), the machines were broken and gross and dirty, and I got to watch a colony of ants march down the wall as we sat in the corner eating. My bad for wanting a McWrap anyway instead of something healthier....
It's hot outside, Sweet Tea time!!!

What makes this international franchise location different from other McDonald's? It's open 24 hours. Too bad it's slow as could be. Employees here are more interested in talking to each other than taking orders or preparing food. The wait time aside, this location could be cleaner. It's not that it's filthy but it's certainly a little dirty. It really shows that employees here are not invested in their job or the company and really don't care about the image they present.

But at least I can get a cheeseburger at 3 am.
I was here the other weekend for lunch and this place its very small the smallest Mac donalds I ve seen. Even the drive service get full with a lot of cars. Service its slow . Food its good.
Didn't have any problems with this McDonalds, but I just went through the drive thru for a couple orders of fries and McChickens..  Not much else to say!

Mc Shelter!  

 Worst Mc Donald's ever! Hangout for druggies. Backpacks, bicycles and homeless in front of "restaurant", filthy bathrooms and dirty unkempt, poorly trained employees Given wrong order after a 20 minute wait surrounded by smelly, dirty people. When I brought the incorrect burger up to request the correct one, I had to call out to get someone's attention. Five minutes later my burger was ready and waiting under the lights, when a dirty backpack toting girl came rushing in announcing loudly that she now had a cellphone. The manager/ supervisor stopped everything to greet and hug over the counter and exchange phone numbers while 10 customers waited in line. I finally spoke out again and asked for my Burger which had already been sitting there ready for at least 5 minutes. They also forgot the sauce for my wife's chicken nugget order, so I had to request that as well. Meanwhile, our food was getting cold and as anyone knows, the fries MUST be hot or they're not so good. This particular store had a 30 minute "stay" period before they kicked you out. We barely were able to get our food, let alone eat it, within that time frame. We ate quickly to get out of this "McShelter" and will definitely never go there again.
  I highly recommend going down the street to "The Nugget", a small little diner in back of the casino with great food, friendly people and awesome prices! Much better atmosphere and way less expensive.

No outlets for plugging in devices :(

This appears to be a newer Mc Donalds and the service is good, food is standard Mc. Donald's fair... the inside is up to date and clean. However, that being said... the fact that I cannot plug my computer in is a bummer.
Five Star McDonalds hands down! extremely clean and the staff was kind and professional.

It is the golden arches... not to be confused with the golden M... Clean place. They have their slow periods but for the most part they get the food to you pretty quick. I must admit though I mainly come here to get my sweet tea fix... Liquid crack. Damn now I want a sweet tea...

Breakfast experience:  Okay wait time in drive thru line at 9:30am, placed order, Sausage McGriddle, is your order correct on screen? Yep.  Paid and drive thru staff was friendly. Go home block away, open the bag, extra napkins and what the heck is this, nasty looking Egg White Delight with ham.   Go back to McD's, go inside, no acknowledgment, excuse me my order is wrong, takes bag, tells coworker, throws sandwich in bag, gives me bag.  No I'm sorry.  No care if my sandwich was probably cheaper, so no refund, just careless employees.  Bottom line:  go somewhere else for breakfast.

I had some breakfast here this morning. I will admit that this McDonald's is usually consistent with their food. But the customer service is lacking here. The employees lack the drive to really sell their food at this specific location. But honestly it doesn't surprise me in the least. This is McDonalds we are talking about not a gourmet restaurant.

In short cheap, decent food, but very lackluster customer service.

It's a McDonalds....not much else to say.  Its a 24 hour location (drive thru only for late night)...Quality is the norm, which is to say good.  My only issue with this store is that they do not like to adhere to customary service hours for dinner and breakfast.  To clarify, the nighttime transition to breakfast from dinner selections can and do occur on a whim, and that whim is usually the 19 year-old punk serving as the crew chief that night.  

Usually due to cleaning up after dinner, then after prepping the breakfast items earlier than normal, they will just start to serve breakfast rather than having to re-open and re-prep dinner supplies....and will just continue with breakfast thru to morning.  

According to McDonalds, their "breakfast-after-midnight" program was implemented to offer breakfast items along with dinner items until a certain hour...usually 2am...or sometimes 430am....however this store has at times I have visited stopped serving hamburgers at 11pm...and was on the breakfast menu....thats absurd.  

I've email chatted with Cathy the manager here to let her know what was going on, but have not been back since that exchange.  Not due to the issues, but just haven't been back....no real reason other than avoiding fast food as much as I can.  My normal trips here usually occur after midnight, perhaps traveling back from a friends house late at night and hungry for a snack.

Dropping a star.....it seems this place just can't keep up with humanity.   I arrive at 345am.... At a 24 hour store only to be told we can't accept orders for 25-30 mins.... What?.  Seems the same mgmt (Cathy) can't get this sheet together.  I come and order only to be told they're on breakfast menu at 11pm then we're just not accepting orders now........aaahhhh the days of corporate ownership.  Franchising is such a bastard way of business.... I despise it....and all who franchise.   There's just no accountability....

This location is convenient for us and we visit at least twice/week.  The food is usually good and certainly (in our opinion) meets McDonalds standards.  What we do not understand is how frequently their ice cream and/or milk shakes are not available either because of breakdowns or because they have run out of product.  Also, their automatic soda filling machine consistently overfills cups and we almost always are handed sticky, wet soda cups with the soda oozing through the tops.  This requires us to ask for napkins and park the vehicle so we can do a "clean up" before driving on.  

This location has a lot of potential but never seems to get beyond the same problems that we have experienced there for years.
double quarter pounder.....who loves ya  baby

It's a McDonalds, with these shortcomings...
- Lots of tables dirty.
- WiFi didn't work.
- Music in dining area kept going in and out.
- Diet Dr. Pepper tasted off.

As someone else pointed out... The franchises owned by "Blessed and Faith" have got the worst, most unfriendly service I have ever seen. You would think buy putting God out there on their signs they would work harder to be a blessing in someone's day. It is horrible when you have to actively avoid the Md's that have the "Faith and Blessed" signs posted. Please listen when i place my order. Say hello, say thank you, say have a blessed day.

Well, I never review fast food restaurants unless they are horrific or much better than average.  I sometimes stop here for breakfast before work on the weekends because it's one of the few places on my way to work that's open.

I've shown up a couple times, being the only one there, and I have never gotten in and out of there in under 10 minutes.  They also always seem to get my order wrong.  An egg McMuffin and a breakfast burrito... REAL TOUGH.  

On my last visit, at 5:30 in the morning (their sign says they open at 5), and their door was still locked.  A vapid employee looked at me, I knocked, gestured that the door was locked, and he slowly meandered over to unlock it, then went behind the counter, faced away from me, not doing anything, just staring at the wall.  5 minutes later the manager thought I might want to order, order came back and it was wrong, and the SAUSAGE egg mcmuffin's muffin was rock hard, and they were out of hot sauce.
This RESTRAUNT is horrible even though we go here all the time apparently, I don't love it at all.
Awwwww, nothing like an after 8 pm Sweet Tea w/ 2 lemons... Yup, I can't help myself.

Worst service ever.  Nobody working registers, and 3 managers sitting at table ignoring customer.  Waited 10 minutes to waited on in a fast food Resturant.  McDonald's standards have dropped wayyyyyy off.
Every time I go to this McDonald's for breakfast they always up charge me for a medium soda. I specifically ask for a small, too. Do the employees get a some sort of commission from this?

Whenever I have my son and its just a mommy/son date night, I often ask his opinion on what he wants to eat... 9 times out of 10 he will choose McDonalds... if you go inside, I've never had an issue, the food is always to be expected, and never had an issue..
However....yesterday I was STARVING and i decided to grab a chicken ranch snackwrap, a small fry and a small iced tea....
i eat my fries, then on to my snackwrap.. i have no idea what the heck it was, some kind of bbq crap but it was NOT my ranch snackwrap.....
I was sooooo heartbroken bc i had my heart set on what I wanted, so thanks for that McDonalds.. we will continue to come back, but for the love of food please make sure your workers get orders right!

I got lured into this place because they have some bizarre moon/burger-face man logo that I've never seen at a McD's before ... from Virginia you can't see the arches or McDonalds signage and it looks like a Bob's Big Boy!

McD's as a chain has terrible food that really can't rise above 2* at best for nearly all of the menu, but this location is about as good as they can get - clean, spacious, pleasant employees ... if this is one of those locations that has WiFi, it's the McDonald's Quadfecta. Oh and they're apparently open 24 hours too.

I gave up on most of the menu years ago but the $1 Sausage McMuffin is easily the best cheap breakfast sandwich around, and their $1.25 sundaes are actually pretty decent too

You know...I used to come to this McDonald's back in the day with my dad religiously every weekend for breakfast before we hit the river in Collegeville for a day of fishing, but for the first time in years I was back in this establishment last week, and I didn't think it was that bad (cleanliness wise) until I went to use the restroom, and the urinal was falling off of the wall, and the sink looked as well maintained as the toilet. Needless to say, I hope that's not the restroom the employees wash their hands in before they cook our food!

This is one of the newer McDonald's. It sits across from the west entrance to the Largo Mall on Seminole Blvd. The employees all seem on the ball and friendly. One of the better run McDonalds in the area.

Again, this is based of the quickness of the staff, and quallity of mainly the Ice Coffee.

Worst McDonald's ever...and that's sayin' something. My wife's iced latte was a disaster. I got the wrong food; there was no organization. You go to McDonalds for speed and consistency. This had neither.

This McDonalds was completely remodeled last year -- it might have actually been rebuilt but I'm not positive on that. It is very clean and service is quick. In the morning, it's oftentimes faster to park and go inside rather than wait for the drive-through line to move.

By far the slowest fast food restaurant experience I have ever had. I couldn't even get mad about it - I truly felt sorry for the employees. The manager was lost and just stood with his back to the customers, looking haplessly at the order screen. I wanted to jump behind the counter and give directions, as nobody seemed to know what what was going on.

Is it odd that I'm reviewing a McDonald's, one of the most available restaurants in the world? Probably. But, let's face it, just because your logo shows up all over the globe doesn't mean that the quality is consistent. And that's especially true for this location.

The website says that this McDonald's has a 24-hour drive-thru but, upon arriving at 4:45 the other morning to get my friend some food before heading to the airport, there was absolutely no response at the drive thru speaker. At. All. I drove around to see if anyone was inside and, sure enough, there was. So we tried again and...nothing. We gave up and headed to the airport sans breakfast burritos. 

I can't say I've eaten here a lot--maybe three or four times--but each time the service (when I've received it) has been moderately friendly and relatively expedient. Each time I've gone, though, something has been forgotten.

I know, I know...it's a McDonald's (reference more pithy musings from my other McDonald's review). But this one is especially irritating. Consistently unhappy employees, cold or improperly made food, and inattention to orders. 

I found it especially irritating once when I ordered some breakfast burritos. I asked for extra packets of mild salsa and the lady at the window grumpily quipped, "It's in the bag." I said, "I know, but I would like some extra packets of salsa...I use a lot of salsa." It would have taken less of her time to just grab a few packets and put them in the bag but, instead, she got pretty immediately angry and repeated (louder this time) that there were already salsa packets in the bag. I, too, repeated myself, pointing out that sometimes a gal just like extra salsa. That didn't fly. I gave up because, after all, salsa's not like my lifeblood or anything. But seriously...why couldn't I just have extra salsa. 

McDonald's are everywhere...go to another one. This one is especially rock-bottomy.

Since this is a McDonald's, I went in with low expectations, but this place still managed to fall short of this low bar. I ordered a chicken sandwich with no mayo. I had to wait 20+ minutes for the sandwich. When it finally arrived, sure enough, my sandwich was slathered in mayo. When I informed the cashier of her mistake, she replied curtly that I hadn't said no mayo. Of course, I had. After another 10+ minutes of waiting, I finally had my sandwich. So much for fast food.

This place is almost always filled with either hoodrats or drunk Penn kids. Stay away.

Gave me a soda when I wanted a coffee.  This seems to be a common problem considering other reviews. 

Otherwise, it's McDonalds.

Inside is better than drive-thru as with most fast food places because I feel they try harder to get your order accurate knowing you will be there to complain if it isn't rather than driving off and not wanting to bother making the return trip.  I've had 50-50 luck with the drive-thru here with weekends the worst for order accuracy.  The same with customer service/friendliness versus attitude & not caring.

Dining inside always seems to generate a better food quality and order accuracy but wait times are much longer.  I get it that drive-thru is a priority but I've seen 5 vehicles get their order before me but not at this location.  Wait times inside here seem to be quicker than other locations or other chains.

Happy meal toys are rotated more consistently than other chains.  Mop service was speedy one time when we needed it.  This is the closest one for us so they get more of our business by default.

This restaurant recently completed a remodel and their facility looks nice.  The service is consistently awful though!  I don't expect much from fast-food employees but this place takes that to a whole new low.  Avoid it!  Subway and Dairy Queen are located nearby, they are nothing exceptional but much better than this McDonalds.
Avoid this place like the plague !! Cold food, nasty drinks and rude service 24/7. It needs to be shut down !
I've eaten here a few times and the food was fresh enough to write something about. I know...I know, it's McDonald's, but when executed properly, it's delicious.

I got a rubbery egg this morning. Yellow on one side and orange on the other. I went up to a manager to get a new egg. I got it after having to produce the bad egg. I was offended that she didn't take me at my word.

Lol, the staff needs to know what's on their menu, they have a sign by the drive thru order place for soft serve ice cream and I tried ordering it and they claimed they don't have ice cream. Not that they were out or whatever, but they they never carry it. Weird
Anyways, they usually mess up an order every other time I come here. The food is fine, I just wish the service was better.

I mean, it's McDonald's, folks. Don't come here (or any location I imagine) and expect greatness. Almost every Sunday I treat myself to a large vanilla iced latte and sometimes a sausage burrito. Well, EVERY TIME they try to hand me a hot vanilla latte. After I correct them it's still a game of which random size/cup iced latte will they end up giving me. Sometimes it's the correct size, sometimes it's a small, sometimes it's in a medium cup with a dome lid and sometimes it's not even an iced latte, it's an iced coffee. Big difference. I just don't understand why they have so much trouble with this standard menu item. On top of the issues with the drink, the person usually taking the order always sounds like they are dying. Not sure if it's a Sunday morning hangover or just hating their job in general but it's pretty annoying. I'll continue to come here when I want my iced latte since it's right up the street, but next time they F it up I'm going to throw the hot coffee back in their face. Just kidding. But I will probably call the manager and see why this keeps happening.

Whatever you do.....do not go to this McDonalds late at night. Even for fast food customer service they bring an all new meaning to horrible service. I sat sandwiched b/w two cars waiting in line in the drive thru for an hour! And I swear that is not an exaggeration. It was literally an hour. Had I not already paid and been stuck between the two cars I would've driven off. They were not apologetic about the ridiculous wait and were not friendly at all. when I got to the window, they didn't even remember taking my order. And when I finally got my food it was wrong. I wish I could give this negative stars because they do not even deserve the one I am forced to give.

Normally this McDonald's does a good job in getting your order right and in timely manner. The customer service is normally exceptional as well. Went there today with my two little ones and the lady behind the counter was awesome. The food was good given that it's fast food.
They served me an egg mcmuffin with the Monopoly game pieces ALREADY REMOVED. Sketchy!

Food may be the same at McDonalds across the city, but each location offers a different dining experience.  It's seems so cramped in here, sometimes you can barely move.  The last time I went, we had a stroller and found the one available table in a booth.  I moved the stroller as close to our table but it was still in the way and this was a Saturday afternoon.  I couldn't imagine what it is like at meal times.  If there's no seating, you can always try the 2 tables outside or else bring it into the mall and sit on the couches and eat.  The service is ok and I've never had an issue.  Again, if it's busy the line up can move slowly.  Last time the pop station had some pops watered down so best to have a taste before you leave the area.  Drive thru is cramped though.
pretty sure a bacon habenaro ranch burger is supposed to have bacon on it...  Bacon IS the first word of the sandwich, not "No," as in NO bacon, habenaro ranch burger.

Cold crappy food... Bathrooms smell like a barn yard and service team members where horrible. No gloves being used while my food and the customer before me was being prepared. Looks like a really great place to visit if you want stress and food poisoning.

My boyfriend and I came here this morning to pick up breakfast before heading to the airport. The signs all around the McDonald's clearly states that they open at 5:00 AM. We arrived at 5:10. We sat at the speaker in drive through for a few minutes and when no one responded we drove around to the window where we saw a blonde male in his early twenties that worked there drinking a smoothie. He clearly saw us and walked away from the drive through window. It was EXTREMELY rude. He obviously doesn't do his job. I will be calling customer service to report this but thought the public should know as well. I work In customer service and could not believe my eyes. When we realized he wasn't going to help us we left. Will never be going there again and will spread the word about the horrible service. From the looks of the reviews we aren't the first to experience the distasteful service that they provide.

Tuesday morning, 5:30 AM,  got scammed,  ripped off..   Ordered the $2.79 Breakfast, plus some other items..  Note,  I even gave price..  got home, got the higher price..  When called, was needed the receipt.  Did Not even get that out..
Watch what you get & at the price posted..  they will rip you off..
Great for that coffee and breakfast when you are running late

I think this is the nicest McDonald's in the area. The food is consistently great. They always get my father's special orders correct. Staff are very friendly and attentive. 

The only downside to this location is the parking lot is poorly laid out. Drive through traffic seems always to be in conflict with parking.

I like the design of this McDonald's on Claymont's Philadelphia Pike . The high , front windows looking out on the street scene has a Parisian aesthetic sociability like being in an open air cafe.  The parking lot around the McDonald's could be redesigned better by halving in two the parking area and placing instead  a more pleasing pedestrian urban space garden with trees and lawn that smoothly flows towards the back where the old  Claymont  river front Mansion still stands.  Some lost parking  could be made up in on-street paid curb parking.

ok i ordered and paid. went to 2nd window to pick it up and they deleted my order. fine np here is my receipt and she hands me the wrong drink size. then no extra cheese on the bigmac. so like normal they messed up my order so i ask for my money back. the manager only gives me back 10 bucks when it should be 10 bucks and change. now i have to park and go inside and get the change. they never sorry is there anything we can do to make it right or anything just here. so i am now done with this place which is really better for me any ways.

Lets just go ahead and erase the "fast food" from the end of this place's title because I'm pretty sure a bunch of snails with sprained ankles could've gotten me my food quicker than the morons who work there now. When I have to pull forward and wait for my food, I'm expecting it to be burning my mouth, but sadly this was not the case. I ordered a Big Mac and apparently in the process of making it the secret sauce button got stuck...that would be my only explanation for the amount of sauce that was on my burger. And now onto the spicy chicken sandwich....wow Got a 2.3 out of 10 from me   Colonel sanders is rolling over in his grave right now even thinking about how bad that chicken was. The only thing "spicy" about this order was the hot attitude I was catching from the drive thru lady. It's called people skills lady and you don't have 'em. Anyway just a total flat performance from the whole Ronald McDonald crew  they could really benefit from taking a page outta S. Truett Cathy's book when it comes to customer service  when my good pal byson and I eat there, we eat like kings and couldn't be more satisfied. All this chicken fil a talk has got my taste buds goin...I'm gonna have to pay the good ppl there a visit to wash the horrible taste this McDonald's has left in my mouth   Lets hope this yelp is a wake up call to all of these buffoons

I've been here three times now, and each time I've had items missing from my order.  Since it happened to me twice in the drive thru, I actually went inside this time.  I understand things get crazy sometimes, and mistakes happen- but when they do:  OFFER AN APOLOGY RATHER THAN SAYING NOTHING AND THROWING A SANDWICH ON MY TRAY.  And this was a manger; I didn't approach aggressively and I had my receipt in hand. I'll be passing on this location in the future.

I really wanted to find something positive to say about this location so as to give it more than one star, but as the ordeal played out, I found it harder and harder to give anything but a one star review. It began when we arrived at the drive thru. The attendant began with the usual greeting then stopped half way through and told us to hang on. Once she got back on she started to ask us what we wanted but cut off again to talk to someone. This happened one more time where we could hear the conversation through the drive through speaker. Once we started ordering, the attendant became confused when we ordered a simple coffee drink and this confusion carried out through the ordering process, as she had to clarify what we ordered after each sentence. When I started ordering my breakfast sandwich I asked for an egg white substitution on one of the choices which confounded her, causing her to almost give me the wrong thing. Then we hit her with a show stopper - a plain biscuit with just sausage on it. After reviewing the order on a screen which did not even display the whole order, we drove up to the window. Upon completion of the payment the attendant at the register window dropped my credit card under my car, which isn't necessarily a big deal, but when compounded with everything else, just made things worse. After retrieving the card and driving up to the second window we were confronted by a different employee who seemed to still be waking up as she asked, "what did you order?" Usually they have your order ready or kindly ask to see your receipt, but since she was still shaking off the sleep she probably wasn't on her game. I handed her the receipt whereupon she went into the back area. As the glass was sliding shut behind her I saw a gaggle of employees goofing around though there was clearly work to catch up on. Only a couple of diligent individuals looked gamely employed. What could have been the manager came to hand me my food but as she was handing it to me she thought better of it and decided to check the order. She looked doubtful as she disappeared back into the back. When she returned she handed me the order and closed the window behind her. I waited patiently until she opened the window again to say, "drinks?" We received our drink and drove off as fast as the speed limit would let us. The first thing we pulled out of the bag was a biscuit sans the sausage. The next thing that we saw was a singular napkin soaked in hashbrown grease. Forget about them asking if you want condiments or even putting any in for good measure. The food itself was what you would expect from a McDonald's. Who knows, maybe I was being pranked on some TV show...?
Great for those days your running late and need a coffee.  It's quality is that of McDonalds, I'm not a fan, but it is always there when you need it.
This McDonalds is a busy one. During lunch 12-1 jammed almost everyday. People that work here are friendly.and is open 24hrs

Clean, very fast service, eating area was much nicer than expected, and nicer than some non-fast food places I've been. Food was as expected, which is not fine dining. Pleasant place to sit and have breakfast.

This review is for the Egg McMuffin only
I want to meet the person who decided these things are any good. They are horrible little hockey pucks disguised as a breakfast sandwich and cost over $3.00 just for the little beast. Want Taste? Don't get this.
This McDs rocks. Everything fast and accurate unlike the Telegraph locations. Keep up the great work guys

Difficult getting in driveway off of West End and finding parking. They really should work on the entrance to the parking lot. and the floors and tables are dirty but great location on West End across from Vandy. Plus, free wifi and long hours. I think they're open 24/7...

Double drive through tells you how busy this McDonalds is.  Even at midnight, there can be line ups in both lines which is better than one long line in the way of cars in the parking lot.  There is one line that has the menu and the other line doesn't so this is good if you know what you want.  The orders are taken alternating between the lines which is good.  It can get cramped when turning to the pick up window.  Haven't had any issues with the correctness of the order and friendliness of the drive through staff.  Maybe the line ups aren't as bad at 3 or 4AM on a weekday.

I've only been inside once or twice and believe there's a kids' area and decent amount of seating.  It's just a matter of someone ensuring the tables are clean from the previous customers which doesn't seem to happen so promptly at McDonalds.

Tell McDonald's: Stop cheating employees with fee-laden debit cards

http://www.dailykos.com/story/2013/08/14/1231137/-Supersize-Those-Wages-McDonald-s

http://campaigns.dailykos.com/p/dia/action3/common/public/

I dunno. 

I went here for breakfast a day after vacation because I had no groceries. Steak, egg, and cheese bagel. No character, really. Not memorable. It was food at least.

Ordered 1/4 lb "BLT" 4 days in a row.  They advertise "Whole Leaf Lettuce"...try "No Leaf Lettuce" - as in no lettuce at all.  Really???

"Red Onion" translates into exactly 1.5 tiny little rings, that's not what their website shows...they show what appears to be 2 full slices....Really???

The McDonald's website also shows a RED tomato slice - not anemic pink.  Every tomato I see in Indiana in late August is blood red.  Oh, and get this.... they take this drab tomato slice and cut it in 1/2, they take one of the 1/2 slices and cut THAT in 1/2, they remove one of the 1/4 slices leaving you with 3/4's of a drab tomato slice...Really???

How hard is it to place the processed fake slice of cheese on the center of the burger?  A blind person could do a better job...

All of this culinary misfire is preceded by the wonderful experience of their twin drive through window's.  I'd like 5 minutes with the moron that came up with this debacle.  Slow service has been replaced by mass confusion.  Approaching the lines is akin to Russian Roulette.  You know that whatever line you choose will inevitably be the slow one.  You size up the body count in the vehicles (less is obviously better, multiple kids stuffed inside and hanging out the car windows to be avoided) the make of the cars and age of the drivers (had multiple Buick's just yesterday with blue haired old ladies) (also avoid rat trap rusty pickups driven by old men wearing ball caps...had one in front of me yesterday that took it upon himself to skip his turn to allow a blue hair to pull in front of him from the other lane out of turn (maybe he was trying to 'pick her up') thereby screwing everyone behind him).  Really???

Placing your order feels like you are talking through 2 cups and a string.  We can chat clearly with astronaut's in outer space. Why can they never get the order right?  Do they have a brass band marching around in there?  It's no wonder they have instituted  'order screens'  - its like watching someone miserably fail a remedial exam with you as the frustrated teacher. 

What about that fakey-fake voice that starts the order taking process?  It's always garbled, you have no idea what was just said to you.  Thus begins the kickoff of this wonderful process.  Do you like dead air?  Try asking 'what comes on a certain burger'.  It's like the person has dropped the microphone and is kicking it around the restaurant.  Meanwhile you are puzzled as the outside visible menu doesn't tell you what anything costs unless its the 'combo' meal they are trying to convince you is the cheap way to go.  Really???

If you really like frustration this McDonalds has something extra special for you from time to time.  You calmly pull up to place your order, you hear the opposing car finish up their order.  They pull through and guess what?  They take the order of the next person in the opposing line.  Fun, isn't it?  You start screaming at the metal box "HELLO?" at the top of your voice over and over again as your blood pressure shoots through the roof.  You try to suppress the urge to get out of your car to run over to the payment window to apply a frontal neck massage.  Then you remind yourself that these people will be up close and personal with the food that will soon be in your mouth.  

There have been times where both lanes are placing their orders here at same time with different employees.  Talk about confusion.  In this scenario I blurt out my order and stab the gas without waiting for any kind of confirmation.  As if they aren't enough confused with just one person taking orders...  

When you are finally privileged enough to pull up to the payment window they ask you what you ordered as they usually have no idea which car is which. If you want to have some fun at this point tell them 'yes' when they tell you someone else's order and tell them you've changed your mind and instead of the 6 special order quarter pounders you only want a cone...

The finale to this insanity happens all too often here - you pull up to the food window and they tell you to pull up farther and wait.  You're in timeout now.  All communication has ceased. Car after car scoots by as you sit there wondering what you did to deserve this.  You shut off the engine to save gas.  You open your window as you become hot and you are greeted by cigarette smoke - what a great place for this McDonalds to establish a smoking lounge.  Hungry and thirsty you slump into a semiconscious state...

Can't wait to come back.
It was sooooo bad!!! The food is greasy, the servers creep me out a little, if you eat their too much it makes you fat, and it gave me food poisoning!!!
Wanted to try new quarter pounders.  Bad Idea,  Cold hamburger and cold Fry's.  Sooo disappointing.

I'm sorry but this is by far the worst McDonalds in the area. I've been here on three separate occasions and their ice cream machine is always down. If you ask me, they're lazy and clean it early. They're losing business by constantly having it "down."

Very busy location -- service is always polite but tends to be slow. I don't frequent this location -- if I'm jonesing for a Coke Zero or a sausage mcmuffin, I will usually just wait until I get to the Binford location. But, as long as you're patient, it's not as bad as the other reviews would have you think.

Do NOT go into the dining room unless you want to be constantly hounded for money. The number of people that will come up to you begging for money or a free meal is astonishing. Couldn't even enjoy my breakfast sandwich.
With a McDonalds on the corner of the most busiest intersections of Philly and high traffic flow of customers, why have bathrooms suitable for just one person? Ridiculous.
Nearly noon, the menu was still on breakfast. Orders were mess up. Fries were well overcooked. Did not know MCD food could be messed up so bad.

Absolutely terrible!
I live a few blocks away and have been here easily a dozen times. More often than not they get the order wrong. Staff is among the worst I have ever encountered. I can appreciate that a job at McDonald's is crap, and that expectations should be set accordingly, but I'm talking conscious-decision-to-be-obnoxious kind of bad. I kept going back because they're close and they're 24 hours, but the last time I went I saw their restroom. I won't be back. Ever.
Go next door to the gas station and get a day-old hot dog that's been on the spinning machine before you go here.
WORST
MCDONALDS
EVER

Probably the worst McDonald's in Philadelphia.  Slow service, COLD FOOD and ignorant employees. If your fries are hot you're in luck. If you get an extra burger or fries in your bag (from the ignorant employees) you're even luckier. More than three times I've drove off GLADLY with extra goodies. Not that its a bad thing on my part but they clearly don't pay attention. I'd hate to be the one who has to wait for food because they passed it off.
It is McDonald's. Fastest drive-thru breakfast in Hermitage 7 days a week.

I agree with previous reviewers who say that it's hard to mess up fast food. And I say that is especially true at a place like McDonald's, a company that practically wrote the book on fast food preparation.

That being said, this McDonald's is similar to every other McDonald's I've visited-- and the food tastes the same as always (I do try to stay away from fast food, but sometimes those fries just call my name). The parking lot is laid out in an annoying way, though. It's very narrow in some parts and it's hard to get around.
Big Mac party is open until 4am on Fridays and Saturdays.. The lines can get long .. But what do expect at 3:30am

Since the new reconstruction, this McDonald's has greatly improved. I just tried it today since it has had the makeover and the tea was good, not sour. Fresh, crisp fries and plain sandwiches. Perfect, still needs to improve a little on customer service but besides that it isn't half bad now.
Disgusting extremely dirty staff are very ignorant and when u walk in looks like the place is full of drug addicts and homeless people ... Walked in and walked out ... Do not go here !
The location is near a nice neighborhood. The place looks clean. The foods are prepared quite fast. There's no salt and pepper packages.

Ahhhhh basic McDonalds. I didn't have the opportunity to go into the restaurant, so I can only comment on the drive thru service & food. 

Annnnnnnnd yeah so as expected, it was a basic, average, fast food restaurant experience. 

-automated greeting
-3to5 minute wait on drive thru cashier
-human greeting
-order placed
-money taken
-mediocre to avg food received

Yeaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Soooooo. We'll see. Im sure I'll be back, not too frequent though.

My little one loves this new remodel place. We have to drive to this place every times when someone wants to get McDonalds food. The service here was better than I've seen at any McDonald's.  I had a chance to speak w/ the owner of the store also, and he was super friendly and proud of this place he owned - and definitely cared about his customers!

Nomas 2 veces e visitado McDonald dentro de este WAlmart y lo hago porque esta dentro y es fácil si ya están haciendo compras en WAlmart pero las dos ocaciones espero de más para comida rápida ... No regresare a este McDonald

This McDonalds has recently been renovated to reflect the new McCafe image. The restaurant is sleek and clean. They now have a bar top perfect for completing work with outlets for plugging in your laptop. With the free wi-fi this isn't a bad place to get surf the net or get some work done. 
I didn't review the food because anyone who has ever eaten at McDonald's knows what to expect from this fast food joint. The menu is constantly expanding though to give customers more cafe options to add to the mix of the traditional burger and fries.

So freakin slow. Stopped here for an iced coffee and a hashbrown at 5:30 am and it took me 10 minutes in the drive thru to get my order. If they're that slow that early I'd hate to see how they are at the lunch rush.

I couldn't find the McDonalds on Lafitte LaRose so this is for them. I gave it 1 star b/c your not allowed to choose 1/2 or none. The service here is HORRIBLE!  It does not matter if you sit in the drive thru or go inside it will take you a 1/2 hour to get your food.  The McDonalds franchise can care less about the lack of service that comes out of this place

We dropped by on our way out of the city; we must have came at the wrong time because the lines was out the door, literally.  

Although there wasn't that long of a wait, staff were polite & wait time depending on what your ordered wasn't bad. They also have a patio seating area, which is nice.

If I'm in the area & yearning for McDonalds, I'd drop by again.

This is the slowest McDonalds drive-thru in Pinellas County. The leadership at this location is on par with a Burger King. Extremely slow drive-thru service and untrained staff. Not even sure why the have 2 stations to order from as they never use them. If you want to really trip them up, try paying with cash, they don't understand the concept.

So McDonald's is McDonald's and sometimes you are drawn to fast food, like a McDonald's chicken wrap with fries!!  But this place is anything but fast, and it's hell to get in and out of.  The lettuce on the wrap did not taste particularly fresh.  I think I'll skip this one from now on.

Often disappointed. Their coupons are mostly nonsense. You get a free sandwich when you buy a sandwich, but not if you buy a combo. 

Their burgers are 'made with 100% real beef'. See the 'with' in there? that means that even though the beef is 100 percent beef, its not the only ingredient in the burger. 

Sure sounds like its only beef though. Weird. What else is in it? Why tell us that their beef is 100% beef? What else could their beef be? 

Their fries are not vegetarian and have wheat and dairy. So much for being potatoes, fried in oil.

Oi Vey! This place is AWFUL------with a capital A! 
My goodness we've never been anywhere we had to repeat our order 4 times! 
4--FOUR times!! 
We went through the drive through on our way to golfing after meeting my ex husband to drop my son off, and we went through the line for convienence,...boy were we wrong!!
My darling better half said our order, and as soon as he was done she said "may i take your order".... he then repeated our order twice, and then...silence.......
Then she didnt get ANYTHING he had said correct, so he had to YELL it to her once more... 
Our actual food items were correct (although our order was simple)- and my dad and stepmom had the same experience and they were in the vehicle behind us...
it was the worst drive though experience ever.... i definitely do not recommend stoping at this McDonalds-- go down to the next exit and hit up Chik Fil A :)
This place sucks. I guess if you're hungry and on a budget it's ok but the people that work here look like they don't want to be here. Smile at least.

If you're looking for a McDonalds where the restaurant portion is open late, this one is open 24 hours. Though this location is loaded with flies and lots of them I might add, the service is adequate with some employees on the slow side. You can do better at other McDonalds locations as far as service goes but acceptable.
The store is clean enough and you can cozy around the centrally located fireplace while you take advantage of the free WiFi and catch on some unfinished work on the laptop/tablet

Service was fast and fine, food was fine, only got a couple things. 

Saw a few "mixed marriages" when we were there, with one person going to the Starbucks across the road and the other person going to McDonalds for different items. The strip mall is also right nearby for other options.
What's the only good thing about a sore throat? An excuse to have ice cream. And for $1, why yes, please. I'll have a chocolate dipped cone.

This is one of the poorer McDonalds, although  to be fair, in this area of southeastern PA, most of the McDonalds are bad.  It's always something.  Usually it's very slow service.  The food is usually cold to somewhat warm.  The drinks seem to be watered down.  The kids working are frequently texting/reading something on their phones instead of paying attention to their jobs.  Too bad my son loves happy meals.  It's not so happy for me.  More and more I find myself going to O'Grady's or the Burger King up the street instead of here.

This review is strictly on the cleanliness of the establishment, the staff was very polite and the food was as expected. I took the kids on a Saturday at around 2PM and the place was a complete dump. There was trash, fries, cups, burger containers, napkins, etc, all over the floor. Seats and tables were just as dirty.The place was not even that busy. Looked like they had a food fight in there. I would have not expected it to look like that considering its location.

I used to be an avid McDonald's fan. Until I ate here. Years ago I ordered a burger and a few hours later became violently ill. I ended up going to the hospital, and they confirmed I had food poisoning. I've never been so sick in all my life. I filled a claim with the restaurant, that sent it to corporate then to their insurance company. I wish I had sued, but at the time I was just asking for my medical bills, and time lost for missing a week of work. I went back and forth with McDonald's insurance company for a year and at the end they said I couldn't prove that it was McD that made me sick. I was only asking for an amount that is less than what the company makes in a second. Since then I have not been back to a McDonalds, they have lost a lot of business from me. Plus any time McD comes up in conversation I tell my food poisoning story as to warn others.

Those of you that follow me already know my "position" on McDonald's.  Those of you that do not, just know that I am not a fan by any means, which is saying something since a 4 star review is accompanied by the description of "Yay! I'm a fan."

Am I a "fan" of McDonald's?  No.  However, I felt it was only fair to this particular location to rate them higher than 3 stars, because they truly do a pretty good job, especially in comparison to the other locations that I have visited over the years.  

I work just across the street from this location.  My lunch options are basically this, a pizza place, a grocery store, Subway, or the QT down the street.  There are others, but most involve getting on the highway, driving a few exits down, and then making the return trip.  Most days, those kinds of trips aren't worth it.  

Anyway, I've been working in this area for about 3 months now, and have stopped here 3 times.  Not once have they jacked up my order.  Not once have they given me soggy or stale fries.  Not once has my tea tasted like coffee grounds.  Hell, they even give me napkins every time!  

Listen, I'm a busy guy.  Generally when I say I don't like a place, I don't go there, but lately I've been forced to stop and eat at one of the only places open late at night in this area, McDonald's.  I'm not proud of it, but in the end, this location has at least given me hope that fast food, and McDonald's in particular, can get the job done in a pinch.  

I appreciate the crew here doing what it takes to make the customer happy.  Keep it up!

This restaurant doesn't deserve a star at all. I have experienced terrible service the times that I went and I'm NEVER EVER going back. The drive thru guy was terribly rude. He wasn't at the window and I pulled to the next window. The drive thru guy gave me terrible attitude because I didn't wait for him. I treated me terrible like I was trash.

Too numerous complaints:  asked for saus. biscuit w/cheese only, got egg biscuit instead.  Asked what was holding up order.... hashbrowns.  Yet no sense of urgency from anyone that orders were backed up.  Did I mention that 2 HBs were on hold and could have been put in my order?  Constant screw up with the double drive thru.  Late night run for food.... got 5 sandwiches and not one was what I ordered. And, I only ordered one.  This issue happens at numerous Dias Mgt. Stores.  Just got off the phone with Paul Dias, owner of several McDonald's restaurants in the Tucson area.
