Tried to tell the guy that his training is lacking, as I have experienced poor service by numerous employees and numerous stores. All I heard from him was his employees are the best. McDs training is the best. Not ONCE did he say what he should have said..... I am going to look into our training methods and see what is lacking and where we can improve. I've asked McDs corporate office to send me the list of restaurants that are NOT owned by Paul Dias/Dias Mgt. Now let's see if they follow thru.  Didn't care for his we are the best attitude..... YOU CLEARLY HAVE STAFF ISSUES.... DEAL WITH THEM............ I'M DONE WITH YOUR STORES!

This place is disgusting. Trash everywhere, messy playground with graffiti, overflowing trash cans, empty dispensers, disgusting bathroom. I cannot believe that McDonald's allows a store to continue to function like this. Absolutely revolting.

So wait. 

Am I even allowed to review McDonalds on Yelp? 

"so I went in, and was surprised to find they had a selection of Fry and Burger combinations that each had a corresponding number....."

We all know the drill, the food is what it is. 

BUT this McDonalds is the cleanest and most updated I've visited. The employees actually seem intelligent and are very friendly. I think we can all agree how rare that is!

How the hell do you rate a McDonald's? It's like the food service version of Walmart -  lousy food with lousy customer service. 

Driving through here is a hit or miss, but it's better than some of the other McDonalds I've been to. On some mornings,  breakfast pickup is very quick despite the lines; other mornings I'll almost be running late just for a coffee. And you'll never leave the drive thru with a sweet tea size any smaller than large which is frustrating because my girlfriend has had to argue her point about why she wants a medium tea (they gave us larges anyway).

I really like this McDonald's ice cream because it isn't plain and creamy like most locations. Instead, it's a strange concoction consisting of grainy, sugary water and milk. Mmm! 

The interior is depressing and closed off due to the half-walls separating it into sections, so light isn't evenly distributed throughout the restaurant. And everyone - customers and employees alike - look like they hate their lives.

Welcome to McDonalds!

Quick. In & out. Stick & move. 

This is one of few 24hr McDonalds in the area since Hurricane Katrina. 

Located on the forever busy Loyola Avenue, you can dart right in & right out, of the inside. The drive thru is very different. Despite having the dual ordering lanes, theres ALWAYS a wait. Oddly enough, most times I don't mind the wait because the food is usually pretty good ie fries burgers etc. So, when in the area I will stop in at this McDonalds, slow drive thru and all.
Whyyyy? Whyyyy you so slow?? Whyyyy you ice cream machine always broken?! Whyyy you no sell 50 chicken nuggets?! I just don't understand

McDonald's and I go way back. I had worked for McDonald's, so I may find myself a little picky when I go into a restaurant because I know what I should be expecting. So, I am frugal, so I ordered off the Dollar Menu. The cashier didn't say much to me, just kind of stood there like he was bored to death having to wait on me. Due to food allergies, I have to special order everything, and that seemed like a bother to them. I had to ask for basic things like napkins, straws, a fork, and ketchup. The manager on duty acted like her cell phone was the only thing around her instead of coaching her employees to be more attentive. Now, the food itself was hot and accurate, but we all know that if you just take an extra second and go the extra step. I mean, seriously, you are not doing us a service by being there to feed us cause we really could cook at home. If the owner had seen that, he would have split a hair. It won't stop me from coming back, but my interaction with the staff will be a bit different next time.

I feel so wierd reviewing mcd's, but this had to be said! The new quarter pounders are awesome! We had a coupon to try one and picked the bacon habenero ranch. It has lettuce, thick slice of tomato, bacon, white cheddar cheese and a yummy spicy sauce. The real shocker is the burger looked JUST LIKE THE PICTURE. When does this ever happen with McDonald's food?! It not only looked good but was quite delish as well. We went back a second time, to see if it was just a fluke, and BAM! More "food porn"! Keep it up McDonald's.

It seems all of us waiting inside this morning had to wait for the staff to finish with all of the drive-through orders before they could work on our orders.  We had to wait at least 10 minutes to get our orders.  My order was filled by a manager, put in a "go" bag when it was supposed to be "for here" and she left, went into the back out of sight, not even waiting to see if the right customer was given the correct order.  I opened the bag and found no utensils, no butter, and no jelly for my Big Breakfast.  I had to wait an additional 5 minutes for someone to help me because again, they were more focused on drive thru than their walk in customers.  No one made eye contact or even looked in the direction of the counter to see if anyone else had walked up.  And yes, there was another customer waiting to place an order for 5 minutes watching me shoo an flies off my food which was getting colder by the minute, and listening to me tell my granddaughter we could not go sit down and eat our food because we didn't have everything. 

We went to eat in the playground area. The air conditioning was on the entire 30 minutes we were in there.  It never turned off once, making it very cold in the early a.m.  Plus there was a constant beeping noise that was very loud coming from the emergency exit.  The flies were bad in this area as well.  The only reason I come here is for the playground, but not anymore.

This place is filthy!  Food all over the floor in the entire restaurant!  Flies everywhere!  When I picked up my tray, it was so sticky I had to wash my hands.  Even in the restrooms the flies were so bad my granddaughter could not use their facilities.  So combine this with the fact they serve you food you did not order, I wonder how they expect to stay in business. 

In today's world of Culver's, Five Guys, Smashburger, and Freddy's, traditional fast food chains like here and Wendy's need to do a lot better to stay competitive.  But what I am experiencing is the complete opposite!  Two McDonald's now and one Wendy's have lost my business in the past two months.

I keep going here because my kids love the food as most kids do. Parents please be aware that I got a kids meal for my son and the milk they gave me was open and used. I went through drive up. I didn't notice til I got home. I took empty container and was told the next time I order that they would comp me a meal......seriously I Want ALL PARENTS TO CHECK EVERYTHING IN THE KIDS MEALS

I have never written a review of a fast food restaurant.  The good thing about fast food restaurants is that you know what to expect.  There may be an occasional problem with the food or service, but these are generally individual issues.  However this morning I discovered something about the McDonalds on Green Acres and Vets that should be known--you cannot get water there. I was told that the owner would not allow them to provide water for their customers,   I was ordering coffee, I try to drink water with each meal also, since it is a much healthier beverage.  And water is definitely preferable to soda for kids.  While I was at the counter, another customer requested ice for her soda from behind the counter, since the dispenser on the soda machine was not working; she was refused.  Needless to say neither of us will be back.

This is the nastiest McD's I have ever been to. We visited during a slow time, yet every table was dirty. An employee was taking trash out and left a trail of liquid behind her from the trash can to the door, a trail which did not get mopped up. The floors were a sticky mess. Stay away, you're better off going down toward the location nearer USF!
Before 8am on a Sunday and needed a quick breakfast. Old hash browns, dry sausage egg biscuit, and an egg white mcmuffin soaked (literally) halfway with grease/oil. Inedible.

Food is typical:
The rest rooms are 5 star!
When it comes to quality, this is the worst mcDonalds.  Fries are always limp and they forget my nugget sauce!

This McDonald's is extremely lucky. Lucky that there are no other options for fast food within probably five miles, at least.
It is not unusual, actually, rather standard, to have a fifteen minute wait, which makes the proximity null and void, since in that time, I could drive to the next closest McDonald's and already be back.
They also seem to go out of their way to hire the most unfriendly staff. Usually they just look in your general direction and expect you to know what to do. Don't even say a word to you.

Last night, I stopped "quick" on my way home and got a snack wrap. My friend tried to order the bacon and cheese burger, which they confirmed was not the Habanero Ranch burger, but he got the Habanero Ranch burger anyway. My snack wrap was the real problem though. The grilled chicken was going to take 9 minutes, so I said a crispy chicken tender would be fine, thinking it would be faster as they said. Though we waiting 15 minutes after paying, with several other people already waiting ahead of us. Even after the fifteen minutes, I still got the crispy chicken, even though supposedly my requested grilled should have been ready by that point. On top of that, since the wrap wasn't ready. The fries and burger just sat in the bag and were cold by the time we got them, and the boy who delivered our food to us outside, didn't look at us, or say a word to us, just literally tossed the bag at us through the window. 
The management could care less, and corporate gives you the response that they know this a terrible McDonald's but it always has been. I guess this is why they have never renovated and the inside still boasts an incredibly creepy array of manquins trying to work a fake radio station.

I meant for this to be short, but I could go on and on about what a terrible business this is. 

Last night was my last time, and I hope I can encourage some others to avoid this place so hopefully we can get a fast food restaurant in the area that wants our service.
This place smells like a bunch of homeless people covered in old grease having an orgy. But for real tho there are a lot of hobos inside.
Great place to eat! Would go there anytime! My only problem that they do not have a complete "Dollar Menu".
Worse sweet tea ever. It sit out too long. How does one mess up sweet tea? It happens. Lol.

This location always gets my vanilla iced coffee just right! ---drive south a little to the location on Magee ...
I have found the staff at this location to be pleasant and courteous and that for me is everything--as long as everyone is nice any issue can be resolved. Keep up the good work!!

You know, I don't expect five star service and filet mignon from a McDonald's.  It's McDonald's.  Order, eat, repeat.  I do, however, expect that someone, somewhere in the management chain has made the effort to educate the employees regarding the basic tenets of civil interaction.  

By that, I mean, I would *not* expect to be privy to the expletive peppered ramblings of several off-duty employees (still in uniform) seated at the table closest to the counter.  I wasn't trying to listen to them discuss the sexual escapades of some random woman with a strange combination of ire and respect.  I am fairly certain that the small child who was within earshot didn't want to listen, either.  I was less interested in the conversation when it escalated from chuckling and snide comments to belligerent proclamations about the skill with which one or two of them might render each other unconscious.  I found myself hoping that they'd just get on with it and spare us all the headache.  

Of course, the self-absorption didn't remain at the table.  After several minutes of back and forth, bantering and bickering, the party meandered toward the door, became distracted from their journey by yet another display of aggression and self-congratulatory professions of vim and vigor, and occupied the space in front of the door for another several minutes.  This forced the customers who wanted to leave to walk around them.  More than one polite request to pass through them was ignored.

The food was the same as it is at every McDonald's.  And since this one is just one of many along the route to Indianapolis, I'll skip it in the future.

This particular McDonald's is very close to home.  Very convenient when I am busy and need to grab a bite to eat or to grab a little snack to hold us over.  This location is open 24 hours, so that's a plus if you are in the mood for a midnight snack or coming home from a night out!  This includes the dining room too!

For the most part, the restaurant is very clean, but at times when it's very busy, I've been there when the trash bins are at its capacity and the dining area is packed.  Again, just depends when you get there.  It's like anywhere you want to go, if you don't like to wait too long, AVOID going after a game, or during lunch or dinner or after practice!  Drive-thru gets backed up too!  (Even with two lanes).

When in the drive thru, make sure to check your order before pulling away, cause I've been caught without something once in a while, but it's few and far between...We're all human.  =)

This McDonald's also has a Play Place and offer kid parties if you are interested.  Free WiFi on the premises too.  The staff here have always been nice and courteous.  Always busy, but willing to help.

All in all, it's McDonald's, I'm most likely going to be coming back for years to come!

Was there for a late lunch yesterday, the place was mostly full but the lunch rush was over. Nobody ahead of me at the counter, and a pleasant young lady took my dollar menu order. A Mcdouble, apple pie and small decaf for $3 is fine and keeps you going for a few hours. Another employee was not friendly as he cleaned around the ice and soda stand. 

They have no competition on the beach, so it's The burger place. It's kept clean and has many seats along the window glass, plus being slightly elevated from the street provides a good view.
In another great display of incompetence, my bacon habenaro burger had no habenaro.  I guess it's a companywide issue that these burgers just don't get made correctly.

The rule of thumb for most major chains is all will offer similar standards of goods and services no matter which location you frequent. Occasionally however some will go above and beyond and stand out from the others but of course there is the other side of the coin where some will fail colossally  

I stopped in at this one after a night of swimming for a quick bite and was disturbed to see their entire dining room was a mess. Literally every table was covered in trash and trays and some of the garbage had managed to migrate to the floor. The manager on duty at the time came out from behind the counter on his way to the bathroom picked up a napkin off the floor and then kept on walking. When the manager doesn't care about cleaning I guess you really can't expect the staff to.

After cleaning off our table we sat down to eat our lukewarm food and then left vowing to never return again. Hands down my worst fast food experience ever in all my time living in Edmonton.

I love that McDonald's now have someone outside at the drive-thru. When its busy, the line goes so much faster. 

I don't eat here often, but every once in a while, I just have to have a cheeseburger and fries! Although each time I eat one, I totally regret it. Its so yummy as you eat it and then after, you always feel like crap. So greasy and nothing about it says this will digest easily.

If you go thru the drive thru, park and make sure you have your correct order, i got all the way home, and after paying for a 10 piece chicken mcnugget value meal, only had a 6 piece chicken mcnuggets in my bag
Ever since this McDonalds was rebuilt the service has been incredible. The staff is fast, courteous, and my order is right 99% of the time. The inside has a nice cafe feel with late hours and Wifi.

It's a McDonald's. What do you expect?

These guys are friendly though, so it's worth the trip out or stumble across
Great location to stop by and grab some nuggets but drive thru can be pretty slow

I wish there drive thru food board wasn't so far away I'm sure they got lots of compliance about this. I've had my good and experience with this McDonalds. It's
Mcdonalds  nothing less.

My biggest complaint is the place is FILTHY-they rarely clean it. I've been here several times over the past couple years and it is always the same.

Customers are frequently treated to dirty tables, food, crumbs, and napkins on the floor and under the tables. The ketchup and fountain counter are usually filthy. 

I recently witnessed an employee picking up and taking out the trash in the seating area, then was called behind the counter assist. Without washing her hands, she started serving up fries and ice cream cones. Nasty. I will ask them to wash their hands before serving my food.

Customer service has been an real issue with some employees, so training is not consistent. Sometimes they do not greet you,  repeat your order, or even say a word. Very cold and rude.

I like the location, but the filth is unacceptable- managers and employees need to step up their game big time.
Hey, when you get a BOGO sometimes you have to use it.  1 Mac and 1 Qpounder. Sandwiches are little dry here, but close to work.

Food and service is typical McDonalds and I would say meets the standards one would expect. 
     WiFi service however is sub-standard. In an empty store, the wireless service here is super slow with the occasional drop. If you are looking for a good resturant to surf the internet while enjoying a snack or a meal, go somewhere else.

Restaurant suddenly closed a few days ago.  Entrance is blocked off, and sign says they are "rebuilding."  No activity there, though.  Update: Building has been razed. New building is due to open mid-December 2013.

Long drive-through wait...it's ok, it was dinner rush. I never had too many issues other than the condiment nazi that wants to charge you for a sauce, and the occasional mix-up. BUT, on this occasion...it actually made me laugh with how outright wrong the drive-thru guy was. I ordered a large drink. He handed me a medium, I said "oh, sorry I ordered a large" He took it back. He then proceeded to pour the medium melted ice and coke mixture into a large cup, and turned around and poured more mystery drink into the large cup. I actually asked him about what I saw..and HE ADMITTED IT!! I laugh because of the admission of just being foul. So, I pull around with my mystery mix and walk-inside. People at the counter greet me..*making eye-contact* i held up my large cup of swill..and dump it out in the fountain drink drain. Make myself a "fresh" drink and making sure to show the  chemist at the window how little of effort it took to just do things right. Ahhh, was I petty?! YUP! But if it would have been anybody else...he woulda got cussed out! Lol

Don't like leaving reviews based off 1 visit however they messed my order up(strike 1) they where out of a couple of soda drink from dispenser(strike 2) and no little cups to put ketchup in, took forever to get someone and to get the cups(strike 3). Drive thru was also slow.
After 10 am on a Wednesday, and was so hot and fresh, and the young girl at the counter actually smiled, I had to review.  Above average McDonald's experience.
Typical McDonalds. That being said I have never had a less than normal expected service and food here. It's what you expect a McDonalds to be.
I'm not a big fan of fast food restaurants, but The new chicken wings at McDonalds are pretty good. You can get them in 3, 5, or 10 pieces. They have a nice spicy kick, definitely give them a try.

This is a clean, friendly McDonalds.  The interior is always clean and I like the layout.  The redbox is a nice plus!  You know how sometimes you get nice, crispy McD fries and sometime you get limp, nasty ones?  I find this location typically has the nice, fresh, crispy ones.  As I said before everyone is always friendly, especially Geoff.  He always remembers us and is pleasant to deal with.  Not sure what else I can add about McDonalds.... I mean its name speaks for itself!

This McDonalds is probably the worst McDonalds I've ever been to in my life.
I ordered the big breakfast with sausage ,eggs, hash browns ,and coffee and biscuit.
I asked the girl at the counter about getting a container of syrup for my meal. The store manager was a guy that  looks like Eddie Munster came over and told me as I would have to pay extra to get the syrup.
I'm 65 years old and don't need to be treated like garbage by a kid at McDonalds !!!
I now go to Burger Kng next door and their senior drinks are only 25 cents and the staff is friendly.
I GAVE THEM ONE STAR BECAUSE THERE IS NO LOWER RATING AVAILABLE !!


By the way, the store manager is called Chris at McDonalds.

I wanted to do an update.  Some lifestyle mean that my husband and I don't eat as much fast food as we used to. That being said, this is STILL my favorite McDonald's in Boise.  When I mentioned to one of the managers the dietary changes we were making she was happy to share what they might be able to do to make an occasional 'treat' workable with our new way of eating.   I still feel welcomed and well taken care of when I stop in to this location.

We stopped here for a break during our travels. The ladies at the front counter were very pleasant to interact with. Our order took a reasonable amount of time to get ready, and the ladies gave us two small kids cups instead of one medium cup. I thought that was very thoughtful of them. We had a nice dinner here and were on our way with a smile on all of our faces.

Came to this McDonald's today for the first time for some post Dora the Explorer concert Happy Meals for the kiddos and our friends.

The restaurant was clean and had been renovated fairly recently with a double sided fireplace that is viewable from the outside patio.

The playplace was decent but our toddler children said they prefer the McDonald's that have longer (bigger) slides and more play options.

The staff member at the til, Kory (a teenager), was polite and patient with us and our overly hungry and hyper toddlers in tote.

He was also visible throughout our stay cleaning up the restaurant and holding doors for people - not everyday that a teenager sticks out as super friendly and helpful.  Kudos to Kory!

The food was okay - not somewhere I would dine on my own but the toddlers were happy.

I did find it odd that their tv screen menu board had the prices wrong for pumpkin spiced lattes and when we ordered one up on leaving I had to request a manager in order to receive the advertised price.

Of our 4 food orders - 2 adults and 2 children, 2 orders had wrong items in them so that was a bit disappointing.  If we had gone through the drive thru that would have royally sucked to be given the wrong things but not so bad when you are in the restaurant and can get it all sorted out.

Thanks for providing a post Dora extravaganza play place for our children to have a quick bite and an area to burn off some energy!  As far as dining goes - meh.  The Signature Sweet Chili chicken wrap was sub par and the pumpkin spiced latte tasted more like nutmeg than anything else.

1.5 thumbs up from the kiddos so overall a 3 star experience.
Line was slow and the bathroom looked/smelled like crap. Cant blame them tho, mcdonalds is prob understaffed and they did look like they where swamped.

Ordered a large pumpkin spice latte. Had to wait for them to clean the machine. Seriously why would you wait until 6:30 in the MORNING to clean a coffee machine? That's not the worst of it. I wait until I get to my destination to have a sip and its your basic latte! Last time I give this place my money.

This McDonalds rarely has their ice cream machine working.  Plus the dude that runs the place at night is not very friendly and always makes me wait way too long to order. It gets worse but I will just say find yourself another McDonalds that is like most of them.  This one is way below avg. if you ask me.

This is by far one of the worst businesses I have ever given money to. Not just the worst restaurant. I was stuck eating here before a soccer game and got nothing but bad attitude from their extremely rude staff. One actually tried to stop me from talking while I was correcting the entirely wrong order she was telling me. Or should I say mumbling. I guess they train their staff to roll their eyes at their customers and to have huge chips on their shoulders. I cannot believe a company would allow such mind bogglingly rude individuals to serve the public. When a customer says.. No I didn't order that, the correct response is not "are you going to let me talk?"

For a McDonald's this place seems much bigger than most.  It is hard to enter the building.  The main door is just as dangerous as the side door that exits directly into the drive-thru lane.  Cars lining up to place orders pass right by the curb and a blind corner for those exiting the building.  A third front door looks like an emergency exit but can be used to gain access.

Inside the cleanliness struck me first as well as it seemed to be recently remodeled.  But maybe not, maybe it just has been cleaned thoroughly, either way, this is what I expect.  I was surprised considering my bad experience at the Magee/Oracle 24/7 Mickey D's with a playground.

So there was one cashier taking orders, a line wrapped out of the order area waiting to place orders and a manager stuck making six McFlurries for the drive-thru lane.  I thought, "oh, no, this will take forever."  So I placed my order, got my drink, parked my granddaughter in a booth, came back to find 12 of us waiting, and counter full of empty trays.  With their equipment blocking my view it didn't seem like there were that many people working there but I could not see very well.  All of a sudden that cashier started calling out names and quickly.  Another pleasant surprise that a "rush" at an off peak time, it was 2 pm, did not catch the staff off guard.  They dispensed the orders quickly.

So they will get a return visit from me to see if they can match this experience.  

I've noticed that several new McDonald's being built do not have playgrounds.  Heads up McDonald's, this is the only reason I come here because the food is nothing special and the granddaughter literally begs me to play here, she doesn't eat the food.

I ordered breakfast for my wife and I . In the order was 2 coffees . The women at the register asked  "how many creams and sugars". I asked for 6 in total. As my breakfast was put together which added up to $18 I was given 4 creams. I asked for the 2 more I originally requested. The girl reached her hand in the bin and gave me one more . I almost blew my stack ! But posted this review instead. Poor management in that store .

One of the better McDonald's locations in Boise.  It's been updated and is nice inside.  They haven't screwed up any of my orders yet either (knock on wood many times).  I enjoy the televisions in the dining area.  Definitely check this place out.
Typical McDonald's in Boise.  Access to this place is a bit difficult with the proximity to Cole due to the high volume of traffic.  Staff is generally friendly.

Not the worst but certainly not the best.  The drive-thru logistics are beyond terrible.  Seems like people who use the drive-thru have no issues with blocking traffic and causing problems all the time.

This must be the McDonald's inside of Walmart.  Customer service is alright but having to fight the "people of walmart" do get your food is quite discouraging.  I'd rather deal with a McDonald's outside of Walmart to get away from "Wal-martians."

This is my local, neighbourhood McDonald's where my family often gets a quick meal or coffee on take out. The place is large, clean, and, until recently, the service was good.

Accent on the "was." My father had a particularly disturbing incident take place here on September 4 around mid-morning. It was at the tail end of the Dollar Drinks promotion. My father went over there to get iced coffees for all of us, and the manager on duty refused to fill the drinks up to the top. My father always requests that the drinks be filled, and this was the first time his request was ever refused. He was told by this very young woman that the drinks would be full once we added the sugar and cream (which my dad gets in separate, smaller cups). 

My father called the manager later in the day to again ask why the cups of coffee were not filled as per his request. She told him that these coffees were on sale, and that if he wanted more coffee he should order a larger size. Excuse me - whatever happened to the concept of the customer always being right? And McDonald's, of all places, can't afford to fill up a lousy cup of coffee, sale or no sale? Get real.

Basically, this manager was not doing the same thing that every other person who has served my father had done AND was being rude to boot. So, my father called the Public Relations office in Vancouver about this incident and was informed that the Edmonton office of McDonald's would call back about the matter within three business days (the Edmonton corporate office happens to be attached to this particular location). No one called. My dad called Vancouver again. They told him they were immediately going to call the Edmonton office and he would receive a call that same day. And again, no one called.

This whole thing represents a very disappointing breakdown both in how McDonald's trains managers in public relations as well as how the company deals with customer complaints. Seriously - to offend a long-time customer over a few cents' worth of coffee? For shame!

I will add that since this incident, my father has been patronizing a different McDonald's a few blocks away, where they are more than happy to fill the cups and even said to my dad if they were not filled to his satisfaction, to let them know and they will take care of it. Now, that's more like it!

No Soft cone ice cream here. You have to ask for napkins and will get 1 or 2 if you're lucky, they don't put them in your bags and are not available to customers. They have not cleaned the large indoor play area, be careful you will have to keep your kids from the random drinks sitting inside.
Recently renovated it looks sleek and modern, sorry no play area but there are touch activated video games on 1 or 2 of the tables :)
Clean, fast and friendly service. I had to pull down my hoodie before entering, so only 3 stars.
It was terrible OH MY GOD it smelt was so dirty I didn't even wanna feed kids there anymore so we left the smell was so bad

The drive-through line was a 10 minute wait between the time I paid and the time I got my food.  Then I discovered that they left the fries out of my order.  I could be a bit more forgiving of the slow service if they had gotten my order correct, but they did not.  Avoid this hub of poor service.

Why do I crave the breakfast sandwiches from this particular location only?  Dunno, but they are delicious and hot every time.  Plus their drive-thru opens before the crack of dawn (5 am) This is useful b/c who wants to cook breakfast when you're up that early.  Anyway, I can only really review the breakfast items since I'm definitely not brave enough to eat their burgers.

The location is very convenient on Rt 45.  There is a indoor play area for the kids that is probably a petri dish of various childhood afflictions, but good for a bribe on a rainy day.  Disinfect yourselves well when leaving is all! 

It's a McDonald's, so you know what to expect.  But it's one of the nicer ones in area I guess.

If you want to experience McDonald's in the worst way possible, you'll want to go to this one !

This place is horrible! A friend and I went in at 6:30pm on 10-7-13 to get a quick meal, and all I got was disaster!

Going into this restaurant,you'll see that trash is laying around the place and that the condiment bar is destroyed! They don't have ranch or BBQ packets--if you need any of those... Not do they have any large drink lids.

The service may be faster than most, but you get a sloppily prepared burger and the fries will be toothpick-snappable.

I couldn't even stomach the fries, not would I attempt to dive into the burger.

When I went up to ask about the fries, the manager at the register stated that he wasn't trained on dropping fries, and, because the timer on the fryer was broken, he was just eyeballing the fries and guessing when they were done.

This is a restaurant that I'll never visit again, and I would strongly recommend that no one visit this location until management decides to take pride in their work and make this place up to (at minimum) a bearable par.

What's more, I was offered a free meal voucher for all the trouble 26 days ago (it's now November 3rd, 2013) and I've yet to receive anything in the mail or get a return/follow up phone call from the owner.

Whaeh whaeh  whaeh,  cry cry cry, complain complain complain....can't believe people are b*tchin about Spanish being spoken or what a sticker says. First and foremost, the damn place is soo busy they don't have time for the food to sit. When you have an employee standing outside that has to take orders in the drive-thru just to be efficient...it's busy. It's McDonalds, not a sit-down fine dining experience. For the maybe $5 you spend there, check to see if your food is in the bag,  if so...shut up and keep it moving.

McDonald's is always ...Just okay... a good burger when you are in pinch or a hurry..Wednesday nights are .60 Cheeseburgers so when I don't feel like cooking...I drop into a drive thru and grab a small mess of them to take home..quick, fast, cheap and Good..besides it reminds me of my youth...

Mickie D's...is always an easy choice!!!

Got excellent service in the very busy drive-through during the lunch hour today.

Ordered the "Mighty Wings" as the advertising intrigued me.  Well, don't bother- at least at this location.  They were mighty greasy (wet with oil) and mighty over-cooked (breading was burnt).

I may try them again, at another location I am familiar with.
Drive thru service was horrible! Employee was rude. Asked for extra mayo on my mcchicken, got cheese, and they forgot our snack wrap. At least the chicken wings were good! Why mcdonalds? Why?!
My orders have always been correct (no missing items) and are completed at that rapid McDonalds pace, more or less, but I would say the food is only average compared to other McDonalds.

I've been using this McDonalds for over 10 years and find it overall reliable. The food is of high quality for a McDonalds, but their speed comes at the cost of missing items, which can be annoying when they occasionally happen.

One of the worst McDonalds I have been forced to use. Makes the entire Pendleton Pike area feel more ghetto than it actually is. A terrible embarrassment that should not be funded by local dollars. The staff is rude and forgets items more than seems humanly possible. I was once told to wait at one of the parking signs for my order, and when I walked in 10min later to ask where my food was they didn't even know who I was and never made my order in the first place. Oh, and to top it all off, they have the arrogance to charge extra for sauces while they are forgetting to wrap a napkin around a cone (if the machine is on). Do not go here.

This is probably the only time I'll ever come to this location since I don't live in Tampa. 

Customer service was decent in drive thru, and the fries were surprisingly hot when we received them. But the highlight of this review is that THERE'S A LIQUOR STORE HERE. 

I am floored. That is all.

I wouldn't even give this restaurant and one star. I have the misfortune of having to go to this McDonald's on my way to work because it's the closest. If I had a choice I would never go. Service is bad people are rude and somewhat mean, food sometimes doesn't taste well. Had a spicy chicken before and several other times lettuce was wilted bread was stale meat tasted weird. Employees really do need to prove improve. The drive-through is the worst ever to have to go through. Has stood in line for at least 15 minutes in front of the menu waiting for someone to come to the computer. I hate this McDonald's with a passion.

Rude drive-thru. Didn't get the order correct. Seemed really put out to tell us the sodas they carried. A google user said this place has a problem w flies. We didn't go inside, but there was plenty of crappy service at the drive-thru to draw the flies in. 
And McDonald's workers want $13/hr?! 
Get my order right & drop the attitude.

McDonald's is usually pretty hit or miss when it comes to how fresh their breakfast sandwiches and hash browns are. That being said... This McDonald's consistently has very tasty breakfast sandwiches and the most delicious, perfectly crispy hash browns I've ever had. The line moves very quickly too.

one of the 3 or 4 best mcdonalds i have ever been to. the kids playland is excellent. the bathrooms are clean. this one also has the 4 nuggets on their dollar menu. the other day, i had a fat guy as my cashier. super nice. i asked him about how big the mcwrap thing was, and he said it was so big that he had to finish it two sittings. i laughed in disbelief. he would have inhaled it in 3 bites. but anyways. their staff is so friendly. the fries are always hot. you can tell they take pride in their work.

Apparently you don't have to get in line at drive through here, you can just pull your car over in front of others in line and place your order at the widow where you pay. The staff won't do a thing about it. I will not be going back.

This is a corporate McDonald's at its best. I love the service that they offer, because it doesn't really compare to the others in the area. I have been to many and know that when you pay your employees well, or at least treat them right, you will receive exceptional service. 

The place is always clean and tidy, they have a busy location that is somewhat hidden from view. I do not visit often, but when I do, I am never disappointed. I love that most of the seating up front is conveniently located next to outlets so you can charge your electronics, while using the free wifi that is in place for everyone's use.

Fast food places are now an afterthought to me but I keep this one in mind because of the proximity to my work place and better than the one closer to my home.

It's alllllllways a wait here.  I mean really, IT IS!!!! 

In the heart of UPT NOLA, Claiborne & Louisiana... Claiborne & Washington... I mean how much more UPT can you be??? Well I guess there's more UPT, but yeah for this review... UPT, Magnolia... yeah e yeah!!!!

Ok back to the review:

Yeah so this is one of the slowest McDonalds this side of heaven.  Right next to a church, you would think the service would be faster, church people coming out all at once, I mean really... BUUUUUUT NOOOOOO!!!  But I guess it is "fast, but not so fast food" & that should be expected? Hmmmmm.  

I can admit on this day, although the service was as stated above, the food was good, temperature was good & the cashier was moderately enthused/friendly... 

This is a newer Mickie Dees, as it has the 2 order taking lanes, ummmm helps to add to the slowness... yeahhhh so slow & steady wins the race I guess.

Once again, like I said, slow order taking service, but ok food...

Where do I begin. I was here at 3pm on a Wednesday and it was not busy at all. I was in a hurry and SHOULD have taken a photo of the drink, napkin station. It was a mess! Napkin holders empty. Trash all over and puddles of soda all over. They told me the lemons for my ice tea were at the drink station but there wasn't even an empty container of them. The ketchup was empty.  I only ordered ice tea... which is self serve and value size french fries and they took forever and didn't even have to make the fries. They had one person running the drive in and the inside counter at the same time. One customer commented that this McDonalds is like this all the time. I'm glad I was out of town and this wasn't a Mickey Dee's that I frequent. I love their unsweet ice tea because it's fresh brewed and not a mix and they USUALLY have fresh lemons. If you're out and about make a note to avoid this one and DO hit a different McDonalds.

This place is the worst! My last 3 orders have been missing items. First it was 2 happy meal milks then on the next stop they forgot one of the fish sandwiches and then today it was the dipping sauce and a cheesburger. All I ordered was a cheesburger happy meal and a four piece nugget. This place is a disgrace to Zionsville!

Usually have had excellent service here in the past years but recently the accuracy of the order has seemed to be slipping.  Now make it a habit to check the order before I leave.  I do have to say when I came back to get the rest of the order they did so with a smile and an apology.  Maybe it's just staff turnover and it will get better.  Hoping so!

I only go to this McDonald's when I am really hungry and this is the only place open. The reason being is that the employees don't understand how to talk on a head set and the food is always bad. Today was not surprising. I went through the drive-thru and got a breakfast sandwich and pumpkin latte. The coffee that was used for the latte was burnt and nasty. I couldn't even drink what I ordered. I also didn't understand what the person was saying over the head set. Bottom line, don't go here unless you really need to.

Its like the last McDonalds on the way down to Lafitte.  So that means they are usually packed.  The order, if you get something special, will always be wrong.   The playplace is kinda funky , as my kids tell me.  Sometimes the employees have their kids in there probably the whole day while momma works, or sleeping in a booth in the mornings.  Gotta do what ya gotta do.  But seeing that always makes me sad and bummed that I came inside to eat. 

This is a last resort place to eat if I am absolutely starving or only have enough $$ for 2 double cheeseburgers.  

Place is typically clean, though in a bleachy cold way.  Still doesn't make feel like its really clean.   
The managers seem oblivious to the pace and lack of pride the kids working there have.  Far cry from the kids at Canes or Chick fil a.

Also have that new dual drive thru set up, doesn't seem like it improves anything.

Chicken McNuggets for breakfast?  here you can!  otherwise it's a clean location with an extensive extra value menu and self-serve soft drinks.  and with free wifi and electric outlets to be found.  this is about everything I'd ask of a McDonalds location.
Went to the drive thru and got some fries, because I was craving for it. Overall it was an okay experience. Nothing special.

My father finally received a call from our local McDonald's as well as a lovely letter in response to his complaint, apologizing for the situation. He now considers the matter resolved and has returned as a customer.
Ordered an egg and cheese on a bagel. Received cheese on a bagel. Laughed so hard I shot coffee out of my nose. A+
This place really is only attractive if you are a homeless person looking for somewhere to shelter. You can pretty much assume you will get standard McDonald's food and encounter strange people.

If you would like a great case of food poisoning this is the place to go! Looks clean and neat but, staff does not know what they are doing. Wrong menu items being handed over should have been the warning..........cold meat, wrong items on the burger and two sick customers. Health department needs to check out this place especially for travelers. Be warned!
Avoid this place at all times! It's always slow, things are always broke down-- jus awful.

Cheap owner. Cuts the Mcrib sauce with cheap barbecue sauce. Does it every year. I should know better than to keep going back year after year. but its the closest one to m job. 

the nuggets are always hard and fries usually overcooked and cold. have seen them re-fry fries to make them seem hot. 

you can see the owner likes to cut corners to make more money. I worked at a McDonald's for 2 years. I know what its supposed to look like. avoid this place if you can. I'm stuck with it when I forget my lunch. and I hate giving them my money. sometimes I just go hungry instead of going there. 

just my opinion. take it for what its worth.

So I visited this place a few times actually hoping to see the shenanigans described in other reviews. Found it to be on the grubby side but otherwise pretty standard McDs. I always visited during the day though, and after a late dinner at nearby Pho Country 2 one night I learned that the Magic doesn't happen until the sun goes down!

This one little block is a mega nighttime bum encampent. And look man, I've been homeless myself, I don't across-the-board denigrate homeless people. But there are homeless people struggling due to circumstances, and then there's just drunk degenerate bums that have ceased to give a fuck about anything. I think this little strip in front of McDs, Pho Country and the Mexican place is a last refuge for the UberGrouches that have been kicked out of all the casinos and can't even set up camp outside the motels anymore. So after they've ingested all the alcohol and drugs they can hold, they wander over to the 24 hour McDonalds with their last $1 or 2 for enough calories to live to drink another day.

Actually my low rating isn't even so much for that - as you can avoid this just by not going after dark - but that the menu here is weird. Prices are reasonable for a McDonalds but they're missing some key items from the $1 menu for some reason, like the McDouble. At least they have the $1 any size coffee or beverage promo going on or we'd probably be talking 1 star here.
Absolutely horrible. Made me wait 15+ minutes in their poor excuse of a drive thru wait area for one small breakfast item. Needs better management.
I gave 3 stars just for speed of service.. The food is always cold, 5 out of 6 times it's a guarantee. Not much to choose from near my work, if there was I would for sure stop going here.

That's it! I'm NEVER going back to this McDonalds! The straw that broke this camels' back?: the drive-thru this morning - waited 11 minutes from the time I paid for my food to the time I received my food only to get down the road and find out they shorted me 1 sausage patty. All I ordered was a drink and 2 sausage patties! I have had consistently bad service here - shortages on my order, luke warm-to-cold fries, sodas that don't taste right and more often than not I have to pull over and wait for some food item that I ordered. I don't know what's going on here, but I just can't take it anymore. I am boycotting this McDonalds - I invite you to do the same.

I've had and seen better, both for food and service.

This location seems to have an old-skool architecture with big yellow arches to it, I'm guessing to model the original McDonald's location.  There's some type of cartoon of a man or a chef with a rather gnarly expression on his face that's plastered on the sides of the building, and he's not Ronald McDonald.

There are signs everywhere regarding no refills, no loitering, the 30 minute dine-in time limit, etc.  

I did get what I thought was food poisoning here a few years back, but it actually was e coli poisoning that probably resulted from a contaminated tea urn spout.  So, those $1 extra large iced teas probably aren't the best option here.  But kinda like various Taco Bell locations around the globe, one bad ride isn't going to stop me from going back to any given franchise as a whole.

The staff seems a little on the not with it side.  A few employees seem to have difficulty speaking English, and there's a couple of others that just seem really young, probably entering the working world for the first time.

24 hour drive-thru, and the dining room is usually open from 6 am - 11 pm.  

What brought me to write this review was an odd experience that happened a couple of evenings ago.  I walked up to the side entrance and there was a rather disoriented, perhaps crazy, individual that was standing a couple of feet inside the restaurant, holding the door wide open, and smoking a cigarette, just blowing the smoke out the door from two feet inside.  Yeah, while customers were walking in and out that same door.  What was worse is that he was in that same spot when I arrived, for the whole 10 minutes or so I was waiting on my to-go order, and probably after I left.  Not a single staff member even batted an eye.  So much for non-smoking restaurants!
Nothing bad, nothing great.  Clean store, well staffed.  Eat here allot and tripped over Yelp one day while here so heres my rating!
Tried the new pumpkin spice latte this morning and I am loving it lol! It was a lot better than I expected and has a different taste than Starbucks. I may even like it better. Yummy yummy!

This is a 24 hour McDonald's, except they will not actually serve you food between the hours of 2 a.m. - 6 a.m.  Instead they will either not respond at all or just tell you they can't serve you whatever you ordered because it's not been prepared in advance!  It's happened multiple times to me, and I no longer consider this a place to eat.

If I could give this zero stars, I would, because that's what it deserves.

At least I can give this McDonald's three stars. Compared to the one on Severn, it is way better. Food is nicer, food is actually not stale. And the food taste better as well. I do wish the unsweet tea did not taste rotten, they need to clean their bins. Other than that I like this McDonald's. Too bad it's too far away from my house for quick access. 
As far as customer service, well it's McDonald's what do you expect they all have bad customer service down here.

As I just wrote a review for my experiences at another McDonald's location on Plumb, it dawned on me that I forgot to write a review of the good ole' downtown location!

Can't really say it's much better in a nutshell.  The food quality is typical of the franchise in general, but this location has some extreme uniqueness.

Regarding the clientele outside (and usually, a few inside,) let's just say that I've heard and seen so many:

-Sob Stories
-Excuses
-Requests for money
-Requests for food
-Requests for drinks
-Requests for drugs
-Requestes for alcohol
-Requests for cigarettes
-Requests for a good time
-Requests for usage of a cell phone
-Inquiries about where to buy drugs
-Inquiries about where the shelter is
-Inquiries as to whether or not my German Shepherd is a drug sniffing dog (to which I usually lie and say yes, just to see people flip out and run like hell!)

...between here and the Walgreen's just down the street on Virginia, that I'm going to compile them all into a novel someday.

However, nobody ever denies me of my Chicken McNuggets.  NOBODY. 

So, once inside, you'll notice a rather not-with-it staff, including someone with a supervisor title on their name tag who handles cash, touches food, and scratches random body parts all at the same time, with no gloves, no soap, no water, and no sanitizer in sight.

The ticketing/ordering system they utilize is completely jacked, especially when it's busy.  A receipt spits out of the register that has an order number (normally the customer's copy in just about every other restaurant I've ever been in that utilizes a setup like this), but they just tell you your order number, and lay the receipt on the front counter, as they need it to put the order together correctly.  Then, they call your number.  I've received more incorrect orders here (usually to-go orders) that I gave up.

In agreement with other reviewers, the menu here is odd.  Even the Dollar Menu items hold an inflated price, I'm guessing due to the fact that the location is right in the middle of all the action and they can get away with it.  In addition, a few items are not even on the Dollar Menu, including the  McDouble and McChicken.  Items that usually fall into the "$1.39" category elsewhere, such as the Double Cheeseburger, are closer to $1.79 here.  But the worst are the combos - I've seen a couple that go up to $1.50 over the norm.

For it being where it is, I was a little surprised that it's not open any later in the evening, or perhaps 24 hours.

Rampant amounts of signs about no loitering, a 30 minute time limit, no refills, etc.  If the staff, or anyone, actually enforced these rules, this place might not be half bad.

And to that one individual I've seen popping in and outta there just about every day since I moved here last year, stealing all the coupon books:  please leave at least a couple available for the mainstream public to consume.  Some of us are professional, tax-paying, law-abiding citizens that appreciate the true value of a coupon, not to mention that the entire casino corridor, patrons and businesses alike, is tired of you!

Steer clear.  Trekking to another location might be your best bet, because this location is also known as the "McShelter," ya heard?

this is the best mcdonald's in carpinteria, hands down.

i took two stars off because I got food poisoning the other day after eating a #1, which consists of a Big Mac, fries, and drink. also, sometimes the fries taste like garbage.
Thankfully the staff were completely distracted and so ignored my presence completely, this allowed me to slip away and go somewhere nice instead..!

Remember when you could sing the entire McDonalds menu song and get a free something? (A big mac a blt a quarter pounder with some cheese ect) Well that was back in the 80's, but it was still cool. Now these fast food joints have free wi-fi, flat screen menus and tv's playing not stop burger-mercials 24/7. It's a bit overwhelming, but at least the iced coffee here is still far better in price and taste than anything Starbuckles has to offer! Rock on..
Long drive thru lines and wrong orders. Just keep driving until you find another one.
They don't even deserve the one star. They never get your order correct, even when they repeat it to you.

I'll keep this short. The tables were filthy and it was 2:00pm on a Saturday afternoon - not prime lunch hour. The service was lackluster. There were ants all over the floor by the front windows in the dining area. Ants! Ick! How long had those French fries been sitting on the floor to attract an army of insects? Not a good McD's at all! Another table had an open bag of Cheetos - huh?! Avoid this location unless you want to try out the McAnts!

I've never been to a business more in my life that routinely screws everything up more than this place. Unfortunately it's the only 24 hour restaurant open in the area and we have to suffer time and time again with the most idiotic employees who can't even remember to put a straw in the bag. I hate this place with all my heart but unfortunately there is no other 24 hour place in the area.

Don't go in here for a relaxing meal, you won't get it. Try not to pay any attention to the sanitation or lack thereof.  It is not a good thing.  Generally, the restroom is pretty clean. 

Every once in a while, I'll pop in for some fries, they are usually fresh, and I am greeted by a counter jockey with the same bored expression that we have come to expect from fast food workers. 

I'm not saying they are rude, they are just a regular McDonald's crew.  I have never ordered anything special so I haven't had the chance to rate their skill with assembling ingredients out of order, but something tells me this crew could handle it. The manager in here seems to be on her food assembly game.

Recently had to survive on fast food in the area since my partner was in the local hospital.  All I have to say is you guys need to take a tip from Burger King across the street and FOCUS.  Get an order right for once!

It's a Mcdonalds, so I won't waste too much time on this. The layout of this place is poor - both interior and exterior. The drive-thru is always jammed! The lines of cars often go into the local road blocking the ability to turn in/out and blocking cars in the parking spots. Second, the waiting area is small so people crowd up eliciting confusion as to who has been waited upon and who needs to order. It also has a ball pit - ugh kids with stinky feet.

Don't recommend this particular location.

Yup, it's all true. Dirty, long lines of deadbeat customers, aggressive panhandlers, rude and unfriendly service,  variable quality, etc... Sometimes the fries are hot and the bag is full, and sometimes they are luke warm and the bag is half full.

The prices on the menu on the wall are wrong. I read that a small soda was $1, but the cash register girl rang it up at $1.40. When I pointed out that the menu on the wall said a small soda was $1 she told me the menu is wrong.

I saw a dead cockroach on the floor.

Just go somewhere else. This place is disgusting.

Well, this location is back open and man is it terrible. I've been 3x since the re-opening and they've screwed my order up 2 of those times. 

1st time- I ordered the pumpkin spice latte and a fruit and yogurt parfait. First they told me they were out of milk for the latte but an employee would be right back with some so they had me pull up past the window. Several minutes go by and a girl comes out and says the latte machine is broken and offers me a frappuccino or something. When she comes back with it she still doesn't have the parfait. I ended up leaving without it because after looking at my receipt it turns out they never even rang it up. 

2nd time- I ordered the pumpkin spice latte again and a grilled chicken snack wrap. Miraculously, I received both on the first try. Unfortunately, the latte was too sweet and syrupy for my taste. 

3rd time- I ordered a large non-fat iced vanilla latte. The guy tried to hand me a hot latte. I told him it was supposed to be iced. After a few minutes he attempted to hand me what was obviously that same hot latte poured over some ice. Really? Like some hot ass coffee is going to become suddenly cold by pouring it over ice! All that does is melt the ice! As soon as my hand touched the cup and felt that it was warm I told him I didn't want it and to please make me another one. So again, I had to pull past the window and wait. A manager ended up bringing it out but with no apologies or anything. And it still wasn't a large. 

I give up on this location.

I agree with Lindy B.  I have been here twice and both times my order was wrong.  The first time my Big Mac was missing the BURGERS.  The second time my meal was missing the fries and the girls at the drive thru were gossiping over the loud speaker for 6 minutes!  I had to say "HELLO!!" At least  20+ times before they took my order.  The staff is super rude.  This place is an epic fail.  I will continue to go to the Donelson location

I can't believe it, but this location does not make the flagship breakfast sandwich, the Egg McMuffin! Only biscuits and mcgriddles... Must be a southern thing? Anyway, mcd's needs to start paying people better cuz these people here work like they are moving through molasses in the winter.

I came here with my brother, son and step father . It's McDonald's after all however the service was good even though the girl was brand new and the food was actually really good and fresh for any  McDonald's.

Just your average McDonalds, I guess. The  young staff is super friendly for a fast food establishment, but I've heard some pretty  
brutal horror stories about the kitchen. My friend who once worked at this location says he dropped a bun on the floor and went to chuck it in the trash. The manager stopped him, took the bun, wiped it off, and used it. UHM EW?! And after he spoke out (in disgust) they fired him for being "slow." I'm Servsafe certified and I'm pretty sure everything about that situation is not okay. 

Anyway, I've gotten stale fries and old, unappetizing burgers on more than one occasion. Really the only reason I ever come here is if I'm really in a rush and need a quick bite (on my way to work, on my way to class, running errands, etc). 

Oh...and the older woman manager with the short white hair can be really freaking rude if you catch her on a bad day or make the mistake of asking her a stupid question. 

Fin.

A McDonald's is a McDonald's is a McDonald's everywhere. As long as the fries are hot and food is warm all is well. The drive up at this location can be on the slow side and we encounter incorrect orders about 40% of the time. For this reason I check the order before I leave the parking lot. The employees are more often than not friendly and apologetic when an error is made. Honestly it happens far to often  at most fast food restuarants so I just expect and inspect order onsite to avoid being upset once home. Food wise I eat McDonald's about 3 or 4 times a year and then only fish or salad. But my son is huge fan and the husband participates occasionally. This is a perfectly acceptable McDonald's.

Ever once in a while I like to get a fix on some McDonalds French fries and when I do order than I like them right out of the oil nice and hot. I order my fries in the drive thru and they were cold after my taste test and request for new ones. I even told them I would park away from the drive thru window and wait for the new fries but less than 2 mins I got a new batch of COLD fries. Very disappointed my fries fixed could not be met and this store could not be helpful enough to give me something as simple as hot fries :-( I give it 2 stars because maybe it was bad timing for me, most of the time in other McDonalds stores I get my hot fries. Because I didn't want to be a pain so I drove off and had a few cold fries and throw away the rest...what a waste of my money.

The worst McDonalds experience I have ever had. It's McDonalds so I don't expect much from these high school drop outs but they should be able to at the very least get my order right and give me straws for my drink. 

Oh and the breakfast sandwiches just sucked. The biscuit was rock hard and not edible at all.

I typically don't have the highest expectations of McDonald's or any fast food place for that matter, but this McDonald's is outrageously bad. I'm not sure if it's just bad management or bad employees, but my wife and I have rarely left with our orders correct. It is close to our house so unfortunately we stop there more often than we should.

We have left the drive thru before missing items and then have to park and go inside to get things fixed. My wife received a chicken wrap missing the chicken. We've ordered unsweetened tea and gotten sweet tea. To top it off, my father was in town and we were joking about how bad this McDonald's is, and when we left the drive thru, he realized that his double cheeseburger was missing BOTH hamburger patties. My wife and I both thought he was kidding, but he wasn't. We had to turn around and go back inside to get hamburger patties on the hamburger we ordered.

Since it is the only fast food place around, go there if you must, but just know that this place is in it's own league when it comes to messing orders up.

With over one hundred locations in the city you are hard pressed to find a neighborhood that McDonald's has not popped up in and Riverbend is no exception. I have been to this one a hand full of times for drinks as well as twice for burgers and once for breakfast. I have to say this location is amazingly clean. The tables were literally gleaming and I didn't notice any garbage on them or the floors. They do a pretty good coffee and the breakfast I had here was really nice and not dripping in grease. The double cheeseburgers however were not great. The patties were over seasoned both times and I got heart burn shortly after finishing them. All in all though this is a really great McDonald's and one of the few in this city of dozens that I find to be worth an above average rating.
Lower quality then Mcdonald's standards.  Dirty, sticky, poor service.  Its always a creepy experience shopping here.

I have been to every mcdonalds in pinellas county. I am a fat guy who loves the ease of driving to a window and getting food without having to do anything. 

I know the local mcdonalds, and this one is not up to par! Horrible. 

Have been here a few times and every time I go something is wrong. Either the sandwich is made incorrectly, or cooked bad and tastes horrible, or the fries are cooked in old grease, or they are overcooked. It is just bad. The training or the management at this location needs to change. 

I worked at the Tyrone Mcdonalds when I was like 16 and it is not that hard to make food here. They have a system and if the system is followed, it is easy as cake. 

So either someone doesn't care, or doesn't have the attention to detail to make sure their store is doing things the right way. Either way it sucks, maybe they have so many Mexicans in the back that cannot speak English and understand what to make. I am Spanish so I do not mean that racist. I mean how can they take directions from a manager speaking English when they only speak Spanish?? They can't. Coupled with nothing but kids that do not care about there jobs and you have a crappy mcdonalds.

This mcdonald's sucks. Plain and simple. 

1st reason they suck - The prices are higher than a normal mcdonalds. Why? Maybe because they figure it is right there so you will pay for it while shopping? You would think a walmart mcdonalds would have the same or cheaper prices, it doesn't.

2nd reason they suck - Understaffed. Usually only 1 or 2 people working. That must be the cheap owner that doesn't care about people's time and would rather cut corners and costs and have people wait forever while you put all the work on 2 people. And they usually are mexican and do not even speak english. It makes no sense. 

3rd reason they suck - Dirty. It's usually really nasty and dirty. I cannot stand eating in a place that does not clean. If I am going to eat there, at least keep it up to par. It looks like it's from the 80's time warp and you are transported to a 1980's mcdonalds in Mexico. 


Whenever I go to wal-mart I do not eat here. If i want to eat somewhere, I eat before or go drive down the road to the Mcdonalds across from Parkside Mall. Just avoid it at all costs.
Fast, friendly service and perfectly cooked breakfast. The entire store was very clean as well. I would drive out of my way for this place. Very satisfied.

Ok, I will be the first to review this location. This is where I use to go when I need Internet. It was cozy here. New comfortable seats replaced old ones. Overall most McDonalds are renovating their restaurants to make their settings more futuristic and edgy. There is usually different crowds that like to sit around and chill at McDonald's like cafe shops. Im guilty of this too in the past. It's a no muss no fuss place. I've been to some really upscale looking and service McDonalds! Lol. I wanna go to the one in West Philly where they placed chess there! hahhaa. Im telling you Im becoming a McDonalds expert! I guess it is what you make of your McDonalds experience. ;-) Too bad this location no longer has my favorite drink Powerade... That's why I no longer go there.

This Mcdonalds was my getaway while I was staying  in New Orleans east. Easy to walk from my apartment when the sun was blazing away the summer I was there. Really I needed a car to get from place to place. I came here just to chill and I was exploring whatever was nearby on foot. When it feels like 100 degrees outside a nice ice sprite soda was like seeing an oasis in the Nevada dessert. That's exactly how I felt then.

I like this McDonalds experience better than the other one south of this exit. I got a lady who offered me a job and met someone studying here. Haha. Good place to just chill. Right off the highway and convenient.
Poooor service. Grouchy staff. The woman lipped us off when we had to go back and fix the order.

After Jamie Oliver won the lawsuit against the king of fast food burgers, I really thought I would boycot them and have. I think it is unconscionable to take meat not fit for human consumption,  wash it in toxic chemicals and serve all of us a Big Mac. SHAME on you and I am so very glad someone finally called you out on this practice.
I will miss my BigMac attacks and your fries.
Tonight a friend came over with 2 of your seasonal egg nog milkshakes. They are so delicious,  I had to pour it down the sink right away or I would have drank every last drop and maybe forgiven your greedy ways at the expense of our health. 
Nope as totally awesome as those shakes are, I could not give into your temptation.  Yes, we all realize your business requires temptation.  But us humans have a thing called choice. 
I choose not to purchase your products due to your deception and disregard for the general populous. 
I love ice cream and a friend did something nice by bringing me a treat and I threw it away.
What can I say, I guess some things are more important than ice cream.....Wait did I really say that?
Oh well, what's a girl to do?  Stick to her beliefs.
Eh good be alot better. I recommend the duck with big mac sauce but the filet tends to be over cooked.  LOVE the creme brule. Recommend the sweet and sour We be coming back soon.
If I could give zero stars I would! Incompetent staff! 75% of the time orders are wrong. Won't be back.

If you're going to get a burger, do yourself a favor and continue south on Rt 232 (Second Street Pike) to the Industrial Highway. This McDonald's is literally located in the weirdest location in Edmonton on an island between 61 Ave, 62 Ave and 109 Street. I remember a while ago I was listening to the radio and there was a traffic update and the DJ literally said "there's an accident at McDonald's Island." I'm pretty sure every local person who listened to that traffic update knew exactly what they were talking about. It made me laugh, and I refer to this McDonald's as McDonald's Island now.

I'll preface this by saying I hate McDonald's. I know some people love their food, their French Fries, etc, but everytime I eat at McDonald's I get sick. Like "why god why!! let this pain end!" kind of sick. Several years ago I swore if I ever went back to McDonald's I would only ever get a drink, juice, coffee, pop, etc. No food ever again.

So my friend and I stopped here for coffee on the way back from seeing a show at Grant MacEwan University. It was later and there aren't a lot of late night, non-alcohol  drinking places. Sure there's Timmy's, but there wasn't really a Tim Horton's on the route we were on. We could have detoured to Whyte Ave to see if Block 1912 was open, but that would involve finding parking, and again it was a detour. So McDonald's Island it was.

This location is really really small. I think there were maybe 6 tables. There is a drive-thru, but we went in and luckily since it was later there was only like 2 other customers in the restaurant. The lady taking our order was pretty slow, and it took me about 5 minutes to get my pineapple juice (which literally just involved pushing a button on a juice machine). There was someone in front of my friend and I who was ordering food, but instead of taking our order (which was a juice and a pop) while waiting for that food order, she just stood around waiting for that food order to come up from the kitchen. I'm pretty sure the order would have been cleared on the cash register (I've never worked at McDonald's, but I have worked at fast food restaurants) so I don't understand why she didn't take our order in the meantime.

I don't like McDonald's food, but I do enjoy their free wifi (something that comes in handy when  I'm traveling as well). Good points - the wifi, my pineapple drink was pretty good and it didn't make me sick, the location is open late (think the drive-thru was 24hrs). Bad points - the strange, confusing location, lack of space, poor/slow service, and the fact it's McDonald's and their food is horrible. I likely won't be back, but the fact I went to a McDonald's to begin with was kind of a miracle.

I tore this McDonald's apart a little more than two years, and I stand by that review as far as it goes.  It was bad.  It was the kind of McDonald's you just keep driving past.

But only about two months later, a fire broke out and left the McDonald's closed for almost two years.  In that time, it was town down almost entire, remodeled, and redecorated. All for the better.  And that's why I am re-reviewing this place.  I can't let my old negative review stand in light of the improvements.

First, the location is no longer the nightmare it was.  The lay out is more open, cleaner, and generally better lit.  The counter works better, the wait is a little better.

The service is a little better, too.  New ownership is trying to create a new culture, and we'll see if that makes a difference.

For now, this is no longer the living, dangerous nightmare it was when I reviewed it from 2011.  We'll see if it stays better.

5 year old:  "I like to play at McDonalds, have fun at McDonalds...I like to go down the slide, I'm not afraid of the slide.  I always have fun at McDonalds - and I always love you guys."

My other 5 year old:  "I like eating chicken nuggets, fries, and tea.  That's it - three."

9 year old:  "I don't know, I really don't play that often - I really like the food I guess."

Not a big fan of their bugers (actually they are kind of scary).  But the chicken nuggets and sauces are great, and the sweet tea is great, and the prices are perfect.

I wish they would regulate the temperature in the play area a little better - sometimes too hot, sometimes freezing.

Overall, 4 stars for what it is.  Check them out if you haven't already - especially if you have kids.

OK, I know it is crazy to review a McDonalds.  I seldom ever eat anything from any McDonalds.  And a four star review?  What am I 500 lbs?

There can be fifteen cars and I know I've got about five minutes to wait.  Starbucks? I was there for 20 minutes and they really don't serve much more than coffee while this McDonalds serves an entire menu of unhealthy food to way more people.  Yet they shoot us through there with ease. I get that Starbucks makes each specialty coffee when it is ordered, so I am not completely dissing the worlds most expensive coffee...

Plus, the people at THIS SPECIFIC McDonalds are ALWAYS really friendly without a tip container sitting in front of them for smile-motivation.  I've been to a lot of fast food joints, I am American after all.  So the super friendly, neat appearance of this staff is certainly worth mentioning.

This is McRonald's food, same as anywhere.  But for a McDonald's I have to give this place credit.  Don't expect Four Star dining, but in its class, this is an awesome fast food operation.  They'd have gotten five stars but they don't have an indoor playground.  I have to draw the line somewhere.

I've noticed that people complain about service in these types of establishments without realizing how they get in their own way. So here are some tips to elicit the best possible service: 

- Carry yourself with a sense of polite urgency
- Know what you want before your order
- State it clearly and succinctly
- Sincerely thank the person serving you once you're handed your change, your food, and/or any special requests

Remember, there's a line behind you, and it ends much more quickly when everyone cooperates, leaving all involved happier.

Speaking from experience, service workers in more "ghetto" establishments treat you a lot more nicely when you don't act like a stuck-up yuppie, but rather a customer who appreciates their work despite it being thankless and low-paid. Too often I see clueless out-of-towners who hold up the line by acting rudely and generally failing to adapt to the situation. Please don't be one of them.
