Went inside at 9:30 on a Saturday morning. Two cashiers...lots of people waiting for orders but no problem taking my order. Watched as everyone got their orders...looked like they ran out of coffee, so I thought that must be why mine didn't come up. After 20 minutes, I finally realized something was wrong -looked like someone cleared my order without actually giving it to me. So, after bringing it to their attention, another five minutes went by while they gave orders to drive thru customers and inside customers, but still not mine. I finally decided that 30 minutes to wait for a bacon/egg/cheese biscuit and coffee was too long..i asked for my money back...then they had run out of ones...wow....manager was not concerned as much with me and the inside customers as making sure the drive thru went as fast as possible. I left there at 10 a.m and went to chik fil-a. McDonalds needs to rethink how they handle orders inside the restaurant...I probably won't go in to this one again soon.

This is, without question, the worst McDonald's I've ever experienced. 

There is no management at all at this location.  

I live down the street from this place and I go here A LOT for breakfast.  I love the egg mcmuffin and now the egg white delight.  Unfortunately, this location is my only McDonald's choice as no other location is close or convenient.   McDonald's competitors don't have a hot bfast sandwich comparable in calories or fat.   

On weekday mornings the drive normally functions reasonably well.  Getting the actual food you ordered is another matter.  I just make it a habit at the pickup window to tell them what I ordered (they never ask) in hopes of getting it correct.  I've stopped ordering the oatmeal because they over fill it with hot water and you just get soup.  The last time I went inside to see the manager and explain the problem and that it had happened 3 times in a row.  She had no interest in fixing the problem -- she just made me another being careful to do it correctly. 

Never go through the drive up at this location on weekends.  I just got back.  At 4 in the afternoon with just 2 cars ahead of me to order, I was in line 20 minutes.  From the time stamp on my receipt of my order time until the time I actually picked up my double cheeseburger was 12 mins.  And they weren't busy.   There is simply no management.  

On a Sunday last year, from the time I paid until the time I got to the pickup window (only 2 cars ahead of me) nearly 20 mins had passed.  When I got to the pickup window they told me they were no longer serving breakfast!!!!!!!!!!!   I tried complaining to the manager but she told me it wasn't her fault because no one there listened to her.   

I've complained to corporate McDonald's but they seem completely uninterested in providing a positive customer experience at an inner city location.  

It's really sad that such an iconic brand that was once legendary for service has willingly become so terrible.

I usually have okay service at this McDonald's, but last night was terrible. I pulled up the the drive thru around 11:10pm for a fry & Mcdouble. There were about 3 cars in the line for lane 1 & no cars in lane 2. I waited a few minutes & decided to go to lane 2. There were no signs or cones to make me believe that lane 2 was closed. I waited about ten minutes at the talk box for lane two, in this time, 4 cars had went through lane 1. I decided that lane 2 must be closed. I pulled around & got back in lane 1, at this time it was 11:25pm. I waited another ten minutes. In the span of that time, I saw the lane 2 service 3 cars. At 11:40pm I decided to cut my losses & get Taco Bell. They really need to work on their night crew.

Why am I giving this McDonalds 5 stars you ask? We'll let me tell you...

First off, this restaurant is incredibly clean. Especially for a fast food chain. 

Second, the customer service at this location is great. Everyone who works there knows what they are doing. It's in a really busy spot so they definitely don't have time to screw around. They have also never screwed up my food. 

Lastly, my 2 1/2 year old son loves the play place here. It's the perfect size for him, so when ever the polar vortex is bringing havoc and he is out of his mind with energy we take him here so he can burn it all off. He loves the tunnels. This one is different from most though because this one is not built really tall which makes it easy for him. If you have kids then you know how important it is to have some place for a release in the winter before the release is you throwing them through the window.
This store is super slow. I have been in the drive thru for 25 minutes with only 3 cars in front of me. 60% of the time orders are wrong. Staff is not very friendly.

Yelp wont let me give half a star, but if I could that is exactly what this MacDonald's would get! Worse service ever!!! 

The night I went the lady was talking on the phone in the drive thru while taking my order. Get to the next window and that woman was just as rude. I agree McDonald's is not the "perfect" job,  however it is a place of business and should be treated as such. There are so many people without work, and if the people working at this establishment do not care how business is ran they need to find a new form of employment.  Some where far from society.

This place is the fucking worst. They gave me the wrong shit then say that's what I ordered. I ordered the number 10. They give me a sausage egg biscuit. Places in the hood are the worst. I hope they close down. Then they always ask off your paying with cash or credit. What difference does it make? What till I get up there and find out.
Sometimes you just gotta get McDonalds. This place is always out of stuff and recently filled my order incorrectly. I was charged for a large fries and got a small.

On two occasions around 3pm and late night around 11 on Wednesday,  my fries are either soggy undercooked or warm and stale fries. The food here is run of the mill McDonald's but I at least want fresh fries with my warm burger And cold chicken nuggets.  The standard of food here leaves alot to be desired.  
 One time while here in the morning on a Sunday it was not busy.  My wife wanted to have her drink refilled but couldn't because the manager was facing away from the counter and with his phone out not hearing my wife clearly say "excuse me" . I get really peeved from bussiness that fire or punish hourly workers for cell phone use, yet a manager can have a phone shoved up there hoot shoot and call it bussiness?  On another note This location is run by McDiaz mgmt which has its hand in most of the Mcds. As well as the one on Speedway and cray Croft. Which I had friend that worked there who was constantly in trouble for cell phone usage by a Manager of who I've never seen without a cell phone. Being said, I refuse to give McDiaz my money because they employ morons as managers who are go figure Mexican American (I have no issues with race just speaking from experience) barely understand enough English to take my order correctly and yet treat their hourly Co workers like mindless morons. I say this because I had a friend who worked at the craycroft speedway location who was Caucasian,  felt that it was hard to work and be trained by someone who's second language is English. I find that to be unfair but compounded by the fact that I have to settle with undercooked soggy fries I no longer choose to spend money here or anywhere McDiaz owns.
Mmmm, gotta have it. Good food on the run or for a sit-in meal, we love our local McD's and the great folks who work there. Always had good experiences at this particular facility.

It's a McDonald's. Seriously, if you've never even at a McDonald's, I don't know what to tell you.

What I will say is that it is a MUCH better experience sitting in the dining room and eating, over going to the drive thru. As a longtime resident of the Media area, I can't count how many times I sat in an extremely. SLOW. DRIVE..........THRU. Even if I was the only car in line, a simple trip through could take 7-8 minutes. When the food does come, the fries would usually be cold, or the order incorrect.

Dining in is usually quite pleasant in the bright dining room. If you need a Mickey D's fix, and this place is your choice, be smart and take the extra 10 minutes to dine in here.

This is a nice McDonalds newly built with beautiful exterior palm trees and nice landscaping. The interior is modern with free wifi. The service is fast. The price is right. What can you say McDonalds billions and billions served

It's after 1am on a Saturday night, the bar down the street has announced last call, and you're on the prowl for a little something to eat before heading home. Bring on the Golden Arches!

This McDonald's is open 24 hours a day -- both the drive-through windows and the inside counter and dining area. They gutted and rebuilt this place about a year ago, following a fire, and the remodeled store has a very hip and stylish interior. The drive-through has two lanes, and the cars will definitely stack up during peak times. The staff makes a good effort to keep the place clean, but this is a high-volume store, and the world is full of slobs for customers.

You already know the menu, in fact you can probably still sing the song, "Two all-beef patties, special sauce, lettuce, cheese, pickles, onions, on a sesame seed bun". Everything is portion-controlled and mass manufactured to be sure that everyone is McHappy.

The staff can be hit or miss depending on which shift is working. Some of the crews are super friendly and chat with their regular customers, while others seem to be annoyed that you've disturbed their conversations with each other. I guess that just comes with the territory of minimum-wage fast food workers.

Oh well, I was glad they were open and had a fresh batch of French Fries ready to pass my way.

Worst service iv ever had at a mcdonalds  just awful. Ordered a big mac and only got one slice of meat then me and a friend were asked to leave after complaining about the big mac no refund or replacement! will not be going back there anymore.

Located in the East of New Orleans in Bullard lies McDonald's in between Cajun seafood & taco bell/KFC. Carby carbs! Works in all ways for a midnight snack (open 24/7, meaning oatmeal all the time!) .. Coffee run..a fat lazy dinner for the family&& not for me since I'm pescetarian and don't really care for fried fast food.
Service is always a hit or miss. However, Sunday night's service is pretty nice. I always go through the drive thru.
Yeah...I'm not sure how to review McDonald's exactly..I mean.. It's McDonald's! I'm lovin' it!
You get to wait 20 minutes even when first in line at the drive thru window. Now worth it - even of their fries are die-worthy!

3 stars is generous. 
Ordered a sweet chili chicken wrap and large drink. Wait time more than average per number of people serving. 
Order handed to me not complete. Order was put on counter, shouted out by food item and person left there. No bother to ask if I needed anything such as condiments etc. And....Neither the cashier or person filling order handed me beverage cup. 
Food quality as expected which was good and consistent but......presentation was horrible. Wraps are placed in cardboard sleeves for easy eating. about 1/2 way down you remove the wrap from carton to finish it. Well this one wouldn't come out and I wondered why.  Tore open rest of carton to discover the reason.  Wrap was not rightly wrapped and literally was torn at the bottom and contents spilling out all over inside of carton. Usually toys is a great to go food but thankfully today I was parked as I ate lunch and it was quite the mess. 

I've worked at a McDonald's before and I know this is not how the customer experience is supposed to go. 

Step it up in there.

To be called "fast foods", you would need to be fast. This is the slowest McDonalds ever, i tried the drive through twice, both times stuck waiting for the foods for 15 min. The employees didn't seem to be doing much
No ice, no ketchup, terrible wifi connectivity, go to the Burger King across the street.

It shouldn't take 30 minutes for a burger, and if it does, don't worry, it's because the long braided, not to mention toothless, ghetto woman threw your receipt away and proceeded to get everyone else their food, even if they were several spots behind you. But it's okay! Once she has to be told that it's been up for several minutes by her manager, she'll VERY slowly put the burger into the bag. And walk it even more slowly to you. But she didn't look like a walker so that explains that. Otherwise, save time and aggravation go to the one down the street. No one should have to wait 30 for a MCDONALS burger.

Worst food, service, and employees known to mankind. 

During prime dinner time, they'll staff the shit outta drive thru, but they'll have one kid as a cashier inside at the counter. 

The shift  manager will look back every so often, but refuses to help out at the counter herself. Her attitude stinks. Not worth the drive.

This is a very nice McDonalds. It is brand new, has two drive thru lanes, has a nice staff, a clean facility, and high tech menus. I usually don't eat at McDonalds, but I sometimes come here for the breakfast and the T because it is so convenient and it is such a nice place to go for a fast food place.
The worst mcdonalds in the nation (world).  They will not greet u, and in most cases they will not even ask for your order.  They also refuse to open on time.

It takes a lot for me to hate a restaurant.  McDonalds has succeeded with the food.  It's just lousy: the fries, hamburger, and frozen drinks taste like they came from a very advanced chemistry set.  They have free wifi and a passable breakfast.

Always greeted when walking in, breakfast is served 24 hrs here. Hotcakes are soft melt in your mouth. 1st time ever where I ordered a egg mcmuffin and the edges were Not Burnt - incredible that has never happened and I enjoyed my egg mcmuffin.

I went to go see Endymion, and happened to drop my ecig. So I went into this McDonald's to use the bathroom so I can clean my ecig, and the line was 30 minutes long just to use the BATHROOM. I know it's Mardi Gras the bathroom lines are going to long. But 30 minutes is TOO long to do one little thing :(  I had to go to Burger King and pay a dollar to clean my ecig.
I will not go back thay will try to rip you off for a 4 pice nugget is a 1.29 x 2 =with tax is 2.72 not 3.68 when I said 2.72 it was said no I can pay 3.68 I said no I will not be back

From the minute I walked in and saw the line halfway through the restaurant and the sad look on all the employees faces, I knew there were going to be issues.  After a LONG wait, my order was taken and I asked the young lady why she looked so sad.  Her response was it was really busy and they were short on help.  I wish I had an opening, I would hire her.  

Listening to the chaos going on behind the counter, there was one person who was obviously in a leadership position. Lady, treat your employees with courtesy and respect!!! I did not hear you say please or thank you once in your barking.

Food, it was just the way I ordered it, a little overdone fries (but salt free, as I requested) My wings were totally edible and once I microwaved the pie, it was as well satisfactory!

Leadership needs to get a better handle on hiring and staffing issues. Stressed out employees are not going to give good service.
I know, Mickey D's? But, and this is a big but (no pun intended), the Filet-O-Fish is a modern day masterpiece. The urge strikes, thankfully not too often, but when it does nothing else will do.

Food is good. The hamburgers are good, sometimes the French Fries are warm to room temp. they don't stay hot for long, like other fast food places. The dollar menu is very good. Ice cream is only in 1 flavor vanilla. It's always crowded which is a good thing. The drive thru is always busy. Bathrooms are ok. only 2 stalls. Wifi free

My favorite McDonald's! I like this location because the staff is always friendly, the food rarely has a mistake made before you're given it, and this is probably the fastest drive-through window I have ever encountered. Plus, they often have neat promotional deals and the inside is well-kept too for those times you want to sit and eat.

This is as much a review of the patrons of this McDonald's location as it is anything else.  I attended this establishment earlier tonight wishing only to order a little dessert.  I left there completely frustrated, without having ordered anything, because of the plague of unsocialised teenagers who were running riot in the place, taking it over in a way that would have embarrassed the children depicted in Lord of the Flies.  I am very unlikely to return to this location and revisit that nightmare.
The dining room could be cleaner, but the service is good and the orders are prepared correctly.  All in all, this is a good McDonald's location.

I recently went to this Mc Donalds for the first time and I can't believe such a place is even in business.
 First of all, while I was standing in line waiting for my order I saw a medium size cockroach crawling on their wall!  Seeing disgusting things like that in a food place is sure to ruin one's appetite. When I received my food(veggie wrap, french fries and iced coffee) the tray was literally oily as if it was unwashed.  At that point I regretted even entering the place but I had already got my order so I just wanted to get it over with. 
My next complaint is their seating:
The chairs and the table are connected in such an inconsiderate way that my legs kept hitting the metal parts because there was no space. 
Food wise, the french fries was surprisingly fresh and iced coffee was ok but the veggie wrap was put together carelessly and had no particular taste. I actually needed to eat it with ketchup to make it taste at least somewhat good.   

All in all, my overall experience left me with disgust.

One of the first things you'll notice about this place will be that it looks a little dirty. Not a lot dirty, but just enough for you to know that it needs to be cleaner. 

The next thing you will notice are the employees yelling. Not at each other as much as just shouting. 

Not a very pleasant experience. 

The parking lot is convenient and is probably better as a drive thru than eat in.

I only used the drivethru so that is what I'm rating.  The path is weird as it makes you go through loops when you enter and exit this location.  That's what the four star rating is for.  But the workers were good and my order was not messed up.  That's all you can ask for right?

This location absolutely sucks!!! The workers suck and usually can't get your order right. Not to mention the late night menu sucks! You can get a Big Mac or any of the fattening food but you're shit out of luck if you want grilled chicken wraps and want to try and eat healthy!
This location always has sucky service. I've lived near here for 10 years. They always have a excuse...

For some reason there are times when my throat needs something very cold. No idea why but when those times come it must be quenched.

Ok so now about five times I have gone through the drive up and requested a shake, nothing more, just a shake, and each time I am told that the ice cream machine is down. They never tell me why it is not operational, just that it is not on. 

So for heaven sake turn the stupid thing on or get it fixed if that's what it needs or take the shakes off of you menu.

Five times is just ridiculous.

No Napkins, No Ketchup in our bag at the Drive-Thu.  

To the girl in drive-thu window, do you have profit sharing or just not care about the people you serve ?
Love this McDonalds everyone is always so energetic and so very friendly.  I only visit this McDonalds on the east side, they are very clean the crew and the store both.

I need a quick breakfast on the go this morning. I did not have any wait at the drive thru and I was greeted by a very friendly associate. She smiled took my money and told me to have a great day.... I told her I would after I had my egg white delight.. Best hangover cure around.
Slow as usual and the people there really are not that friendsly food was good though

Holy bad customer service. Gave the drive through cashier who was a hs age girl my BOGO sandwich coupon. She took it off the bill but shorted my change the $4 or so. Swung back around when I realized to get it corrected. No "I'm sorry about that" or even a word said. Someone else I assume was a manager fixed the problem. Annoying.

Only place open near ruskin after tampa bay hockey game at 11 pm on  a Monday . Hence mcdonalds. I only average about 2 times a year at Mickey ds. Easily dirtiest one I have been in though.you could sense staff wanted to go home.food was decent and filled my gut, so I should not complain much.

I don't bother to review McDonalds very often, but...

This location really tries to work the speed of their drive through.  They have a double drive through to start, then at rush times they put another person outside to collect cash so they are working two payment windows too.

I went throught at peak breakfast time this week and my car almost never stopped rolling.  I give them a lot of credit for being innovative and trying to keep the wait short!

Time, and time again, I give this location the opportunity to improve on their customer service. Yet every time I find the experience lacking. So again, for the 3rd or 4th time, I am again left without a receipt for my order. It is not the responsibility of the customer to request a receipt for their purchase, it is the obligation of the seller to provide a receipt. The franchise owner needs to make it a policy to provide their customers with a proof of purchase. I am sick and tired of using the drive thru, returning home, and finding myself without a receipt.

I am in NOLA for spring break and today I finally woke up in time for breakfast. After getting my cash back from Rite Aid I decided to treat myself to some Micky Ds breakfast. I figured a coffee, hash brown and a bacon egg and cheese bagel would help the hangover that was slowly taking over my body.

I got in the crazy long line that snaked around the store, confused as to why a "fast" food joint would have such a long line. Well after about 10 minutes the line hadn't moved because out of the two cashiers one  was standing at the register glaring at the customers and the other was playing with her hair. A little angry I asked if there was a problem with the register since neither of them seemed to know how to do their jobs - surprise, no response. After another 10 minutes it was almost my turn with only one order ahead of me. Two middle school kids were in line before me and the cashier refused to take their order and instead told them "go back to school and take your exams". I was shocked. I have never seen anyone refuse an order before. Little did the ignorant cashier know that they were also here on vacation and were sent in by their parents who were waiting in the car. Apparently the drive through line was longer and more stagnant than the one inside - hard to believe. They walked out empty handed. 

When it was finally my turn to order the cashier didn't say a thing and just stared at me. I said hello and she responded with a blank stare. Tired of waiting I told her my order. She wasn't listening and made me repeat it. I tried to order one of their breakfast meals without the coffee. She didn't seem to grasp that concept and gave me the coffee anyway. Instead of trying to correct my order I gave it to one of the homeless men who was waiting outside. 

I have never seen such poor customer service before. If you are in need of a fast food fix avoid the Canal Street Mc Donald's! Go to Rally's around the corner on Broad Street instead.

I come to this location often, with the majority of my transactions happening via the drive-thru. Because I come during breakfast a little early, I never have issues with waiting a long time. And even if there are other cars there, the crew is really efficient about getting everyone served quickly. It's an average McDonalds that fulfills all of my Big Mac wishes and McFlurry dreams.

A Nightmare in the morning!
We ordered 2 sausage biscuits and 1 sausage mcmuffin w/ egg.  How simple could it get.  No meals.  No drinks.  Simple. 
They made multiple mistakes:

This McDonald's is the WORST SERVICE we have ever had in all of our travels from California to New York!

My kids and I stopped in this McDonalds while  vIsiting Tucson with nothing better to do but sit in the hotel room bored. 
Upon arrival I noticed that this must be the place where every teenage mom in town brings her kids to let them run wild while she gossips, does her nails, plays on her phone/tablet or everything but watch or control het children.  
The line wasn't very long so were able to place our order quickly. That's the extent of the positive things I found about the place. :(  
The food took a long time but wasnt freshly made, the soda was flat, the happy meal toys sucked, the employees are rude, and the prices are outrageous.  
We would have been better off eatting rocks in a tornado.

The service at this location is hit or miss. The drive through is what I use most often and I have had to write a few complaint letters to the franchise owner. They NEVER offer you ketchup or anything else in the drive thru. They are content with you driving away and when you notice you forgot to ask for ketchup or something else you are angry that they didn't even offer it as a reminder. 

I've had bad luck inside as well. I ordered a combo for breakfast and it seemed unusually expensive. I looked at my bill and was charged for a large coffee, not the medium that I asked for. I spoke with the manager and all she said was she would talk to the person who took my order, didn't even offer to make it right. 

I only go here so often because it's very close to home and it's convenient. If I'm heading south on 149 street in the morning I prefer the 87 Avenue location, the service Is a little slow there but their prices are actually a little lower for breakfast.

This is the worst McDonalds I have ever experienced. I keep trying thinking it will get better. I only use the drive thru. I have yet to have a server who smiles, thanks me, or even tells me to have a nice day. I only order a Diet Coke and I am sure that they spit it also. Sad part, is I have called the owner of this store and nothing seems to help.

I will NEVER go back to this McDonald's.  As my husband and I were eating our fries on the drive home yesterday afternoon, I put one up to my mouth and then saw a short, THICK, curly black hair wrapped around it.  Needless to say, we threw our entire meals away without eating anymore.  That's just disgusting, and they should be ashamed of themselves.  There's no excuse for that.

I'm so over McDonalds in general, and stopping here reminded me why I don't want to go back. 
 
Granny's always say if you don't have anything nice to say don't say anything at all. I just don't know how I could write a review full of silence..... Customer service not quite servicy, extra long waits, equipment not working, skimpy fries, sticky tables - yes, I could go on and forever on. 

This trip I came in for an ice cold beverage, and that's about it. I waited two minutes in the dining room line (drive thru was super long) that is normally one or two people. After finishing my order, the cashier took the receipt and crumbled it up then tossed it in the trash instead of handing it to me. For a moment I thought maybe there are two receipts, but no, he walked toward the back like whatevs, and I headed toward the soda fountain. 

A spray bottle and dirty rag were left sitting on the fountain counter, and the fountain itself was a hot mess. Napkins, lids, ketchup stains, and soda spills covering everything. I'm not sure what happened mid cleaning, but I moved the bottle over got my drink and quickly put a lid on it. 

Walking out the door through a group of teenage girls affectionately calling each other every curse word they could think of, I was definitely not coming back here any time soon. 

This McDs gets the food part right if they have your order correct. I'm not sure if it's lack of a full staff or lack of motivation there's just something missing here.  Seriously supersize missing.

Went there on 3/27/2014 at 5:59 AM. The Hashbrowns we ordered were cold, so I went inside thinking it wouldnt be an issue to get them redone for my girlfriend. I guess it was bc when I was driving off and bit into them, there was a black mans pubic hair tucked under the hashbrown sleeve. My worst fear has finally come true after 25 years of being a McDonalds customer. I knew there was a problem when the guy ignored me when I thanked him twice.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS MCDONALDS.

I cannot believe someone would ever violate someones food just bc they wanted it to be hotter. I WASNT EVEN RUDE ABOUT IT. i thanked him twice.

disgusted...

I'm not a huge fan of Mcdonalds but the time I go through and they ask "would you like 2 apple pies for a dollar?" And I finally say yes...they forget the freaking pies. Smh and they want minimum wage to go up? GTFO here with that shit.b

This review is not for this location but my love for a food item, the Filet O Fish. When done right like I had at this particular location, nothing says lent in New Orleans than a freshly fried Filet O Fish with just the right amount or tarter sauce, hot fries and a cold Orang Hi C to drink it down with. No other seasonal seafood dish at the other fast food restaurants can compare.

This is, and always has been, the worst Mc. On the West side.  The place is always busy because of it's location and they are ALWAYS understaffed!  The tables are always dirty, the bathrooms are gross and "fast" food is a joke.  Slooooooow.  Slooooooow. Slooooooow!  Being that they are always so busy and so slow, I don't know how it is that the fries are never fresh, yet always way too salty.  Got a fish there yesterday and it was dry and cold!  I sent it back from the drive-thru and refused to move until they gave me a fresh one.  I don't know why I EVER go to that one.  I am done!  THE WORST!  Got to the one over by Marsh if you HAVE to have MC.

I thought this McDonald's looked very clean and up to date. The service was also very quick, which is what I would expect from McDonald's. I ordered a McDouble with tomato, bacon, and mac sauce and a large fry. I don't what people say but not all McDonald's are created equal. I didn't think this was the best McDonald's, I think the one that serves the best food is the McDonald's right before you go to Honeymoon Island. But, like I said before, I think this Mcdonald's is very clean and I would certainly eat inside it again.

Bog standard McDonald's with nothing remarkable to comment on, which is always good for a chain restaurant. Quick service and friendly too. I'm removing stars because I find they are hard to get in and out of (location, location, location) and because my Mighty Wings were overcooked.

worst,slowest,dirtiest McDonald's ever. Its the one closet to me so i still go here all the time i just know i will wait forever. but tonight i chose to go inside since the line was pretty long. not only did the cashier tell the person next to me they hate how they hate that they serve breakfast as im ordering it the lady got off her shift and no one even started my meal til 10 mins late then just to say it would be another 5 min. but then it gets better they gave me a free soda cup to i guess make up for the crazy wait at this point. the soda had a stream of ANTS going from trash to the soda. if you go here you have been warned. dirty,long wait,lack of care,hates what you order,killer ants. good luck if you go...im not even mad im just informing the public. of my trip to this mcd's

Bad food and not happy with the service. This place  looks a lot nicer than it used to 10 years ago, due to the forced remodeling. The remodeling was caused by a drunk driver hitting the building years ago but it's still a Mcdonalds.
Really bad service and terrible drive through. Sorry not sorry, this is a terrible place to go. If you want to waste 45 minutes of your time come to this location.

I usually don't think about reviewing places like McD's, let alone grace going inside one outside of breakfast hours. But I made an exception here since I was desperate for something to eat, was carless (took Metrolink and bus to get out to this area and was staying at nearby La Quinta) and hoping for a shot to eat Jack Box's food (got my shot next morning), but they unfortunately locked up their lobby early that night. So I reluctantly chose to ate here.

What a surprise at how great this one was! If all McD's were as good as this one, I'd be way less reluctant to eat at them post-breakfast, to the degree I usually am unfortunately. Staff was friendly and ACTUALLY not indifferent, lobby/inside dining area was 24/7(part of me was thinking lobby/dining area would only be open till 11pm, beforehand) AND actually clean for once ever, and it even had a Redbox inside to boot.

Chicago area McD's operators should visit this one, and take notes on how much better this one seemed to me, vs. 98-99% of the local ones I've eaten at. Oh, and you also should also borrow charging less for the Shamrock Shake ($2.59!), and not overcharge for it like I saw Chicago area ones doing at most I've passed by ($2.99, what the!!). Glad I saved my Shamrock Shake craving for this one.

I've been to this McDonalds a million times and up until recently, I've always had terrible service. The employees wouldn't speak to you or even tell you your total at the window, just put their hand out without even making eye contact, and I'd never been thanked for my business. However, someone must have gotten the message, because the service recently has been delightful! The employees smile, actually speak to the customers, and I haven't had an order messed up since I noticed this change. Thank you whoever made this change in employment or training, and thank you to the nice girls who sold me two #3 meals this evening:)

Its McDonald's what more do you need

Service is pretty good though

Filet o fish only 2 bucks right now

Finally reopened...newly remodeled/renovated! Staff still needs more training == there were some bumps with our drive thru experience (i.e. order wrong, amount charged incorrect), but its' McDonald's not the Four Seasons. I go there for the $1.00 Large Iced Tea.

Yikes!  Brought my 5 year old and three of her friends here after a date at the Jube to see the Backyardigans.

This location is in the parking lot at West Mount Mall with ample parking and I believe it is the largest PlaySpace location in Edmonton.  This particular PlaySpace McDonad's is targeted for the 4-8ish range where as some locations have play structures/activities closer to the ground for the 2ish age range that cannot climb.

Unfortunately, the three story play space was so dirty that I had to pack them up and drive to another location.

I cannot comment on the food here as we left without ordering and based upon the lack of cleanliness in the kids' area, I don't think we will be back :-(
I always get the wrong order and have to come back and the manager who works at night is not very friendly.. Other than that, its a beautiful building and is consistent with McDonalds food quality.
Fine dining!!!! Across from mountain view high school. Always lots of minors smoking cigarettes ... Yuck!

As I'm sure any and every Mc Donald's gets busy, as far as customer service, this one is by far the worst Mc Donald's to go to. Just about every time I've been through this drive through my order never comes out right and I've always gotten attitude from the employees. I won't even stop at this Mc Donald's and it sucks because when I want a late night snack this is the only 24hour drive through near me.

So I went to the McDonalds on South Virginia to get a chocolate-dipped ice cream cone with my girlfriend. The guy making the cones went ahead and touched all over them, then, with one cone in his hand, proceeded to type on the computer screen. Naturally the cone ended up pressing against the plastic screen protector, where the chocolate fused with the germs on the screen protector. All of this, of course, happened right in front of our eyes. Then the guy handed us our ice cream cones, which we quickly thew away. We thought we'd try again at the McDonalds on plumb, but apparently this guy is some sort of archetype, because like clockwork, another guy working at the plumb McDonalds wiped his nose with his glove-less hand and fiddled around with our lopsided, and I mean lopsided, dip cones. I don't know how to integrate this experience into my life in a meaningful way.

That was the worst mcdonalds experience I have ever had. If anything would motivate you to stay in school so you don't wind up working here this would do it. I occasionally get breakfast and when I do it's the bacon egg and cheese bagel with the caramel mocha - not only did I get the same thing the other day from a different McDonald's and it was exactly a dollar less but it was WAY better service! I get to the window and the girl goes "did you have a sprite?" I'm like no?? She goes "what did you have?" And I told her - she goes and gets my drink and says have a nice day. I'm like umm I also had food? She goes "oh what did you have?" Why on earth is she this clueless!? This place is a disgrace to the McDonalds name! Awful!!

Stopped in here for some ice cream cones after spending the day at the Children's Museum.  We ordered 4 ice cream cones, 1 apple pie and 1 drink.  There was no line when we went in.  You would think that this would be an easy order that was quickly filled.  We waited 10 minutes for that small order.  I don't know if they had to milk the cow and hand churn the ice cream or what.  Maybe they had to pick the apples and bake it themselves but it was border lining on ridiculous.  We finally got our cones and such and sat down.  We could not sit without people trying to bum money.

I've been to some pretty bad mcdonalds and this is definitely not the worst one. It's a relatively big McDonald and for it's size and location it is kept pretty clean. The surroundings of this McDonald's can seem a little ghetto at times, but if you can get past that it's pretty nice inside. 

The service here is good as well. Not that fast. I went during a non peak hour as well and it looked like they were all just playing around on the other side of the register. 

But all in all you can fill most of your McD cravings here.
Horrible service. Very rude. They always get something wrong on my order. Is not clean at all. I would not recommend this McDonald's to anyone.
This McDonald's has a great location and the food is okay.  It gets quite busy at times but it's a good value.

This place is  always slow and messes up my order almost everytime I come here. I would say 2 out of 5 times they get my order right. Also there 24 hours but there's times were have gone to the drive thru and there closed.
Who stops serving breakfast at 10:30? I will not be back until this oppressive policy is changed. I want my egg mcmuffin for lunch or maybe even dinner. I demand satisfaction.

Like most McDonalds. Although this one has a knack for getting about every other order wrong. If you ask to not get something, then expect to get it anyway. Although that is the way most McDonalds are these days.

Four stars only because, well.... This McDonald's is always nice & without incident. We often use & abuse the drive thru for cookies (3 hot fresh chocolate chip for a buck?! YEEE!) and I have been known to swing by on busy weekend mornings for a nice, greasy, satisfying breakfast. My cutie adores him a sausage biscuit! And so he shall have one! Sometimes I will bring my people at work breakfast & the staff here is always happy to serve up my order with individual bags, per my request, so that I can deliver to individuals.
This is one of the better McDonalds that I have been to. Fresh fast food isnt something that is easy to come by in Indianapolis. But I have found it here.

I have never gotten a correct drive-through order at this store. Even though I live less than a mile away, I haven't patronized this place in over two months.
I have contacted corporate, and their solution was an apology letter along with a free meal coupon...that could only be used at a store on the opposite side of town.

Hadnt been to this location in a hot minute, and needed a little something for brekkie. I rolled through the drive through, ordered my free coffee and a parfait. (On a diet). I wait and get to the window, and they young lady informs me I have to park, they forgot to make them.  Well it is 14 minutes to I start work, and there are 4 cars in front of me also waiting. ( I wonder if for parfaits?)  I just take off. It just was not worth the dollar.  

This store has an obvious problem with their leadership, they advertise 9.00 an hour and still cant seem to get staff. Last time I was in there the manager was so crappy to her employees it made me cringe, I am guessing that is the rule rather than the exceptions. Perhaps Mc D's needs to review this franchise holder thoroughly.

ALWAYS check your bag, and your order on the screen, and your reciept. Always.
 Food is typical, employees seem generally confused, but genial.
 Not at all sure what it's like inside, looks scary from the outside I use drive through, and think "They **** with you at the drive through" every time!

My biscuits and sausage gravy were great.

That's where the positives end. The staff were incredibly rude, the service was slow, and the place was filthy. I was there with a couple of friends - one's food was literally dripping with grease and the other's breakfast sandwiches had mayonnaise on them for some reason. Usually you can count on McDonald's for a decent, cheap meal. This one wasn't worth it.

Only stop at McD's once in a blue moon, 24 hour drive through is great IF YOU CAN GET YOUR FOOD. 5:45 AM, way to work, ordered, pulled up, waited a couple minutes and finally looked in to see two women employees arguing about something! I waited a few more minutes, they hadn't stopped and I noticed my coffee hadn't even been made yet. The final straw was after all this time I see one woman pull out my take out bag and continue arguing and pointing. Ain't no body got time for that!, I left. NEVER AGAIN, go to Hurffville, SH. 47 and 41, 5 points, Deptford/Washington Twp.

after the 4th time receiving the wrong meal through the drive through, I decided to call a manager.  I was given a hollow apology & was told i would have some coupons sent to me as their way of saying sorry.   one month later, no coupons & i still havnt been back

Exceedingly poor service. Waited nearly 10 minutes in line only to be told that they would not serve breakfast. It was Sunday at 10:48. All literature states that McDonalds serves Breakfast till 11:00 AM on Sunday, till 10:30AM Other days.  Manager said NO when asked about the before 11:00 AM time. Lazy group? Never again at anytime will we go for more reasons than just this. This McDonalds has always had poor customer service

This is the worst mcdonalds I have been to. The employees are slower than slow with no desire to be faster at all. No sense of urgency from the employees including the manager there. While waiting for our food we saw two orders get messed up and have to go back up to the counter to get their order fixed. We saw a lady get completely skipped over 4 times. She finally asked where her order was because the numbers called were after hers. We had told
The cashier we wanted it to go and they put it for here and when we said no we asked for it to go she have us attitude threw it in he bag and tossed it to us. After reading some of these other reviews my experience is not uncommon 

It's sad too because I haven't had mcdonalds in over a year - it's no surprise why

I like McDonald but every time they give me my drink through the drive thru they always and I mean 90% of the time they give me my drink dripping on the side.  So that when I reach it I get coke all over my hands and then out it in my cup holder and it all over . Leaving it stuck and nasty.  I always asked to get extra napkins so that I can wipe around the drink as well as the bottom of it. I hate that and I have taking the survey on their receipt so that the can fix it bug they still don't.
Went in wanted a large fry.  Got to the car stone cold and stale.   How do you screw up FRENCH FRIES at McDonalds????? HOW??????
The slowest mcdonalds on the planet...been here 5 times....always slow!!!!!! Bad management
McD's is always great, fast and cheap. This location is just that.

Very poor service we went today and got a very rude cashier and someone had spilled a soda by the main entrance and it took them more than five minutes for them to send somone out to at least put a wet floor sign out even after I saw various customers telling them about the wet floor never again will we go there

It's Mc Donald's enough said.  We don't come here for the high quality healthy food we come because the kids like to play.  It's not the cleanest but on a hot, rainy, or snowy day this is a place the kids can unleash their pent-up energy and give us parents a few moments to ourselves.

Awful.
Takes literally 20 minutes to go through the drive. The later it is the busier get and the less people are working. 
Once I even saw a roach in there on the floor and when I told the manager no one did any thingthey just kind of laughed it off. Definitely would not recommend this McDonald's would give it one star but the fries are pretty good.

Really bad Mcdonalds. The restaurant wasn't clean and did not have much seating. When we walked in we noticed that there were a lot of homeless people just sitting in the restaurant and not eating. The staff wasn't friendly and it took over 15 minutes to get our two meals and it was not at all busy. They also gave no napkins and did not want to give any ketchup. Very trashy Mcdonalds.

Why am I reviewing a McDonalds? Because they deserved to be praised. I stop by here twice a week on my way to work for breakfast. They are quick, efficient, and never screw up my order. 

I could probably order, pay, and pickup without stopping my car. That's how good they are. The employees are also very friendly.

As with any McDonalds you will find the food almost exactly the same everywhere. 

This facilty is a bit odd in it's placement as it is attached to another store and the parking lot is for customers to Sobeys and banks among other things. Parking is not prime ever if you can find it. Fairly quick drive thru but tight turns, not recommended for large vehicles! The seating area in this one throws me also, there is next to none, I guess they realize it is just about a drive through only location.

That being said the service was on par with other Mickey D's and they have the full selection, nothing is left of the menu. It is in a convenient location for parents to grab a quick bite for their  whining kids (or well behaved if you have them) after they endure you grocery shopping next door at sobeys for half an hour.

Traditionally, in New Orleans, on the Friday before Easter, we abstain from eating meat. It is with that intention the I decided to partake of my mid day meal at this establishment since I knew that they served at least some non meat foods.

When I entered through the side door of the restaurant I was not able to locate either the maitre 'd  nor a hostess. In fact I was not greeted in any way.  In establishments like this, you do not get seated at a table and have a server come to take your order and deliver your food.   Instead, you are required to wait in a cue to explain what foods you would like to a waitress at a counter.

You will not be given a menu to choose from.  The items that are available from the kitchen are displayed in large illuminated frescoes on the walls.  After I had made  my selection I cued up to place my order.  The gentleman in front of me was just receiving his  order and he was loudly explaining to the waitress that if his food was not prepared correctly that he would return to inflict some sort of bodily harm on the employees of the establishment.   I assume that since this is a holy time for both the Christian and Jewish religions, that he must be following some fairly strict dietary rules and that he would be greatly upset to find that his meal would cause him to suffer eternity in hell. For the sake of the employees I hope that the bread used to make his sandwich was unleavened and did not contain chametz.

Now it was my turn to order.   I tried to enquirer as to the species of the fish used to make their Filet ' sadwitch (oops.. typo there.. I meant to type sandwich, but it came out sadwitch) .  The waitress did not know and did not seem interested in bothering the chefs with my question.  Oh well,  I was hoping to enjoy a serving of fresh fried Louisiana catfish today, but I don't think that is what the fish of the day was.   I also choose to have an order of french fried potatoes with my meal.  I paid for my purchase and within a few short moments I was handed a sack with my meal inside.

My fish sandwich was tasty, though the bread was certainly leavened . Along with the (unknown species) fish patty and leavened bread, there was also tartar sauce and a slice of yellow film. The breading on the fish filet was certainly not matzo.  The fried potatoes were at first hot and delicious, but as they turned cold the began to have an odd chemical aftertaste.

All in, I will give this establishment a thee star review.  It was reasonably clean, the people were moderately freindly and efficient. The food was at least edible.

If it is a holy day and you want to be penitent, why not show your god you humble side by partaking in a meal at McDonalds.  It might not ensure that you get into heaven, but at least you will have some idea of what it might be like to eat in hell.

ZERO STARS!!!!!!  Never again!  Stopped here last night, after my kids were still hungry, and we all ended up with GI problems all night.....terrible stomach pain  and diarrhea for hours on end.  Couldn't be a coincidence, since we all ate, and all started getting sick at the same time.  My husband did not eat anything, and was the only one who didnt get sick.  Lucky him.  It was Easter evening, and we ate our family meal at an odd time of day, so on our long commute home, passed by this McD's and decided to stop. Whatever manager was on duty needs to make sure employees are washing their hands.  We were violently ill.  The only good thing that came out of this experience, was finally getting my kids to realize fast food is CRAP!  Anyhow, don't go here.  They obviously don't wash their hands.  The food tasted fine, so it had to be hand washing.  Just gross, and you will regret it.  Still have stomach pains this morning, but at least not sick.  But one of my kids had to stay home today because they were up so much last night.  If you eat here, don't be far from a bathroom soon thereafter.

Oh, and btw, the drive through was RIDICULOUS.  No one eating inside, and ten cars in the drive through, all waiting up to ten minutes to be handed one bag of their crappy food.  Slowest McDonalds I have ever been to.  That, and the nuisance of avoiding all the teeangers from the skate park across the road, that were just loitering and making it a challenge to drive around to get your food.  They were there as we pulled in, they were around back STANDING against the menu sign near the intercom, crossing in front of you at the window after picking your food up.  A complete ZOO!  Who puts a crosswalk from a teenage hangout like that, directly up to a McDonalds???!  McDonalds does.  Ka-CHING!  What a nuisance.  They need to put up some No Loitering signs, and Get the H e l l out of Drivers Way signs up for this joint.  

Well, at least I won't ever be going to McDonalds again.  We eat there 1-2 times a year when we are desperately hungry, but now nothing will make me go again.  NOTHING!

The first word of my first Yelp review is "SHITTY". Shitty, even for McDonald's. A man walks into an empty restaurant, orders two items and both of them are wrong. I tried the new bacon deluxe vomit burger, but somehow they forgot to add the bacon.   And that was the only thing they were working on. No one cares there. Zero effort. No surprise there.

The tables were filthy, the manager was cussing with the staff, and they don't need your PIN! They just run the card through, no questions. So if you ever steal a card here's the place to go! 
 Food was fine. I have a tetnus shot, so it's all good.

well damn where should I start. service sucks, food tastes like they needed to clean the fryers. waited 20 min for a ice coffee. no apologies either. cashier was a rude snob. besides that I will admit that the bathrooms and dining area were clean.

This McDonald's is notorious for getting orders wrong. Not to mention it is on of the slowest McDonald's I have ever been to. On top of it they charge you for extra sauce for nuggets and never ever give it to you without you having to ask for it after you get your food and then explain to them yes I did pay for it already. All in all the cooks can't read, the employees are rude, and the owners just don't seem to give a damn.

Great place to eat.  Comepetative  value....... Good taste........employees are fast and curteous.......communication is always good.   What a great location.... Inside and out...quick and fast. You hardly wait at this place.

Hey it's McDonalds, not the Mecca of good but my kids love the place. We probably frequent here once a week. Two hamburger happy meals are around $6, the give away free tiny ice cream cones and I can sit and relax while watching the big screen TV.

After a long LONG day running around the French Quarter and watching parades we got in the car, slowly crawled through traffic and mobs of people in the street only to discover we had not drank enough WATER during the day and I forgot to leave my water bottle in the car. We saw the arches way up the road and knew we had to get there before one of us expired from dehydration. 

The lines were long but the iced tea here is super good, nothing bitter about it, as most Mc D's have that issue. So props to them for good tea and friendly service.

I go to McDonalds around the world when I want a fast meal with consistency.  I rate McDonalds against their own chain standard. This restaurant exemplifies what a McDonalds should be.  All of the employees were friendly, even away from the managers oversight.  The landscaping outside was well maintained and employees were observed cleaning inside and out.  The bathroom was clean. The store has averaged only one deficiency in the last two years health department inspections.  This McDonald's is located on the Pinellas trail.  They have been the start point of the American Volksmarch Association's Bellair-Largo walk for at least the last ten years.

This McDonald's just had a makeover and it looks great now! Very clean and modern. I think they should have put a PlayPlace in though, because this is a suburban area and the next nearest McDonald's doesn't have one either. You have to drive all the way to the one on BBD  near Pebble Creek.

McDonald's new Bacon Clubhouse on the artisan roll is what I wanted to try.  Being a burger fan, I was saddened when McDonald's discontinued the Angus line and attempted to relaunch the burgers using the quarter pounder as a way to reintroduce the former Angus offering.  It was gross and I haven't enjoyed McDonald's in almost a year.  I must say that they nailed it with the new Bacon Clubhouse burger. Right amount of burger to topping and condiment ratio. The grilled onion,  crisp lettuce and juicy tomato are compliment the special sauce.  McDonald's thank you for making a great burger!

They were very busy on this Saturday afternoon. But I went through the drive-thru ordered a chicken sammie & sweet tea. Folks were pleasant and my tea and chicken were fresh made and really didn't have to wait too extra long in line. Got to hand it to this crew - excellent job for fast food!

This is the location that obviously didn't get customer service training. This is a super busy spot but hey, it could be much better. Don't expect any hello, thank you, come again, don't come again, get lost, or whatever. This is exactly what Ray Kroc had in mind when he opened Mickey D's up....blank stares. Time for Ronny boy to send one of his inspectors to check this location out.
Having said all that, the egg, sausage and cheese McGriddle  is a nice breakfast alternative. Very tasty but not cheap at over $3.00, but they are good. 3 Stars and that's pushing it.
Worst food prep and service ever.  The employees would rather talk on their phones then work.  There is no pride or sense of managerial presence at this store.  Best to eat elsewhere.

Iced tea is supposed to be the same at all McDonald's, but for some reason I taste more of a bite at this McD's, which I like very much. I'm used to tea with a bite at the end, not like drinking colored water.

I've used the Drive Thru here several times in the past year and it has always been very quick and my orders are always correct. Then again, I usually just order an iced tea, fries and chicken nuggets, so there really isn't much room for error. I can't recall when was the last time I went inside the store, so can't comment on it.

This McDonald's, probably like all others, is very busy during breakfast time, but the employees are working really hard to make it a quick experience for everyone. Only one tiny negative is that one employee working at the 2nd window (where she hands you the food) doesn't say anything to me but hand me the food, even after I've said Thank you to her.

I and my friend decided to go there for lunch.

The food was good and hot and the dining room was clean.  

If I had anything to complain about is the highway being divided.  Hard to get to.
The absolute worst mcd's I've ever visited. Horrible em pluses and horrible management. If you can get in and out in less than 20 minutes you did great! Stay away!

C'mon, what can I say that you already don't know.

Running errands, was hungry, craved a fish sandwich... where else but here.  

Nothing special, nothing different, so so employess trying to earn a buck, except this particular McDonalds is AWAYS packed so be ready to wait a bit.  

Filet-O-Fish = Guilty Pleasure !
Slowest McDs on the north side. Staff is friendly but I've waited an average of 10 minutes on my last few visits in the drive thru at non peak hours. Not fun.

Went for dinner on a Thursday night since I got a coupon in the mail. It was very busy, but the staff had everything under control. We were worried that we might have to wait for food since the drive thru had a long line.   Our order was taken immediately & we had our food in less than 5 min.  It was very clean. Noticed staff tending to tables & interacting with customers.  Very pleased with my dining experience .

No matter what day, what time the staff of this store fails to meet even the basic customer service standard. Never fails, my order is wrong or has a missing item, or at the very least the food quality is subpar (cold, under/over or none salted fries or end of shelf cooked burgers).

I have always had my complaints met with the same thing, free order. Its great to get food... but seriously I don't complain for free food, I complain to make you want to try harder.

Every other store around can manage to meet the basic standard of customer service and food quality I would expect (as a former employee and as a customer), but this store never meets those standards. I only went as much as I have out of proximity of my home. I am done with that though. I would rather go elsewhere, give my money to store and staff that cares enough. I know it isn't a dream job, but show you care about your own performance, about your own results.

If you need a McDonalds fix, make the drive up to the one in Bryn Mawr. Seriously. The "service" here is abhorrent. Every time I have gone through the drive-thru the workers have been incompetent and down right rude. It takes forever to get your food and my order has been wrong EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. This is honest to god the worst McDonalds in the world.
Mcdonalds is so good. I love to eat there chicken mcnuggets. and the fries are like heaven.

Gross. Even for McDonalds every time I seem to come to this location the food is absolutely terrible! Never fresh fries. Burgers always seem a little cold. Last time I ever come to this location is today.

This is one of the poorest McDonald's I have been to.  Customer service is terrible.  Although I have had some positive experiences here... I am uncomfortable pulling in due to the inconsistency and not knowing what kind of service to be expecting.  
One time the guy ON DRIVE-THRU SPEAKER told me they were closed... when the signs said "open 24 hours"... go figure... And the WORST is "ice cream machine is down"... they should have BACK UP  ice cream
machines. Just my opinion.. they apparently don't take pride in their work as a whole... Although the few employees that care are obvious and I genuinely appreciate their contribution.
Add wrong order to the list of atrocities this location commits. The blank stares and don't give a S**T attitude this morning was the worst ever.

5/5/2014  2:30 PM   Ordered from drive thru. 2 -1/4 pounders, 4 Mcdoubles, 1 Large Fry.  Window 1- Paid for order. Window 2 -A short black girl hands me a bag and says medium fries. I say Large Fries?. She looks and says oh ya they're large and closes the window. I sit 10 more seconds and she says what do you need sir. I said I'm waiting on 2- 1/4 pounders and 4 Mcdoubles. She looks back on the counter , hands me the  bag of food and gives me a look like I got 3 heads. I said why are you looking at me like that.  I said she was the one who screwed up my order and she better wake up., She got SUPER SNOTTY. I've been going to this Mcdonalds for over 25 years. I think probably longer than this girl has been alive. First time I was ever treated rotten by any employees. This girl needs to be diciplined in the art of how to treat customers. I will go back again ans see how I'm treated if she still has a job.
The manager asked us if "everything ok with our order?" While passing by. First time in any mcdonalds or fast food chain and maybe last time.

Came in today for a breakfast on them as it is Teacher Appreciation Week and they are giving teachers free value meals all day. I had the Big Breakfast which is scrambled eggs, sausage, hash browns, and a biscuit.

The scrambled eggs weren't quite scrambled. Well, they were, but they were just flipped-folded while cooking and not folded to produce nice, fluffy scrambled eggs, if you know what I mean. Overall, the meal was sort of decent, though I felt as if I was eating chemicals for some of it. The hash browns have the same weird after taste that their fries do. If you do not know what I am talking about, next time you have McDonald's fries, take a swig of Sprite after you eat some fries and you will know what I am talking about. The Sprite is not necessary, but it magnifies that after taste. I did not finish my hash browns and I love hash browns.

I don't know what happened to McDonald's. I grew up on them. They were great in the 60s and 70s. Somewhere along the way, they started becoming more of a factory than  concerned with their product. They used to have the world's best fries. They changed their shortening or something and the flavor changed. They recently cut ties to Heinz ketchup, the best, and now make their own. It doesn't taste as good.

I was going to have a free lunch on them today as well, but that breakfast just reminded me why I never eat there anymore. Yuck.

I went to this Mc Donald's for the free Extra Value Meal offered to teachers for "Thank a Teacher Day"   I was treated very politely by the young man who took my order. However, when he needed the promo code for the cash resgister he called the manager over.  I handed him my school district issued ID.  He looked at it and said he couldn't take it because it was issued in 1999 and it was too old. I have been a teacher in my school district for 21 years, this is the only ID I have ever been issued.  Grey management will not answer their phone.  I hope that this review serves as their lesson in customer service.

This is a typical McDonalds on a busy corner. I drive bus and stop in almost everyday for a bathroom break and to refill my water bottle and occasionally for a snack. They will rush my order if they see my bus and every single staff is smiling and friendly. Very fast and efficient.
This the true Mcdonalds location. Somehow it's showing up about a mile to the south near Main Street and 135.

This has got to be the unfriendliest McDonald's I've ever been to.  They have a very rude, customer insulting sign posted that reads:

NO LOITERING
Time Limit
30 MINUTES
While Consuming Food

After I finished my breakfast, I stayed a bit longer to relax and read my emails. Tuesday May 6th was National Teacher Day.  If you remember it was advertised on TV and radio stations in Tucson that McDonald's would give teachers a free extra value meal. Teachers only needed to provide an ID OR a paystub.  
 I decided to stop at my neighborhood Mc Donald's at Cortaro Road and I-10. I have been a customer at this McDonalds' for 21 years.  When I arrived at McDonalds' I was greeted by a very pleasant young man behind the cash register.  I placed my order and told him that I am a teacher. The smile on his face grew, he thanked me for being a teacher.  The young man called the manager for the promo code.  I handed the manager my district issued ID.  This is the ID I am required to wear at school, and present at other schools and district functions.  My ID is issued once by my district and is not reissued unless it is lost or stolen.  The manager looked at my ID and told me it was too old, it was issued to me in 1999.  I have been a teacher for 25 years.  Prior to 1999 my school district did not issue teacher IDs. 
He asked me if I had a paystub.  My paystubs are issued electronically, I do not print them.  Frankly, the advertisement was ID OR paystub.  Since I had the proper ID I didn't think I needed my paystub. At this moment the manager of my neighborhood McDonald's, at Cortaro Road and I-10, became the authority, with detailed knowledge of the policies, procedures, and inner workings of the school district by which I am employed.  According to the manager I should have an email with my paystub attached to it.  My district does not issue paystubs via email.   The manager said to me "you have to understand that when we did this last year a lot of people said they were teachers and took advantage."  I was completely humiliated and embarrassed by the manager of the neighborhood McDonald's, I have been doing business for the last 21 years. The McDonald's located at Cortaro Road and I-10.  I politely said thank you and left the restaurant. 
I immediately called the corporate offices of McDonald's and filed a complaint. McDonald's corporation has not responded to me.  I called Gray Management the franchise owner of the McDonald's at Cortaro Road and I-10, I left a voice mail. I was contacted again by the manager of my neighborhood McDonalds. During our conversation he was arrogant, condescending, and unapologetic.  The conversation added insult to injury.   He told me, "You need to understand that this is a security breach." He followed that statement with, "You are the only teacher we had a problem with."  Perhaps I am the only teacher whose ID he so closely scrutinized.   I would like to add that I spoke with two colleagues who stopped at the same McDonalds, used their district issued ID that is as old as mine.  They were not interrogated and not have a problem.  I told the manager I wanted to speak with Gray Management, franchise owner of the McDonalds at Cortaro Road and I-10.  The franchise owner has not returned my calls.  
This is not about a $3 dollar sandwich and a cup of orange juice.  This is about the customer service I received at my neighborhood McDonalds. The one I have stopped at for late night snacks, quick meals on the way to work and activities, or just because my children wanted a treat or happy meal.  I have been a loyal customer at the Cortaro Road and I-10 McDonald's for 21 years.   
As a teacher I have served students and families in Tucson and the state of Arizona for 25 years. I was embarrassed and humiliated by the manager of McDonald's on a day when members of my profession were to be celebrated. Sadly, I'm not, "Lovin it."

That being said, when I met up with Mark & Gigi in Westchase for a Thursday evening Surf Shack taco feast, I didn't balk when they proposed walking across the parking lot to Mickey D's for some dessert. Picture one of the clown's hot apple or cherry turnovers filled with sliced peaches and a shot of cream, and you've got the basic idea. I'll stick to an unsweet tea at the drive-through and just keep on driving down the road till I find a better choice for a meal.
