McDonald's is McDonald's, I get it, but this particular one is the most disgusting one I have ever been to. Every table in the whole place was dirty, there was visible crud on the drink machine like nobody had wiped it off for months. The ketchup dispenser was broken, so the had it open without a lid and flies flying around it and people were actually using their hands to take little solo cups and dip the ketchup out. Needless to say I did not use it, but it was absolutely disgusting. The floors were gross and the staff were unprofessional. This is the worst one I have been to in Indy and the surrounding areas, and it should be shut down by the health department.
This location is wonderful. The food is, always Fresh the, staff are always Professional. I only use the drive thru unknown about the inside

Went to this location both Saturday and Sunday was told both times the shake machine was down since it was 91 plus degrees all weekend mcdonalds lost alot of ice cream business this weekend. I asked today when the machine would be fixed the man said Monday being tomorrow. .how convenient.

Very slow.  I ordered one coffee and one hash brown.  After waiting ten minutes I was asked to pull forward and wait for my hash brown.  I had to leave without the hash brown.  One. Hash. Brown.  Really.
Our order was correct and the service was fast and friendly, overall would definitely go back.

listen... i get it... its McDonalds but come on! This place has the worst attention to detail i have ever had to deal with. I ordered a bacon egg n cheese biscuit with a coffee (2 creams hold the sugar). What i got? a bacon egg n cheese mcgriddle (ewwww) with  black coffee.... ugh

sucks that they dont get the orders right. so be warned CHECK YOUR ORDER before you drive off......

Take exact change, or close to it, if you use their drive through. If they short your change, they will make you wait to find out it's not their fault. Essentially, if you can't prove that you gave them a $20 instead of a $10 (or whatever) your money is gone, into someone's pocket or correcting an earlier change error by the cashier. The food is still basic and adequate McDonald's, but your Egg McMuffin doesn't taste as good when it costed $13 instead of $3! And if you are in a hurry...you will either be late or SOL.

It's McDonalds so u know what the food is, but the reason I'm reviewing it isn't because of the food, it's because of the ppl working there. Easily the most welcomed I've ever felt at a mcdonalds. This location takes pride in customer service, for that they get 5 stars

I try not to normally eat at McDonald's, but when I do, this is my preferred location. I am able to take the back roads so I am not stuck on Kennedy and usually get in and out of the drive-thru very quickly. 

The staff is very friendly here and normally process orders in an efficient manner. I always order my fries with no salt (you get fresh fries and you salt them later) , and they are more than happy to oblige.

Worst McDonalds I've eaten at. Requested a signature sandwich, which was advertised, and told "we don't sell that no more". Purchased the 20 piece mcnugget and was even asked what sauce I'd like... Didn't receive any sauce and am several nuggets short. Do not eat here!
The owner took my tray to the trash can for me and gave me a free Big Mac card! Excellent service!
Omg! Close this place! They charged me for a #15 and kids meal and acted like I didn't order anything! Don't ask for a manager because they won't help. Just awful!! The dirtiest one ever.

meh...its McDonalds, rather than offer good food worthy of review McDonalds is a place of circumstance. On any day it is a one star option, feeling hungry late at night with no plausable options near by? Well it can be a 5.

This Ellerslie location was at least clean and efficient and my order was correct, a low bar but true enough.
The food is great, the service is spot on.   But I refuse to come back.  The place smells like farts.

This is probably one of the worst McDonald's ever even with the remodel and the double drive through I sat over 20 minutes tonight in the drive-through waiting for food
What is wrong with McDonald's why can't they hire people who can actually do the job
Just got even think they know what fast food is
Steer clear of this McDonald's and the one on route 130 they are the absolute worst McDonald's
This location is excellent! Especially compared to the Mc Donald's on 41. Always prompt & courteous.
Sweet and sour sauce is .30 cents extra but you gave me 16 free ketchup packets when I asked for ketchup instead.......that makes a lot of sense.

So understaffed and unprepared they asked me to leave the dining room and go to the drive thru. So I did that. And waited for 20+ minutes while they screwed up the order and were rude to me. It was 5:30 am.
I have pretty low standards for fast food joints but this place fails ANY test.

Don't bother stopping here. This is among the worst McDs in the Tucson area. Monday, 7/82/14: Fish sandwich patties that had been held so long they were barely still warm, one basically inedible served swimming in tartar sauce. I'm pretty sure they wouldn't have been at an acceptable holding temperature, so maybe we'll get sick as a bonus. Cold fries, placed on our tray by the shift manager himself. When we asked for replacements, they said they would be right out, they never brought them out. Incredibly, the employee who was on break while all this transpired was the only one who ever thought to ask us about it!

Edit: It turns out they had a reason to be giving away all that tartar sauce. My wife was sick for two days. Stay far, far, far away from this location.
Run away! This place sucks even by McDonald's standards. Service is slow. Lines are long. And the cleanliness is horrid!

This "hole in the wall" restaurant is soon to become a great success. With bright colours, friendly staff, fountain sodas, free wifi, meals with toys for children, smiling & easily identifiable mascots, and an ever expanding menu, this place is sure to become a family favourite. 
I go to this McDonald's (there are about 5 just in Belleville, I imagine they will start to expand out from there!) every Wednesday & Thursday. I haven't purchased food from here in a bit. I normally go in, fill up my water bottle, & use their free wifi and clean washroom facilities on my allowed 30 minute break from waged labor. The staff smiles & waves at me. Most importantly I am never asked to leave because of my mild misuse of the restaurant's main purpose (selling foodstuffs). Notably, there is a Redbox location out front and a dual "drive-thru."
Being a place that serves up mostly burgers (originally a sub-par meal that people of low income consumed), there isn't much for me to eat - because I am vegetarian. All of the food is served quick, with a smile and a hint of Better Living through Chemistry. 
I imagine with the acquisition of the McDonald's name by Ray Crock, this small time operation will be marketed excellently. The workforce of this McDonald's is specialized, each worker performing one particular job (so not to get swamped by doing several things - because of the popularity of this restaurant). That gives each worker a better chance for job satisfaction (as well as replaceabilty). The "Happy Meal" (meals with smaller portion sizes that include a toy), comes in a box to be used as a house for the enclosed toy, (strangely resembles the mascot "Happy" that can be seen next to menu options) or a place to perform a science experiment on the biodegradation process of foods purchased.
Is this review based on 1 visit? No
Will I go here again? Yes
Should you try this place? Yes
Lasting impression - With so many negative things being said about McDonald's lately, it is satisfying to see that not all locations fit the same mold. Moral seems high and many employees know their customers (names, orders, and families) - which is different for a large chain.

It is a newer mcdonalds.  It is clean and attached to a moto mart.  The tables are incredibly high!  I imagine the usually short and rotund mcdonalds patron loves them.

They have the same ridiculous policies about condiments.  And the burgers taste like crap.  

Basically come here for the cheap drinks, and breakfast food coupon items.

My husband & I usually pick up our morning large coffee here & I am always pleased the coffee is hot & the staff always correctly gets the order. The inside is renovated with lots of seating & play area. Usually busy, so you can expect a bit of a line up but overall above average for McD's!!

Without question one of the worst Mcdonalds I have ever been to. The wait time is totally unacceptable but during that time I witnessed filth behind the counter, an employee try to figure out what an order was by unwrapping a sandwich and picking it up with her bare hands to examine what it was. While she was doing that her co"worker" stood by scratching her stomach under her shirt before immediately going back to handle orders.

Totally mismanaged, disgusting and likely breaking health codes. You deserve to treat yourself better than eating here and potentially getting sick. 

Just went back to the hotel and ordered a pizza. If you have a decent amount of money, open a 24 hour fast food place near by, provide good service and you'll rake in the dough as this place stinks and is the only offering for late night food in that area. What a shame.
Once the best McD in St Louis, CLOSED now for remodeling.  Im hoping for good things, here, soon!

They always mess up my iced coffee! I explicitly state that I want a black coffee with cream and Splenda on the side. What have I gotten in the past?

Coffee with mixed in Splenda and cream
Coffee with just cream
Coffee with cream and sugar (not Splenda)

How hard is it to make an iced coffee in a pretty generic way (black with cream and Splenda on the side).

I'll keep coming back but the employees should really try harder here.

Once upon a time, this had to be my ABSOLUTE WORST McDonald's of all the ones I had patronized (when I eat at McDonald's--which is not often). It wasn't the cleanest, the associates played around too much often giving the wrong orders to people or missing orders all together which would then result in refunds (happened to me 4x over several years), rude employees who act as if they are doing you a favor, drinks made wrong, CONSTANTLY out of stock, and VERY slow lines--and this was just in the mornings! The managers weren't much better. 

That being said, while I still don't make a habit out of McDonald's, I have been past there several times and in twice in the last month and have seen SUCH a HUGE change in the place. Nicer employees who realize that they ARE at work, cleaner, well-stocked, food hot and fresh, no lines, no waiting, and I have to say that the two times I was there were actually pleasant dining experiences. I asked about the change and was told that they have a new GM. Well, I must say, bravo to the new GM because before, this McDonald's was the pits! They needed someone to help them clean up their act and I'm glad that they got that someone whomever they may be!

This Location has been spiffed up over the last 6 months with extremely comfortable seats.  They're like those beds that conform to your curves. Plan to eat inside and veg-out awhile.
     I sense this McDonald's is in kind of a competition with the one at Speedway and Alvernon, down the road, which is rated a little higher. So, to try to make some points, they have DEALS here that some of the other McDonalds don't.  Like for breakfast at this time, at this location, you can get two Sausage & Egg McMuffins for $3.33, but the other location does NOT have that special!     
      There are a couple of real characters that work behind the counter here. If a Hollywood sitcom of a Fast Food joint was ever wanted, THIS would be the place to film it. One works in the  morning, the other works at night. If they ever worked on the same shift, there might be a food fight. It does not diminish the eating experience at all to share space with people who are so outlandish, they might be from Mars. I find characters like that quite likeable.

This McDonalds is very conveniently located off the 101 (though a little hard to see if you're heading Southbound).  I stop here to grab breakfast if I'm in the area, or to use their restroom if I'm on a long drive home.  The staff are respectable and polite and the food is typical McDonalds grub.  The location is generally clean and well maintained.

I wish I could give this place no stars.

2 months ago I went here with my kids because they like chicken nuggets and playgrounds and I like air conditioning. 

Ordered a 20 piece and a sweet tea. The cashier was super rude. Then the sweet tea was out, the manager (?) and the cashier were in a heated discussion over gossip so I stood there ignored until an employee who was on lunch grabbed my cup and went in the back to get me some tea.

The chicken nuggets come up and we hit the play spot. Sit down and give my kids the chicken nuggets. They eat some and tell me that the nuggets are weird. Bit one and find out they're under cooked!

So back up to the counter I go. Manager and cashier are still gossiping. Explain the situation and ask for my money back. They offer me new nuggets. LOL NO. So she refunds the nuggets but only gives me back half the money since my kids ate/spit out 5 nuggets. Then wants me to sign the receipt saying I got the whole amount back. NOPE!

Go home call McDonalds Customer Service line. The next day I'm contacted by a district supervisor who says he'll send me a gift card for my trouble. Cool.

Fast forward a month - still no gift card. Call back customer service. They say they'll contact the franchisee and see what's up. No response. Wait and week and call them AGAIN. Rinse and repeat x3. Finally point out that I've called 5 times and ask what corporate could do for me. They say they'll send out some free coupons.

What did I get? 2 coupons for a 6 piece. I originally ordered a 20 piece and I still have to go back to this place to get my money worth. UGH!

Seriously skip this McDonalds.

The food is cold and old if you drop by for a late night run, I advise you to go a little further to the next local eatery. My husband and I's first time here we literally spent a half hour in the drive thru, we should've left but had already ordered and didn't feel like going anywhere else. On top of this I think I got food poisoning from a McFlurry I had from here last night, I've been sick all day!! We will not be back, avoid this McD at all costs!!!

Right around the corner from the house. Usually great service until today. Running a little behind and the manager (Jamie) tells me at the first window that her employees have no clue what the f**k they are doing.

Doesn't even deserve a star. Horrible service where the employees don't care about you or the food they produce. I had to tell/correct the cashier 3 times what I wanted. Then, I tell her I don't want any sauce with my nuggets and they still put sauce in the bag. Now I can see why they have to charge an extra $0.30 cents for a packet that cost them $0.05 to make. I miss the days where I could go to a McDonald's and still get great service and outstanding food. Now, they are just a money hungry corporation that doesn't care about you and they only care about their wallet.

It's a McDonald's, so I'm not going to bother reviewing the food - it's always at around the same level of quality every where I go. This location is super nice in terms of its appearance. It's got a patio outside, a little fireplace inside, and the colour scheme makes it feel vaguely cabin-like, which I absolutely love. There's even a decent sized playground for the kids to hang out in.

There's tons of seating, however it's always messy in there when I go. At least 1/3 of the empty seating are dirty. It's always well staffed in there, so I don't get why someone isn't sent out to clean the tables every now and then. 

Speaking of staff, they are very friendly. They are also very slow. Every time I go, I end up having to wait forever for my food. I've also had a couple of mix ups happen in the drive thru, so check your food before you leave! (You'd think I would have made a habit of doing this, but lets be honest: ain't nobody got time for that)

This location has such fantastic customer service. Happy, smiling and truly helpful employees. The food is good like most mickey ds. Its just refreshing to be treated nicely and makes me want to eat there :-)

I live very close to this establishment or I would drive farther, it's true 7/8 times out of 10 order is wrong. My worst experience was a egg bagel that was molded...not just a little ( which is still unexceptable) but obviously green with mold, and they served it. It's almost easier just to call your order in to Nashville Biscuit House and pick it up or for a bagel go to Bagel Face Bakery is on Main Street, their bagels are better than average with a good selection.
This mcdonalds has THE worst costumer service in the world. The workers are rude beyond belief. TRY to not come here if you don't have to.

I usually go to this McDonalds location before work everyday and have never received service like I did today.  I went to this establishment to pickup lunch for my coworkers and myself and the visit was unacceptable.  I put my order in, which was a large order, and pulled up to the first window to make my payment.  I hear one of the male employees, who wasn't aware that I already pulled up to the window, say to the young man working the window "DAMN, 5 SOUTHWEST SALADS?!?!" while hysterically laughing.  Now I understand that ordering 5 Southwest Salads, 2 large fries and a diet coke is a large order but acting with this behavior is not only unprofessional but it reflects poorly on the whole team and even the Mcdonalds brand itself. This type of behavior embarrasses and makes the customer uncomfortable; I can only imagine how many other customers have felt this way and never said anything. I did mention the incident to the young lady at the second window, she was so pleasant and apologized multiple times.  It's a shame that this happened and I will not be returning to this location.

McDonalds is known for their monopolization on fast food and how they have systematically created a way to make food fast, hot, and with a smile. 

Sorry, but you are not going to get it here. Sometimes they can get away with service when it is late night and you are dealing with a car of drunkies. However, the food should at least be hot. I totally agree with the other comments about the food being left out to COLD. I got COLD fries and a COLD big mac, I even got weirded and couldn't even stomach it down. I was pretty annoyed :( Plus the person who took our order said 4 words total and a grouch. 

I knew there was something weird when the bag came out cold and there wasn't even that french fry smell. The fries tasted oily and grainy. Weird!

Went thru drive thru about 15 minutes ago. The girl at the pick up food window handed me my bag I went to look in it and she said "no need to look in it it is all there " I said well I want to check before I go home  again she said no need it is all there and walked away. I thought ok she is confident about this so I drive away.
I get home and IT wasn't all there. I live pretty far away. I am pissed that I didn't look when I should have. 

CHECK you order or go to another fast food store. . I don't usually go to McDonald's or fast food  and now I will choose another location or go to the Burger King or Arby's that is right next to them, when the mood hits.
This mc Donald's sucks and last time I went there it was gross. I will never go there

Stopped here for breakfast today. Had the breakfast burrito, hashbrown, and orange juice. The ordering and food pickup experience is always fantastic. I wish I could say the same about the burrito. The sausage egg and cheese all tasted microwaved. It was not very pleasant. The hashbrown was perfect as was the orange juice.  With competitors in the mexican fast food  breakfast world coming out with new interesting and tasty options, the should be very worried.
terrible . order is always wrong so be sure to check your bag before leaving so you don't have to return .

Probably the best McDonalds in the area. Efficient staff, quick service, correct orders, hot food. 

Plus the location is ideal. Easy in easy out.

We went in to get a couple of burgers and coffee.  The sign behind the register said clearly:  All coffees $1.00  When we paid for our items, coffee was charged on our receipt as $1.19 each.  When my wife mentioned that the sign said all coffee's are $1.00 each, the clerk asked," What sign?"  My wife said, "The sign behind you, can't you read it?"  Another customer said, "You're being rude to the girl."  The customer interfered with our conversation and then threatened my husband.  My husband had to call the police.  This is NOT my type of place for children and families!!!

This will be a mixed review. We had 2 issues, both of which were resolved to our satisfaction. 1) even though my husband's milk was four days before the expiration date, it was sour. They replaced it with a new milk which was fine. 2) The TV was set to CNN channel which was showing violent news about the middle east & genocide. There were a lot of small children in the restaurant. Three young ones in the booth next to us were asking their mom why  all the people on the TV were crying. The mom was upset. I asked an employee if they would please change the channel & was told that could not be done. I asked for the manager & she said the only other channel she could put it on was sports. The change was made & the mother was very relieved & grateful. 

If like to add that the food was delicious, the service fast & the staff very friendly.
The bathroom is disgusting. Not just bad but totally and underlay disgusting.  Shame on McDonalds for letting this owner let this entire place go into such disrepair.

Well, usually I just drive through here for a dollar soda but last Saturday I actually went in to buy some oatmeal too.  I ordered and the guy at the register asked me if I wanted brown sugar with that.  I've ordered oatmeal dozens of times at different McDonald's and never been asked that so I thought maybe he meant... if I wanted something different than the usual oatmeal.  I politely declined.  

Well, brown sugar is definitely something that's normally in the oatmeal.  I found that out when I tried mine and it was plainer than plain.  Okay, so he asked and I declined. I'll take the blame for that, but the oatmeal also wasn't mixed properly and had several pockets of uncooked dry oatmeal.  Bad.  

I had purchased 2 soft drinks and filled them myself at the soda machine.  I got a Diet Coke for me, and a Coke for my friend.  She took one sip and said, "This is Dr. Pepper."  I know I filled it correctly... she mentioned that this is not the first time she has had this happen at this location.  Thankfully Dr. Pepper is among her favorite sodas so she was fine with it.  My Diet Coke tasted a bit watery/thin.

But seriously... 

The women's restroom was fine.  The food was not very good and the soda was the wrong kind.  Overall not a great visit.

Pros: Bathroom was clean and usable.  Staff was polite.  Restaurant was clean.

I must disagree with the other reviews. Since this location opened (2yrs?) I have gone to the drive through 9 times (I'm obviously a slow learner) and EVERY SINGLE time they have screwed up the order. Missing fries, missing sandwiches etc. They clearly don't change/filter the fry oil as often as they should because fries and nuggets are often DARK brown and bitter tasting.

I finally decided to write this review because just this morning I once again returned to this location for more punishment (I've got young kids who like McDs) and I went into the outer lane of the "both lanes always open" drive through and guess what? FOUR cars were served on the inside lane before I gave up and went up the street to Burger King.

This McD's has really gone downhill. They were out of cookies, sweet tea, and BBQ sauce... They were incompetent as I ordered a plain burger and of course it was loaded. Rather than let me keep the incorrect order for another member in my group, they instead threw it away in the garbage. Our fries were cold and they weren't even filled up. I've been coming here since it opened, but now it's incompetence has taken over it's nearby convenience.
Open 24 hours, and next to a sketchy 7-11.  As with all McDonald's, you get what you pay for.  "Meat" and HFCS at any time, day or night.

I've been in line for probably 30 minutes now. This is ridiculous!  I honestly can't stand mcdonalds in the city. When we got our food it was cold and the Breakfast burritos were hard. I won't be coming back!

I have to say they have pretty fresh food and usually get the order correct I just can't give them more than three stars because since I was a child all mcdonalds serves breakfast until 11 on the weekends except this one. They only serve breakfast until 1030 on Saturday!!!!!! Crazy....

I'm not sure that the staff was even aware that they were talking to us but they answered questions and did manage to present our order, even though it was a bit more complete than just "two medium coffees"..

I have certainly seen cleaner McD's but they have kids' stuff and I really wouldn't expect anything spectacular from a fast food joint.

An ok place..that's all..

When hunger strikes and you're about to start a marathon of running around doing chores what's the answer? My guilty pleasure, Mickey D's filet o fish. Always good. This particular location is an extra busy one, cars always seem to be wrapped around it but the drive thru was fast and efficient and I was on my way in a jiffy. The staff was great, everyone was happy to see you and it showed. The coke was cold, the fries hot and the fish sandwich had just enough tarter squeezing out, perfect. This is one of the best run McD's I've ever seen.

It's your typical McD's. Went through the drive through to get myself and the husbeast a $1.00 large Iced Tea.  Unsweet for the both of us, because sugar is a no-no.

There was a line, they're not fancy enough to have the double drive through, so there was a back up.  It was not unpleasant, but it was about 7 minutes of our time.  Nothing bad, just a wait. The iced teas were ice teas. Nothning spectacular.

If I could give negative stars I would. Total incompetence. I've worked at McDonald's several times and couldnt imagine treating guests with such disrespect. Breana on graveyard needs to be fired. Not once, twice or three times, but four times she has somehow managed to mess up my order, and is always beyond rude. Bitch, there's 300 McDonald's i don't have to spend my money at that one. The owner of this franchise needs to focus on accuracy and friendliness.

No 0 stars option available. My cars in park and im reviewing from the drive through. About a 15minute wait just yo order and another 10 in line. Its mcdonalds the foods the same everywhere but the wait and extreamely rude employees put me in a bad mood. 0 stars avoid this place I had shrimp and lobster at feast this afternoon and they offered faster service. BTW im still in line for my food. Maybe add another 10 or 15 minutes to my wait time. Never returning to this shithole.

Stopped in the drive thru on the way back to orlando from the amphitheater in Tampa at around 11:50pm tonight. Waited in the drive thru line 15 mins before even giving our order (not unreasonable considering there was a line and lots of people were leaving the concert). After giving our order (chicken nugget meal, jalapeño burger meal, onion burger) we waited 14 minutes to pay! Then another 8 before receiving the food. Received food (which was cold) but not any ketchup or sauce for the nuggets which they specifically asked about. Fiancé goes in to get some for me and everyone inside has been waiting the same amount of time we have (a woman we saw go inside when we pulled up was just getting her food). Took a couple minutes to get the attention of the manager who was working the window to ask for sauce. Not one of the employees said Hello, thank you or even were personable the entire 40 mins we were there, including the manager. In fact he basically threw the food out the window to us. I would avoid if there was any option at all!

Food was okay. It would've been better if it was the correct order. 
They can't tell the difference to crispy or grilled as well as Diet Coke or regular Coke. 

I ordered a Premium Crispy Chicken Bacon Clubhouse Sandwich and received a Premium Grilled Chicken Club Sandwich. The wrong sandwich? By the time I realized it I was about a mile and a half away and it's not easy to turn around on Rt. 13. 

Fries were okay. 

I also ordered a Diet Coke but received a Coke. Let's see, I say D I E T.... C O K E and you give me a C O K E. Forgot the d in front? I ordered a minute ago. Short term memory loss maybe? The receipt is even wrong.

Service was quick, probably because they screwed up the order.
Don't eat here! The food is unhealthy and will make you like 1/2 of the people in Disneyland. XD
The fries are always cold! Sloppy work and slow. Oh and they always give me the wrong order! I will never go there again.

We've used this McD's on rare occasions after seeing a show at the Bucks County Playhouse that has run late or too long especially since after ten or eleven there is only so much open in the area especially on a weeknight.

If there would be one negative about this location it would be that the right turn into their parking lot is very tight and if you have a larger SUV exiting the drive thru lane and one turning into the lot I could see some white knuckled driving or maybe a few prayers to Our Lady of the Blessed Accelerator for assistance in not exchanging paint on the side view mirrors.

I can't speak about the restrooms or anything else on the inside as I have never been inside but the employees have always been decent, the order done correctly and the wait time has never been an issue.

Past that who really cares?

(On a brief sidebar this location has not been on Sugan Road for years as the McDonald's website will tell you, it's been at 324 West Bridge Street for years.)

Very unfriendly woman at the register.  As soon as I got in, she had a miserable attitude.

If you need a brick of regret to stick into your gut, you might as well choose McDonald's.  At least the drive-thru people don't think twice about serving you, even if you're dangerously fat.  

This particular location has odd hours - not a 24 hour drive-thru.  Lobby closes at different times during the week, drive-thru generally at 11pm, later on the weekends.  At least the people are friendly and nonjudgmental about my horrible eating habits.

Okay, first things first. Yes, I'm really reviewing a McDonald's. I know. I know. I can't believe it either. While I'm not opposed to reviewing fast food joints, let's be honest and acknowledge that unless you're in a bad neighborhood or a really good neighborhood then you know exactly what to expect from McDonald's. 

While I do frequent McDonald's for breakfast, mainly because it's on my way to work, it's incredibly rare that I choose to actually go inside one and have a meal. However, tonight I wasn't having much luck finding anything that sounded good and I knew I wanted an abundance of iced tea. Mostly, I just wanted to chill for a bit and read the newspaper. 

This particular location is located across from Castleton Square Mall. This makes it neither a bad neighborhood nor a good one, but definitely a high retail area. This location has a bit of the retro vibe and has generally been fairly consistent with service at the drive-thru. 

Tonight, however, McDonald's did a couple things that drive me absolutely batty and I felt compelled to come home and document them. 

First, it completely drives me nuts when chains become inconsistent with their pricing. Everyone knows that McDonald's has the $1 drinks. The vast majority of McDonald's locations will upsize the drink at no charge and many of them do it automatically. So, I didn't even think of asking for an upsized drink since I was getting iced tea and it should have been automatic. When she started to hand me the medium-sized cup, I asked to upsize and was informed it would be $.21. 

I know. I know. I feel petty. I really do. But, really. It's what makes McDonald's different from the other folks. If you're going to nickel and dime customers then I may as well head on over to our favorite border crossing corporate dudes at Burger King. Mostly, it's just inconsistent because multiple other McD's in the area don't charge for the upgrade AND it makes buying a value meal less of a value. So, it really is contradictory.

Then, of course, there's food quality. I can remember when McDonald's had the best fries around. I know they're trying to be healthier these days, but between that change and the fact that these fries tasted like they'd been sitting around in the pan for a bit I can honestly say they were completely abysmal. 

The chicken McNuggets? They were decent, but even they didn't seem particularly fresh this evening. 

There's really not much more I can possibly write here. This is, after all, a McDonald's. However, I've come to expect better from this location and given its high visibility location they definitely need to do a better job. This visit was a definite disappointment.

I will never be back to this location!  It is a split drive through lane and they just took 5 orders from the other side before switching to me.  People behind me were backing up and switching to the other lane and ordering before me.  The lady at the window was not very accepting of me letting her know what happen.   I have never seen a place take orders that way.  It took 15 min before I was addressed.  Ridiculous.

Not sure if anyone realizes this,  but they completely knocked down this location and did a brand new and improved MacDonald's here.  I would say it's now better than your average MacDonald's - it's clean, the staff are friendly, and it looks modern. There is even a TV in the dining area.  I don't order fast food too much in general, but I don't mind getting it from this place.  Big plus - they aren't stingy with their condiments or napkins!

The Mcdonalds on Carmel Drive has lower prices on the menu at drive up window than they charge you.  I pointed this out a month ago & they have not changed the drive up menu prices.  Today I told them at window again, they said they would charge me the menu price, when I got to pay window, they did not charge menu price & I had to wait at pay window while they got a manager, which I'm sure did not please the many people behind me in line.  Either get the menu right or get the computer right!  Its been this way for over a month!

Being that this is McDonald's the food is generally consistent regardless of where you go. That's been my experience at least. So this is based almost solely on customer service. It was pretty bad. I went to the drive thru and the male voice that came through the speaker said, "Can I help you?" I had flashbacks of my older brother saying that same thing to me when I bothered him when we were kids. No "Welcome to McDonald's", no "Would you like to try our new (insert random diabetes inducing item)?", no "My name is "so & so" how can I help you today?" I stated the meal number I wanted and he had a very efficient way of asking what I wanted to drink. He literally said, "Drink?" Hmmm...ok then. He appeared to really not like his job. Or maybe he was having a bad day. In any case, the same quality of service continued when I pulled up to pick up my food. He literally handed me my food and drink and with his back turned to me gave me a half assed, 'Have a nice day." Then the drive thru window closed shut. Well then. Uhhhh...you too. 

Also, this was an unusually long wait for a McDonald's drive thru. McDonald's drive thru's are normally really quick. This was the first time I had seen a McD's tell someone to pull forward and wait. Apparently, after reading other reviews for this place, this is a normal occurrence here.  Wait, I get it...this McDonald's makes every order fresh. No, seriously...maybe they do? Ok, stop laughing now.

This place is unbelievable. I love McDonalds compared to other fast food places, yet the one in North Wales ALWAYS fails me... One time I got a Big Mac late afternoon and I found rings of onions, no lettuce and 2 cold patties stuck together. Then today (I just came back), I ordered large fries for my friend and a medium for myself, and the containers were less than half filled. Then they tried to cover up the lack of fries by laying the containers down in the bag. Unbelievable. DON'T GO HERE.

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The playground was dirty. We asked if they would wash a table for us, and they just have us a blank look, so we washed them ourselves. The playground itself was all greasy. Also, they didn't give us all of our order, and they didn't care.

I recently started going to this McDonald's a lot because it's close to work, on the way, & no city sales tax. But every time i come to order breakfast thru the drive thru between 5:30am-7am they take forever! I shouldn't have to wait 3 minutes for an order when nobody's in front of me. McDonalds is supposed to be the fastest but for some reason this particular location has slow service! I haven't had this problem w/ other mcdonalds only this one! It's not until someone honks that the employees start moving a lil faster. The young male inside apologized for the wait once which i appreciated. But the young lady inside w/ glasses didn't. The older lady inside is good & better than the young lady.
It was worse when i first started going there last month in august. There was always a young employee cleaning the driveway. Hosing it down, sweeping, & blocking the last window out. The driveway looks clean w/ no trash every time i see him cleaning it so why is he cleaning it? Perhaps put that guy inside to help take orders instead, or hire an additional employee because another young male & a lady working inside need help!
Also, why is the 2nd lane of the drive thru usually closed?
There was a time when i came & the drive thru line was 7 cars full so i didn't even bother & left. Cmon, didn't McDonalds invent the drive-thru?!
Why would anybody eat the crap it is all chemical! You might as well just eat are sick because there is nothing good about the protein and the nutrition in this crap

Service was friendly and nice. However, they got my order wrong when I asked for a plain sandwich. 

The bigger issue was the ants all over the drink area. That was a little disturbing. Also their water button doesn't work And that was all I was able to drink. 

A little disappointed.

Nasty,  dirty indoor kids playground. Used to take them all the time a year ago, it was very clean. Looks as though it hasn't been cleaned since. Couple days later my kids got sick, they are sleeping now so I am glad to have a moment to warn all the parents out there.

Great food. Service left much to be desired. The employee taking my order was very short and did not have the winning attitude I usually find most McDonalds' employees to have. I got the chicken nugget happy meal. The nuggets were just delectable- no complaints there. They were crunchy but not overcooked. Yummy yummy in my tummy! :P The fries could have been a little warmer, but overall they were still tasty (would you expect anything less from McDonalds?!). Happy meals now come with a yogurt or apple slices which was a nice touch. I went with the apple slices but the yogurt looked great as well. The best part of the meal was definitely the desert though! It was the best Oreo McFlurry I've had in a long, long time! The Oreo to ice cream ratio was on point and they even let me add whipped cream :) All in all I was pleased with my experience at this Mcdonalds and would recommend this location for your next date night, late night stop, or just 'cuz!

You order from a McDonald's in an airport, and you have certain expectations. Higher prices (over a dollar for single cheeseburgers), brain dead worker drones that passed the background check to work in an airport, no free refills, awkward queues, and food that's not as fresh if they're not as busy.
This location had all of that! I was really craving a "cheap" burger, which really refers more to the generalized quality and price, if not the exact trade value equivalent of a hot sandwich in an airport, and there wasn't a Burger King in this terminal. So, Mickey D's it was.
I arrived at an off-peak time, evidenced by the presence of one bleary-eyed young man rooted to his cash register like he'd taken root, a solitary line cook and the manager, who was making drinks and filling orders--basically, most of the work. I ordered a Double Quarter Pounder, and asked for the habañero ranch sauce to be substituted.
The first problem occurred when the young man didn't know how to input that order. Having worked at McDonald's, I know it's s matter of finding the button that says "Add Habañero Sauce" under the modification menu. He didn't look for it; he instead muttered to himself, looked dazedly back at me, and called for help.
The sandwich came out more slowly than I'd expected, since they were slow and didn't have to cook the meat to fill the order. They also gave only a small dollop of the sauce I ordered, which was an upcharge to boot. I came back and spoke to the manager, who apologized and have me one of their habañero sauce packets to rectify the situation.
All in all, the burger wasn't fresh and the service was lackadaisical, though they did make right their error so I had to include that. Should have gone back to the Japanese joint on this visit, though.

It's the same everywhere. Not real tasty, healthy,  or visually appealing, but it fills in the hollow spots quickly and relatively inexpensively. You don't feel good after you've eaten, but you can check the 'Need to eat something' box off your to-do list and move on to other things. Personally, if it was an option, I'd rather eat iguana.  "You can live on it..."
Stopped in for a quick run through the drive thru......big mistake.....two cars in front of me and it took 20 min!  Terrible.  Just go on down the road to the next McDonalds.
I love this macdonalds...hott food and clean store. Close to where i live. I have never had a issue.

This place gets worse every time I go. Slower service inside and out. Homeless people sleeping in booths and and manager did not even care. They were out of icecream for months, the inside found drink system stopped working for days. The staff  is increasingly rude. I think I will stop going . I also called their service number and they never bother to call me back ever (5 calls over a years time).
Too bad.

Ok ok McDonald's is McDonald's right? 

Not really though. Some are better than others and I am just sitting here killing time before an appointment so I thought I would share my thoughts.

For a McDonald's this one is really nice. Brand new, I think? Very modern, cool decor. Clean. Super clean bathroom. Friendly service. Food came fast and hot and exactly as ordered. Pleasant place to kill some time. Definitely one of the nicer McDonald's I have ever been in.

it is mc'd. What else can I say.  This location had two drive thru's. It is alright. We picked up coffee for the road. The line for drive thru looked long, but it was fine. It is here. It is fine. Do not go here often, but at least it is convenient when I need it. They have free hot coffee right now. Just ask them. It doesn't say it on the ordering menu, but it says ur when you drive by and see their sign.

Just awful. It is worth your time to drive to another location. The order was incorrect and the staff was offended that I wanted it corrected. They bring customer service to a whole new low. I would not expect any improvement any time soon because the manager was the rudest one.

Worst run restaurant in Nashville!

Drove in tonight to get nuggets for the kids and decided to get something for my wife and I so we don't have to cook.  Nice guy at the drive  says he can take my order but he only has chicken nuggets and fries.  Pathetic management and franchise!  I really feel bad for the staff who wants to work but don't have food to serve.  I will not be returning.

Most awkward drive through ever to enter and exit. 

No playspace for kids.

Efficient if you can manage to get in and out during busy traffic times.

'Nough said.

This McDonald's has the nicest fast food employees I have ever encountered. The food is just regular average McDonald's food, nothing special about it, but the employees make up for it and are why I'm giving this location five stars.

Is this a new McD's? Inside is very clean, nicely decorated and cute! Lots of cool, modern decor and seating. I was joking with my husband that this could be date-passable because of the decor hahaha! I'm kidding. Sorta. Customer service was excellent for a McD's. McD's food is McD's food- guilty pleasures! I enjoyed my Hot N' Spicy McChicken and fries. Busy location located right off of US 19.

If you're in the mood,
for some luke warm food.

This is the place to get it.

I don't expect fine dining at McDonalds, but at least give me something hot. I'd not had a Big Mac in years and for some reason thought it would be a good idea to get one, boy was I wrong. I've had luke warm food here before, so as soon as I got my food I tried the fries - they were warm (at best), so I asked for some hot fries and got an equally warm batch from someone who looked like he may have been the manager on duty - at this point what good would complaining further do? 
5 minutes later I got home and bit in to that Big Mac only to be even more disappointed with the taste of an equally warm burger - maybe I'd built up my expectations too high!
The food is meh, but the coffee isn't bad. I only eat here out of convenience. They are always busy, but the drive thru is pretty fast. They are also open 24 hours.

They consistently have the longest line and slowest service. And I'm told they don't offer milk for coffee. Just half and half. In fact the mention of regular milk in an ice coffee sent everyone looking around and asking each other. It was like they are having a hard time even understanding the request.  So weird since they serve lattes. 
Oh well, it's just McDonalds. But sometimes I need McDonalds!

Why am I writing about a popular fast food chain such as McDonald's?  This one just stood out to me so much that I praised them while I was there.  Yesterday 9/30/14, McDonald's started again their Monopoly game.  This location had great spirit with all of its decor of Monopoly money, enlarged property cards, etc.  Go check out the fun.

Also, on Tuesdays (limited time) from 4 PM to about 8 or 9 PM, they are offering 59 cents hamburgers and 69 cents cheeseburgers.

This is the slowest McDonald's I have ever patronized. To add pain to the injury, they only accepted cash. They apologized for the slow service without making eye contact - this business is far disconnected from the modern standard of fast food service.

Without a doubt this is the filthiest fast-food restaurant that I have ever seen -- and no one seemed to care!

I met a business associate at the McDonald's on 34th Street N (US 19) at 11th Avenue, for a quick mid-morning meeting. He ordered a cup of coffee, and I had a small Diet Coke. We walked towards the back of the restaurant to try and find an unoccupied and clean table.

Our feet stuck to the floor as we walked around, and both of us commented on the filthy condition of the restaurant. The tabletops were sticky, and the seats had not been wiped down. I did my best to clean off a table with napkins, but finally gave up as the napkin stuck to the tabletop.

There were two employees (I presume they were on break), who sat there and laughed at us as we tried to clean off a table. I walked back around to the front counter and asked to speak with the manager, and was informed that she was too busy to see me????

My business associate told me that while I was gone, several vagrants came in the side door, and dumped their life's belongings on one of the booth tables before heading back to the restrooms. Apparently these folks were well-known to the McDonald's employees as they chatted with them when they came out of the restrooms. These folks then gathered up their "stuff" and walked back out the side door. 

I'm not going to jump to conclusions about what was going on with the visitors, but I find it deplorable that any restaurant would be in this disgusting and unsanitary of a condition while serving food to their customers. Shame on you, McDonald's!

This place terrible.  I go there always a problem.  People being rude. I'm sorry if I am paying for my meal I should have it made the way I want it. They only hire people they know as well. Not cool.  Food always cold burgers are soggy not cool especially if your feeding a child. They need to hire better employees

I usually won't visit an establishment 30 minutes before closing. I picked this place because I was under the assumption that it was opened 24 hours. I was wrong. I arrived 5 minutes before closing. Instead of being upfront with me or, at the very least, giving me a reasonable excuse when I went to order food for myself and a friend ("Sorry, our fryers are down," would have sufficed) they gave me my total and told me to pull up to the second window. After paying for my food, I had the pleasure of listening to two employees bicker over something while the third, the woman who took my payment smiled nervously. I was given the food and pulled forward, but didn't leave the parking lot because I wanted to make sure they got my order right. My friend's fries were missing, so I backed up and informed them of their mistake. One of the bickering employees told the other that she didn't ring me up the fries. I checked my ticket and sure enough, she hadn't, and proceeded to tell me that the fryers were down for the night. Now, I know what it feels like to get that one annoying client who comes in a minute before closing, and I hate that client with a fiery passion-which is why I have a mandatory 30 minute before closing rule. But the fact that these employees didn't have the balls to be upfront about the whole thing pisses me off to the point where I'm considering never coming back again. The only reason I might ever come back is because their morning crew are usually excellent. I've never had problems during their breakfast shift. In fact, the morning crew have often gone above and beyond (the only reason I'm giving this McD's 2 stars instead of 1). Management really needs to crack down on this type of behavior because the next time they screw up, they'll have lost another customer. Not that the night shift probably cares.
It's a really great location the place is clean with a nice and efficient staff the food is good I love the breakfast stuff it's great

While I hate admitting that I "dine" here,
I'm certain I'm not the only one! Let the food shaming begin... 

On occasion I stop in here for a quick breakfast when I'm running short on time. It's on my way to work and the price is right. 

The food is nothing to write home about but the service at this location is fantastic! In the mornings that is... The staff is always smiling and seemingly pleased to process my order. They really set a great example of what good customer service should be. Especially at 7am when nobody wants to be awake!

October 3, 2014 Friday - 5:30 AM breakfast
1 adult

Atmosphere - NA
Food - 1 stars
Service - 2 stars 

Background - My nerves were bothering me at home before I left for the airport so I did not eat.  Looking back perhaps I should have packed my breakfast.
 
Atmosphere - I am not rating this as it is a walk up counter.  

Food
  Drink - They only had coffee, black coffee.  None of that fancy stuff like Starbucks I like.  So it got skipped.  I head back towards Peets for that.

  My Meal - Egg White Delight McMuffin is what I got, not what I order.  That is what my receipt said too.  I went back to their website to see if the receipt matched the item I received and it did.  So I will rate the food on what I got.   The egg was runny, how you make scramble whites runny I don't know and get them into a sandwich.  But here is the extra twist the cheese corners were not melts but dried and crusty as if they were exposed to air and heat but not enough heat to melt it.  The ham, well it was more like jerky than a slice of ham you would find on a pizza.  Very sad.  The bread was good.    

Service - By now you know I did not get what I ordered.  I am not fan of thinly sliced ham. I will take some Easter ham which nice and thick and juices running out of it, mmmm, bring it on.  So I asked for the McMuffin with Sausage.  I have done this many of times at other locations, not here as this is my first time at this location.  But I got no feedback suggesting I was crazy, I can hear all of you saying I am, shhhh, I am writing here.  At the end of my order I clearly stated that is all.  The next sentence from the cashier was would you like anything else.  Did I not just state and that is it.  Dude, Where's My Car? started playing my head "And Then???"  No And Then!!!

Future - Convenience :(
The food is not upto the standard of most Mcdonalds. You need to be having great patience to deal with the staff here coz they don't respond that well to your questions.

Took my toddler daughter here for French fries on my lunch break from work. A male employee proceeded to walk by our table and exclaim "wow what a shame take your daughter to lunch and you don't even pay attention to her cause you're playing on your phone" ..... Actually I was answering a work email. Very offended to say the least. Saw this employee stop at other diners tables and make comments to them also.

don't ever go to the drive-through friday or saturday night! i was there at 10:30 ... got stuck in line for over 45 minutes! i will drive to new castle next time and go there... would have taken less time than waiting in this damn line.

This is the worst Mcdonalds I have been to. I live close by so I have been to it plenty of times but I've decided NEVER to go back.  You forget about going at 2-3:00 am in the morning. The black girl that works the window is awful! She will tell you to look at the overnight menu and  she will be right with you. She never comes back. THEN when someone pulls up to the 2nd drive thru window she takes their order. When you say hello she just ignores you. I have witnessed this more than one time at this Mcdonalds. If they seem to be slow at night time and revenue has dropped this would be why. They dont wait on anyone. They rather you leave. Most of the time when you go late they will just tell you the computer is down and they dont know when they begin taking orders again. I could tell you so much crap about this place but I'm not gonna go on and on. just know this is NOT my only complaint with this place. Everything from very soggy hamburger buns to wrong orders, no napkins, Begging for ketchup,  diet soda when you asked for a coke, all the time. it's not worth the headache to go to this place.

Remember when McDonald's had the best fries..hot, crispy and salty..yummy! No more they are either undercooked, cold and bland or they are burned, hard and cold..what happened? Bring on the original McDonald's values!

Was here 9/14/14 and this will be the first and last time I will be coming to this location! The people were rude to the street people who wants to buy coffee/drinks only.The person cleaning the trays used the same towel to wipe off excess from the soda cup....so GROSS! (luckily, we didn't order any drinks just french fries that was just taken out) There was 2 managers there but no one said anything! The cashier looks like she didn't want to be there, no energy, no customer service! However, when there was no customer to attend to, the cashier and the person wiping the trays and 2 managers were so happy and energized!

So I ordered a chicken club and that is what they charged me for. What I got was a plain bun with a piece of chicken and no condiments or toppings.  Where is the quality control in this place, do the cooks not know what a club means...
I don't enjoy having to wait long periods of time at drive thrus.

I went here to get breakfast this past Sunday morning around 10:33 am. I ordered the breakfast for my family. I normally don't do bad reviews but the Caucasion woman at the Drive thru window 1 was very rude asking what did I order,,,,I immediately informed her what I had. I was with my daughter and felt she was very loud. I got to the 2nd drive thru window and they said I would have to pull up and wait at the reserved parking because they were waiting on bagels, then when I did recive the breakfast it was not correct and I was missing an Apple juice. The person went back gave me an orange juice which was incorrect then went back to get the Apple juice. To top this all off the person was on his cell phone giving me my breakfast. Do not go here for breakfast. The service is very bad and rude.

Very slow, 20/25 min before you can even place your order in drive through. They have a manager on nights that is very rude not only to customers but to crew members.  She will go outside and smoke instead of help the crew. She is hateful. I had her slam the window shut on me because I asked for another drink.The drink I had tasted gross. Not to mention another night they mixed something in my friends drink. I always ask for unsweet tea because Im diabetic. .they give me sweet teas. Constantly have to get my order corrected. This manager gets complaints constantly but instead of the gm, owner doing anything they keep her on. I guess they dont value their customers.

Well, what can I say, it is a McDonalds. The staff here always seems to get your order wrong.  You had better repeat it at least 3x if you want to get what you ordered.  Given the turn around rate of cashiers and other workers (I almost never see the same person at the drive thru) it is no surprise.

Micky Ds earns its 3/5 stars by being exactly what it is: fast, greasy, delicious food after a night of bar hopping, a late day at the office, or any other time where it becomes impractical to cook. No surprise here.  While your arteries and gastrointestinal tract may protest in earnest, either by boisterous poop or the early onset of atherosclerosis, the slimy salty goodness of the Big Mac or the wonderful lard doused fries soaked in salt and drenched in ketchup can not be underestimated. 

Sure you may die an early death if you eat here too often (one Big Mac burger contains usually almost 100% daily value of sodium, fat, cholesterol- basically everything your doctor told you not to eat).  But damn, at 239am after a night at the bar with the boys does it taste so good.  Wash it down with the syrupy goodness of high fructose corn syrup Coke and you might as well be in heaven. 

Due to my anal retentive perfectionist nature I did check the facts on the big mac.  85mg cholesterol (28% daily value), 960mg sodium (40% daily value), total fat: 27g (42% daily value).  Per McDonalds Website, accessed 10/7/14.

Not quite as bad as I thought.  On that note, "I'll have a number 1 with a Coke."

Well it's exactly what I expected. The service was very fast, the staff was very pleasant and the food tastes exactly like it always does. Last time my bun was a little stale, but again, I don't have super high expectations for a fast food place that is supposed to get your food out in like a minute or less. Overall, next time I'm craving fast food, I'd come here. 
Also they are doing monopoly again, which can be fun.
Horrible. I've tried to order a frappe on about 30 occasions on various days at various times and they can NEVER MAKE one. Hate them.

This entire McDonald's used to have a dinosaur theme both inside and out.  Not anymore.  All remnants of anything "dinosaur" has been effectively snuffed out with the exception of the life-sized dinosaur statues outside.  Now this is just another McDonald's, and one that needs to catch up to its newer counterparts at that.  

There is no self-serve drink station, no Coke Zero, and I really can't believe how bland and boring the interior decor is compared to what it used to be and compared to other McDonald's.  There is wi-fi, but no TVs or other amenities.  This is not a go-to place anymore.   Food and service are the same as you'd expect, but it feels old, tired, and sad in here now.

I've been eating McDonald's food for years. It's pretty consistent no matter where you go in the US. This location was quick, service was pleasant, food was almost consistent with the other franchises. 

My English muffin was a little burnt. I know, picky. It's just that you expect it to be the same at all McDonald locations. Who knew burnt edges would change the McDonald's experience so much??
MERIDIAN, ID: Reviewing McDonalds seems like a futile exercise in OCD behavior or passing boredom, but I think every restaurant should have one review.  This McDonalds was fairly friendly.

In the beginning I rated this restaurant a 5 mainly because the people were polite professional etc. However this location continues to get my order wrong every 2 weeks and the restaurant refuses to address the issue today as always I ordered hot cakes sausage biscuit and a tea what I received was the above with eggs even thou it plainly says no eggs no butter syrup or anything to eat with i am thru with mcdonalds repeat offense. ..

Not that I expect a high bar from McDonald's, but just witnessed something disgusting.  The restroom looked as if it hadn't been properly cleaned in weeks.  As I was about to wash my hands before leaving to order, a McDonald's employee enters the restroom and uses the bathroom.  But as he finishes, instead of washing his hands, he pulls out the cleaning sheet and initials that the bathroom had been cleaned (which it hadn't), even with the toilets unflushed and water all over the countertop, then exits the restroom and heads back into the kitchen, again, without ever having washed his hands.  Needless to say, I left without ordering.

Postscript: This review was written on 12/24/2011.  (Only now posted.)

This is the only McDonalds location that has never messed up my food even once. Not only that but the way they present their food is also unlike any other McDonalds I've ever been to. Every burger I've ordered is put together very neatly, no sloppiness whatsoever goes on with this crew. Never had a fast food experience like these guys!

Average at it's best. Employees want your money and then they kick you out. It's adequate food, adequate staff and adequate hygiene makes it an adequate restaurant. I see nothing special but being rushed by employees to order and eat. Sometimes a random homeless man eats inside and smells up the place.

Why have a television in a restaurant when they're picky about people lingering in their restaurant? I'm supposed to finish my food in 30 minutes? That's just weird and unusual for me. The atmosphere was better before and in todays' standards it's just bleh. 

Also the occasional cholo or chola will give you attitude when you order. My pro's are the proximity of this place, the fries are usually fresh and their modernized look but bummed that they have the authority to kick you out. I'm sure that law was placed to kick out the homeless, since I've never been kicked out. I just saw the sign posted.

I would recommend people eating here if they like McDonald's but if they're picky like me. They wouldn't return with high expectations.

Worst place to eat breakfast ever. I prefers 2 sausage muffins an a sausage biscuit I Got food that was hard as a rock like it was from yesterday and the biscuit was with bacon not sausage an they won't replace it

Decided to hop off the interstate on the way to Tampa thinking it would be a quick stop at the drive-thru.  Wrong!

Even though it's just off of I-4, it's a pain the butt to get to.  The road has a good deal of traffic and there are U-Turns involved which is never quick or fun.

The drive-thru is hellishly slow.  There are two different drive-thru lanes and the people in them have no concept of who is to go next which just leaves people cutting each other off left and right.  

The food was not hot and it was haphazardly put together.  There must have been about two - three tablespoons of ketchup on my burger.  Yuck.  No napkins in the bag.  So, messy food with no napkins.  Lovely.

Neither of the people at either of the drive-thru windows smiled or even so much as said one word.  

What I thought would be a quick 10 minute stopped turned into a more than a half hour ordeal.  Seriously...  it took more than 30 minutes just to get food from the drive-thru of a FAST FOOD joint.

Never, ever will I stop here again on the way to or from Tampa!

My local McDonald's only go here out of desperation and if you are seriously starving and have no other options otherwise I recommend going quickly through the drive-through.  On a good note this McDonald's has never messed up one of my orders and no one has begged me for money or was shot in the parking lot when I was leaving!

If I could give this mcdonalds negative stars I would. I went in the night of October 11 to get a snack I usually go through drive through so this was only the second time I've gone inside the restaurant. After we ordered our food we were standing by the counter waiting for them to give it to us and I saw a MANAGER touching the Big Mac with his bare hands he was adding veggies and the top bun. He didn't even bother to wash them before touching the food. He was wearing a maroon shirt and looked middle aged. We were all completely disgusted by this and felt horrible for whoever got that Big Mac. I will not be going to this mcdonalds again.  There is a jack and the box, wendys, Burger King, Taco Bell, and little ceasers all right next to this mcdonalds so there are plenty of other options nearby.

For a McDonalds, this is one of the worse ones I have ever seen. I am always missing food from the drive thru, today they ran out of monopoly pieces. 

I don't eat here often but every time I do there is a issue.

This is my first bad review ever.  I always think to myself that if its not positive i wont write it.  But this place is so bad i want to say so.  They dont take credit cards at night and use the excuse that their system is updating.  Seriously?  8 hours of updating.  Sounds more like they are skimming cash at night to avoid the taxes.   The staff is a bunch of kids and they have been very unprofessional on many occasions.  At night they stop taking the cards and they dont tell you until you are at the speaker so if someone pulls up behind you then you are stuck in line even if you dont have cash for the food.  Its crazy that they wouldnt put a sign up saying they only take cash so that people dont get stuck in line.  Its amazing to me that this place is owned by the same people as the others in the area because I never see the same issues at the others.  Drive a few miles and avoid the headache.  McDonalds Corp would be ashamed at the way they are treating their customers.  Burger King puts this location to shame.

Avoid this place at all costs. I used to work at this store as a maintenance worker and I've seen the most vile things done behind the scenes.  We have a freezer in our basement where we keep our frozen products. The workers would go in the freezer and drop the food on the floor and still serve it to our customers. The workers would eat food while they were making your food! They would drop all the meat patties on the floor and still use it. The basement has alot of mice running around. It is very unsanitary as well. The manager Anthony Hill is extremely rude to customers and has no respect. Its so nasty don't go there !

My son & I went to breakfast here and I ordered a sandwich off the dollar menu.  They charged me over $3.00 for it.  My son heard the Hispanic woman telling the cashier that he over charged us.  When I looked at my receipt & questioned her.  She argued with me but still gave me my money.  She knew they messed up but still wanted to argue.  Why didn't she just admit they made a mistake.  ROTTEN customer service.

Not much to say about this, as it's a McDonalds, and I don't need to describe the food. However, this place has seldom to never gotten my order correct, and when you call the staff upon their error, they get an attitude, like it's your fault that they didn't get your order right.

The staff overall has an unfriendly demeanor, gets snippy, and never says thank you. The fries are cold every time I get them, and the food usually isn't much warmer. On top of that, the service is painfully slow, and on a Sunday morning, customers can expect to wait at least 20 minutes to get through the drive-thru with a simple order.

Worst McDonald's ever.

Spacious McD's just off of 65 at exit 90 ... but parking is a hot mess. The drive-thru line was wrapped around the restaurant, so we parked in the overflow lot. Only issue? When we went to leave, we were nearly parked in. We had to back out of the lot ... which meant the car waiting behind us had to back out of the lot ... it's an accident waiting to happen!

Sometimes you want FAST food, well.. not Fast.
there are 2 drive thru windows here, so that means a person behind you in line does and will always get their order before you and go in the other lane ahead of you in line. that is so messed up. And yes, they are extremely slow! The service is hit or miss, sometimes its really fine and they are nice, other times, like tonight, the girl rolls her eyes as I'm explaining something to her. Go at your own risk.
Update, actually got cussed out by some crazy old man in the drive thru at this place because of the 2 lanes which are a nightmare, why McDonald's thought 2 lanes is a good idea is beyond me. and people think you took their spot, which I didn't but does it mean you have to cuss a woman out? Great experience.

I like how you can save 10% if you go to UCSB or SBCC. Really fast service even at rush hour. The food is good and what you expect from a McDonald's. I like how it is close to UCSB & I'm sure to come back when I'm eating on a budget.

This McDonald's employee stepped directly in front me, on purpose, at Walmart and when I returned the favor, she started cussing at me and making racial slurs.  The employees at the Walmart electronics counter told me to go away "before it got worse."  After I finished shopping, I went to the McDonald's location to try to get the girl's name and the manager wouldn't even give it to me, but the young lady decided to be offensive again and I got it all on tape.  I hate going to any Walmart, and especially this one.  That will be my last visit.
Couldn't get the order right. They took my receipt and asked me to pull up. I waited 10 min until someone came out. Wrong again n since they took my receipt I gave up & left.

This is the poorest manage McDonald's I've ever been to. I was one of two cars in the drive-through and for some reason my one burger and medium drink took so long they made me park in the parking lot and wait on my food. It took 6 min. The bathrooms are also disgusting. Every bit of this - should be fired and they should start over from the beginning.
Typically McDonalds, Nothing out of the ordinary.

Stopped in for a quick bite to eat after an afternoon of boozing but first I had to use the restroom because I had broken the seal previously. It's a McDonalds, so one should not expect much. A fast coffee in the morning, a quick bite to eat on the way somewhere. But this particular McDonalds is the worst on both accounts. They tore it down and rebuilt it and now it's worse than ever. The customer service totally sucks and it takes forever to get served. They will get your order wrong and they will overcharge you, no doubt about it. Or you will be waiting by the cash register and they will just ignore you until you say something. I work nearby and used to come here because it was convenient but not anymore. Blech stay away until they get new management! You have been warned
Fast and accurate with orders. Clean with local specials. And everyone in the front of the house speaks very good English.
I'd give another star, but the playground is always messy . kudos to the manager who thew some jerk out of the building. Nice to see someone being strong and protecting their business.

2.5 stars. 

It's McDonald's, so you know exactly what you're getting here; for the most part, it's clean and consistently offers the typical Mickey D's experience. I've never had a problem eating here. 

The only reason I'm reviewing it is to point out the historical significance of this store: it's the birthplace of the Egg McMuffin. Yes, the ubiquitous breakfast sandwich was invented here, a few miles from the beach. 

http://www.aboutmcdonalds.com/mcd/our_company/amazing_stories/food/the_birth_of_the_egg_mcmuffin.html

Super unfriendly staff.  Sat at drive-in speaker (one other car was sitting at pickup window) for 6 minutes before someone took my order.  After I gave it, silence.. silence..4 more minutes of silence before they asked for the order again.  All of this at 3pm in the afternoon.  Do not go to this McDonalds unless you have a LONG time to wait and don't need anyone to do more than mechanically take your order and thrust your food to you.

I really just stopped in to use the restroom but the lady working to counter greeted me so I thought I'd get a quick bite after all. The place was pretty clean considering. But everyone know what McD's is so I'll leave it at that.

The only McDonald's I go to  in Reno...it's super convenient on my way in and out of town, or I can buzz by for a 20-minute lunch break. They get my order right, treat customers well, and you can always work out your existential crises by jockeying for front runner position in the bifurcated drive-thru. The salads here are always fresh, love the lattes, smoothies, and always, the burgers and fries. If I have time I sit inside and study or catch up on my emails.

I am an unashamed fan of McDonald's: despite being guilt-tripped about their accused complicity in rainforest destruction and styrofoam container use in the 80's, to factory farm bitching and sustainable farm-to-fork whining today, this is a business model that rocks: give people what they want in a timely and efficient manner, have consistency, cleanliness, and value. Take that, eco-freaks. I haven't seen lines snaking around that tempeh-on-a-stick drive-thru you thought of.
The worst McDonalds in all of Pinellas County!! They will mess up your food every single time when going thru the drive thru!!
It's so nasty and out of pocket. Like it is just falling out of my pocket it's so nasty. I mean the food isn't even real.

Ok. You got me. I ate here once when I was coming home quite late and was honestly too lazy to get something good. 

It's the same as every other McD's on the planet. Bleah.

Terrible service, our order got screwed up, and once we actually started eating there was a hair in one of our meals.
Another thing that I found odd was that they didn't have any ketchup dispensers, they only had packets of ketchup. I personally like a lot of ketchup and I had never been to a McDonalds before that didn't offer ketchup in a pump style dispenser. 
Strange expereince to say the least. I won't be returning to this location.

The staff here are always really sweet and friendly. The building is pretty run down, but I don't have super high expectations for a McDonalds. It's clean, the cashiers are always extra-friendly, and they get my order right. I'm always pleasantly surprised by their cheery attitudes. Fast food workers aren't usually the friendliest in food service, but that's not the case at this location. They do a really great job.

Ugh...

Sometimes you just have to stop at the closest place when nature calls. Today it called next to a McDonalds. There was a token lock on the bathroom (which I later found out was unlocked) so I bought a drink to get in. Which brings me to their ice. Standard hollow cube. Nothing special. 

Inside the unlocked bathroom I found that the stall doors do not lock. Most of the graffiti has been wiped away save for an urgent message to call a lonely person looking for something specific and R.o.b. gang. There's toilet paper at least single ply, not too scratchy. No toilet covers so there was a hover. 

On the way out a guy panhandled me for change in front of the counter and the employes didn't seem to care so there's that too.

After about midnight they usually say they can not accept credit cards only cash then refuse to give you a receipt. Don't even think about getting an ice cream product after 12am as they will say the machine is down. They ALWAYS screw up my order and they must have the slowest drive thru in the history of fast food.  (Waiting at the window for over 3 minutes just to pay, and an additional 8-10 minutes waiting for my food.  It wasn't busy inside or in the drive thru.  

The only positive I have to say is that usually the attitude and kindness of the staff members is noted, I just wished the rest of the service didn't stink so bad.

Average. Just what you'd expect of a McDonald's. Nothing fancy, no frills. Just fast food to dine in or take out. Good in a hurry. Good if you have kids and want to grab something to shut them up when they begin crying about how hungry they are. There are apples in the Happy Meals for the wee ones. Great a couple times a week. But not a place you can "LIVE" on "Everyday" but a good treat for sure!!!!!!

Best McDonald's ever. Maybe because I'm in Philly and all the McDonald's here suck.  I mean this McDonald's was so good, my daughter was surprised that the food came out right away.  The fries were hot, the food was fresh and hot and it was clean.  I know, I know, that's how it's supposed to be but in Philly McDonald's it's not, so this was a breath of fresh air.

The employees were friendly and there was not a long wait.

Very slow at the drive through this morning. I waited two minutes (yes, I was timing it) at the order speaker before someone asked if I was ready to place an order. I was just about ready to drive off!

How can you not have coffee on a Saturday morning at 9:30am? Will not go back here again as we've had very incompetent service.

Came threw the drive thru this morning,my bag tore in half right after she gave it to me and didn't apologize,1 biscuit wasn't even wrapped,all the biscuits were hard as a rock an the hash browns weren't cooked all the way. I have the choice between 2 McDonalds an every time I come threw this one, there's always a problem. I think I'm done with this one an I'll start going down to the other one by Old Nashville Hwy

I was here for breakfast nothing fancy, fast service, hot coffee, good service, lots of seniors with their coffee cups.
As for a fast food joint, it's a winner.

Most terrible service I have ever had.
