There was absolutely no mayo on my mcChicken. Do not go there!!
Great and quick service food was hot and fresh no complaints here the young lady at the drive thru very friendly the outside of the store very clean its a great location its around different stores

Terrible drive-thru service. Order is wrong every 2 of 3 times, and usually have to 'pull forward and wait' EVERY time. Not like I was ordering a unique or 'special' order either, just stuff straight off the menu. Need people here where English is a first language and where high school is not the ultimate graduation goal.
No honey, no ketchup, old nuggets, a total waste of $10 & my McDonalds embargo.  3 months has passed since I ate mcdonalds & now I am reminded why.  Aweful-don't eat here!!!
Worst worst worst! I have never in my life seen so many paid workers standing around doing nothing. Not all mcdonalds are like this but this place honestly deserves negative stars.

This is the worst McDonalds I have ever been to.  It is convenient if you live in Broad Ripple and you are starving, I will give them that.  Every time I have been there for last 8 visits (because I was starving and in a hurry) I have had extremely slow service and wrong orders. 6 of those times I have had to pull up so they could bring my order out.  I did not order anything special. This morning no one was getting food from the window. They had 6 cars pulled over to different spots waiting for there food.  I have complained to corporate about this store several times. Nothing has changed.  The people are nice. I believe it is bad management.  I will not go back. I will take the 5 extra minutes to go to 72nd and Keystone or 52nd and Keystone where they have there sh*t together.

This McDonalds has the worst drive thru service in town; they are slow; they get your order wrong; and the food is cold by the time you get it.  And!...when you bring these issues up to them there is never an apology, but plenty of attitude.

Because it is close by, this was our go-to MickeyD's, but the last two times have left us cold...literally.

First take-out breakfast - got home and pancakes were still frozen in middle.

Second take-out breakfast - got home and missing hashbrowns.

Luckily there are other McDonalds around - and other options for breakfasts - so we won't have to go back to this one again.

The staff is very friendly, and always manage to get my Bacon Egg and Cheese Bagel, no sauce, no cheese right.  
I recommend going in vs. drive thru, and going to the parking lot next door when exiting.  Much easier to get out when turning left.
Weirdest drive thru experience... There girl didn't give me any change and she was like I'll get the manager just drive on through so I did and the guy at the next window gave me a weird look

Haha, this McDonald's suddenly closed sometime after 10/31/14. 

There was no "official" explanation on the door, just a notice that former customers should try one of the other vendors in the concourse. I wonder if it closed due to escalating rent, franchisee issues, or if it was due to a healthcode violation? 

The only good "memories", if they can be called that, that I have of the place were of the free coffee samples that were available for a brief week in September 2014, otherwise the food was overpriced and they didn't even have a dollar menu. 

Good riddance!

I won't echo any of the pessimism that nearly every other reviewer has stated, but I will mention that the only memorable thing that I witnessed at this McDonald's was a trio of women exiting out of the only working public restroom (at the time.) All eyes were on them as they stumbled out the front door.

The women were dressed like they were ready for a night out at the Hard Rock Cafe, but somehow ended up at McDonalds. Definitely an oddity and a travesty.
I have been to this place only twice and both times I got pink eye, for some odd reason.

First time here. Waited 5 minutes at the drive thru and didn't move so I parked and went inside. Waited another 30 minutes for my food. I ordered 2 things, definitely not "fast food." I've never seen such a discombobulated bunch. To top it off, I got home without the drinks (I just wanted to get out of there so I forgot about them) and my order was wrong. 2 breakfast sandwiches and the order was wrong.

Love living close to almost everything. We really don't have to drive far. We are surrounded by fast food joint. I don't mind eating at McDonald's. I love my Big Mac. My fav. The girls will always get their chicken nuggets happy meals, especially on Tuesday and Thursday because the happy meals are $2.99. Not bad at all. We always do the drive thur. I like this location. The people here are on their game. Service is fast.

Honestly. ... They dont even deserve a star but I think I'm required to put at least one. Horrible, horrible, horrible every time. Maybe I have too high of standards for a fast food restaurant but every single time I visit this place there is something wrong with my food and the service is horrible. Do yourself a favor and visit the subway, Burger King or Wendy's down the street instead of this McDonalds if you are in need of a quick bite at this exit.

This location has really diminished in the last few years. Service is always slow in the drive thru and SUPER slow inside. They recently updated the inside decor and it looks great but I don't care if the couch I'm sitting on is art deco if my food is cold and gross. I ordered a McChicken with cheese and a sweet tea. I got a hard cold McChicken with no cheese and a coke. So I was forced to go inside and ask for my food and drink to be fixed. It took 8 minutes to replace my McChicken and I had to ask again for my drink as they forgot to replace that. In that 8 minutes I saw 5 cars go through the drive thru but only 1 customer of the 4 inside were assisted at the counter. Absolute horrible service, rude, and almost always my order is incorrect. Avoid!!

I just recently went to this location since its renovation and let me say, WOW! The previous store was a scary location with food always cold and not a good setting either, the employees would fight and the food always stale. HOWEVER, this update really took a turn for the better! It seems as though the employees are all new, and they were sooo kind and professional and worked quickly! The store on the inside gives a warm feeling (although I do miss the wildcat UofA theme) with all new seating and menu boards and even the prices went down slightly and it now has two drive through lanes. Best McDonald's location in tucson!
Got a breakfast platter.  Small orange juice cups were not filled and I didn't get ice.   What a disappointment!

The line for the drive through moved so quickly, we couldn't even watch a whole music video!

The young lady taking orders informed me of a deal that I was not aware of which gave me an extra sandwich for the same amount of money. This was terrific. The second young lady handing out the food was equally nice. All the food was fresh and exactly as ordered. 

Can't ask for anything more! Nailed it!

Cold or old this place will serve you just about anything:  on the floor, burnt, raw; its coming your way (I've got a mole on the inside).  The employees are rude. They talk on cell phones while taking your order. They won't repeat your order and rarely give receipts.  Its one big party here and most of the employees are on permanent holiday. Unless you like food poisoning and waiting 20 minuets no matter what you order, I would avoid this place like the plague.  This could quite possible be the worst Mcdonald's in the world.  Its certainly the worst one I've ever been to.

After a long stressful day we had to eat. Yes I could have gone to any quick service restaurant but lets blame my long day. The fries were fresh so was the rest of the order and most importantly handed over with a smile. They also got my entire $24 order correct! Yay McDonald's!  Shhh don't tell anyone I ate here! Solid food delivery and solid service.
Why McDonalds? Consistency...but last two times cold old fries. Slow drive thru but cold fries inexcusable

I wish I could give no stars. The service is absolutely terrible! Every time I visit there the staff are rude! There is always a problem at the drive thru. 

Do yourselves a favor and avoid this location! Honestly it is the best thing you can do!

This mcdonalds is terrible. Place is dirty, employees take too long to take an order, they mess up orders and seems like everyone that works here is miserable. Avoid the aggravation and go some where else.

I've visited this McDonald's 50 times in the last few years but I hadn't been there in about a year until 11/3/2014. I arrived at 8:15am in the drive thru.  It took 5 minutes for someone to actually acknowledge that I was sitting there waiting to order. This also happed with the two cars in front of me.  So I waited from 8:15 to 8:30 in the drive thru line before I could even place my order.  Once my order was placed, I pulled up, paid for my breakfast and pulled forward to pick it up.  It took a few minutes more before my order was ready.  I thought maybe they were waiting for the hash browns to finish cooking.  After receiving my food, I pulled into a parking spot to eat it. The egg on the mcmuffin was cold and the hash brown was also cold.  I have no idea what the staff was doing that morning but it was definitely not focusing on customer service and food quality!

Well, McDonald's food is pretty much the same the world over. And since I only ever seem to get to RNO at the crack of dawn, it's helpful that this place is even here not for the breakfast, not for the free wifi (RNO has free wifi anyway), but as a place to sit down at a table with electrical outlets for a quick charge and internet surfing before your flight.  Plus you can look out the windows and watch the sunrise!

Slow service. Rude employees. And even the employees that smile and say have a nice day, do it with a fake and sarcastic smile. You can tell they don't care about treating customers with respect.  Nice clean contemporary store too!  Service way too happy for working a McDonald's, but I appreciate it !

Best Mcds around,  just count your change before you leave the drive thru!

The food is always hot and fresh. They always skimp on the fries but this is def the best Mcds food wise.  

On more than 1 occasion I have had to argue with the person at the drive thru window to give the correct amount of change back.

After waiting several minutes in the drive thru lane, at precisely 10:29, I am told they are out of breakfast.  I say but it's not even 10:30.  They tell me it is.  Now I am stuck in the drive thru lane 3 cars back.  Sigh.  Now I've wasted my time with no sausage egg mcmuffin to show for myself, and probably healthier for it (other than the increase in my blood pressure).  Well, I know where I won't be returning.
Great customer service! The manager made sure my order was taken care of. Will definitely come back to this one.

Pros: They have a TV and this place is new and clean.

Cons: Slow service. Asked a worker to change the TV channel. She said K. Then did nothing.
This is the best managed McDonalds I have ever been to. Rosario took care of the order that another McDonald's location messed up. This is now my favorite location!

This is your typical McDonald's, so there really isn't too much that can be said.  This one is open 24 hours and is good for a late night snack.

I was coming home from an event held in St. Pete and needed a quick soda. The wait for the drive-thru took longer than usual. But, this is to be expected late on a weekend night. 

Not a huge fan of this drive-thru. The setup is strange. It is a weird windy drive-thru that you practically have to be Mario Andretti to maneuver your car through the path. 

They screwed up my order, but somehow I knew that would happen. It was very late and I didn't want deal with the hassle of letting the restaurant know. So, I just decided to deal it with. Lesson learned, check my order before leaving the drive-thru, especially at this location.

Not one of my favorite places to go but it's close to the house it is a little chilly and I wanted something to warm me up and since I don't drink coffee they have some pretty good hot chocolate, The staff seems to be friendly but as far as the food goes I don't really care for McDonald's. But I must say my hot chocolate is pretty yummy!

A very simple order... two quarter pounder with cheese meals and a 10 pc nuggets. After waiting 5 minutes at the DT window we were parked for "waiting on fries." After another 5 minutes we had our order and headed home. Got home with NO NUGGETS IN THE BAG. This was outside of the normal rush times (2pm). I know this stuff happens but there's really no excuse as the manager brought the order out to the car. I was a McDs manager for 10 years. If it passed through MY hands I always checked it.

I should have read your yelp review before ordering Jules.  I have never been so sad in my whole life as placing a well executed  order this morning.  I truly thought this was my day today but McDonald's proved to slap me in the face.  I firmly took 2 steps up and clearly explained my love for a number 8 which translates to a sausage mc griddle, hash browns,  and coffee.  Much to my udder dismay as I dove in for my tasty breakfast treat it's hard for me to express what happened next.  I chose to polish off my hash with my left hand I unfolded my greasy mcgriddle paper wrap with my right. There was NO cheese! I thought to myself how could this possibly be happening to me?  Did I hurt someone recently or not give them the time to lend a helping hand?  A waterfall of thoughts of clear black and white metaphorical road divides rushed my visual brain play back device.  I couldn't think of anything recently that would have caused this catastrophe. At that point when I thought nothing else in my life could go wrong I realized that not only did I not have cheese but there was no delicious yellow folded egg. I sat in the car 6.4 miles away from where I had just purchased the worst breakfast know to all mankind in all of history! No egg and no cheese! I knew at that point there was nothing I did wrong that would have giving me the results of what had just been placed in my right hand. My whole meal was ruined as my body started rejecting my hash brown.  My only hope is you use technology at the tip of your fingers to review yelps about McDonald to avoid mine and Julie's pain!  Learn and go forth my fellow earth walkers!

McDonalds is your kind of place.  They steal your license plates.  They feed you rattlesnakes.  I forget the rest, but not really.  This is not a recommended McD.  Slow, dirty, and what kind of crazy person reviews a McDonalds...?

They say it's fast food, but always have to wait so long for food. Should be called slow food, 

The only thing. that's great is there $1 menu, 

But when is it comes from one of the cleanest McDonald's I've been  to. 

They could do a little better on how they wait on customers and make sure they give them what they order. But other then that it's okay. 

Don't ask for extra sauce for your chicken nuggets because there charge you extra for it.
Hands down the worst service I have ever received.  The staff was lazy and incompetent. Never go here!!

Although I understand that I came through during a late hour but I also work at a fast food chain and regardless of what time it is you always want to make sure that you receive food that is fresh. Our burgers tasted as if it hadn't been sitting for a good while and the fries were as if they had been cooked forever ago. The girl in drive thru had no personality and your suppose to be pleasant even if its fake. Completely real bad service won't go back.

I like the location of this McDonald's the most because it's downtown! The actual restaurant feels oddly constrained despite the abundance of seats. This McDonald's has an ebb and flow that makes one feel more alive - the people don't stay very long and you know that you are no longer at Milpas. I think it's the lack of CNBC!

Service is good here. The soda fountain is kind of weird, it's small and crammed in the corner but where else could it go right? Watch out for indecisive people and you'll be ok.

I made a goofy error of sorts where I grabbed the tray before they put my fries on the tray. Maybe they shouldn't have called my number if it wasn't ready but I was amused that the crew joined me in blaming me for the SNAFU. I got hot-just-out-the-fryer fries for that. Win?

This is the cleanest, friendliest, and best service you'll get at any McDonald's! The few times I do get McDonald's I always like to come here. They never mess up my order while in the drive thru nor inside. The food taste fresh never taste like it's just sat around! If you want a good McDonald's to visit try this location, you won't be disappointed.

The early morning (6:00 AM) weekday experience at this restaurant is nothing short of AMAZING!!  The availability of healthy breakfast choices like egg white on a biscuit has made this our family's breakfast place of choice.  The drive thru attendant is so professional, courteous and considerate.  She makes an effort to be kind and makes us feel like she knows us.  One time we failed to order a drink that we regularly order and she verified and inquired if we indeed did not wish the drink.  The general manager usually serves the ordered food at the window at 6:00 AM.  His cheerful smile, pleasant manner and professionalism is a wonderful start to any day.  This McDonald's establishment is extraordinary thanks to the morning staff. It gives you the feel of a small town like Mayberry from the Andy Griffith Show where you are welcomed warmly.  I have noticed that the later day staff is young and many are high schoolers.  I appreciate how this establishment gives back to our community. Thank you McDonalds of Richboro.

I like this McDonalds because they have a separate play area for kids. I think that is a major plus for the little guys in my life. What I don't like is the French Fries. This is the second time I have been up here and I have to return to the counter to ask them to give me fresh ones because the ones they give me are old, stale and cold. Its quite annoying and petty to have to do that. The food looks kind of old period but like I said, the play area keeps me going back. I went to try the tea in the lobby and was very disappointed in that also. It was old and when I poured it out, I seen brown grinds all in the cup. I order bare minimum with this McDonalds because I know I will get very below standard food. Also... The crew is unprofessional. While I was in there I heard a girl scream to another girl "stay out my business". That was really not the place or time for that. I was thinking, where is their manager? In the office? Very disappointing experience. (Be happy you have the playhouse, because you guys deserve a fat 0 ) .

Oh my gosh this place. I'm hoping that we are here with bad timing.  No condiments. No ice. Soda station disgusting. Tables in play ground sticky. I usually don't come to this one, but it's close. 

Not a good place yoday.
Every time I order I receive my food before I can put my wallet into my pocket, literally. Pretty happy with the service here and haven't seen anything close to it!

Worst service ever. Worker never came to the speaker. 3 cars deep and everyone had to go to the window to order because there was no response at the speaker. I finally got to the window and after another 2-3minutes the worker says " yes". I'm like uh OK. Wtf. "I need to place an order". She says, "what is it". Smh. No ma'am, no way I'm I placing an order or ever going back to this location. Crazy part is it was only 7:30pm. Not like it was quitting time.

The service was horrible it took 20 minutes to go through the drive thru is unacceptable and I finally went inside and that took an additional 10 minutes.  No explanation or an apology for just a cup of coffee.  Will not be coming back to this McDonald's ever

They r hatching the egg for an egg and sausage biscuit!!!
Never again will I stop here. Waiting now for almost 15 minutes. Talk about NOT FAST FOOD!!!

worst restaurant ever. Never have any heat during the winter, so you freeze while dining in. Their drinks are more expensive that anyother drinks owned by other franchises.  A Senior coffee bought at a non Diaz owned franchise is $0.31 cents cheaper. Very rude workers!
Food here was fresh and tasty. This location was swamped on the Saturday morning we visited, but we did not have to wait long for our food. Restrooms were clean and well stocked.

Time to get your food takes forever. Food is slightly warm at best. If you ask for management to lodge a complaint you get a look that tells they get a lot of complaints and that they really don't care. I guess it's because they are the only large chain fast food restaurant in town they don't have to care. So if your getting anything other than a beverage I suggest finding another place.

The outside has changed but the service is still the same. Average drive thru wait has been 10 minutes.  It's so convenient, but, will go somewhere else out of the way for iced tea because it will still be faster.
Most disgusting McDonald's I've ever been to. Employees cursing at each other, dirty mop water in the ordering line, trash everywhere...you'll do better at the gas station across the street.

The bathrooms were very dirty. There was no toilet paper or soap and the trash can was overflowing. I brought this to the attention of at least 3 staff members, in the time I was there no one reacted to the news that the bathrooms were in such a horrible state.
The person taking my order was rude and rolled her eyes at me. I ordered a Happy Meal and requested apples. I was informed that they "Don't do apples" at this location. The same response was offered when I asked for Go-Gurt instead.
The wait for the food was quite long, exceeding 10 minutes. The store was busy. And I can understand that orders take longer at busy times. But the staff had plenty of time to stand around and chat, joke, and play with the brooms behind the counter. The man filling my order was the only person who was not rude to me and tried to help any one.
The manager was not rude to me, however she was horribly rude to another customer. She got very loud with the customer and kept repeating that the customer was "Not gonna jerk nothin' out her hands". The customer requested to speak to the manager and lady stated that "she was the manager and ain't nobody gonna tell me nothin". It was at this point that my 8 year old was scared & wanted to leave.
The drinks were self service, not an issue. But the mix was off, there was no ice, and the lids were everywhere.  This was brought to the attention of a staff member who told us "the machine has ice.... it is just slow".
My husband was waiting for us in the car where he was bothered my a few panhandlers, not a McDonald's issue, but be aware.
Overall, it was a HORRIBLE experience and my advice would be to go ANYWHERE but here.

Cons - The place is dirty.  Had to stop in to use the restrooms and they were filthy.
- The floors were dirty
- The Service was bad.  Slow and unfriendly staff
- When using the drive through, they have NEVER gotten my order correct.  There is always something missing or incorrect,
- Frequently get the drink wrong.
- Staff acts as if they could not be bothered.

Pros- Compared to other fast food locations in the area, their service is horrible.

For groups of people who want $15/hr as a minimum wage they are not working at a pace or ability to be worth the $15/hr.  Why can other businesses in the area hire much more qualified people than this McDonald's?

I highly recommend going to one of the local competitors, Jack in the Box, Taco Bell, Steak N' Shake, Hardy's, Wendy's, et cetera..

I am not going to ever say that McDonalds is the best.  They have a purpose, if you need a quick bite, this is the place you can grab one.

The building here is clean, as for the service, lacking even through drive through.  However, this is not a service restaurant, it is to get you in quickly as possible, even though they don't most of the time and get you feed and out the door unless you dine in, then you can linger a bit, I get the feeling they want you to hang around eating and drinking, they offer plenty of TV's and free WI-FI.

The food looks good most of the times, unless you get a special burger then it can be all over the place in the box they put it in.  I don't eat the value menu beef or fries here.  I only eat the fish, premium chicken or premium beef sandwiches.

I ordered a double fish fillet here and it was good, I love it because they usually have to make it fresh and hot for me, so I don't mind the wait for that!

They can be a bit slow because of the kids playing around while preparing your food and you have to double check all orders because they will get it wrong.

The food always has a nice smell to eat, so they change the grease regularly.  Taste is good, I never have had anything out of this McDonalds that had a bad taste to it.

They do have the 2nd best coffee to me other than a coffee house which in Granite City, there are none.

This might be the worst Mcdonalds I have ever had the misfortune of walking into. Was thinking a quick exit off I40 for some fries and burger. I was with the GF and decided to get something to hold us over driving to Knoxville. 

The burgers were cold, fries stale. Returned both and waited for fresh food. Fries better but not really. I think they never cleaned the fryer grease out. "Learned watching Bar rescue".  Bad oil just will not cooking anything good.  To top off the stop the coke machine was kicking out highly carbonated drinks. Just sucked.  No way I will stop here again. Drive on, I say!

On my way to work, I ordered a simple cup of coffee and an oatmeal. it took me three minutes to get to work from this location.  Couldn't tell you about the coffee since I threw it out after seeing the oatmeal, which I also threw out. The oatmeal was lukewarm.  It was basically a cup of cold water with unstirred contents.  It was completely disgusting and inedible. You guys have renewed my faith in continuing to cook at home and not eating out.  You should be ashamed of yourselves for serving food like that!

I work until midnight by the time I get to sahuarita McDonald's I take 10 mins out of my drive only to hear that the machine is down, they are only taking cash. I mean I hear this every time I go. Would be nice if they post on their 24 hr sign that for some reason they only take cash after midnight seems a little strange too me. I'm thinking the crew doesn't want to work @ 2 or 3 in the morning and make up the story of machine being down cash only rule. It's every time I got late at night how can the machine always be down?

I work around the corner and get this McDonalds fairly often. The fries are ALWAYS over cooked and cold. I wonder how one restaurant can consistently over cook their fries everyday. The employees are not too friendly. I have been through the drive thru on several occasions where I would place my order at the speaker, drive up to window 1 to pay, then drive up to window 2 to collect my food and neither person at the windows spoke a word to me.

This review may seem like it's a joke but I kid you not.  If you cant believe it, just ask any employee next time your at a McDonalds.  As for me, I really don't understand McDonalds nugget sauce math, because it does not add up!  Employees tell me that they can only give me two (2) dipping sauces for an order of 10 piece nuggets.  I ordered the 20 piece meal and was told that they can only give me three (3) dipping sauces.  Worse yet, employees insist on charging myself and every customer .25 (That's twenty-five cents) for the additional sauce! In addition, (no pun intended) I can not believe that employees would run the .25 (That's twenty-five cents) charge on my credit card because I had asked for the extra sauce when I picked up my completed order!  Don't they pay a fee per transaction? If so, I bet its more than the quarter charge and the manufacturing of the nugget sauce in the first place!  It almost seems like they robbed themselves any profit from this kind of transaction. What the hey is going on here?  Plus, I was under the impression that applicants were at least required to have a G.E.D. or equivalent to be employed with this popular restaurant chain. What's next? An extra charge for the to-go bag?  I mean, are the nugget sauces driving you toward bankruptcy?  It sure does appear that way.

I go to this McDonald's about once every month or two. I have never been accosted by a roach living the thug life. Neither have I achieved a Buddhist enlightenment because of their food. it is a McDonald's and it does what a McDonald's does, neither great nor badly. The bathrooms are usually moderately clean, but not sparkling. The rest of the facility is pretty clean and well-kept. One wall is glass which provides for a nicer sitting environment and view, even if the view is of a state highway. It's fine.

This used to be the worst McDonald's in New Jersey hands-down. I am not sure what happened, but first the staff suddenly became good. Several months after that the entire building was redone and became miraculously clean. This place is a true McDonald's miracle. 

Snarkiness aside, facility is clean and well-kept. They have a very nice play area (and doors) for the kids. The staff is friendly and helpful and well organized in their processing of orders and food. other than that the food is... well, McDonald's food. If you know McDonald's food, and you know what you're getting here.

Yes I am reviewing McDonald's only because I have had the most unpleasant experience at this particular location! I found a hair in my food!!!!!!!!!! GROSS. Avoid eating here! This has made me not want any fast foods anymore. Maybe for the best... YUCK!

As far as McDonald's go this one isn't bad as the staff seems to understand their job and take some kind of pride in what they do. Place was clean and the bathrooms weren't a disaster as they are in other local members of the chain. The couple of mistakes food wise have been fixed and credited back from staff which is also a very rare at least with no attitude. Not a bad McDonalds if you have the need.

So nice- I dropped my tray of food and they told me not to worry about cleaning it and they gave me a new meal for no charge. 

So clean- they actually have people cleaning the walls. 

It is McDonald's though so...
This place is a dump and I wish they would close it down and build something that properly represents the neighborhood.
I only give this place two stars because they have a kid playpen. The food is still disgusting but at least there's some semblance of Athletics for kids eating here.
This place is a dump and a blight on Temple's campus; get rid of it! The interior is disgusting and the trash left around the front of the place is destroying property values.

It's mcdonalds foods the same.  But the service here is horrible horrible did I say horrible.  You might find a few good ones but they are usually gone within a few months.  

Almost every morning I get a large unsweetened tea to take to work. They only reason I keep going here is it's only a dollar.  I  have to try it cause the one time I don't they give me a sweet tea.  And at least 3 out of 10 times they get it wrong.  One time as I am pulling up I see the lady is pulling sweet tea in the cup then I guess she realized it was suppose to be unsweetened and filled it the rest of the way up with the unsweetened.  Like I wouldn't know know the difference.  

I realize we all make mistakes but the employees at this location are terrible.  Either they just don't care or they have no understanding of their job.

I could tell you so may more bad experiences with this particular mcdonalds but I'm sure most of you already know.

Haven't been to a McDonald's in years so wasn't even sure what to get. Went through the drive through for a quick bite while shopping. Decided on a cheddar onion burger for $1.00 and a small drink. Hard to judge any place on such a small order. Burgers have shrunk quite a bit in size since I last got McDonald's but for a dollar who can complain. 2 drive through lanes moving fast so very efficient despite a long line. 

All in all I am not a big fast food patron but certainly met my needs today for $2.00

Quick checkout times on the drive thru during the hectic AM rush makes for one satisfied customer! 

No surprises here at this McDonald's as you come here knowing exactly what you are going to get each time with no surprises. Food is ok but what else do you expect for a fast food chain. Its cheap and does what it does best, fills you up just enough to get by to the next meal

Each person i've encountered here always greeted me with a friendly smile and a greeting - Thank you! Inside the bathrooms and sit down area inside are clean which is a credit to the staff. 

5 STARS for the restaurant cleanliness & staff
2 STARS for the food itself

Now If every McDonald's only offered Chicken McNuggets in the AM ...

This location is always filthy and the service poor.
The food is never fresh.
I made the mistake of stopping there for breakfast last week.

Same old story.  Messy/nasty and the wait was 10 minutes.  I get on the road and they gave me the wrong item.  Not to mention, the item they gave me was covered in burned onions and some sort of dark colored juice.

Soggy, burned and nasty.

The worst McD's in the entire area and we have a few.
The lot is an absolute disgrace and falling apart, it REALLY needs to be repaved. The entire store needs to be remodeled, it's original and falling apart! The food is almost always cold, they get the drive thru orders mixed up more often than not and in general I try to avoid this one whenever possible.

In contrast to the Wayne McD's, this one is the best in the area.
Always gets the orders correct and HOT. I met the owner, he really seems to care whether his customers are happy and satisfied. A few years ago they had a special make to order upgraded menu, apparently it was one of eight in the country. Unfortunately it did not work out but I enjoyed many of the items they offered.
They took our order fast, easy, & friendly! I highly recommend this McDonald's. The management must have changed because everyone there is so polite & helpful!

Decided to get a quick lunch at the McDonald's and felt the need to write about because I was completely taken back by the service.

The employees behind the counter we're friendly and my food came out expeditiously. They have 2 employees on the dining area continuing cleaning the drink station, tables, chairs and asking us, the costumers, if we need assistance.  The employees on the dining floor asking if I and others needed something was a shocker to me and a nice customer service touch.

Food:  Food was fine, but just keep an eye out on the fries as mine weren't all that fresh -if there's one thing I love in McDonald's it's the fries, so don't mess that up.  :-)

Let me first say that this restaurant is a cesspool of dining. Even among other stores in the chain this one is the pits. Place is always a mess with garbage all over and a general layer of grease coating every surface. Homeless people are allowed to hang out inside and panhandle for money. Staff seems to have given up and seems apathetic. Over this location.

I always go through the drive-through at this particular McDonald's they never seem to have my order correct even if it's just a hamburger and soda I have to double check the bag before I drive away.  Remember Monday through Friday morning to after lunch you get the A-Team all other times is the B and C teams or D, E...... And just think these people want $15 an hour
Was at this McDonald's about 15 min ago and they were extremely slow took 20 min for 2 burgers and 2 drinks and then told us they were out of pies horrible service

I went in for a late lunch. Ordered a double cheeseburger. I was very hungry. ~4 p.m.

The only reason I went INTO the store, is I had to use the facilities.

She asked, "Is that all?" I replied yes.

She was not friendly. She was perturbed with my order.

I got my double cheeseburger to-go.

$1.55 without tax.

If you take off the attitude, it should have cost $1.

I'm grading this on typical large chain fast food scale. Consistent McDonald's food and cleanliness.  The interior has been updated to a more modern styling.  What really sets this apart is the fantastic kids area. It's half the restaurant. Many individual tables and a large family sized table that seats 12 comfortably.   I've seen some families bring in crafts during the afternoon to do as well, even a birthday party.   The playground jungle gym thing is quite big and entertained the kids for a good long time.  Free WiFi
Terrible! No supplies out at all.  No napkins, katsup etc. have to wait in line and ask for everything.
It's McDonalds so my expectations were low already. However, because of exceptionally poor customer service I can't even adjust their rating favorably.

Family tradition is to get McDonalds breakfast on the weekend. Our order is never correct. Always missing something ( a breakfast sandwich , missing a hash brown, incorrect beverages ). It has been incorrect for the past 4 weeks. This is getting old folks. With a big long line rushing you out of the drive through line - I don't have time to double check your work. Maybe the staff should double check their orders. Please.

Except for the grouchy manager this a nice McDonald's. The manager here has been in a bad mood for at least 4 years now. The good appeal of this McDonald's is there is a little privacy. No one bothers you. 
 It also on the way up to Lake Tahoe and you can get something on the way up there.

The manager staff here is very grouchy. She is unpleasant and yells at the customers and the work staff. She has been in a bad mood for about 4 years now. She makes feel like I'm bothering the place and I'm not welcome.
Only good thing about this place is that it's on the way up to Lake Tahoe. But that's the only.
Management must show the customer that they are valued.

I live a block away so I come here several times a month. Service is quick, however the workers are rude and occasionally mess up your order. The building hasn't been updated in awhile, so expect to go to a 80's-90's era McDonald's. I ordered a McFlurry and they "didn't have ice cream", so I had to order something else. Dissapointing.

I never thought I'd review a McDonalds hahaha unless it was really bad but this place is so awesome super fast and everybody in there is really fashionable! I did not feel like I was at a McDonalds and everybody's in energy and fashion sense (hair, makeup and manager's clothing) really made my morning :-)

Let me first say that this restaurant is a cesspool of dining. Even among other stores in the chain this one is the pits. Place is always a mess with garbage all over and a general layer of grease coating every surface. Homeless people are allowed to hang out inside and panhandle for money. Staff seems to have given up and seems apathetic. Over this location.

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever seen and it is sad because it is right by my house.  They always mess up drive through orders.  I tried them again today after more than 6 months and the same lady was working the window and yes they messed up my order.  Unbelievable! . One time they told me to pull around and wait. While waiting I cleaned out my car at their garbage can inadvertently throwing away the receipt.  They came out and told me they were out of what I ordered did I want to substitute.  When I said no just a refund they wanted th the receipt which I just threw away and they would not refund the money.  The girl told me she needed proof I purchased it. Really, you just asked me if I wanted to substitute.... 

 The one on Hampton between 44 and 60 is awesome but hard to get in and out of during rush hour.

This McDonalds is my local McDonalds location, so when I am in the mood for some fast food, this is usually where I am headed.  I don't think I have ever been inside the store as I usually go through the drive thru.  The drive thru has two lanes which are always open.  This not only speeds things along but the staff seem to have a drive to get cars pushed through the process.  I am assuming they have some metrics they are evaluated on a seconds per car basis or something.  A fast drive through is important as nobody likes to wait long.  I would recommend that they slow it down just a bit though as I think at times I am missing items from my bag or not given a drink I ordered or something like this.  On the last visit, the person at the speaker and I discussed the sauce for chicken nuggets probably three times to ensure I would receive these (my wife doesn't enjoy the chicken nuggets without the sauce).  Still after quite a discussion over the sauce, the bag was empty.

Hands down to the slowest McDonald's in town!! Expect at least 15 min just to get a drink in their drive through. Probably  short of staff.  Dont go to their drive through  if you're  in a rush or you'd be late to wherever you're  going to.

Has anyone ever watched thru the window when you're eating for food or even inside? They don't wear gloves and yet when they go to put your food in the bag they put their hand inside to open it. And 9 times out of 10 the fries spilled in the bottom of the bag. Just think about that for a second.

If I could give them NO stars I would!! Worst customer service ever!!! They messed up my order than had such attitude when I asked them to fix it. When I asked the girl her name  she ignored me then gave it to me about 2 mins after (thinking it would bother me to sit in the drive threw and wait) I told her I have all the time in the world then she finally gave me her name, I asked for a manager and they brought me the  assistant manager, even though the manager was there- he came over and I told him what happened he just said "Ya your right" I'm sure the issue won't be fixed! If it wasn't for my kids love of happy meals I would never come here!

I don't normally complain about fast food establishments, I know how hard the work is for the amount of pay. That being said, this has been the worst MacDonald's I have ever been to. I go out of my way to McDonald's, not because of the food, but because they're know for fast and FRIENDLY service. I have been here 5 times and have received the same rude attitudes from different staff members. They all have the annoyed looks on their faces and you know they don't want to be serving anyone, they want downtime... They let me know that this afternoon.  From the drive thru to walking in, they never smile, they're are so "busy" that they get order wrong and when they say thank you and practically throw my food and drink at me, I leave wondering why I came back. I can guarantee I will never come back to this McDonald's ever again. The management needs to take responsibility for their team and train them on their service. If any of the workers are reading this, my review is not a personal attack. I know the food industry, I've worked it. Its not glamorous, but your smile truly can make or break a customers day. Strive to do better, I'm sure I'm not the only consumer to feel this way. God bless you all

This is possibly one of the worst McDonalds I have ever been too. They constantly mess up your orders, or the fries are always cold. If you ever order nuggets, check your bag before leaving, cause 9/10 they will forget to put it in the bag. 

Then there is the inside. Its almost always gross and dirty. If it wasnt right beside my house, I would never go there, ever.

Poor service. They don't know how to deal with excessive foot traffic. The employees go to the beat to their own drum and don't have any sense of urgency to make the "fast food" experience s fast one. Their drive thru has two speakers which is supposed to make the ordering process faster, however not having the double lanes it really defeats the purpose. All that said, let me make a general comment on McDonald's:

I am OK with McDonald's. I can eat lunch on the road, do a little work undisturbed, and get out the door cheaply. Panera and Starbucks are good stops for road workers like me, for the Wi-Fi and decent work space, but you struggle to have a meal on the cheap. I am in the field literally every day, and spending $8-$10 a day, every day, on lunch makes no sense for workers like me.

But at McDonald's I can have one of the under-400-calorie sandwiches, a side salad with dressing (balsamic vinaigrette; why does the staff always assume ranch?) and a large un-sweet tea for around $3.25, feel like I ate something, feel like I didn't kill my nutritional program, feel like I didn't blow my budget and get my work done.

The problem I have with them is that there are so many items on their menu that you just shouldn't put in your body. Their marketing is designed to point you towards high-calorie, high-carb, low-nutrition items. As I said, there are some good alternatives on the menu, and with some personal responsibility, common sense and self-discipline, you can make good choices. But it's like crossing a minefield: you shouldn't enter a minefield if you don't have to, and if you do, plan ahead and watch your step. But the guy who lays the minefield does bear some responsibility for the consequences.
No answer At the drive thru and then the guy at the window took our order and ran off to hoot and holler. A giant fail

This is one of the newer design McDonalds with the double drive thru and no kids play area. The dining area is a bit more upscale than the typical McDonalds and evidently plenty of seating as I've never seen it overly crowded here. The place has always been clean anytime I've been there. As for the food, I'm not really a McDonalds fan, but kids like stopping in here from time to time. I do like the fact that they now accept ApplePay, even in the drive-thru!
There were 3 hobos and a security guard  when I walked in, I left as soon as possible

Every time I go to this McDonalds I wait longer in the drive thru than going inside. The people are nice, but are beyond slow. I just waited 10 minutes from the time I ordered to the time I got my food, that is unacceptable.
In the dining room, the music is too loud.  The manager should turn down the volume of the music coming through the speakers in the dining room.

I hate McDonald's and I haven't been there in over a year for myself although I have picked it up for the kiddos. But, Chicken Selects are back and better than ever. I had to stop and get a quick fix with Buffalo sauce. Yum
Cashier was friendly. Requested hot fries, and they were hot when I got them. Frappe with extra caramel drizzle was awesome!! Dining area was clean.

Can be a hassle to get to if coming from the south, and it's connected to the gas station, so that's odd. No play-place, no "McCafe" area, but a solid McD's to have lunch at.

Staff is nice and friendly, and the food's fine during he rush...nice and fresh.

Managers and Crew at this location are extremely nice. Service is fast and friendly. You get hot food all the time and it's quick well organized even when it's busy. Has to be the fastest dt in town . 5***** location.

After reconsidering my previous rating of three stars, I just can't see it deserving more than two even comparing to other McDonalds locations.  They never check their bags before handing them out the window and I have arrived home too many times missing big items.  They pressure you to move fast through the drive through but o recommend you stay and check all the items in the bags.  Undoubtedly they will have forgotten something.  Don't try to call the number on the receipt either, they just won't pick up.
Went through the drive-thru real quick. I was able to get in and out fairly quickly. Fries are super hot. They did forget to get my water, but realized their mistake.

Well it's a McDonalds so we know what it is. This one's kinda busy, a bit messy. The food is ok, I mean it's a McDonald's so you know what you were getting. Nothing outstanding here but we all know that.
Just go to another one. Place is dirty.  People in the bathroom drinking  beer, taking showers.   More like a reststop for the homeless.   Just keep going.  You will find another McDonald's.
Well it's a fast food joint, one of the cleaner ones around. Service is pretty good here too.

The worst. This location used to be really good. The staff was quick and friendly, but recently there have been some dramatic staff changes.  The new staff is not knowledgeable about the menu, they are beyond slow, and the machines for hot chocolate, ice cream, and milkshakes are always broken. I come here twice per month on average so for these machines to be broken ever single time I enter is unbelievable! Plus the wait time is horrendous. There can be 5 people in line (all ordering one item)and you will still wait 25 minutes to place an order. What makes it worse is that while you're waiting, management and workers will be talking and laughing behind the counter.

Please avoid this place if possible.

Filthy Dirty..
Tables in morning are all greasy...
French Fries still laying around from previous night..
Freezing Cold and management states he has no control over thermostat..
Even though you may see up to 6 people behind counter and most of them managers try to get waited on...
Coffee is cold and old...

Awful food, horrible service, and slow lines. If it's past 11pm.....they won't answer you when you drive up. I've had to literally start talking into the speaker and lie and say I'm diabetic so that they answer and take my order. Their friends pull up to the windows and just hang out and talk to them. It's literally the worst service in Nashville. Their manager obviously doesn't care.
What can you say about McDonalds?  If you're going there expecting a good cheeseburger or big mac there exactly what you expected to be sober that I have to give them 5 stars.

Although it's McDonald's, which is always tasty, THIS McDonald's is particularly unprofessional, rude, and haphazard. Nobody seems to know what they're doing and the manager is just barking orders at people unprofessionally, as if we can't hear him. Grow up

Quarter Pounder doesn't come with a lot of stuff on it, but when I ask for no onions, I mean no onions. I'm allergic to onions. So I get a sandwich with onions. After I get home. Can't eat it. Waste of money. Done with McDonalds. Not worth it anymore.
I think they were having a bad day when I was there. They forgot the cheese on my filet O' fish and generally seemed flustered.

This is a very clean McDonald's with a friendly enough staff and fast enough service. The only reason for the average review is that their hours are really hit or miss. They close very early for a McDonald's in the city, even on the weekends. They also tend to leave their lights on even when no one is manning the drive thru, leaving the customer sitting there waiting for a voice that will never come. 
If they adjusted their hours to serve the late night crowd in Metairie, this would be one of the best McDonald's in New Orleans easily.
Staff are rude, they always get orders wrong and I always have to come back to correct  it. Worst McDonald's and food service ever! I wish they had another McDonald's nearby

A 24-hour drive-thru McD's, so if you hate yourself at 2am you can buy some burgers.

Last few times I've been in "my dark place" (my dark place is when I'm hungry and don't want to cook for myself), their credit card machine has been down.  So bring cash as well - also they took jalapeno mcdoubles off the menu, which is sad.

Closest McDonald's to me so I've been there out of convenience but almost always have a bad experience. They never get my order right and other times they charge me extra for a "large" meal that I didn't ask for. The fries are cold and soggy right out of the drive thru window so by the time I make my 5 min drive home they are not edible. The burgers are usually very dry and are more like a rubber toy than a burger. I would much rather drive anywhere else than five minutes away to avoid their terrible service and bad food. To be honest, this has to be one of the worst McDonald's in Tucson/Marana.

Yuck, that is all I can say about this location.
I don't expect much from a fast food restaurant, but this is one to avoid. 
First, counters at the register were noticeably dirty. It looks like they could care less about the counter. 
Then I started to notice other dirt and poorly cleaned locations. The drink dispenser area for example is not kept well. Then I noticed someone cleaning, he had a rag and was wiping down. Then he rearranged the lids. Wait, did I just see that. He took his wet dirty hand on the lids people place on their cups? 
Walls have soil marks as well. 
Second, it is March so I ordered the Shamrock shake. I've liked it before. Not this time, whoever prepared it has the formula wrong. Way too much mint and it ended up tasting more like toothpaste. It became drinkable after rigorous mixing and insuring all the whipped cream was mixed in. And it was not just mine, another person ordered one and it was the same. 
The fries tasted like they used stale frying oil. It is not a taste I like. 

This is why the place gets a one. I am seriously thinking of calling the health department. I tried to look up the restaurant performance with inspections and could not find it.

Today will be my last time driving thru at this McDonald's. My youngest wanted breakfast this morning. We have been to this location numerous times because it is so close to our home. I should have known this morning would be no different than any other time we have gone there. The only time you get an order correctly is if you go in and that is if you can deal with the long wait. There is nothing like getting home only to realize you did not get what you ordered. Never again. I will take the extra time to go to another location next time.
My salad was frozen.  The time stamp on the bottom said to use to 6:30AM, unfortunately I purchased my salad at 1:30PM.  How do you mess up a salad !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This is the worst McDonald's in the city. The service is terrible and the food is worse. The drive thru seems to take double the amount of time and they still don't get your order right. I've never received hot fries from this place. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else.

Worst McDonald's EVER. I have NEVER received the correct drink order. I order an UNsweet tea and ALWAYS get sweet. This has happened 4 times. It's disgusting. To make things worse I say extra ice and instead I'm convinced they give me no ice and EXTRA sweet!!!! It's now just more funny than anything. Bc I've accepted the fact they are incapable of doing the simple task of pouring a drink.

They got my order all wrong! I don't eat cheese on fish.  But was quick to correct the error and to upgrade my fries to a extra large which is why I come to McDonald's anyway; and a coupon for my next fish sandwich free very friendly staff just made a mistake as humans we make mistakes it's how you handle it

Doesn't deserve one star. My mcdouble was dry. Ends were dark brown of the patty , the cheese was old, there were no onions on it. Sorry to say although I'm new to the neighborhood I won't be returning.  Why sell food that's not fresh, especially why sell food that's been in the heating lamp for a couple hours or more. That's restaurant suicide these days, yes it's fast food but it still needs to be fresh. I would not recommend this location.  Apparently the owner doesn't care much about his customers.  Look at all these bad reviews.  Obviously something needs to change

Took the word Fast out of Fast Food, I went in this morning March 30th 2015 and ordered the 2 egg white delights for $3 and coffee, first sandwich was fine, second one was horrible, I opened it up to find a few very small pieces of egg whites smashed into the white piece of cheese! I showed it to the worker and she said, YEAH? I asked "You don't see anything wrong with this?" NO she states, I told her it is only a few lousy pieces of egg white and she told me ALL THESE COME PRE-MADE AND FORMED, I told her, this is not good! I don't want a free sandwich or anything else, just want them to know this place is tarnishing their name. You can't get a cup of coffee and sit outside in the morning to have a cig without herds of bums begging for a cig and/or money. I can't say homeless because I know some are in housing and drink away all their money and you see (mostly nights and early mornings) the garbage bins are overflowing and stacking up on the floor. I'll be going to the one on Tyrone Blvd from now on!

Felt fine until I went to this McDonald's. Either I have food poisoning or something on the Big Mac was bad. The bun was as hard as a rock. The French fries were hard, tiny and tasteless. McDonald fries are my favorite...not anymore!!!

Beware and don't stop here unless you don't care for quality food. 

;-(

Ate there today with my 3 kids under 5. The service was not only fast, but everyone was super polite and kind. The manager brought our food to our table. Another young lady helped with a small mess I had made. And one of the other staff was super helpful in assisting my girls while I was helping clean up the mess. Not only that, my food was hot when we got it and everything was as we ordered. I was super impressed and blessed by the wonderful service.
This is the worst McDonalds in the United States. Consistently bad service - in fact, the staff might try to make you have a bad day. Not sure if I'm being punked when I go here.
constantly forget food in the bag, long waits, breakfast is to be avoided at all costs!!!

Very slow drive thru.  I'm the next car and I'm writing this in the drive thru.  Every time I come here they're extremely slow.  Slowest McDonald's I have ever been too.   And every time they say they're waiting on hot fries but I don't understand why they don't have fries always ready because fries come with almost every meal so that's like saying they're waiting on a hot hamburger because they don't have any hamburger done it's ridiculous.
Always slow and filthy dirty inside. Bad even for a McDonalds. They rebuilt this place a few years ago but the outward appearance is misleading.
This restaurant is new renovated clean and pretty bright environment for lunch and dinner!!! P.S. Thanks for the medium mocha frappe today on April fool.
This restaurant is new renovated clean and pretty bright environment for lunch and dinner!!! P.S. Thanks for the medium mocha frappe today on April fool.
If you love cold McDonald's from yesterday, this is the spot for you. Serving it "fresh" all day. About a half step up from eating old fries off the floorboard of your car.

Newly remodeled McD's with friendly employees.

Sadly, that's where the positive traits end.  DISGUSTING interior that desperately needs to be cleaned.  The soda fountain, ketchup dispenser and surrounding area looked like their last cleaning was 2013.  The floors were caked with dirt.  Easily one of the dirtiest McDonalds I've ever been in.

To top it off, the bread on our sandwiches was stale and the soda was flat, regardless what flavor we tried.

Avoid this place.  Disgusting.

For three nights we have gone by, once at 2 am once at 3 am and once at 1 am to get fries and a coffee but they turned us away saying the registers are down. Definitely not open 24 hours like they claim when 3 hours a night they turn people away yet the lights are on and it says open.

I won't try again!

I rarely have a enjoyable, or even somewhat good experience here. From unable to take orders, unable to make change ( what business can't break a twenty dollar bill?), being clean, or hearing personal conversations between employees. I'm sorry I don't care about hearing about sexual activities when I'm trying to make my daughter happy with chicken nuggets.

So, it's breakfast time. One of the busiest times for this establishment. There was only one cashier with a long line. Ridiculous. He was going very slow, almost as if he was trying to be slow. 
I also work in the food industry and I've dealt with very long lines and you have to be fast and accurate to make the morning rush a success. Well, he was doing neither. 
Everytime I come here, there's only one cashier. That's just going to piss off customers. 
Decent hash browns.
Doesn't even know how to make coffee... Stay far away from this one.  The dunkin donuts next store is a much better option

Why is it some McDonald's are just better than others?  This isn't one of those McD's!  Stopped in for some McGrease breakfast and went to wash my hands before eating and almost barfed at the smell in the bathroom. There's a WalMart next door. They need to go there and buy a bottle of bleach. After I regained an appetite had the hash brown and it was cold and oil sogged. I wasn't expecting 4 star dining but was hoping for minimum bar at McD's
This McDonald's location gave me 3 raw McChickens last night and no receipt. The staff seemed fine but the food is going to force me to stay away from this location

I understand that it's a  minimum wage job but please, you still need to conduct yourself in a professional manner, especially the manager. I have been sitting here for almost 30 minutes and all I have heard is the employee's behind the counter SCREAM back and forth to each other and discuss their personal lives. Do you really think this appropriate? HECK NO, IT'S NOT!! AND BELIEVE ME, HECK ISN'T THE WORD I WANTED TO USE!!

What can I say? I go through the drive thru relatively often and my order is always correct and promptly done. Never had anyone be unfriendly either. I mean, is McDonald's. How much can you expect other than the basics? They've got those right in my experience! Will continue to come here.

Pretty much like a regular McDonald's, except cleaner compared to Philly standards. It's location is well suited in case you're out partying in the city (close to many clubs and bars), and can serve as a great midnight snack if you live in the Rittenhouse neighborhood.

This is a perfectly typical McDonald's. Food, service, and speed are all exactly what you would expect. The restaurant itself is generally clean and well-maintained. The staff is professional on the whole. There is really nothing exceptional about this location to make it stand out among its peers, either for the good or the bad.

I work near here, so I frequently stop for a bag of ice (and, let's not lie, an occasional cup of crappy vanilla coffee) on my way in to work.

This morning, as I was waiting in line to order (after having been ignored for fully three minutes with not even a, "Sorry, I'll be right there," from any employee behind the counter), a cockroach ran across the counter from under the cash register. A cockroach. Right next to the bag of food that had just been set there. A COCKROACH. MERE MILLIMETERS AWAY FROM A BAG OF "FRESH" FOOD.

Not only was it a cockroach, but it was a baby cockroach, the harbinger of infestation.

I am less horrified by the incident itself than I am by the fact that I've been coffee-ing (and, let's not lie, occasionally Egg White Delight-ing) here for over a year.

D.O.N.E.

Three stars were given because about the dozen times I've been here every employee encountered was friendly, courteous and very pleasant. This is big for me because I haven't found too many people working in that venue with upbeat attitudes.

As for the food - it's standard - sometimes the fries aren't as fresh or hot as I'd like. Only once did they give me regular coke when I asked for diet. No biggie.

The drive thru is awkward when you're trying to get back into Lancaster - weird turn and if you're waiting for the light to turn green it feels like cars coming in are going to hit you.

If you're coming here for a quick meal, before you leave....make sure you have everything. Utensils, condiments and such.

I eat at McDonalds all the time and when I order my food to go they always put everything I need in my bag. I ordered coffee and she asked me if I needed any cream or sugar, and I told her yes. Welp!!! There wasn't any in my coffee or bag when I finally received my order! Also, I had to go back twice to get utensils for my hotcakes and a stirrer! There's nothing more irritating than not having what you need when you've spent your money!

This location was very clean but the customer service was subpar. Great location as well!

Do I have to give them a star? I feel bad, the window people are always nice but I feel like they know they're handing you the fast food equivalent of the island of misfit toys when you order. I've literally never been here and gotten an entire order correct. Whether it's fries in the chicken nugget container or missing lettuce, tomatoes, or sauces nothing is ever quite right here. If my only two options were this McDonald's or a hunger strike I wouldn't be lining up in the drive through.
Nothing special, a typical McDonalds. What i do like it that if i ask for my food to be hot and fresh, they don't give me attitude :) polite and good customer service!

It's crazy how it's 8pm at night, no one in line at the drive thru, I ordered a large fry and a 20 piece nugget for my kids, and the fry and nuggets we get are cold. The fry was no way a large fry. It was a medium at best. Also most McDonald's in delaware have "family night" $2 happy meals on Wednesday and Friday nights, however this is the only McDonald's I've found that doesn't do it... Why? Poor quality and service all around.

This has to be the WORST McDonalds EVER! It was already bad before they rebuilt it. But I guess that was like putting lipstick on a hog smh. I've never once gone here and had my order correct! Not once! The management is just as bad as the workers. Just yesterday I watched a crew member and manager bicker about who was working there. They should replace the ENTIRE staff, except the older gentleman that usually works the drivethru. He's the ONLY person there worth a damn! Don't even waste your time!!!

This is a nice location.  They are fast, the food is always fresh. I really like  how they have the drinks. The McCafe is just great.  I'm a fan of the McNuggets and love the Fries, when it comes to fast food, Mcdonalds  is winning with those. Love the cookies, there so delicious  and warm. Really enjoyed  the new Frozen Strawberry Lemonade.
This location is so slow. Doesn't matter what time you come here.I don't understand why it takes so long.

This is not the Dinosaur McDonalds.  This is the McDonalds several miles east at Tanque Verde and Catalina Highway.  Went through the drive through at 9:30 p.m. for snacks.  The ice cream machine was 'not working', in other words, we started cleaning it 1 1/2 hours before closing.  We were then urged to order apple pies and when we did, we were told they were actually out and it would be 20 minutes before more were ready.  So we ordered fries and nuggets with ranch. When we got to the window a gal tossed a bag at us, nuggets and fries, no ranch.  Had to sit there calling out for attention to get some ranch (one) tossed at us.  We know you are bad (health-wise) for us.  We can't get what it is we actually want to order.  You are rude and don't care what we want.  Other places with similarly bad-for-us food are attentive and actually have available what is on the menu.   Why would we come back here??
Best McDonald's in the USA. Great Staff & Management. My family spends at least $100/ mo at this McDonald's location. Always courteous and accommodating when going thru drive-thru.

You think ordering a double cheese burger in a bowl with no bun and no condiments including onions would be easy. You would be right unless you tried getting it from this McDonald's. They have messed it up so many times I officially have given up. If I could give zero stars I would. There has been other numerous times they have messed up my wife's orders as well. So it's not just me being a nitpick about my personal experiences.

1 star because you have to. 2 weekends in a row they have messed up my order. This weekend they had me wait 15 min for food then when they did bring me my food they did even have the right order. I called the store and the manager said oh I'll  write it down. Not helpful I will never return to  this location ever. Rethinking ever going to any McDonald's anywhere.

One of the worst McDonalds in this area. They are so slow. I sat in drive thru for 20 minutes and when I received my food it was cold. How the hell does that happen? They're slow inside as well. Their prices conflict what's presented on the board. I've brought it to their attention in the past but nothing was done. I guess this is just more reason as to why I shouldn't eat McDonalds. Lol

Had to eat here on way to a tournament but will never return. The wait time and environment alone were so bad the food doesn't matter. I had no idea what I was getting myself into. There is no parking on this downtown street, so my husband dropped me off, at 7am on a Friday. There were at least 10 homeless people inside the Mc D's and it smelled like sour grapes. With 1 cashier it took 25 minutes to get two breakfast combos. Luckily, the gal making the food was wearing gloves, so I waited patiently. Also, I had to ask for cream for my coffee to mask the taste of burnt water.
Terrible service. Currently waiting on my food. Been waiting for 15 minutes.  Why McDonald's. Why...

Worst McDonald's I ever been to....you will never receive the right order and the taste is horrible...just order a hot chocolate...how can they mess that up, right?...well it was ice cold and I looked inside and the whip cream was curdled!!!!! Nasty mop looking water was inside...I feel like throwing up now!!!! Oh I was offered a replacement...flip it...keep it...I'm done with the Mickey D's bull!

The new create your taste and service is amazing! As this is the only McDonald's in Florida with this new service at this time, Wesley Chapel has hit the big time!
My meal even came with a card with name of the preparer.  So I say, Thank you, Ernesto. You did great.

Yes, I'm biased...I love McDonald's. But this is a solid location. Clean, quick, and consistent. The staff really seems to care. Nice, modern atmosphere that stands out over other McD's. 

I now avoid McDonald's locations that aren't up to my standards. But this location stands out as one of the best in the area. I pass other locations to visit this one.

This location happens to be your typical McDonalds. It's one of the newer renovations to reflect the whole make cafe theme. Overall I really stopped eating McDonalds and I don't really  havent indulged in McDonalds within the past 3 years but today I stopped in and said let me get a soda and tried out the new mini bundt cakes that I have seen advertised.

I feel like I paid way too much for a sprite with light ice. At that price I could have just went to the supermarket and brought a two liter bottle. The bundt cakes were actually surprisingly good, a little sweet but overall they were fresh. They were warm and you get two of in the case, a chocolate one and a cinnamon swirl.

After all this time I honestly do not miss indulging in McDonalds. I don't miss the long lines, greasy smell or the customer service. I don't really recommend McDonalds as a choice for a meal, but if you need a cup of joe, wifi and bundt cake stop in there. It's a cool location.

So now the $1 tea is no longer a $1?. That's bull!!! If i could leave a ZERO  star, I would!!!

I'm sitting a table away from some McDonald's exec's that have no freaking clue as to what's going on with the "conglomerate" because all they care about is their paycheck. And just to prove that I kniw what I'm talking about, there was an AA woman in black pants and a leopard print top hanging around the front counter. And the exec's sitting a table away from me, the younger gentleman mentioned that he had 4yo twins at home.

Worst McDonalds I have ever been! It's 5 minutes from my apartment. I have been there three times. None of these is a good experience. I got bad service, low quality food. When I did the drive through, they didn't even give me any napkin or tissue. The large fries you get is only the small to medium you can get in other place, but in a large paper bag!

25 YRS of living in this area this McDonald's has always struggled with customer service - Sunday only person in the drive thru place an order with food and drink ordered a 1/2 tea 1/2 lemonade - we can't do that - interesting I order that at other McDonald's at least 3x's a week - let me check (seems like 2 min later) as I'm sitting in the drive thru - no manager says we can't - ok 1/2 tea unsweet 1/2 sweet -  employee at the drive thru very nice - indicated manager would prefer you come inside for that - ok - may not always be convenient if you have kiddos in the car especially a special needs child - still during this whole time maybe one other car entered the drive thru - McDonald s customer service issues is not always the employees it starts with the manager training and how they choose to run their store and train and empower their employees.   The only reason I would give them 2 stars is the politeness of the drive
thru employees.

This McDonald's is nothing special. Only two or three employees seem to put effort in their job but the rest of the employees seem to just stand outside of the McDonald's socializing. At least when they are working, they seem to know what they are doing. 

The tables are usually dirty, so you have to wipe them down yourself. The food is the regular McDonald's food that is served at every other McDonalds. There is a small play area with games that do not work all of the time. 

If you have no other place to go, then you can go to this McDonalds.

I've been through a crap ton of Mcdonalds in different states, and I have never been disappointed until I found this one. It was close to our lodging location, so we stopped by at a familiar place expectin familiar service. 

We ordered just 4 McFlurries. It's only 10:30 in the evening and the staff couldn't be any more incompetent. This lady, I understood as my cashier because she was just in training. There were these two other stupid ladies that didn't process our order until we asked for it a second time, after 15 minutes have passed. 

Making ice cream isn't difficult. Surprise-surprise, I know yall work at McDonald's, but damn. Could you be any more stupid?

Nice clean location and a great crew.  There's not much I can say about the food.  It's McDonald's.  the food has a self life of half a minute and it's inedible.  Just eat it hot and you'll be good to go.  :)

Have you ever heard of an upscale to buje' McDonalds? Well this McDonalds has that atmosphere. When you walk in you stop to wonder for a second if you walk into McDonalds. the service is friendly and fast.  and the food is as good and fresh as any McDonalds. for fast food this is a good McDonalds to visit. in fact if it wasn't fast food I would have probably gave it 5 stars. When ordering breakfast this morning the manager asked if I would like a free coffee. it's nice to see good customer service at all levels that I want to earn your business.

This is the first McDonald I have seen kick people out. One person reading a newspaper (didn't look like a bum or anything bad) and eating breakfast and I was working on a paper. I literally was here for 33 minutes (including the time I was waiting in line for food), and they say they have a 30 min max. Several people thought they were joking but there security guard literally followed one person out.
They limit your drinks not only that but bought a jalapeño mcchicken isn't it suppose to have jalapeños ? My fries were old

I arrived at McDonald's 5 minutes before closing and while I understand that it can be inconvenient the associate was very rude and told us that she would give us what she had and that they were closing.  After leaving I realized she salted the fries to the point of being inedible.  While I hadn't gone to McDonald's in a while this definitely made me never want to return.  The costumer service was horrible.

This is the worst mcdonalds I have ever been too. If I am going to be trapped in this cult community, I at least want my shitty fast food restaurant to be on par with all the others. You could order a small fry, and they would have you pull forward and wait for it to be ready. I am completely convinced that a blind dog is the manager, but I wouldn't be surprised if these kids were managing themselves. A moment passes, and she comes back with someone else in tow, who rings it up and explains what needs to happen. Pull to the second window, where the woman is hanging out the window with my food, because I'm the one holding up progress. She thrusts it at me with "haveagoodday" and I pull onto Broad Ripple and hit the College light, where I discover that I have no sandwich in my bag. UGH. At that point, I had to go to work, so I fumed about this stupid 3 bucks I was out all day. (Yeah, it's the little, petty things for me.) I filled out the survey afterward explaining why I was so heated. Today, I found an email in my junk folder marked "Gratitude" with the following- "I'm very sorry for your unpleasant visit." No greeting, I had to look at the e-mail address to figure out it was from McDonald's! I have to laugh at all this, and because I laughed, I wanted to share it with you.

We slowly eased our way thru the drive thru at McDonald's​ store #36748 on North Michigan Rd. The time stamp on our receipt shows the order was taken at 10:32 AM. Convenience sometimes requires we make lesser quality dining choices, but that's one McD's I'd just as soon see close.
