I have visited this specific McDonald's location on four or five occasions, having lived very close to it for a number of years. Every single visit has convinced me further that this place is horribly run and has turned me off from giving them business for another six months to a year. At this point I'm finally done, having only given it too many chances because it is by far the closest fast food "restaurant" to my residence. A sampling of what is wrong with it:

-Customer Service-
Every single time I have ordered at this location, I have had to repeat every single detail of my order at least once. Example:
"I would like a six piece chicken nuggets with barbeque sauce to go please, no meal, just the chicken."
"And how many pieces?"
"Six..."
"With what kind of sauce?"
"Uh...barbeque..."
"And would you like to make that a meal?"
"No..."
"And is that to stay or to go?"
"..."

Somehow, even after that, they still manage to mess up my order the majority of the time. It's hard to blame them because they seem understaffed. The scene there is usually chaotic. Every employee is running around like a chicken with their head cut off constantly. And they have to put up with some very shady people all day...

-Clientele- 
There is a reason there are prominently displayed "no loitering, 30 minute time limit" and "free refills for dine in customers only" signs. This place is generally filled with more vagrants, drug addicts and prostitutes than a homeless shelter. Most of the time you have to step past drug dealer types and shopping carts full of cans to get into the front entrance.

-Hygiene-
As a consequence of the aforementioned customer base and staffing issues, this place is almost always absolutely filthy. People toss trash on the floor or leave it on their tables, and a lot of the time they can't be blamed because the actual garbage bins are overflowing. I fortunately have never set foot in the bathroom.

Do yourself a favor and go a couple blocks east to frequent the Wendy's there instead.

All in all not the meal I was expecting. I took the cheese off so I had a sirloin burger, which, if that was what I had ordered, I would have been happy with.  The meat was good.  This experience was inexcusable since I was the only car in the drive-thru and they had plenty of time to fix it correctly.  So, not ordering that one again.

As McDonald's continues to be made irrelevant, they have done some strange things to jack with customers.  For instance, they ran adds announcing that the cheeseburger would be a dollar, the double cheeseburger would be $1.50(raise in price) and the triple cheeseburger would be $2.  Fair enough, yet at the same time Nashville launched the Triple Cheeseburger for $2.39, despite the national advertisements that ran to the contrary.  It wasn't just that it was more expensive than the commercial, but that they were actually advertising it in their stores as a "special".  
Currently, the McDonald's here are advertising their "spicy McChicken" for $1.29, as the special.  Meanwhile, the regular McChicken (which is the spicy one in most states) is still $1.  How can you advertise a special by INCREASING the price of an item.  This makes no sense.
Last complaint.  All drinks at McDonald's are $1.  I can get a large Diet Coke for a $1.  I don't particularly like french fries, so when i order a combo meal I generally ask for the drink to be a large without increasing the size of the fries.  That has always been free while all drinks are $1.  However, Nashville McDonald's have begun charging an extra .30-.50 to increase the size of the drink, which they have NEVER done before during the $1 drink promotion.  WTF?  This makes no sense and is only going to piss off customers.
My patronage at McDonald's has fallen to once every two months or so, but these marketing disasters had to be documented.
Given that, this Bellevue McDonald's is always very busy when I pass by, and I've never had a problem with the service or good (Beyond stale fries).
I do see an end to McDonald's.  Long live the Chipotle era.

The reason that this McDonald's is of particular interest is that it provides a good visual contrast of old versus new fastfood chains. What was probably only 10 years ago (?) the eating highlight in the area, and maybe 20 years ago (?) a place where people wanted to go, is now clearly the most out-of-time-and-place restaurant in the area. This place looks like a dump - no new paint in many years, all the lights on the McDonald's sign probably don't work (I think a good indicator that a business isn't doing well is that they stop replacing the lights in their sign), and the inside tired and worn. And the advertising on the windows (e.g., highlighting current specials) is old school. 

In contrast, just down the street, are maybe the best (or at least very good) examples of contemporary and very successful fast food chains: Bobby's Burger Palace,Sweetgreen, and Chipotle. These places are clean and have contemporary design (food and eating area). I'm not convinced the food is healthier at these places versus McDonald's, but the food does taste much better. And the advertising at these new place more clever (especially Chipotle's cups and takeout bags).

These new chains are where people who have extra $ (and even people who don't have extra $) go. Looking at the people going into these restaurant chains on Walnut Street, mostly only the people who don't have much $ go to McDonald's. 

McDonald's is to Bobby's Burger what Jordache is to Diesel Jeans. Except that isn't exactly right because I think in some circles Jordache still has some cachet and in no circles does McDonald's have status. 

I'm all for McDonald's making a come back (go USA!), but looking at this McDonald's on this street I just don't see it happening. 

Update: the very next day after posting this review I ate at Chipotle. I saw a father eating Chipotle who was with his son eating a McDonald's Happy Meal. Turns out Chipotle does have a kid menu, just not posted. Seems like kids are a group Chipotle could better target.

Food: I have several menu items I like from Mickey D's, one of my favorites being the grilled sweet chili chicken premium McWrap. I also like the cookies! I don't think I've had anything bad at this location and if you like fast food, it's a fine choice. Oh--I DO recommend the oatmeal. McD's oatmeal is one of my favorites, trumping even that of the fast Starbucks! 

Drinks: Best Coke around! McDonald's has their own special syrup!

Atmosphere: This is a new McDonald's so it's pretty nice inside. The tables aren't always clean and there are sometimes flies buzzing around (drive-thru problems, not the fault of the restaurant), but it's generally a nice place if you're opting to sit-in and enjoy your meal. 

Service: I once stood at the counter for about 4-minutes before I was even acknowledged. Even then, my order didn't come out right away, and no one else was even there or in the drive-thru line. I have definitely had good experiences at this Mcdonald's, but some poor ones as well.

Happy Hour Offerings: 

Healthy Hack: Try the grilled sweet chili chicken Premium McWrap. It only has 340 calories if you order without cheese & garlic sauce (I add honey mustard)! The grilled Southwest Salad is also a great option. Go with honey mustard for dressings as it has the lowest cals. Want coffee? Try it black and add your own sweetener. Their brand is very high cal/sugar! If you like a healthy breakfast, try the oatmeal. It has a much higher nutrient content than the other options.

They denied ketchup to me at the drive-thru one time and went without punishment.  That is my rating on McDonald's of the Conchester.

If you expect a burger, you'll get it and $500 worth of fraud.  I don't use drive throughs for this very reason and on the day I visited I was rushed and had no cash, so I charged it. The employee "dropped" my card, I'm sure the skimmer was easier to hide below the register.  That weekend my card had multiple failed attempts for purchases and I terminated the card number.  Thanks, McDonalds!

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever been to.  Service is terrible, seating is limited due to the stupid architecture, and the drive thru is HORRIBLY slow.  It is faster to drive to the Sunnyside location than to go here if you live in McCordsville.
toy game weak. Like i mean burger king gives you dem crowns and then a toy on top of this while my boy micky d only gives you a crappy minion toy. Also they never give extra sauce

Worst McDonalds experience I have ever had!  I pulled around the girl asked me to go to spot 2 cause it would take a few minutes.  I did not get my food for 20 minutes!  The guy next to me at spot 1 waited 25 minutes!  I then asked for the GM's phone number and they did not have it but said they we're going to get it!  I waited 7 minutes and they never came back out!  The sad thing is there was 5 cars behind me in the drive through, and they all got there food before me.  I will never go back here

Hey. It is Fast Food. But the service was fast and efficient. 

Food was standard McDonalds faire. You know what you are getting. 

The restaurant was clean in the dining room and in the restrooms. 

There was nice handmade decorations for the fall season around the restaurant.

They've messed up my breakfast order nearly every time I go through the drive thru! What's up with that!? I usually don't make complaints but I called back on my order was missing its ingredients and the manager was vague on being sorry.? What's up with that also?
I'd rather go hungry than visit this drive-thru. Rude, unfriendly employee, slow service and cold food. Absolutely terrible, even by McDonald's standards.

Best McDonald's I have ever been too. The facility is always clean, employees awesome, food is always hot, and fresh. Also, I have no idea what they do differently to their sausage biscuits, but they are consistently the best I have ever had. This location is one of two in a 2 mile radius, but trust me, drive 2 extra minutes. It's worth it!

Stopped there is October 2015 and ordered a cheeseburger kid's meal. For the drink I ordered an apple juice. They said there would be an up-charge for the juice. I've been to many McDonald's before and after this time and have never been charged extra for a child's apple juice. I also ordered an ice water with the meal. I was told that the water would be $1. So, I promptly said to give me the free cup of water. No free water, they all cost $1. Again, only  at this McDonald's.

That's one way to run away business! Now, when the baby wants McDonald's I will drive out of my way to avoid this one.

I have been to many a McDonalds in my life, and this one is by far the worst. The first thing you notice when you walk in is the smell. It's a combination of stale BO, cheap floor cleaner and grease. It's terrible. 

The second thing you tend to notice is the clientele. It's like every bum and "people of Walmart" type person in university city. 

The food is terrible (even by McD's golden standards), the restaurant is incredibly dirty, the bathroom is unusable. If you do decide to go here, lord help you. Check your bag before you leave because you will probably have been given the wrong items. Also probably wash your hands.

I feel bad for the people that work at this McDonald's and even the store itself has weird practices. 

Firstly, their late night menu is limited and has slightly more expensive choices. None of their dollar/value menu. They're also cash only...or they were atleast when I was there around 2:30ish before a much-needed trip to Fresh Grocer. I always carry cash and my card, but, I can see how this can cause chaos in the store. Especially, when you have like 25 drunk college kids in line. 

Don't even let me get started on them...I am 23 years old before I come off as an old fart, "Get off my lawn."-type. I party...even rave. I embarrass myself and do stupid shit. However, I have never walked into an establishment like it was my house and just left a whole thing of trash on a table and just had complete disrespect for everybody. The place isn't the cleanest to begin with and that adds on. 

There's also the people from the Consortium and other nearby clinics that hang in there all day...but, that's a whole-nother-ball game. 

I'll give them a star back for being McDonald's (everything is standard for the most part) and the extended in a convenient location.

The food was okay. The chicken nuggets were not very good. They have very bad and unhealthy meat. The fries made up for it though which are really good. The service was good and was out in 3 minutes. Great place to stop by on the road, not if you are looking for over the top food.

Okay, I think I was way too generous giving this place two stars previously.  After going through the drive thru yet again this evening, I vowed once again never to return.

There are two lines on the drive thru.  I pulled into the empty lane and waited and waited and waited.  Meanwhile, three cars were services in the other lane.  I spoke to the speaker and said hello and tried everything.  No response.  Finally as I was pulling away to backup into the other line someone answered.  I complained but couldn't get an apology at the very least.  The most I could get was an apathetic reply.  After the compliant, I thought for sure a manager who was listening on the speaker system would come speak to me.  Nobody really cares.

I still ordered and you could probably guess that things were missing from the bag and I had to remind them of missing items.  I know from prior experience to never drive off from this location without checking.  

Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.

This morning while headed to work I stopped at McDonalds like I do every other morning ,so around 7:36am .  I pull out of the drive thru and began drinking my drink(mocha frappe). As i Wisk the mocha frappe thru my mouth this I felt a foreign object I suspected to be a chip of ice. But later discovered it wasn't once my mouth wasn't filled with the cold drink. I proceeded in turning around and heading back to the restaurant, after confronting the drive thru person who had made and handed me the drink she chuckled a little and told another manager who acted as if she didn't care and proceeded to go to the back and get another manager acting as if I wasn't standing there . Before walking into the store I made sure I gathered myself and wasn't completely irate. But the level of seriousness and professionalism only lead me to believe things like this happened all the time. Shortly after a woman who I believe is the general manager came out to do an incident report on was instructed that I will get a call back within 48 hrs. The way this was handled was completely unprofessional and I feel there should be some kind of investigation done on this place so that things like this don't happen again.

Ordered the sausage gravy biscuits with large Coke they had no large cups there was no sausage in the gravy which was put in a tub with no lid spilled out everywhere and forgot my straw typical mcdonalds
This is a  high class restaurant that has the fanciest of service. The workers are high trained professionals, most France. The options there are hand made and the wine is to die for.

Long long time ago this was the best McDonald's ever. 
Food was hot and fresh. Now the food is dry. Breakfast or lunch. I think they cannot do so many items well. 
They could go back to just burgers fries and shakes. Too many variations for the staff to get right.

The staff here are a very obliging and diligent bunch.  The food quality can be a bit inconsistent, as it is at many locations of the McDonald's chain.  Likewise, the dining room could be a bit cleaner at times.  (The area around the drinks station, unsurprisingly, always seems to be a bit messy with trash and spills.)

Try the create your taste option for a unique customized McDonald's meal.  Having tried it once, I was sufficiently impressed by same that I might try it again.  Recommended.

Stopped in just before midnight to get some food, was very leery at the fact I may be in the drive thru line a long time, but actually it didn't take that long at all. In fact I ordered a couple Egg McMuffins, they told me it would be 2 minutes for fresh eggs I said no problem. This visit was actually very nice.

Extremely slow service. Then they never apologize for being slow. Should not take 15 minutes in a drive through. They are not customer service friendly at all wish I didn't even have to give them one star

I don't think Ive been here since cutting hs w my friends! Its improved but what a crowd!  Strangers talking to us spooked my daughter!   

Im ready to eat my hand - skipped lunch and apparently breakfast all day is popular!   Waiting and waiting ....

Only thing Id order here - the rest goes through me like a freight train!!!!

Food was pretty tasty, as usual. Unfortunately they got my boyfriend's sandwhich wrong. He asked for no pickle no onions & got extra pickle extra onions on his Big Mac. 

He brought it back, they were really nice about it & fixed it right away. I just think that the cashier needs to pay closer attention the first time to avoid these mistakes because if we were going through drive thru & didn't notice til we hot home I think we would have been very upset. 

Also, the lobby was very dirty! It appeared as tho they haven't swept or mopped the floors all day & the tables were dirty as well.

The lobby is a little dirty. I ordered a Big Mac no pickles no onions. Some how I got extra of both and no salt on the fries. Yes salt on the fries. 

Saving grace, the people were very nice on fixing the order.

We will see next time.
Can't believe this pit stays open. Like walking into a Fellini set. Disgusting. Dirty.
Came here for drive through one morning. Took about 25 minutes between waiting in line and waiting for food. Too long for a breakfast "on the run". Been to better McDonalds' drive through.

If you want to waste 10 min waiting for someone to take your order in the drive through then this is the place for you!  Then I was asked my order and sat there for another two min waiting for a response....I work at a day care with 2 year olds so I really love getting off of work and still having to repeat myself 5 times.  Ended up driving to the Bayless location where the food is hot and the employees actually do their job.  Way to Mackenzie point.
Food was cold and the ice Carmel mocha was just coffee with ice not to mention they shorted me 2 dollars in change the worst Mc D's I've been to

I'm going to start this review by saying it's my fault for returning to this location so many times. But, it is the only place, other than a gas station, that's open at 4am. And with where I live, I have to give my self extra time to go here because I don't pass it on my way to work. 
One morning I go to this location at about 330am or so. Their drive thru is suppose to be open 24 hours. However, when I arrived both drive thru lanes were blocked. So no breakfast that morning.
I wrote to the company because you can't advertise 24hour service and  not actually be 24hours. I receive a generic  letter with a coupon for a free sandwich at this location. In addition, a phone call. Funny thing is the time they choose to call. Clearly I would be working as I stated in my letter to them I work early mornings.
After a week or so I decide to give them another chance. I go around 4am. They are open this time. However, i am told at to drive thru they can only accept  cash. Okay, i thought, your credit card machine is down. It happens, not your fault. But no breakfast for me.
I try again maybe another week later. Again I am told they can only accept cash. Odd....but this time I had cash. I ordered and went to pay. This is where things were fishy. I got no receipt. So I don't know if I was charged right. They had someone doing the calculations on paper. I asked if this is an every day thing and the person at the drive thru window said this happens every morning. A multi million (or is it billion?) Dollar company has the inability to take credit card every morning. That doesn't seem right. Well there was nothing I could do so I get my food and leave. Only to find out half way to work, they gave me the wrong food. I should note that while ordering I had to correct them twice for what I wanted. I just wanted two egg mcmuffins. The ones with Ham. What did I get? Two sausage mcmuffins. I threw them away. What a waste.
I again return about a week later (at this point I should have just given up). Same thing as before, only cash, no reciept. But they gave me the right food. That was good. I took a few bites and everything was good. And then it wasn't. Something was crunchy....that shouldn't be. Best I can guess is there was egg shell in my sandwich. At least that's what I hope it was because I'm not sure what else it could be. I threw them away.
Today was my last day to go to this location. I ordered my two egg mcmuffins and an orange juice. A gain all cash no receipt. Well unless an orange juice is like 5 dollars, I know was over charged this time, but there is no way to prove it.
I have finally given up on this location. It really is unfortate as I do enjoy their breakfast. But I've wasted so much money on their mistakes. Do yourselves a favor and go somewhere else.

My wife and I are from out of State visiting relatives for Thanksgiving for a week as we have done for several years. We frequent this location often during our visit. 

Keep in mind this is McDonald's and compared to many that we have seen in various states, I feel this one is exceptional. It is very clean with quick service and the staff was very friendly and courteous.

Dual drive thrus make it easy to get a Half/half tea when the person in the other lane is apparently ordering 1 of everything off the menu. Mine was a quick in and out trip and It took less than 3 minutes to order and get my tea. 

I am sad though. Large Iced teas no longer are $1.00. Le sigh.

I almost just threw up all over this Mickey D's! Let me start by saying the food is ok, but no matter how good or bad food is its hard to keep it down when someone comes and sits next to you and starts changing their baby's diaper. It's hard to describe what table had the used diaper on it so if you ever eat here keep in mind it might be the one your food is on. What makes it worse is that two employees knew about and said nothing. It appears she is related to one of the Hispanic employees. I cannot describe in words how disgusted I am right now. Also, there are a few loud bums in the store hitting on other customers and conversing with some employees like they are old friends. It only took ten minutes for me to remember why I haven't been to a McDonald's in over two years.

this McDonalds has fast service (they have 2 drive thru lanes). i love this idea!

the woman in the morning who takes your money at window #1 is the best. She is sweet, genuinely happy to see you, and makes small talk enough to make you smile. 

food is mcdonalds... so let's be real its not your mom's homecooked food. i'm just here to talk about their service =)

I waited 10 minutes for two Egg McMuffin's. My hashbrowns were double dipped and burnt. I did the survey and got a call from a manager. She apologized after I told her what happened but never offered any kind of complementary coupon.

Yup still as slow as before. Ugh makes no sense. This is the only location I've ever been to where it is a minimum 10 minute wait in line. I really just do not get it. I'm sitting in line at the drive through as I write this review. So far I have been in line through 4 songs. LOL thats how I time the wait. So you figure I've been here at least 12 mins. Now I continue to wait because I want to see if the receipt shows the time I placed my order...........ok finally. Placed my order at 10:15 received it at 10:30.

Went through drive through. Kept screwing up my order. Food utterly disgusting. Waited a long time for soggy hash browns. Steak/Egg/Cheese bagel stale and truly gross and nasty. Had to immediate spit the food out. Such a bad experience the one time I tried them that I can't bring myself to go back there. 

Alas, there are no good McDonald's in the general area (though this is, by far, the worst in the area). I don't see how any of them stay in business ,but they seem to get by (only one farther down route 30 toward Wayne has shut down, I think). Are they really making money off the sale of their food?

Just go home and eat something from the fridge!  They can't even get two pieces of cheese on a DOUBLE cheeseburger. Plus, it was so cold the cheese didn't melt by the time I got home. Something has to CHANGE!!!

Yes, drive-up service is that bad. Tonight I stopped for for a pumpkin spice latte. The guy at the window took my order, I paid, and when I got to the second window, I was told they did not have lattes. I replied that it would have been nice if the person at the first window had notified me that they were out before I paid. I then ordered a hot coffee with cream and sugar sub, and also asked the person taking the order at the second window to be sure the coffee was hot. The thing is I love McDonald's coffee, but I like it hot.
Last week I ordered a grilled chicken snack wrap, and paid at the first window. When I got to the second window, I was informed that they were out of grilled chicken. They couldn't have communicated that to the guy at the order window? The manager did nothing, and she was standing there, looking on, no apology or explanation. It's like this McDonald's is being run by a bunch of ill-trained newbies, and it never gets any better. There is usually a wait, there is confusion at the windows. The owner of this McDonald's needs to take a good look at the incompetence at this location. The McDonald's on East Prater is so much better at customer service.

Horrible place. 11:02am this Saturday morning we went threw the the drive threw to order breakfast since they  advertise all day breakfast. The breakfast menus were still up and said all day. Nope, we were told they weren't serving breakfast. What a joke.

Went there today and I must say it was a bad experience.  Me being a diabetic I ordered a diet coke and my husband ordered a regular coke.  Well the staff member who poured the sodas did not specify which was diet. So we were lead to play the guessing game. When we tried them both, they both tasted the same, so needless to say, I went without a drink because I was too mad to go into the store and explain the situation..

Horrible service, moldy bread on my grandson's hamburger, cold french fries and when we showed the bread to the manager he was very  rude. I'm not crazy about McDonalds to begin with, but the kids like it. All that being said, I will never ever go back to this particular McDonalds.
I'm not even exaggerating when I say this is the worst and slowest McDonald's in Tucson. Avoid.

They say they're open 24 hours, but that's only true if you OWN A CAR because that's the only way you can get food from them between 11pm and 6am.

The idea that a place can only be open to car drivers is silly in the most extreme sense. If I don't have a car, why am I not worthy to get food?

The food was totally fine and as to be expected from this chain but this restaurant... Wow, the dirtiest one I've ever been in. Gross! 

Pretty convinced they clean the table tops with Pepsi because our arms stuck to it! The bathrooms, the floors, counter tops, everything was sticky, dirty and disgusting. 

Unlike other reviews the service was fine and fast but this place is gross. We used the play center area but my daughter wasn't too interested in playing on it. We ate and quickly washed up and got out!

Dirty.  Soda machine often needs refilling and staff often has excuse why they can't do it right now.  Last time I got breakfast, biscuits were cold, hard and dried out.  French fries often end up sitting too long (also hard and dried out).  Staff people do seem to try.  Problem is bad management.  McDonald's used to do great quality control; not anyt more.

This location sucks. I have had problems in the past but tonight made me get on here to review. Just went through drive-thru and brought food home. Buns were stale, sandwiches were made sloppy, and meat was overcooked. Don't think I will be going back to McDonald's for a very long time.

I used the drive-thru today and had a great experience. I visit this McDonald's frequently and always have a good experience. 
I regularly have a special order of a quarter pounder plain w/o cheese and they get it right. 
There was only one time they were out of Diet Coke but overall I always have a great experience here, I highly recommend it!!!

3 Stars for the service

Ok, this is just another ordinary McDonald's. The food, decor, and setup is pretty much the same as any other Micky-D's. The service can be hit-or-miss and it can be randomly busy on any given day. Restrooms are typically clean but the major drawback is there isn't a playground!!! NO PLAYGROUND! So, if you're like me and really love to slide down a little slide after a few McNuggets well, you're going to need to pass on this establishment. Frowny face incoming     :-(

WHATEVER YOU DO AVOID THIS MCDONALDS!!! I was here today, and I asked for a sauce while we were ordering and the lady said ok. This happens every time I come here. 
        ALWAYS SKIP THIS LOCATION. There is one that is 1 mile away and it is much better. NEVER COMING BACK.
Incredibly slow drive thru on a Monday night, in excess of 10 minutes wait time to fill the three orders in front of me

STAY AWAY!!!!! 

Don't even bother going to this McDonald's, take a cab to another one. I'm giving one star because the food tasted fine and I can't give no stars. This is the worst McDonald's we have EVER been too and we're from Las Vegas so I think we've had our fair share of bad McDonald's. This takes the cake. We are here for another week and will never go there again. 

They need not only new employees but new management.

Let me start off by saying I am fully aware I am about to write a review for McDonald's but for this specific location, I feel my review is absolutely necessary. I do not eat the food McDonald's serves often, maybe once every few months or so, but I do like to order a milkshake or a McFlurry one in a while. I've gone at different times throughout the day on multiple occasions only to be told the same thing, the shake/ice cream machine is down. Over four weeks I was unable to have my order fulfilled, so I decided to contact the restaurant manager AND corporate. The restaurant manager had no idea of the shake machine being down or broken at all, and corporate had only one claim report of the machine being down. So basically that means the employees were lying all of the times the machine was "down", besides the one time it really and truly was down. I do not have high expectations for McDonald's whatsoever but I do expect McDonald's to run business as any other restaurant would and employ employees who wouldn't lie to their customers.
didn't even order, just  used the bathroom. probably one of the top 5 best experiences of my life

I don't usually write reviews on franchise places such as this, but seeing that i've been here a bunch of times and still see zero review, I had to write a little something about it. This is your standard McDonald's. Its clean, has inside seating, no outside seating, no playhouse, two drive-in's, and on the corner of a busy intersection. I usually come here if I'm feeling way to lazy to cook and just want something fast. Most of the time ill use their drive-through and idk if its just when we go, but it always seems busy. Regardless of that the line usually goes pretty fast. The people who work here seem pretty patient and nice, never got one of those mean fast food people here yet...maybe I should try and push there buttons. JK. 
Anyways, all in all its fast, easy and tasty (fast food standards).

Been here quite a few times. Mostly come to let my girlfriend's kids to play in the playplace.If it wasn't for the play place we would likely never order food from here. Everytime we come there are more dirty tables then clean(especially in the play place) , and our orders are done incorrectly. We end up having to clean our own tables before eating most of the time. This used to be my favorite McDonald's to go to but now its one of my least favorite. It could be again with a little bit more attention on the cleanliness of the lobby, better communication , and orginization of the staff. I hope to see this place flourish again but its going to take some work.

Slow service. Been there twice and twice the service was at a snails pace in the drive thru.


Today at around 4:15pm I ordered thru the drive thru for just a large iced tea with half sweet and half unsweetened.  The SUV in front of must've ordered half the menu because I sat there for at least 15 mins after I paid for my 1 item waiting for her order.

This is where the manager should've moved the SUV along  to a designated waiting area specially if her order is not ready thus allowing someone, like me, to process their order. That did not happen.

...and to add salt to injury,  they got my order WRONG!!!! 

No bueno, senor!

I typically won't review fast food restaurants but this establishment awe-inspired. Never have I seen a general manager (Blake L.) as engaged and determined to deliver food to his customers as promptly and accurately. He encourages his employees to do the best job they can praising them when they do a good job and providing them with constructive criticism when improvements need to be made. I was able to witness all of this within the course of a few minutes while waiting for my food. I arrived at a remarkably busy time of day,  ordered a grilled chicken wrap and received a crispy chicken wrap. I mentioned the mishap to Blake and was astounded by how professionally and promptly he handled the situation. The establishment is clean, condiments and plasticware are well stocked, and the entire staff seems to coordinate well with one another to ensure customer satisfaction.

This was one of the worst experiences at a fast food place I have ever experienced. The service was extremely slow for the drive-thru. The employee that gave me my order was very rude when I told her my order was incorrect. I was very polite even though she rolled her eyes at me and questioned me a few times like I ordered incorrectly. She then handed me a soda with soda all over the outside of the cup. I will NEVER go back to this McDonalds.

I love Macdonald since today!!! I've been looking at this cashier lady for long time,anytime when she start placing my ordes she giving us dirty looks and being so rude I guess she doesn't likes Spanish people....today she treat my 10 years old girl really mean so I left i just said never mind cause that Hurst me to much.....so this an old white lady with glasses, I'm sorry about this but it's something that people can't take

Don't get me started on probably the worst McDonald's employees of the 21st century. This place is horrid and I mean HORRID. I ordered a chicken sandwich and it had no box and was just thrown in a bag with no bag or anything ?!?!? I went one night not knowing that they were closed early and a big black man was laughing at me and dancing when I realized the door was locked! This place needs a new staff!

I would give this restaurant a zero if I could, I arrived before the closing time and they wouldn't let me in to order or use the restroom. The sign said they were open until 1130 I showed up at 11:25 and was not allowed to order. The manager was very rude and not professional!

Free coffee for the week in posting this (across McDonald's Canada) and happy staff with interesting takells to tell gives me a happy moment.

Three-star quality food, hyper-consistent but soulless, is what it is.

At least there's the free coffee, while it lasts, and the happy staff and their tales.

Hit and miss. 

Front of house is always super friendly and helpful. 

Back of house must be asleep. Ordered some Filet-O-Fish and they looked "slapped" together. Have a little pride in what you do!! Make the sandwiches the way they are shown on the pictures. Service is very slow. 

Very slow kitchen. There was no-one in the place and it took 10 minutes to get my order.

If I could give no stars I would. I have lived a few miles from this McDonald's for 9 years and 80% of the time we have a horrible experience. Either the order is wrong, missing items, and/or it takes forever. 

Today was the last straw. We went through the drive through to get my wife and I some food on the drive to thanksgiving. The kids ate but we didn't have time to eat ourselves. Long story short we had to pull up in the drive through and wait as usual. After 8 minutes I went in and the order had been removed from the screen. They packed what I told them and they still missed the fries. The couple behind us waiting also had to go in to get their food. Worst part was the shift manager didn't say a word to me when she handed me the food. No "sorry for the wait",  just nothing.

If you have an opportunity to visit this location, skip it.
This place is good. The workers are very friendly and keep the place looking nice. For a McDonald's it's one of the best I've been to.

Very disappointed. Offer a sale on Sausage McMuffin with Egg and then they don't even make it the right way. Egg is not supposed to be folded like the biscuit sandwiches. I wonder if McDonalds corporate would be ok with them changing the recipes. Consistently get sub-par food from this location. Needs new owners/management.
Almost every time I eat here, the food tastes dry,like it was cooked an hour ago. If you really want to eat at Mcd's, go elsewhere.

If their was a zero that's where we would be ...I pay 3.59 everyday for a Plain Fish sandwich my order is wrong everyday they either leave the cheese or the sauce on today the Manager David threw the sandwich inside the box to me needless to say your be #Boycotted

Given that this McDonalds is right down the street from one of the largest high schools in Pennsylvania, you shouldn't be surprised when the joint is inundated with teens at the fringes of the school day. Terrible service. Had to wait 10 minutes to get two things. They need a better management. Employees are either on the phone or eating or just walking around.

I wish I could rate below one star because I was not even able to get anything. We noticed a person in the parking lot at someones car smoking cigs, who in turn ended up being an employee. We pulled around through the drive through to try and order at the window and someone already had did that and we waited behind him for a while and then just decided to leave. Worse Mcdonalds experience ever.

Drive through very slow. The attendant ask me to wait and forgot there were cars in line. Employee taking the cash only said $8.94. The young lady at the next window said nothing, just unfriendly handed a bag. Half fill fries and a cold big Mac
I love the people who work here but you should note they have just raised the price on all drinks.   Was $1.00.  Now raised 20%

Just ate at this location and it by far was the best food I have ever eaten at a McDonald's. The fries were hot and salted well. The burger was excellent looked like the picture. I will only eat at this Mcdonalds. Keep up the great work.

11AM Sunday morning, when lunch starts I ordered 2 cheeseburgers in the drive thru. They told me they didn't have cheeseburgers... I parked and went inside and ordered 2 cheese burgers... After standing there for 5 minutes I asked for the manager and said, "all I ordered was 2 cheese burgers" she gave me attitude and said they weren't ready yet...

Funny how for 30 years McDonald's always gave you a problem for ordering breakfast after 11AM, and ironically I couldn't get lunch after 11AM...  

I stood there another 5 minutes still no cheeseburgers. The manager didn't care, and I knew at that point they just were not going to give me my order. Finally the poor girl at the register gave me a bag and I stormed out... When I sat down in my car and opened it was a Big Mac!

I had to laugh. 

In the event anyone ever reads this , it was in November 2015 and was a Sunday... And the manager, well she was a jerk.

Really rude woman with a million piercings at the register. I was waiting on her to refill the receipt paper when she gave me the international hand signal for hurry up. Perfect fit for their team. Food was perfectly greasy.

Without a doubt, the worst McDonald's on the planet. I've tried and tried and tried. I've supported the localness of this Mc D's as I know it provides several jobs in the area. I've even sworn it off that I would never ever ever go again, then forgotten and because I have an 8 year old....found myself in the drive through a tonight, but this is the very last time for this location. EVER. Sausage McMuffin? Ice cold. Nuggets? Barely cooked. French fries and hash brown? Absolutely still frozen. Cheese sticks? So hard, it was like the plastic was still on the cheese stick. milk? Expires today, so I can let that one go, I guess. 
I'm giving it one star because today's experience was quicker than the last time in line which had my car trapped in the drive through for 48 minutes, no exaggeration and then delivered the wrong food and because the soda is absolutely perfect. McDonald's must have some patent on getting the ratios right on their sodas, because they are consistently awesome, no matter where you go.

writing this review while sittin the drive thru. it's been about 20 mins I have yet to get my food and three cars from behind me have already pulled out of line and went to Wendy's. I should of done that same.

"It's McDonald's," I said to myself. "They're all the same so it can't be that bad right?" 
Boy was I wrong. This one IS that much worse. 

I got a McMuffin, hash brown, and iced coffee through the drive-through. The service literally sucked butt. First and foremost- they didn't even talk to me at the window, let alone provide ketchup. It's a first world problem, I know, but after having the Mickey D generic dry hash brown and barebones McMuffin, I then had the pleasure of discovering that they didn't even bother to give me a straw for my coffee...Which was more like 95% international delight, 4% ice, and maybe 1% diluted coffee. Gross.

I agree with all of the other reviews- this place sucks. I'd rather starve on my commute next time than come back. Hell, I probably wouldn't even trust them with an order of soda...how in the world do you forget a straw??!

I've been going to this McDonald's for years and for the past two months, I've had to wait longer than usually (15-20minutes). I went to McDonald's today and I placed my order at 10:45, I did not leave the drive thru until 11:20!!!!! 35 minutes of wait time. when I drove up to the window,  the lady asked me what I ordered......when I got my order,  they gave me wrong sauce and wrong burger. overall,very disappointed.

Fast and friendly. Was explained by both windows that they are making a fresh chicken patty and it will be four minutes and sorry for the delay, which I barely even notice. Food was cold but it was 20 minutes to my hotel and another 10 to get into the room so clearly that's not on them. Thanks for the great service McDonald's.

I sometimes I go there and they are busy. They tend to miss people's orders up a lot. I go to the drive up and ask no onions on my burgers. Get home and find onions on the burgers. I think what really happens is that people making the burgers are not paying attentions to the tickets. Either they are talking to on another and they are not paying attention to making the burgers.

At least 50% of the time, they get the order wrong.  And I'm not making substitutions, or changing ingredients.  They just don't seem to care.  Update #1: just ordered a SEC biscuit; got bacon and cheese on a biscuit.  That's not even a thing!  And it's not like I can catch that by looking in my bag.  I lowered my rating from 2 to 1.  Update #2: they gave me 6 chicken mcnuggets in my kids meal instead of 4, so I bumped them back up to 2 stars.  My daughter can't eat 6 nuggets, but I can eat 12, so we're good. The worst drive thru service. Shouldn't be considered a fast food establishment. Every time I come here its like this. Shame.
They try and i see it, sometimes  its hard when its busy but they are amazing ppl with a smile no matter  how busy it is...

I had the worst possible experience coming to this location. Rude workers, and the manager was rude, ignorant and mean towards customers. Sign claims they cater to ALL DAY breakfast, yet at 10 AM they had no mcgriddles left. After sitting at the drive through for 20 minutes I asked for a refund FIVE times with the manager ignoring me and after the fifth time asking the manager finally responded rudely telling me I should have said I wanted a refund earlier, which I did. I finally left and went to Burger King because they definitely have better service then whatever this trashy place did.

McDonalds is McDonald's but I was happy that they made an iced coffee with caramel- not on menu. Staff was friendly. And the iced coffee was good. It was also cheaper than expected. If you're in a hurry they were great.

Worst store ever.   After 5 different visits using drive through  missing food every time.   As well food heavily salted wrong rolls on quarter pounder... when approached counter staff on 5 visit was told to basically F myself they are a franchise and they don't answer your anyone. JUST GO SOMEWHERE ELSE  FOOD BAD PEOPLE RUDE MANAGEMENT NON EXISTENT

Worst McDonalds I've been to! The food looked nasty. The chicken nuggets & fries were dark. My little sister felt sick after and ended up getting food poisoning. Don't eat at that McDonalds! Better one on Keystone.

Much nicer now that it's been completely renovated. The staff is friendly and service is quick. It's my go-to for a late night burger or hangover food the next day. The traffic pattern was changed to allow easier access off of OYR
Smelly restrooms, patchy WIFI, descent deals on tea and staff is friendly. They allow the homeless to hang out in the restaurant at times and they bother people for food and money.

One of the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Disgusting conditions inside and out and some of the slowest service I've ever encountered both inside and at the Drive through. So slow and so lazy. McDonald's corp should shut this franchise down.
Worst mcdonald's ever. Never open on time and constantly everything is down. Employees can't even do simple math when the machines are down.

This McDonald's location has been there since McDonald's started selling franchises in the late 60's. It was the only fast food restaurant in area for years then more competitors came to town and the spot got various upgrades over time. I went there today and wanted 2 hamburgers and small fry. That is exactly what happened to me today. Just make sure you check your bag before pulling away.

This is a great spot to stop for a quick bite if you are on Route 295 and hungry. Everytime i visit here i get a quality meal and it has clean restrooms and a playground onsite, if the kids need to stretch their legs. And burn off some energy. It has been here since the mid 70's and it has always been a bright spot in the area ever since. I am lovin' this location.

The service here sucks but it's McDonalds what do you expect?!  I'm more concerned about the fact that they have a picture on the wall that has an Italian chef and pizza on it.  Are these people on crack?!
Terrible attitude!  Treats their customers with no respect and think it funny!  I sat there and watched them do this for 30 min until I stepped up and told them enough!

Came here for a lunch. Yes, please make sure you go inside to get your order. The drive thru who stated all items were in the bag got it wrong.  This happens to often at the Mc D's establishments.  Customer service for the organization could really get a new energy going, the simple mistakes would be much less than what I've been seeing
When you need a fountain soft drink, this is a sure shot. This was a new location. Very clean. Food was standard nothing special but it served.

Every single time I come here which is not often at all like once or twice every month they mess up my order the manager rolls his eyes at me and I never get Diet Coke like I ask they always give me Dr Pepper and not to mention every one seems mad that works there I never see one smile . If you hate your job quit your customer service job and go into an auditing company those attitudes.
Corteous and quick service. The manager responded immediately to my complaint regarding restroom cleanliness. Will return for breakfast

1- instead of honoring the local tv commercial discount (s), the a.m. mgr. made excuses &  did not honor what was advertised.
2- lack of service - for only one mcmuffin, had to wait for ...more than 4 minutes. had to remind a front line employee about order, prior to receiving. sad!!!
" will never return to this location & must warn all on social networks to not waste time, fuel & $ (not 1 red cent)  here."
if, the owners really care, hopefully, they will wake up & know how much they lose & will continue to lose due to the power of social media.

I worked two times in my youth at McDonalds and am quite aware of the corporate and franchise requirements. This particular McDonalds needs to have the manager relieved, fired and the restaurant shut down until it can be revised, retrained and corrected. It is the single worst McDonalds I've visited in the world, much less Tucson. Allow me to explain.1) Food quality; below substandard. The fries are always over salted, ALWAYS! This store's manager is a poor excuse of leadership and should be relieved of her position. This store needs a fundamental enema.

Pretty clean for a McDonald's and the food usually seems fresh. Unfortunately, this location has a problem with getting orders correct. Make sure you have everything correct before you leave the window, and make sure to try your drinks too.

Stopped by today for a sausage egg and cheese mcmuffin this evening. Friendly and quick service. It tasted good and the price is average for a breakfast sandwich. But i did get a stomach ache within a few hours..I'm assuming it was the sandwich I had from here.
Good service and food is usually good. Inside is usually full of homeless and meth heads.

Just for the record, I'm not lovin it.

I was in the drive thru this afternoon. It felt like 20 minutes but looking back maybe it was only 10 or so, but still, there were only several cars in front of me. The line should have moved substantially faster.

That's not the serious problem though. They servied me RAW nuggets! See the picture I posted. How the hell does that happen? I go to McDonalds only a couple times a year and this has to be my experience? Bleh. 

I then called their phone FIVE times and they chose to not answer. Awesome. So I called their HQ after Googling the number and reported the incident and requested someone contact me. We'll see what happens, but I'm really not happy that they put my health at risk. NOT cool.

Remarkably okay. 

On our most recent visits, they have:
Been out of McRibs in the middle of the McRib promotion. This did not bother me b/c I do not eat the pink slime but it greatly annoyed my husband that looks forward to its return every year.
Made us wait for quite a while parked outside the drive-thru for our food. This didn't both me much because this usually is an indication the food will be fresh but, again, it quite annoyed my husband.
Forgot the put a honey mustard sauce in our bag and we didn't notice til we got home :/

The food here is hit or miss. Sometimes hot, sometimes not and I usually avoid this location if I can just because it so close to all the airport hotels & interstate.

Overall rating: 3 out of 5 Big Macs.

Went to the drive thru today and everything was usual until I came to the second window to receive my food. The lady asked was such and such my order and I said yes. Honestly how hard is it to properly give someone their food and tell them to have a nice day?? Apparently for her, it's REALLY HARD

Everyone knows McDonald's food. The food is typical McDonald's, the service at this location is some of the worst. Staff is rude, not attentive and could care less how long it takes to serve you. If you have to go to this location, plan on waiting. 

I've rarely seen them mess orders up but it does happen. The thing that is the most upsetting is the lack of any sort of customer service.

It goes to show that the only good reviews for this location are not actually for this location but for the food of the McDonald's chain as a whole.

The worst service and they need people who know how to read and put the correct food in their proper wrapper. I ordered McDoubles but got singles when they were wrapped as McDoubles. I was told to pull up and they would bring the food out to me but after atleast 7-8 other cars got their orders and some of them were large orders which I could see in my rear view mirror I finally went in to get order. McDonald's  saying is " I'm loving it" should say I'm screwing you". 
This McDonald's is the only one I know that will not make black and white shakes also. I was going to stop at Burger King but the drive in line had atleast 6 cars in line to order and McDonald s had one car in front of me. I should have known better. This McDonald's is the worst and I have been to several in the area and in other states and this one takes the cake. I have written before about this McDonald s to Corporate and you get a call apologizing but it seems nothing ever changes.
KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK BURGER KING AND WENDY'S. YOU HAVE NOTHING TO WORRY ABOUT WITH THIS LOCATION'S MCDONALDS. FIVE GUYS NO WONDER YOU ARE ALSO BUSY RIGHT ACROSS THE STREET.
I will be writing another letter to McDonald's corporate but I really think it's a waste of time.

Worst McDonald's I've ever encountered. Twice this week the credit cards have been "down".. Makes me think some shady stuff is going on. I have lived half a mile from this McDonald's for two years and every single time I've been my order has been wrong and every time I try to order ice cream the machine is "broken". If you ask me, a bunch of lazy ass, shady people work at this location and refuse to turn on the ice cream machine and more than likely ask that everyone pay only cash so they can pocket it. If the manager ever reads this, fire everyone and hire competent people. I wish I could give this location no star. Avoid at all cost.

One star for the food. It's McDonald's so it tastes exactly like it should. The service though is atrocious. On every visit spanning several months I've experienced rude employees, incorrect order, and ridiculously long wait times in the absence of any significant customer volume.

"My manager said she'll give you the large drink this time, but next time you have to prefer it!"

This was said to me after being given a medium Coke when I asked for a large diet!  It's not a huge deal, but you're a fast food restaurant drive thru--isn't the customer always right??  And furthermore--this isn't the first time this manager provided rude service!!  

I hate to write a terrible review about an $8 meal, but I was so offended that I was being made to feel like I was trying to steal $.69.  Maybe the Burger King, Taco Bell, Wendy's, Arby's, Boston market, and wawa down the street can offer up better service to my close location!

By far the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Slow, unprofessional, rude. Went thru drive thru waited there for about 5 minutes with no answer. Pulled up to the first window no one there. Pulled up to the second window. Employees saw me never came over sat there for another 5 to 10 minutes no answer until I honked my horn they finally came, he was rude. And they want $15 an hour.  I will be contacting corporate in oak brook, IL

Thank you for being one of the few, if only one, that has good customer service! Your drive through personnel said words like "Thank You" and "Have a good day." One even made a joke with me! The employees at the McDonalds on US 19 don't even say anything to you. That's right, a silent drive through. Thanks again for a pleasant experience, at least in the customer experience. 
Now, the actual contents of what were asked for is another story. If you as the customer are asked if you want sauce and you say "Yes", please put the condiment in the bag. I arrive home and "SIKE" no condiments.

Hard to say why but I have always liked McDonald's    I don't go often but usually once a month when I am in a hurry.  Usually just do a cheeseburger or double cheeseburger.   Prices are among the best out of fast food choices and like I said I tend to like the flavor.

This is the one true McDonald's that's there for me at 3AM when I have the drunchies. I can't tell you the number of times I've stopped here after a night on the town. Usually, the service is slow which is weird because there is literally no customers there but whatever. Nothing better than greasy fries and a cheeseburger when intoxicated.

I love my egg mc muffins!  However, methinks that it is not worth it at this McDonald's.  I go here often and the service is awful.  Slow............to just name one of the problems.  Mixing and missing orders all the time.  Fed up.  Today was last straw!  Just got finished a colonoscopy at the nearby Endo center.  Was STARVING so where to turn?  McDonalds for my egg mcmuffins.  My driver repeated several times the order and how we wanted it.  Very clear I must say.  He specifically stated at least four times how we wanted the order.  We get to window and what is missing....a hash brown.  He very nicely tells the cashier and from the back we hear a woman yell, they didn't order them so they are gonna have to get in line and pay for them.  My friend said get the order right the first time and we would not have to worry about it.  He went to get back in line and then I said just forget it.  I have to find out who owns the store.  Ridiculous.  We just bought 20.00 worth of food to rip McDonald's off of a hash brown!   And they want 15.00 dollars an hour to flip hamburgers!

4 stars for a McDonalds? 

Yup. 

On our way home from Tampa, we needed a little grease in our bellies, from drinking a few nice strong IPAs the night before.....

Clean, updated, and I dare say, some of the new designs reminded me of the Aloft hotel color schemes... 

Anyway, bathroom was fairly clean, and they have self ordering stations, which I had not seen before and I thought was pretty cool! 

So egg mcmuffin and hashbrowns ordered... and I'm happy to say, the mcmuffin was actually properly toasted (might be a first) and the cheese was actually melting on the sandwich. (Another first.)

Best mcmuffin I've had from a MickeyD's in years. Could have been a fluke, but I was a happy camper. :)
When you get a short lunch...well let's say there is NOTHING fast about this food and then you sit down and your burger is cold...what?!?!? Won't be coming here again anytime soon...

Went to this McDonald's today to order nuggets and fries..I then drove home just to notice that the fries were old and burned...I then drove back over there so they could fix the issue and all they did was reheat the fries and gave them back to me...Horrible service..It can't be that difficult to make fresh french fries...This is the typical service these days.

This location is a joke.  

Every time I try to go there is a line of cars wrapped around the building.  And NOT because they are spectacular or anything different than a typical McDonalds food wise.  It's because this has to be the SLOWEST McDonalds i've ever seen in my entire life.   

I've gone a few times the rare times where there wasn't a line wrapped around the building, and I watch the few cars in front of me.  10-15 minutes to get their food and it's a SMALL bag of food!  I've seen this several times, and personally experienced it myself as well with small orders taking them like 10-15 minutes to hand me my small order (somehow it takes them 15 minutes to make and bag a cheeseburger and medium fries even though the inside isn't crowded).  How in the heck are people waiting 10-15 minutes at the food window to get small orders? What are you doing in there? It's not even like the inside was crowded those times either.  You know that line of cars I mentioned forming because of their slow drive thru service?  The few times I went when it wasn't like that, by the time I got through the drive thru it WAS like that.  I'm like "oh no wonder the line is always so long, when I got here there was no line, i've been waiting so long to get through the drive thru that a huge line formed behind me (and the few cars in front of me).  

Seriously, fast food shouldn't take THAT long.  It shouldn't take 20 minutes to get each car through the drive thru!  If you are taking this long then there is SERIOUSLY something wrong in the kitchen.  

If you are in a hurry to get somewhere then do NOT go to this location, choose a different McDonalds location.  Trust me.  This one is unbelievably slow.

McDonalds on Cross Keys Rd, you have failed this city!

This is one of the worst McDonald's that my husband and I have ever been to.

The staff seems completely incompetent and are much more focused joking and yelling loudly back and forth to one another than paying attention to their customers.  It takes quite a while to get any service at all, and even longer to get food!  

Now, on to the food.  It's terrible.  I'm not typically a big fan of McDonald's food, but this was by far the worst that I've had.  It arrives cold and tasteless, and the employees are simply rude if you ask for warm food. 

On top of all of that, the restrooms are unusably dirty!  I would definitely recommend that you stay far away from this location.

This is a drive-thru review.  Surprisingly, compared to the other reviews, I don't have a problem with this place.  Staff always seems to be super friendly.  Seriously.  Don't even remember if I've really had a bad experience here.  It gets a good rating.

Seems fine.  I'm a drive-thru guy so I can't really comment on inside.  The drive/they has gotten better over the years.  Haven't had any real mix ups often enough to care.  People are friendly.  I think I had a birthday party here when I was a kid.  What's not to like? 

Oh, that drive lane in the front of the building is super tight.  I always feel like I'm gonna hit something.  Other than that, this place is fine.

Only been there one time . I had cold fries during a busy mid afternoon .  I will not return. The main reason I go to McDonald vs other fast food places is : hot and fresh French fries . I know that anyone who manages a McDonald's or works there must know that the fries are a key/ major draw to their restaurant.  So, I'm assuming their is either a lack of management or many disgruntled employees.  Either way even for $1 cold fries are disgusting and would rather pass on a repeat visit.

I barely ever write reviews in Yelp, but I feel like this particular McDonald's deserves some praise. Every time I go to the drive thru there, the employees are very fast and courteous. Very friendly. I just want to say thank you:) Good job:)
I started coming here back in 2011 when I moved closer to this location. Service here has always been good. I think I've been in the drive thru maybe 3 times when it's not busy.

Worst McDonald's ever, just moved into gibbstown and I've been there 3 times  1st time the black lady manager taking orders was mad and rude and the food was cold, 2nd time there I went though the drive thru, got home the order was wrong and fries were ice cold and old, today I went though the drive thru again for just 2 mcdoubles with no cheese,  I got down the road and I found I got 2 single cheeseburgers so this time I went back to get them replaced but they told me it's going to be 3 or 4 mins and to go wait in the parking lot. Well I'm to pissed for that so I said give me my food or my money back, wouldn't you know the same black manager gave me my money back, no sorry no nothing.. sad

Open 24 hours- the food is what you'd expect. The only real criticism I have is that sometimes the food tastes like it's been sitting out (temperature isn't up to par). Either way, I'm glad there's something open late when I'm starving and don't want to cook.
no matter what the order, they never get it right, worth you to drive 10 minutes south and go to the other one at continental.
This McDonald's is ok. The food tastes like any other place and it's just as slow as the other McDonald's in the area. Entering the drive-through from the Target side is confusing.

When there's no line at the drive through, this place is great. Employees are friendly at the window. But when they have a line you can be there for 15+ minutes and they even forgot us one time when they told us to pull over because our order was taking extra time. I avoid this one when there's a line.
Single lane drive through and it backs up into road at busy times. Small lot but if you can a spot it's quicker service inside.

Terrible service, the young woman at the drive through window pretty much throw my credit card back at me. 

I worked for 4 years at close to minimum wage when I was in high school, yet I still managed to muster up a please and thank you for every customer. I do not understand how the manager allows his/her employees to get away without using these common courtesies.

I normally don't do this type of shit but omg. It wasn't even busy and the girl taking the orders messed almost EVERYONES order up including mine. Instead of apologizing she decided to give everyone attitude & ignored the fact that she messed up but had enough time on her hands to give her number out to a customer lol so classy! Now I know why they say "there's NOTHING like the bay!"

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Wait times are 15 minutes or longer even at night when they're not busy. They get orders wrong and said they gave me coke but actually gave me tea. I've never seen service so bad anywhere.

Got to be the worst McDonald's. I've been harassed for free food from bums while I'm ordering with the cashier...cashiers tolerate this behavior. Other times, I'm waiting in line extra long while the cashier is hitting on customers. Drive thru has messed up my order. Food quality is worse than other locations. I only go on rare occasions because of the location...it's on my way to work. Each time I hope it will improve but I'm always disappointed.

Quite possibly the worst run drive thru I've ever seen. Always forget something or mess it up. Overcharge or undercharge. And it takes like 10 minutes no joke to get through it. Old fries/nuggets every time

Weirdest McDonalds I've ever been to. Been here a few times and have witnessed a homeless guy doing drugs in the ladies room and getting kicked out. Saw a domestic argument here. Saw drunk street kids loitering in the seats while the staff did nothing. Signs telling you not to loiter are posted on the walls, which is the first time I've ever seen that in a fast food place.
