If I could give it a lower rating, I would.  Although expectations are never high for McDonalds, regardless of location, I do expect basic food hygiene and safety practices.  I ordered a McChicken and small fries, but kindly requested no Mayo.  At the pay window, I double checked that the cashier successfully captured this small adjustment.  At the pick up window, the good intentions of the worker to verify my special order were overshadowed by the fact that he moved two recently emptied trash bins out of the way with his bare hands, then proceeded to pick up my order of fries to check the contents underneath.  When I complained, he yelled at me and someone else got my replacement order.  That someone else just happened to be the same person changing the trash bins.  She also did not wash hands or change gloves.  Fortunately, I'm only out a $2 "meal" because the replacement went straight to the trash.  gross.
Vastly improved service the past six months. No longer do attach members test you like a nuisance.

If I could give zero stars I would. This location is dirty and gross. I ordered fries for myself and two kids and some chicken nuggets. The Nuggets were all dried up but totally mushy on the inside. The fries looked completely raw. They smelled awful. It's the smell of oil that has obviously not been changed in a long time. Several hours after eating some of this horrible food my seven year old got very sick several times. Please do yourself a favor and AVOID.

Sooooooooooooooooo slooooooooooooowwwwwwww. 
15 minutes in drive-thru for 1 small coffee. 

No regard for their customers that are waiting. They're inside just chatting it up while people are getting impatient.

I mean... A girl has to review her local chicken nugget vendor. Living next to this McDonalds for well over two years. I've never had any issues, the people have always been nice, and nothing has ever been forgotten. Thank you 52nd and keystone for getting me over all my hangovers and saving my bad days with Diet Cokes.

Don't forget to tell them you want the promo pricing on something otherwise you'll be charged regular prices and then schooled on how it's your fault because you didn't say you wanted the 2 for 2.00 McDoubles. Obviously most people who eat at Mc Donalds would rather pay the regular price. This Mc Donalds is close to my work but every time I go I swear I will never do it again. They can't get an order right even if it's a single drink. Missing items, wrong orders, wrong items. I will try to remember, the next time I just have to have fries to drive the extra mile or so to the next closest Mc Donalds.

I don't care how many times you go there they never get your order right...how hard is it when you order an Egg McMuffin Coffee and a fruit pie..and you get a sausage egg McMuffin and a fruit pie that is burnt...

Slowest drive through service I have ever witnessed. 4 cars in front of me, 2 cars got ahead because no one would greet me in the second order line. I just don't understand. And the employees have terrible attitudes. When I finally got my food (literally 23 min later) it was cold and the fries were stale. I don't normally eat fast food but it was late so I decided to get something quick. Never again. I don't know how they manage. Never going back. Ever.

I like macas! The old style one. Now we order at a terminal and get table service "we'll sort off" ppl keep asking me are you finished with your tray... If I was I would put it up. Coffee top up sir.... Please bring back the old style store. I just want to sit drink my coffee be be left alone.
Shoutout to these people who want $14 an hour but can't put any sauce in my 20 piece nuggets! Even though we asked to make sure they were in it. They aren't. Sad.

They don't serve dine-in customers at 7 o'clock on a Wednesday night. At least they wouldn't serve me. As I waited at the counter, five employees were scurrying to give zippy service to drive-thru customers. Two employees walked right in front of me, avoiding eye contact. Zero employees wanted to take my order. After growing a bit older, I left.

Funny thing is, I came here because the exact same thing happened at Bojangles. Must be some new starvation diet.

Gave two stars because they usually have good service ... when I drive thru.

I went through the drive-thru today and was told I could only get a bottle of water or tea that if I wanted anything else I needed to go inside to get the drink. Are you kidding me? But everyone else at my job has gone through and got their drinks through the drive-thru.

The drive-thru was awesome this morning! Literally a dozen cars in front of me and I made it through in 3-4 mins.  The reason for 4 stars was my English muffin was a little too toasted around the edge but I always know I can get in and out on my way to work at this location. Great job!
I came to this McDonald's when I was little to go to one of my daycare friends birthday.

If you like a surprise in the bag, you may find this restaurant charming. For those of us that expect to get what we pay for, always double check your bag and beverage. I use to frequent this location multiple times a week on my way to work but, I recently decided it's worth the 10 minute drive to a different location when I get that McChicken craving. The staff is often distracted when working in the drive-thru and from my experience, never really know what you ordered. Last month, I visited the restaurant's drive-thru six times and each experience was exhausting. The employees never smile, rarely get the order right the first time and don't appreciate when you pay in change. The food is more often than not meant for a different customer, cold or thrown together so quickly that ketchup and grease ooze from the packaging. When they give you a cheeseburger after ordering nuggets (true story), don't expect anything more than a half-hearted apology and a longer wait on "fresh" nuggets. Review in short, If you are not willing to go inside and order your food, it may be best to avoid letting this burger joint ruin your day.

I'm waiting to get my money back.  Asked for 4 mcchickens and 2 med fries 4 snack size mcflurries and 2 sodas...   Nothing was correct.  Got 1 sandwiche 3 fries 1 soda 3 big mcflurries.   What should have be hot was cold. What should have been frozen was like milk....   And they think they deserve to start at $15/hr...   What a joke.
Never been here but apparently they have mozzarella sticks now. Asked if they have beer and they said they don't sell beer. I thought this was America.
This McDonald's was closed at 12:41 on a friday night. Now I'm drunk and sad and hungry

It's 6:23 am Saturday morning. It's 24 degrees outside. I've come to McDonalds to pickup a warm breakfast. The store opens at 6am. The store is locked but all lights and signage are on. 6am means 6am not "any damn time you want"

-January 30, 2016- 
We got up to the speaker and dealt with a girl with apparent hearing issues. Every single thing we ordered she would say, "HUHHHH?" and my husband would have to repeat it "louder and clearer" than what he already was. I can't really complain about the slowness, I guess, since it's lunch hour and a lot of customers in and out. We were finally off...... We get home, my husband opens his Chicken sandwich wrapper and there is nothing there besides a bun, mayo and lettuce. That was sweet.  Now, on to the rest of this amazingly beautiful day!! Almost 60 on January 30?! Yes please!!

I asked the manager if my coffee was ready(I had just received my food to go) and she turned around and started talking to someone else, so disrespectful, she knew I was talking to her.   A young lady by the name of Ashley saw what was going on and she asked what I was missing. She proceed to get me the coffee. She is the only reason why I would ever put a 5 star review of this place. Thank you Ashley !
The best McDonald's ever!  Always fast service with a smile, and hot delicious food! Glad to also see new ownership because it's better than ever. The store is always very crowded. Nice job!

Honestly many people automatically write off McDonalds and before u dismiss my 5 star rating as crazy , you MUST try their CYT (create your taste) line of premium burgers. I believe it can only be ordered by the kiosks and dine in.
 McDonalds has outdone themselves by reinventing into a customizable gourmet burger place. This location is brand new with comfy seats, nice tvs, table service and amazing new burgers for around 10 bucks , this deserves 5 stars. 
When I tried cyt for the first time I had a great server who assisted me with the kiosk ordering making suggestions on what goes great together, taste pairings and all. They have artisan bakery buns that are amazing u wouldn't believe u were at McDonalds. I noticed premium ingredients like variety of cheeses, sundried tomato pesto sauce, guacamole, chipotle aoili and more! Then u get to the toppings, the crispy onion straws are a must! After u choose the toppings you select your side. At that point you take your seat. 

When my food was brought out I immediately noticed that the quality of the burger patty was really good and better than the patties on the regular menu. My server went above and beyond to make sure that we were satisfied. I forgot to get a topping I wanted and he went it got it for me on the side. He was terrific. His name was Tobi and I wish we were allowed to tip. I could not believe the level of service and quality I received for 10 bucks! The burger was huge too! Free WiFi and all. Whether u want to sit and work or grab a gourmet burger McDonalds has created a new atmosphere that u can do this at select locations available 24hrs! Plus if you are gluten sensitive they now have a lettuce bun and gf brownies! 
If you are still skeptical just try it! My only suggestion is that they should include chicken patties In cyt. I was so impressed I have to give 5 stars!
Hit or miss on this location. Sometimes they're prompt other times really slow. Customer service shifts wildly during the time of day and day of the week. Pretty typical for a fast food chain though.

I could write a better review for a car accident or my wife attempting to cook. Orders always inaccurate and staff seem to not care. The French fries are always soggy and over-salted is under statement. I can easily spend $30.00 on five of us here. So when I pay that much I at least expect to get what I ordered and how I ordered. I ordered a double quarter pounder meal with no pickles, I'm allergic to pickles and stated this at the drive in. When I got home it was cheeseburger loaded with pickles. Me being to irritated due to this consistently happening decided to toss it in garbage and told my kids were no longer going back.

I was waiting in the drive thru for 25 minutes. I was told by the window attendant that they had NO food prepared! After waiting 25 minutes I was told they also didn't have the kind of chicken I wanted for my sandwich so I was told I'd have to do take grilled or wait YET ANOTHER 4 minutes. I work at papa johns so I know the hassle of high demand but come on people at least try to be prepared. As a resident of kuna I won't be visiting kuna McDonald's again. I am very dissatisfied!

Awful service... ALWAYS the wrong order. How many untrained, non-caring employees can one location hire. Every order is missing items. Maybe that is the plan, save money by not filling the entire order knowing that once someone drives away they very likely wont return to get the food. How much can one location save in a year by shorting every order just a few bucks. As a corporation knowing this location is in an affluent area you would think they would step up the surveillance and correct the problems. Avoid this location!!!!

Really it's McDonald's. Not much that can go wrong with the order because it's the same menu you have as every other location. But I walked in here and there was only one other person ahead of me who had already ordered and we waited a bit for her order and then I waited for my coffee and muffin to be handed to me. It's McDonald's. They are not making the muffins fresh in the back. The woman t the counter looked flustered and that doesn't help. It's not a busy place so really just calm down and let those of us who are in the place wanting a quiet coffee in a Sunday morning enjoy it. Next time - I'll just do the drive thru.
I like the they have a play area for children.  They do not have a self service drink area so the staff have get your soda pop or iced tea. The French fries are also good.

Let's pick a word for this place.  Hmm I'm gonna go with terrible.  Service is terrible, everyone has an attitude, order gets screwed up and one girl is ignoring us and floating around with a broom like she's in a ballet. Frys are raw. Considering the hospitality of this city,  I'm surprised this McDonalds is in New Orleans

Service was terrible, ordered 2 southwest chicken salads at the drivethrough and they were given to us vertical in the bag. when I asked for new salads the manager which looked all of 17 years old said to me WHATS YOUR PROBLEM, I said to him the salad is all lumped together because of the way it was but in the bag, then he said he would not replace the salads. he argued with me for 5 minutes saying there was nothing wrong with the salad just because it was put in the bag vertical I then told him when you go in a restaurant do they bring your meal and throw it in your lap? when I said that, he rolled his eyes and clinched his fist at me, there were not a lot of people there  now I know why, a bunch of young children standing around in the back  doing nothing! he finally agreed to make new salads waited for 30 min as people came and went and still no salads, so went inside to ask and the manager and he said we have to prep the salad, prep the salad, really' I said to him its not rocket science to make a little salad. at that point I did  not trust them/ him making the rocket science salad as they would spit in it. so I ask for my money back. that store has no idea how to run a kitchen, let alone be professional. that manager should be fired for his mouth as well as  his incompetence

Giving this McDonald's 4 stars, I don't think I can fairly give 5 stars to a fast food place!  The staff here are the nicest and most professional I've ever experienced.   They are consistently friendly, talkative, and just generally a pleasure to do business with.  The food is standard Mickey D's, so no changes there.  I will say that the work week crew seems to be more efficient at moving the drive thru line than the weekend crew!  Great place to stop by for some fries and drinks!

Slowest fast food restaurant I've ever been to (including the stereotypical slow ones like Subway), and a hot spot for panhandlers, you unfortunately can't beat the convenience given the lack of downtown fast food options.  Keep in mind, never drive off without double checking your order, I've almost never had one 100% right the first time.  Most employees are pleasant to downright friendly, but night shift brings out the worst.  Straight up didn't care at all about missing a sandwich AND my drink from my order, and also told me the store has never had mayonnaise, because I'm fairly certain she didn't know what it was.  That being said, if you can handle the rush at lunch and dinner times and you want something easy and cheap, it's one of your only options downtown.

I recently visited McDonald's over in goleta at market place and found my experience not the best. The employee that helped me was named Eric and he was very quick to talk and rude. I waited on 40 nuggets for close to 20 minutes, asked him when my order was going to be ready and he immediately shut me up by interrupting.

Drive-through at about 4 a.m. today. My daughter wanted a meal. I wanted a diet DP.

Drive-through attendant on the squawk-box confirmed dinner was served, so Miss C. got her meal.

I got my diet DP. Deliverer of food was incredibly gracious and nice. Miss C. wanted extra ketchup, which was delivered appropriately.

Great service.

Before I begin my unusally long review for this particular McDonalds, I wanted to note that this is a 24/7 McDonalds. I know it's not stated on the page yet and it would've been valuable to know when you're on the road. 

Anyways...What can I say? I had amazing service, the night manager that was in charge that night was awesome. He did his best to accommodate as many customers that night as possible, while keeping a smile on his face and dealing with each person properly. The food was as it should be, which is hot and obviously taste like McDonalds food. During that time they had the monopoly pieces so we ended up with a lot of free pieces and he took them all (we were a large # of people) and didn't give us any problems. 

We only went to this McDonalds in particular because it was the most convenient one to go to on the road to Dallas, Texas. It was right near the exit and entrance of the highway and so it was as busy as one near the highway would be. I wanted to give them 5 stars because I appreciated how the manager that night was active and stayed true to the whole happy customer service part, even though I did witness some crazy customers that came in that night. He still dealt with them as professionally as he could and if for the love of christ I remembered his name I would've given him his well deserved praise and pat on the back. IT really isn't easy being a fast food manager, but he nailed it and I appreciated it, especially since we were on an incredibly long car trip to Texas. 

I also think it's good to remember that these places are FAST FOOD. We're not trying to rate them against gourmet restaurants and as long as the food was hot and tastes good and the service was up to par it deserves a 5 star rating despite being a McDonalds restaurant. 

I should note that we did stay there for a couple hours due to the fact we were trying to rest up from the car trip and even though we did they didn't give us a problem which was very much appreciated.

On this one particular morning, I ordered at the drive-thru.  This location has 2 drive-thru stalls, so try to pick the shortest one to get through the line the fastest.  The line seems to move pretty quickly in the morning when drivers are usually just getting a cup of coffee and a sandwich to go.  My bagel was the perfect temperature, the cashier was polite.  No problems!

In the past, when my order was not ready upon arrival at the pick up window, I have been asked to pull ahead for them to bring it out to me.  When my order was delivered minutes later, I was also given 2 coupons good for free fries or pie.  Not an inconvenience at all!

Night manager had no control of the staff, they seemed untrained and slow. The first drive thru person kept walking away while people were waiting outside. 2nd drive through seemed to be his first day. Dripping the ice scoop on the floor and picking it back up like nothing happened. Manager was "working" the front counter. She was working with a broken finger and annoyed with her staff begging to go home early and annoyed that the stores phone was ringing. Also didn't ring me up for the 2 for $2 special but items at full price. Never gave me a receipt so next day when I went back after noticing the higher cost I can't get money back because I don't have a receipt. Please avoid this location
Probably the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The service is horrible, they're extra disorganized too.

This fast food really isn't served very fast anymore, particularly at this location (which, in their defense, seems to be busy pretty much all the time). It's close to home and my kid likes it, and you can order and receive a full meal (with little nutritional value) in about 5 minutes by way of the drive-thru-only reserved parking spaces. Be sure to check your order. Every. Single. Time.
This is one of nashvilles best fast foods, the food and service was splended. I'd recommend coming here it is a delight!

The staff has always been courteous and helpful when we go. They get our order right most of the time. (You have to have reasonable expectations from fast food places.) We like to sit in the seat by the fireplace on chilly days or on the chairs that spin from side to side. Lately the happy meal toy display has not been maintained to let us know what toy to expect. I wish there were a play place and a step stool in the bathroom.

This is the first McDonalds I have ever had a bad burger! I like McDonalds occasionally for their double cheeseburgers. Was working close by and chose the drive thru to purchase my favorite a double cheeseburger. When I unwrapped the burger wrapper I found a squashed sandwich with 2 unmelted slices of cheese. Each bite got cooler until I turned around in my car, entered establishment, asked to speak w mgr.
Good grief, all this for a $1.75 sand. No one came to counter so I then stood in line behind other customers with half eaten burger.  When it was my turn I asked for a refund.
I would have been happy getting a fresh exchange but the mod didn't even offer or ask what was wrong but just handed me my money. Barely uttered any apology or offer for something else. I don't get it. Left hungry.

Today my husband and I went to this McDonald's to get our lunch. When we got back to work I opened up my burger, there was a bite out of the burger. I took the burger back and all that was offered to me was a drink. I said no because I had a drink and the manager threw in an apple pie into my bag. I hate apple pies. I called the corporate office and they were much nicer to me then anyone there at that McDonalds. I hope to get my money refunded to me. I will never eat there again.

Wow! They were quick. Got my order right and even brought it to my table. And when me and my friend were chatting the lady came by and asked if I'd like more coffee. And she got it for me with a smile! This is a new leaf for McDonald's.

Makes me want to come back even though the food is supposed to be full of fats and stuff.

Store is clean and the staff are all working together. And the layout is nice.

Don't ask for a fry without salt because if you do, then they dump half the fries into the hopper while trying to dump them in a fry box. In the process you end up with a small size fry in a medium box. 
Also make sure that you get the sandwich you ordered. Even after I repeated my sandwich twice, he was still only doing a quarter pounder. So I insisted on getting a double quarter pounder, it wasn't my screw up.

This place sucks the service ls the worst I have ever had every time I went there at the drive through I had to  park and wait and all I ordered was 1 burger but the people behind me ordered a lot of food and the smallest amount of time  I waited was 18 min. So I told all of my family and friends to never go there again and every time I went there the food was cold so for this McDonald's I give zero stars.

I don't usually bother reviewing fast food places. I'm sure a big machine like McDonald's gives less than a rat's ass about Yelp reviews but customer service at this store today reached epic levels of SUCK and this story needs to be told. Everything I'm about to relate is a true story and the names of the participants have NOT been changed to protect their privacy.

A little backstory: I went to their drive-thru this morning and paid for my breakfast with my McD's card. The server tells me that the meal came to $10.16 which she said was exactly what was left on the card. Then she chucked the card into a pile. Later on that morning I decided to check the receipt as I thought it was a weird coincidence that the amounts were the same. It turned out that there was a balance of $9.48 left on the card. Moral of the story?--know your card balances. Don't rely on the retailer/restaurant to keep track for you and don't take their word for it. But that's not the epic SUCK I spoke of in the first paragraph.

My wife called the restaurant and told them what happened. They said to come back to the restaurant and talk to Nolan, N-O-L-A-N, and he would give us the card back. Later on that day we drove all the way back to 100 Avenue for the sole purpose of getting the card. When we got there my wife politely asked young Nolan if the restaurant could compensate us for their mistake. After all, we had to go out of our way to pick up the card. Even if they had offered to reload the card for the amount we spent on gas to drive back there that would have been a decent gesture.

Nolan responds: "Wellllllll, it was an honest mistake. It's not like she was stealing from you and you did get your food after all." First off, we weren't accusing anyone of stealing. I realize it was an honest mistake, just like I honestly didn't know the amount on the card. I informed Nolan of the pain in the ass it was to have to drive all the way back there. I could see that the young man was starting to lose his cool and at this point he went to what I assume must be his boss, Natiche (spelling?). He says to Natiche, "I just gave them their card back and now they want compensation." Now play that sentence back in your head and imagine a self-entitled punk-ass teenager who just had the car taken away from him for a week and that will give you an idea of young Nolan's attitude. He then stormed off in a huff into a back room.

Now Natiche: He stood there and looked at us as if we were two Jehovah's Witnesses who just showed up at his door. Then without a word he turned around and walked to the ice cream machine, dispensed some vanilla into a cone, and offered it to us, like he was trying to appease a child.

I thought that service like this only happened on sitcoms. I don't usually like to complain at fast food restaurants because I don't want to end up being like the guy on Fast Times at Ridgemont High that got Judge Reinhold fired. But in instances like this, I don't mind being the cantankerous old guy.

What happened in the morning with the card was a mistake. What happened later on with little Nolan and Natiche was not a mistake. That was just clueless indifference, not to mention condescending and rude.

It's a Mac place.
Clean.
Nice staff.
You get what you pay for.
So there it is ....... bah bah bah bahhhhdahhhhh

One of the worst McDonald's in the area. 

I always go in because it's faster. They no longer give you your cup after ordering so that you could fill your drink before the food is ready. 

And they usually make things wrong. Last time o got a Big Mac, there was NOTHING between the top 2 buns, and on the bottom was the 2 patties and a single slice of cheese with minimal Big Mac sauce. 

If this was $1 it'd be somewhat ok - but a Big Mac meal is about $7.50 now. 

Id rather go elsewhere when I want a quick burger.

This place, needs to be under new management. 

Went through the drive thru today, and a MANAGER hands me the bag of food, and tries to hand me my medium drink. They must of just sloshed the drink up in some bucked of Coke? The outside was COVERED in syrup and carbonated water droplets. When I asked SAID MANAGER to clean the cup up he acted put out. 

These guys always try to hand off non cleaned ups. They mess up the orders, and then they ask you to park and they will bring your order out to you. I REALLY hate that part, that is so their "numbers" look good. This place is horrible, go up to Vista or SOME WHERE ELSE.

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. I go maybe once every 6 months hoping it's gotten better and it's always the same. I instead stop at the ones in New Castle on my way home from time to time. The food quality is always sub-par. Fries in particular are always old.

If I could give this establishment 0 stars I would.  I went through drive thru at this McDonald's during the evening and ordered a large Vanilla Latte with light whipped cream.  Upon receiving my beverage it felt light so I opened the top and the beverage was close to half full.  Upon politely notifying the window clerk of the discrepancy and without looking at my drink, she pointed out that there is a line that they go by and pointed at a line, near the top of the cup.  I pointed out that the beverage was still filled 2 inches below that line.  The manager, Shelby, then approached with an attitude and said that the machine does it automatically and that they could remake it but it would be the same result.  I said that's "BS" because A. I filled out the survey on the receipt and early the following morning went to the McDonald's in Lemmon Valley prior to a road trip and received a perfect coffee beverage.  I got a call from the owner and not long after the conversation began I quickly realized that he wasn't going to help correct the issue and to make matters worse, once I mentioned that I was a retired veteran, his tone changed for the worse and told me not to visit this MacDonald's or the other two that he owns because they cannot meet my needs.  I won't be visiting any of his establishments and will advise others not to as well.   They are OK with ripping customers off.

Horrible. Just horrible. Service is horrible, quality of food is horrible, ordering your food is even horrible! How can I tell you my order and then you give something totally different! You get to the window and they tell you the price to a different order. Are we serious?!

This location needs work. Went thru last night for convenience's sake and there was more crew outside than inside. Guy at the window was pleasant tho, no problems there. I ordered an artisan chicken sandwich meal. They were out of unsweet tea (again) so i got a diet soda. That's fine too. In their defense they did try to fix the problem with the salad expiration sticker by offering a free meal but I just can't in good faith go back to this location.

Horrible McDonald's they forgot my chicken sandwich that I ordered and put Canadian bacon on my egg mcmuffin even though I said without. Also, when I got there it appeared most of their machines were not working. Definitely, not going their again.
I would say that the staff is rude and place is dirty but, The food is good for a McDonald's especially the breakfast.

I went thru drive in and placed my order. I noticed the price was higher, than should be. I told the lady and was very rude. She said" I needed to order right". I explained ... I did. I ask to talk to Mrg. because of how was treating and her name. She just walked away from me. I waited trying to get her to look at me. She said" if I don't move I will call the police and still wouldn't give her name. I think a Mgr came over, but wouldn't give name. Said .. I am being rude to her. REALLY!

When I first walked into this McDonald's, the weight of a thousand misdeeds lay heavy upon my soul. But in the moments as I awaited the beleaguered greeting of the night's hostess, I came to the astounding realization that during this dining experience I would both find and lose a part of myself; a part as connected to our humanly collective experience with food as it was so far beyond it.

I took my first bite of the fried buttermilk chicken sandwich and felt, in that first recognition of flavor, all the internalized misery and self-doubt I'd become accustomed to bearing melting away.
In that hot, moist patty lay the answer to all my years of wondering:
Who was I, this ethereal creature with some vague concept of itself, in the grand scheme of what we know as the universe?
Somewhere in that expanding void of nothingness there lay the rock that had somehow, against all odds, given birth to the creature now sitting here and typing this message.

It seems odd, I know- 
trust me when I tell you that I know-
but somehow, as my incisors cut through the hormone laden meat product that had been haphazardly tossed between that sweet set of buttermilk buns, I realized that I was biting into myself. Biting into myself, not simply in some ethereal sense of self realization concerning the connectedness of all life both past and present, but in a much more real sense because I had somehow slipped a finger into my sandwich. 

As the pain coursed through my nerves to my brain and out of my mouth in a blood curdled scream, processed chicken product spewing forth upon my companions, everything was suddenly clear.

This is probably the worst McDonald's I have ever been to, and unfortunately, it's my local store. They never, ever get the drive through order correct! I literally have to check every item in the bag before I pull off, and 90+% of the time the order is WRONG! Last week was the last straw! I'm NEVER going back to this store! Even if your order is right, they can't build a burger to save their lives! Ketchup oozing off one side, mustard off the other, burger half on the bun... WTF?

Be careful when using your credit card when going through the drive thru. I handed my card to the girl and she disappeared with my card for about a minute. A week later on that same card all these mysterious charges appeared. I called and talked to the male manager but that was a total waste of time.
They don't even deserve 1 star everyone that works here is SO rude every time I have had a horrible experience every time I have come here won't be coming back because of the RUDE employees!!!

Last time me and my hubby was at this McDonald's, they mess up my unsalted fries for my daughter. I know I ask for a small unsalted fries, but I've received salted fries and  less than 10 fries. Today I went and ask for 10 mcgriddle cakes, the guy told me $16.80. FMI, the mcgriddle cakes are on the Dollar menu 2 for $1, but some how they tries to overcharge me. I ask the guy about the mcgriddle cakes, he simply told me that's how much they cost. Usually I would avoid going to this mcdonald but since I was running a little late I figure I can give this place another try, BUT HELL NO NEVER AGAIN.....

After coming here at least once a week, I've realized the service and workflow is poor! Morning service should be smooth. With people going to school and work, you need to be fast. The manager tells me, "we're short staffed." That's not my problem! Adapt! I had to wait 13 minutes for a mocha caramel coffee while they focused on a spill! The customer was not the primary focus! I try to be fair in my reviews but this staff just pushed the limit. This is the responsibility of the Manager! When I wrote my first review, the manager was a training manager who kept staff moving efficiently. This present manager doesn't have the presence who needs to drive the staff.

I wrote this as part of a survey feedback, but I thought I would share it publicly.  I live in downtown Indianapolis, and the location on 16th and Meridian is much closer. However, I found this location is far superior. I began driving a bit further to go here, and I do not regret it at all. The staff is super friendly and efficient. I know my order will be taken quickly, accurately, and carefully. The staff thanks me along the way. I know I will be able to order what I like, too, without being told "we can't do that." None of these things are true about the 16th and Meridian store. I am very pleased with this location, and I recommend all my downtown friends go to this one instead. Keep up the good work guys!

This is the McDonald's that is closest to my apartment, and that is really unfortunate. This is by far the worst McDonald's I have been to in my life.  The workers clearly do not care at all about their job, and it shows in everything they do.  They barely speak to you, they do not thank you, they are slow, and they practically throw the food out the window at you. The last time I went to this location, I was the third car in line, and it took me thirteen minutes to even place my order.  It is always lined up because they are terribly slow.  If you are in a hurry, you should avoid this location.  Most of the time, my order is wrong.  I used to go here frequently and just order a Diet Coke since it was on my way home from work and school.  They managed to mess that up more often than they got it right.  It's quite evident that if your order might take more effort (special order, get something dirty to prepare it, breakfast food after 10:00 when it technically doesn't end until 10:30), they will just tell you that they are out of it.  I can barely understand what most workers say, and it's not because they are just learning English.  It's because they don't care and mumble in short, guttural noises.  This McDonald's is terrible.  I found that there is one on West Washington just past Holt Road, and I drive farther to go to that one instead.  The service is so much better, they thank their customers, and they are fast.  I would recommend anyone living near IUPUI do the same.  Best of luck to the rest of downtown.  It's very clear the only reason that this location is open is that it is the only McDonald's in downtown Indy.  Otherwise, it would have failed long ago.

You know what? I bet all the other reviews are true. But I went through the drive-thru on a hard day and the employees at the windows were so nice to me, without knowing I was having a bad day, that I felt better. I think they accidentally upsized my order, but whatever. I had really been lusting after the large fries anyway. And they were tasty.

Consistently known as the worst McDonald's in the city, likely the world. I've been going here occasionally for over 25 years, since my dad worked down the street for years and I later lived in the neighborhood. I've been to McDonald's restaurants in third-world countries. They were all much nicer. I give 2 stars instead of 1 because one time they gave me a bunch of extra food they'd made by mistake, and the food tastes like it is supposed to. Once you finally get it. Once they correct whatever mistakes they made. Once you get past at least one panhandler and/or rowdy patron - this includes the drive-thru. DAMN, I am being generous here.

It's McDonald's I get it. 4 stars really? Well, yes! I know what I'm getting into when I get in line at McDonald's. Quick, hit and filling. Not necessarily great or even good food but something hot to keep my kids blood sugar from tanking. 

I have been to this location MANY times, more than I will admit to for sure. The people are ALWAYS nice, the food is typically hot and they rarely screw it up. I've been missing sauce for McNuggets a few times and if I even start to ask for something they give it to me. 

It's right off of the freeway and attached to a mini-mart so they deal with every type of person and that can be hard. The always nice and the food almost always hot? Yes, it deserves 4stars for a McDonald's.
Fast drive thru this morning and friendly smiles handed me my caramel iced coffee. Coffee and smiles, a good way to start the morning.

I would have given this place a zero but there is not an option. McDonald's is just McDonald's, however the people who work at this location are the worst. While at the pick up window at the drive through I was threatened and treated awfully. I told the lady at the window that the order was wrong and she immediately became irate, then her husband who also was working there began threatening me saying he was about to be off and wanted to fight in the parking lot. WHAT KIND OF SERVICE IS THIS!!!!!  I know it's just McDonald's, but this is the trashiest place by far. Stay away, beware of the ratchetness!

Bad service.  Told me to pullover so they could bring out the food. Instead, I ended up waiting 15 minutes. Then, I had to walk in the restaurant myself to get the food. Don't come over here go to Wendy's .
This place defies the definition of fast food. It took my friends like 15 minutes to get 3 orders of food.
This is the worst McDonald's in all of Reno/Sparks! They constantly screw my order up and more often than not, my food is near cold by the time I get home less than 2 miles away.

Customer service doesn't exist in this place, especially at night time. Waited forever for someone to come on the intercom and when they finally do, he says "what do you want?" with annoyed voice. Everything I tried to order either they don't have it or takes at least 20mins to make. This lazy a$$hole with bad customer service lied so he doesn't have to make anything. Drove off without ordering anything and wished I never stopped here. 
Do yourself a favor and skip this dump especially at night. go the next exit(Ina) and order at JACK IN THE BOX. The staff are more friendly, good customer service and they actually have what I wanted to order!! Imagine that.

I'm desperate for breakfast, we have no groceries, and I live only 500 feet away from here, but I can't stop thinking about how badly they messed up my order last time.  It's the easiest job in the world... it's McDonald's.  There's just no excuse.

One of the better McDonald's locations in the area. The building was recently renovated so it's nice inside. Staff is friendly, although a bit unprofessional at times. Service is usually fast, but during busy periods it's often total chaos.
The only thing wrong with this place is McDonalds' business model: mediocre, unhealthy food served by minimum wage staff which is totally disengaged. Overall they do their best.

I would normally never take the time to write a review of McDonald's but I have to give this one a shout out to the amazing staff! They are by far the most friendly staff I have ever experienced. It's so cheesy but every time I go through the drive thru I leave with a smile.
Don't visit here. Bathroom is disgusting, the cashiers didn't know what's the meaning of customer service. And the play place is unsanitary.
The food here is horrible, the restaurant was super dirty. The staff was pleasant though. Will not be returning to this place when I come back to  visit Reno.

This location has a small indoor toddler playground inside. It's decor is pretty modern but cleanliness isn't "A" game. 3 stars only because I've visited far better clean McDonald's so this one didn't completely impressed.  I'd prefer to simply go through drive thru because when I dine inside today - food took a while. Ah while like more then 10 minutes wait. My visit day was lunchtime Saturday so if your truly in the mood for some McDonald's - just drive thru ok?!

Horrible. There are no words for how horrible this is. Closest McDonald's on Broadway closed. Now this is the only option and the service is SO slow, SO RUDE and restaurant is FILTHY! Took over 35 minutes to get through the line and I still had to settle for something I didn't want because this glorious location does not participate in any of the specials. Breakfast all day? Not here. UGH!

Really unpleasant experience all around.  I've tried this place a few times because my daughter loves a fast food outing and this is by far the closest.   But the place feels like a dive bar - dim lighting, loud bar,  sticky surfaces, a few sad patrons.   The drinks often do not work.   The fries are usually really dried out.     It is just really crappy all around.
Both drive thru workers were very rude to us. They had attitudes from the start and we were missing half of our order.

The worst in area. Inside constant beeping. Employees standing around, disinterested, taking breaks in plain view. Order accuracy poor. Drive up is like roulette. I don't speak getto and can't understand the order taker. Rarely is my order correct. After so long you think I'd learn.

meh. I've experienced better. could use an updated eating area. some of the tables are a bit too dinted and pale. dreaming of sausages on a cold irish morning. triple distilled vodka with lemon and frozen twistys in a barber shop drunken sailors swaying off the starburns from community college with no degree to shower cuz I can't afford deoderant, rant rant rant about nothing exists but my dirty underwear please can I be a yelp elite?

I keep hoping that they will get better, but they continue to be the worlds worst McDonald's. Nothing tastes quite right. The beef is rubbery, the toppings are hap-hazard in placement, and something is always broken. One day I was in there and they didn't have straws. Please McDonald's corporate, Fix this location for chestnut hill fast food lovers.

Beware. This McDonalds is gross, when you walk thru the door. Smells like something is rotting inside. Most of the workers look like they are zombies and on oxy. The food is gross. Cold fries and a double quarter pounder that has been the warmer for days. Just plain disgusting.

Normally I don't do fast food reviews. Always 3 star or less. But this place. Seriously? Took 15 minutes for a double quarter ponder. 

Drive thru girl was hanging out the window to smoke her cigarette. Looked stoned red eyed.

I'll be honest, I go here only because it's super convenient. If I could teleport to another McDonald's during my work breaks I would. I've been here quite a few times and almost every time, they get my order wrong. 

Most recent example: I went inside and ordered an iced coffee with no cream. The drive thru line was at least 10 cars deep. The cashier asked me THREE times if it was to-go (I am still trying to figure out why this mattered...coffee is not placed in a doggy bag with a napkin). Also asked me twice if I wanted to add anything to it. Took a while for her to enter it into the register. Took my money and I ended up with an iced coffee with extra cream. It took another 10 minutes to get the attention of the staff to fix it. 

Not that I am inconvenienced by this but others may be: there is no trash can by the soft drink machine where the straws and napkins are kept. You have to walk to the entrance to dispose of your straw wrapper. The drive thru is super slow and I don't trust that they'll ever get my order correct. The staff was complaining about not being able to schedule a day off. I don't blame the workers, I blame management and lack of training.
Quality of food is bad, fries overcooked and hard to eat my jaw hurts from chewing them. Burger bun dry and meat lukewarm.

This is the third time they messed my order up, but the food is still pretty great when they don't mess it up. It's a fast food place that I would still go to so that should say something lol. Service is consistent so you know what you're getting. Fills me up, can be cheap enough to only use tips, and they have my favorite soft drink.

OMG!!! If I could give it Zero stars I would! This is the worst location in Tucson. Over the years this place has gone dowhill. Bad , horrible slow incompetent  service.The service and people working here have hit rock bottom.  They are rude, incompetent and have no sense of what is important to customers or do they care. Recently  ( 5/18/16) 7pm.] I had trouble with scan strip on debit card. Tryed all the tricks. Paper receipt, plastic bag ect. Nothing was working.  I asked the employee  just to manually run card. Did the drive thru a few minutes after 7am. Had a special order and they nailed it. It is crazy that some of the local McDonald's have no idea what light ice really means. Great smiles from everyone I interacted with. Good job.

Food was terrible. The employees are rude. Got mad at me because she couldn't get my order right. On top of my order being wrong the fries tasted like they had been setting all day. I will probably never be back.

I stopped here to pick up breakfast for my office. I went inside and ordered 15 sausage biscuits. That's it...not too complicated. 20 minutes later after seeing orders go out the door and asking several times where my order was (kept being told it's coming right up), I ask again. I'm told "they're waiting on a fresh batch of biscuits." I've been watching them and I've seen at least 20 biscuits go out since I placed my order. When it finally comes up, she says she threw some pies and extra stuff in there and she's so sorry. I say, ok, that's cool, people make mistakes, and at least she's trying to make up for it. I get to work, and she gave me 2 pies and shorted me 2 of the biscuits I ordered. And the people putting the food together in the back...were practically making out. So yeah...great job, guys!

This was my time at this restaurant in Camden, NJ but I have been to the other one near the Camden One Stop and that was back in 2012. I didn't order any food or drinks, even though I wished I had done that but I came here get some change. I had no problems with their service.

This place doesn't even deserve ONE star. Just close the doors. Incompetent staff, slow as molasses and they clearly couldn't care less about their ability to deliver any kind of customer service. I'm DONE.

Wow. No customer service here. It's nice to walk up
To the counter and have three employees look at you numerous times and then turn away and ignore you for 30 seconds. No hellos, no have you been helped, no welcome, no service. And one of them was a manager. To top this off, once it was brought to his attention he finally acknowledged us and then rushed out order as if we were holding HIM up from doing something. Then the next more important thing to do was all the personal chit chat instead of promptly getting our breakfast. No smiles, no thanks for coming in, no come back soon Nothing. It's a shame when you ask for ketchup and they hand you one packet of ketchup. You ask for more butter and they hand you one butter. Really? Are condiments now made of gold? Will McDonald's fold up if they give out one extra ketchup packet? And just check the news reports, "McDonalds executives baffled with a downturn in business" Ha! Get off the golf course and Tahitian beaches and personally mystery shop your stores and learn your customers, know your business and business might mysteriously reappear! Wow. What a concept!

If I could give it 0 stars I would. Drive thru is the slowest ever. You get stuck and can't back out. Sitting here now at 7:00 in the morning on a week day and guess what? 10-12 cars in line and no one is moving. Been sitting in front of the box for 4 minutes and no one has even acknowledged me. The staff is miserable and trashy and rude and the restaurant is FILTHY! If you dare stay in line long enough to be waited on, double check your change and your food!!!! Oh and don't bother trying to call the proprietor...she doesn't return calls. Ugh!

I wish I could give this establishment 0 stars. The service is slow and very bad. They filled mcflurry only 3/4 of the way full and couldn't even get a simple order correct. I went here twice and both times it was the same. The cashiers acted like I was putting them out and treated me and my party with rudeness. However if you knew the cashiers then they were super nice to you. 
Seriously you should avoid this horrible place. Even the bathroom was disgusting. The toilet paper was sitting directly on the ground (the tools were huge and clearly could never fit in the tiny roll dispenser) and the soap dispensers were broken.
All the employees were in street clothes and on their smart phone. More reasons for employersto have Kiosks outside of the 15 $ min wage. As a employer, i think this is disturbing

Update 10/13/16: Recently, ordering breakfast here during non-breakfast hours has been better because we've learned to specify when placing our order that we want things (such as hash browns) "made fresh".  Doing this, we've had a lot better results.  I also like that they've expanded their all-day breakfast menu, as breakfast is my favorite meal of the day.

***

I love breakfast, and the idea of breakfast served all day is good in theory. But in reality, if you order breakfast during non-breakfast hours from this location, your order will NOT be fresh or cooked well. We've tried on more than one occasion, and the food is either hard and cold because it's been sitting around for hours unordered or hard-as-a-rock and overcooked because old product that has been sitting around is refried a 2nd time, like the hash browns we ordered today in the late evening. If you're going to serve breakfast all day, it needs to be made fresh no matter what time it's ordered. Otherwise, "all day" breakfast is nothing more than marketing hype.

This is THE slowest place EVER.  You would think if they were so slow the food would be right???  No.  Every single time its wrong.  EVERY TIME.  15 minutes in a drive thru is absolutely ridiculous.  Inside is just as bad.   And, the manager looks like he hates being there.

I entered this McDonald's in 1982 and I'm just now leaving.  I exaggerate, but not by much.  The service in this place is so incredibly slow.  We places our order at 6:12 (as per the receipt) and didn't receive our food until almost 6:40.  Just ordering the food was an ordeal.  The operation of the register was a little complex for the gentleman working it (bless his heart).  It took at least 5 minutes to order 4 10-piece nuggets, a quarter pounder with cheese, a Big Mac, a chicken sandwich, and some fries.  It took a ridiculously long time to order and get our food.  By the time we got our food, we were very hungry and irritated.  The chicken sandwich was inedible - the lettuce was wilted and the chicken patty was dry and old.  On the positive side, the chicken nuggets were hot.  The fries, not so much.  We had to ask for ketchup packets because the dispensers were out.  One of the drink machines was out of ice.

The store wasn't busy, but everyone was getting the same painfully slow service.  We couldn't wait to leave this place, and I will hesitate to enter any McDonald's in the future.

EDIT TO ADD:   6/17/16
McDonald's contacted me via Twitter to provide feedback on my terrible experience in their store.  When I gave them the information, they said that they couldn't find the particular store that I was referring to.  I gave them the street address.  Nice to know that they're just as competent as the employees of this location.

No complaints here, this place is what it is, and everyone already knows, lol. I have eaten inside and used their drive thru window, and most of the time they get my order correct and to me in a timely fashion. 

I usually am there during off peak hours, so maybe that helps me too, but normally the drive thru has been pretty quick getting my food, and I even order my burgers without onions, which takes them a few extra minutes to make fresh. 

I like when they have the 2 big mac's or 20 chicken nuggets for $5 deal. Now I think it's 2 egg mcmuffins for $4, and they serve breakfast all day long now too.

If I could give this place zero stars, I would.  Four times in the last month I have tried the drive through, and three of the four I have had to park and wait in food.  Every time, it has come out sub standard.  I will never go to this McDonalds again.  Go on down the street to anything else.

As another reviewer said, I typically wouldn't take the time to review a McDonald's but this one is so excellent all around I felt the need to! Every time I have ever picked something up from here I have had a great experience. Staff here are always very friendly, professional, and pleasant to interact with, which really makes this place stand out as that's not very common for a McDonald's! The wait time has been virtually non existent every time I have been here, and the food is always fresh and warm. In addition, this McDonald's is very clean! Definitely worth going to this one over any of the other McDonalds' in the area.
Probably my favorite McDonalds in New Orleans.  The freshness of the fries and buttermilk chicken sandwich actually make me feel as though I'm consuming fewer calories.

This McDonald's is legendary for rude employees and terrible service. Had to learn this the hard way. Will never go back.
I asked for catsup and they told me to go use the dispenser in the restaurant rather than be given packets at the counter.
(See below. Management has apparently instructed the employees to hoard the to-go packets of condiments to save money. They actually charge you for extra condiments.)
I went over to the catsup dispenser. The crusty nozzle was covered in fruit flies.
I returned to the counter and told them I'd prefer packets, and why.
The employee laughed in my face like a wicked witch. This was comedy to her. She then reluctantly gave me some packets of catsup -- after checking with her supervisor to make sure it was okay to relinquish some of the precious catsup packets.
No move was made to clean the area.
As has been noted below, management doesn't care about the customers.
At all.
And the employees hate their job, and they hate you for making them do it.

This has got to be the worst McDonald's restaurant in the history of mankind. To be a brand new facility their driveway time for their drive thru is anywhere from 5 to 15 minutes. The staff appears to be untrained and not caring so I would imagine the management staff is piss-poor also.

Three times at 3 am I stop here and I get the same message "we are closed for 10 minutes due to a computer problem " what kind of software do you guys run here Windows ME. I checked the front area and seen people lounging around. 

Fourth time I come here and ask for a breakfast burrito.

Their response: We don't have them until 2 am, unless I can't read good and went to the Derek Zoolander School the sign says " All day breakfast" not all day except at 1 am.

This place needs help big time. McDonalds Corporate needs to investigate this place.

My husband and I have eaten here a few times over the years. Five days ago, we thought we would give them one more chance to resolve themselves. Sorry to say, they are still the worst McDonald's we have ever tried.
Their burgers taste as if they cooked them in the am and just threw them in the microwave at dinner, per order. Shoe leather!

Absolutely hands down the worst McDonald's in the city.  Can't track orders, don't know their own menu, and ridiculously slow.  If you want what you actually ordered in less than 30 minutes go somewhere else.  You can actually make it yourself correctly at home faster.

This is the absolute worst McDonalds I have ever been too. Sadly, I go here at least once a week just because it is across the street from me and they can never NEVER get the order right. They manage to screw something up with your order every time. Whether it's no straws, no syrup for the pancakes, 2 times a coke instead of a Diet Coke, cold fries, a dbl with 8 pickles on it when I asked for a dbl. plain, a dbl made cheese meat meat cheese, or breakfast sandwich with bacon on bottom then cheese then the egg, etc... You get the idea.

I decided to revisit this location this morning. I figured after 6 months, and multiple bad reviews, they would have shaped up a bit. However this is not the case. 
I will say I am happy I at least got a receipt this time. 
When ordering, I had to repeat multiple times that I wanted the drink with out Ice and as a large. They kept putting it in as Medium and/or extra ice. I did not check the order when I received it as I was on my way to work. When I did get a chance to open it up I discovered I was given the wrong food, just like before. I ordered a number one, which is the egg mcmuffin, the one with had. I was given a sausage mcmuffin, the one that has just the cheese and the sausage patty. These items are not even really the same, so how can they be mistaken for eachother? Not to mention I will not eat the sausage, so I threw it out. I was out breakfast and money this morning. completely unacceptable.

Place is not clean. Bathrooms dirty and floor grout is disgusting in the mens bathroom they are not courteous to customers. Orders are wrong and food that seemed to me has sat a while and they still serve it. Never going there again.

This McDonald's has gone downhill since my initial review. Or maybe I just was luckier before with my experiences. 

Today I stopped in just for some fries and there was no salt on them. I thought maybe my order was mixed up so I went inside and explained and they said they were out of salt. I said I would like my money back then and the guy rolled his eyes and threw some salt packets at me. 

I have come a few other times here and there for breakfast sandwiches on my way to class and the employees are consistently rude lately. I don't know what's going on, but I am willing to be patient about subpar food when it's McDonald's... Not subpar service.
Impressive McDonald's, the food is good and of course gorgeous Christmas Decorations.

The best McDonald's in the area. The staff is extremely friendly. Very patient with the orders in the drive thru. Extremely fast and I honestly never had my order wrong. Its a busy McDonalds, yet you still get the best service with a smile. Food taste always good and fresh.

On my way to Chicago, I decide to stop by McDonald's in Camby, IN. I'm not head-over-heels crazy about Mickey D's, but getting a sausage McMuffin with cheese this morning just seemed like the right thing to do.

The the first thing I noticed, since I went through drive-thru, was how speedy the service was. There were a line of cars, but they ran cars through there so fast, you wouldn't even be able to see the tires. I went ahead and ate in the parking lot, and my first bite took me back to almost make me remember my first experience at McDonald's as a kid.

The egg and sausage was so fresh, and the cheese was the finishing touch to this breakfast masterpiece of a McMuffin. The customer service might I add, was so friendly!!

This McDonald's makes you wish that these experiences should be everywhere. Very good, and please continue to show how it's done!!!!

This McDonalds is guaranteed to completely screw up your order.  


Example:  burger with no bun
Just not good at all, the fries are the only thing that they have good and that's only if you order them without salt.

Nice clean and fairly new McDonald's. Had breakfast before church at 7am. Staff was very friendly and kids were happy with their breakfast. I asked about purchasing separate happy meal toys and was happy to hear that they offered them for $.80 cents a piece versus others charge $2.00. I love franchises run well and will continue coming here for food versus other Brandon area McDonalds. Just make sure to double check your meals when you go through drive through as they often do not communicate certain changes to meals we have ordered.

This place should be avoided at all costs. You are constantly harassed by panhandlers for food and money. The people working in there don't seem much better and really don't care what they serve you. I don't believe they were ever taught what customer service was.

This location is absolutely not the cleanest at all. I stopped eating for from here about 2 months ago. The fries are not all the way done around lunch time. The bagel is very stale. The only thing I will get here is the ice coffee. I do come get an ice coffee almost every morning. I asked for a small ice coffee which is $1.06 with tax. A medium is $1.29 with tax. Not everyone here can make ice coffee. The one worker puts so much cream in the cup, the coffee is beige color. Sometimes it's strong and you can't even taste the flavor. I asked for a small ice coffee with an extra squirt of caramel like I always do, so I can taste it. This one particular morning, they tried to charge me $.38 for an extra squirt. How is that even realistic. I never been charge before, so it took me by surprise. So I mention I will come inside and get the coffee myself, because they have all the condiments out so you can do it yourself. It was a male taking my order and it was ok with this. All of a sudden a female comes on the intercom and say well mam if you come In and do it yourself we will charge too. It's out for the customers. http://www.floridahealth.gov/diseases-and-conditions/food-and-waterborne-disease/how-to-report-a-problem-with-food-in-florida.html

Inspection records for this restaurant show that they have had repeat violations related to failure to protect food from cross-contamination in the past, from as far back as 2010 to as recently as 2016.
