Most dysfunctional McDonald's I've ever been to. I could write a long review but there are so many things wrong I'd have to write a paper on it. I get that it's fast food and I can't expect "greatness" but this was absolutely absurd. 5 people standing in front of me all didn't even know what they were doing and 2 out of 3 stations broken.

Casper family get your regional manager in here stat.

I had not patronized McDonald's in many years as there are many other establishments that actually seem to work for their customers business. 

It took over five minutes before one of the four employees asked gruffly if I had been waited on. I placed an order for a #1 meal which is their Big Mac. As I waited for 14 minutes to get my meal several other customers approached the counter  complaining about their order accuracy. I watched as several people had to repeat this process three or more times before getting their order right or they gave up in frustration. No staff member including the English speaking manager/supervisor ever apologized or acknowledged the customers exasperation it gave the assistance if caring at all. 

I figured with my long wait that I would at least get a hot fresh meal but apparently my food must have been praised long before my arrival. I received a cold Big Mac that was half unassembled in the box with my side of cold soft fries. Not sure why it took 20 minutes from the time I arrived at the counter until I received my order since the time was obviously not doesn't preparing my food and there were not many other customers in the store. 

Lack of employee engagement, lack of empathy and poor or no management seemed to be the order of the day here. How on earth they can keep the doors open with every customer on site complaining and NO response or concern from staff is simply amazing.

Most of the employees at this McDonald's are very rude and the service is slow.  The restaurant could also be much cleaner.  The food is average quality compared to other McDonald's.  Even the drinks taste awful.  I've been there about five times and each time I've regretted going there.  The employees also act like you're wasting their time by being there as well as acting like they don't want to serve you.

The weekday morning crew is almost always very good. Kudos to them. The day crews are poor and the weekend crews simply pathetic. Dry buns, lukewarm fries and otherwise poor tasting food and a lackluster customer experience are unfortunate hallmarks of this McDonalds and all restaurants owned by Moore Company around here. Save your frustrations and head down the street to Hardees for a far better experience.

This place is just awful!  While the establishment itself is relatively new, that's where the appeal ends!  For years now, I've been bringing my kids here to eat and play on their (what used to be relatively clean) "play place."  But over the years, the quality of the food and especially the EMPLOYEES has been alarming!  

I mean, I realize that I'm not going to Spago's, so I kind of know what kind of tasteless cheeseburger I'm going to get.  I also know that "turnover" at these fast-food places must be extraordinary, so I also get that keeping "quality" personnel must be next t impossible. 

But nearly every visit to this location recently is met with sour, rude, indifferent employees who clearly convey an attitude of not wanting to be there!  I'm sure they probably DON'T want to be working at a McDonald's on a beautiful Sunday afternoon, but today's experience set a new low... even by this establishment's standards!

My sons and I visited today, and we were greeted (?) by "Kayla" at the front counter.  She clearly did not want to be there, and it was very evident by the disgusted and sour look on her face.  My boys and I like our food completely plain (i.e., no sauce or anything else on the burgers), and Kayla appeared irritated at the somewhat confusing order.  Not surprisingly, when we received our order, one of the items was incorrect (it was not plain).

Dreading the confrontation with little Miss Attitude, I walked back out to the counter and explained that one of the burgers had sauce and everything else all over it.  Kayla grabbed the burger, walked back to the cook in the back who glared at me-- as if I had violated some "holy code of returning food" or something, quickly slapped together a correct burger, and slung it across the counter to Kayla.  I said, "thanks, Kayla!"

Silence!

The weekend "manager" here walks around the place with her shirt untucked, and doesn't seem to have a grasp of how this establishment is going.  I'll call the 800 number on the door and see if that gets me anywhere, but bottom line is this:  this place has really gone downhill, and it's primarily because of its employees and management who don't seem to care!
Worst McDonalds ever!  Customer service lacks in every possible aspect. I don't understand why they are ALWAYS so slow as well.

Drive through is slow as turtle... I like that you can order breakfast 24hr but have to wait 10 minute for 1 sausage sandwich. Was surprised to wait that long for fast food is all. They got the order right though.

I hit this location usually in the morning on the way to somewhere.  They have recently remodeled.  They seem do to fairly well at pushing through the drive-thru.  The employees have been polite, and my orders have been accurate.  They seem to be doing something right.

Main issue here was this is one of those McDs that charge 30 cents for one sauce. No thanks!!! I should get at least one sauce if I just spent $8 on a meal, c'mon now stop trying to nickel and dime customers. That might help you in the short run but personally it really aggravates me and I will tell others not to come to a place managed this way. I came during early lunch time and got a chicken sandwich. The chicken was clearly not freshly made and was dry, my fries were over salted, and my coke tasted gross (had hints of dr. Pepper in it). The service in the drive thru was unfriendly. Employees did not show any enthusiasm and looked tired. This was the about the 5th (and last) time I went to this store and the other times weren't good either, so I decided to write a review this time.

My husband and I both worked at McDonalds in High school and college and have visited McDonalds Restaurants in every state in the country. 

This was, without a doubt, the worst drive through order fulfillment we've ever experienced. Everything was correct on the screen. When we pulled to the first window, the woman read our complete order to us before taking our payment and the order was correct. At the pick up window, almost everything was wrong. They handed beverages first and we got a large iced tea and a large Coke. I explained that we'd ordered Diet Coke, not Coke, and it should be a medium as it came with a value meal that wasn't upgraded to a large size. Then she handed me the salad with Southwest dressing. I explained that I wanted the "diet dressing." She said, "We don't have a diet dressing." I told her I'd ordered the balsamic vinaigrette and she gave that to me.  On the package it clearly says low fat. Next she handed us a strawberry shake instead of vanilla. Again she said sorry and returned to the window with a vanilla shake. 

After we finally entered the highway and divided the food up for all the folks in the car, we realized the iced tea was really sweet tea (despite my husband clearly saying regular and it showing up on the screen as unsweet tea, there were only 2 orders of fries instead of three, and rather than using a new cup for the vanilla shake, they simply dumped out the strawberry and filled it with vanilla (there's no covering up that fake strawberry taste) and my boy couldn't drink it. 

Our visit to McDonalds on Waldron and Kill Something (can't remember the word after Kill) was 7/13 at 12:30ish during the lunch rush.

I am one of those rare senior citizens who actually like McDonald's food! My granddaughter and I stopped in on a hot day. Wow, the air conditioner was not working and as it was Sunday afternoon there didn't seem to be much chance of relief. We ate in the kiddy playroom - normally a place I carefully avoid, but there were only two other adults having a quiet meal in the only part of the restaurant that was a bit cool.

Our counter dude had such an accent that he was extremely hard to understand. I appreciate folks who come here and work like he was and I know my German and Spanish accents have made many people struggle to understand me. But, a business needs to be able to communicate with its customers.

Men's bathroom status: not good and I shall say no more except to note that the lack of air conditioning made it even worse. There were very few customers and I can see why as the place was not at all comfortable unless you went to the play area.

The food was typical McDonald's - adequate for the occasion. The fries were hot and fresh which is sadly increasingly unusual at many McD's where I stop while on the road.
Can't get an order correct.. Ever, they even put on the receipt"extra mayo" and it's like they intentionally put less  really?

This franchise needs a management overhaul. Employees are nice for the most part but not empowered to manage simple problems. There are always probably because they don't get the orders right. Manager Angie in particular, zero customer service skills. Recommend continuing to Olive and Dielman location or Burger King a bit west.

Went through the drive through to get my daughter chicken nuggets. The service was fast and the food hot and good. My daughter was pleased. I can't speak in regards to the inside of the place. Maybe next time. The employee that assisted me was pleasant.

Why can't I give this place negative stars?  Or call for a boycott???

I walk in with a friend of mine, a woman in her sixties, who is tired, with back pain, and all she wants is to sit down and have a cup of coffee.  She sits down, I'm about go order her coffee, but the FULLY ARMED security guard is immediately in her face, lecturing her about how McDonalds is "not a hangout." I ask him why he needs a taser, mace, baton, and a GUN to throw paying customers out of the restaurant, and I get ordered to leave.  I go outside, my friend gets her coffee, I'm standing on the sidewalk waiting for her, and HE comes out and tells me I'm not even allowed to stand in front of this McDonalds. 

I've tried to talk to the managers, and they were just as disrespectful, and have gone as far as to call the police, to report that I was looking through the front window. Taxpayers' dollars!  I was just looking to see if the same security guard was working, because if he wasn't I would have gone in for breakfast.

I happened to be in Clearwater Florida today and stopped by this McDonald's for lunch. This is a nearly brand-new restaurant on Gulf to Bay Boulevard. When I went inside it's very modern and clean- new architectural design for McDonald's. I sat in the dining area and they're actually now delivering the food to your table for those eating there. Very clean restaurant and the staff was very friendly. Also for the kids they have touchscreen video games-could've been a nice experience for a McDonald's. They even have a ice cream and coffee bar separate from the restaurant area. I was very impressed and I will definitely be coming back.
Excellent indoor playground! Clean. Kid friendly and free wifi. Staff allowed us to choose what happy meal toy my kids want . The burgers are suited for my taste buds.
New staffs and so much different customer service and willing help to the people who want to go though.

Was early for an appointment so I stopped in to waste some time.
Bathroom was closed... Isn't that special.
Ordered a milkshake.....
Paid my money and waited.
And waited.
And waited.
Finally told the milkshake machine was down.
Really?
How hard is it to have a functioning store?
No, avoid this store!

I went there since 1979. Up until today no problems. I ordered a value meal and the counter kid gave me a jillion 1's in change. I asked for larger bills and he said no but then he said he'll ask the manager. Waited ten minutes, I overheard manager calling me crazy. All they had to do was look in another drawer. So finally I took the ton of bills and shoved them in my wallet. I told them I will never come back again. Customer service is declining everywhere.
I've been in this McDonalds several times and I've never seen it this clean I'm very impressed its usually a filthy disgusting place. The service has improved more than I could have imagined.

Servers at all the drive-ins they need training. I wanted an Iced Coffee with both vanilla & Carmel, there were several discussions, if this could be  done. It was made.  or an order could be slightly changed. Had the Battered fried Chicken dinner.  I Will order again.

Visited around 3pm.

Have ordered through drive thru several times for work. Hey people - the eggshell does not belong in the fried egg!!!  Have never had one mcmuffin without some part of the shell in it. Crunch!!!   Yuck!!!!!  This was my last time eating that crap.
I felt like I was dining at a 5 star steakhouse this morning, excellence at its finest.
No refills on soda and evidently a McFlurry is just ice cream with some Oreo crumble on top. Waste of space....

Absolutely terrible.  HORRIBLE workers with terrible customer service, & they act as though they're doing YOU a favor - which is hysterical. Ignorant,  lazy,  You name it.  McFlurry machine is always "broken", and they always get your order wrong.  On the bright side,  Wendy's is across the street and a new Cane's is being built too. Thank god.
The customer service isn't great, the place is usually very messy, and they consistently get our orders wrong.

Lazy!!! Went to the drive through @11:45. All my family wanted was a couple milk shakes. They said they had no food left to serve. I asked what time they close and they proceeded to tell me 12:00. So... 15 minutes till closing and no food to serve. In our opinion that's just plain LAZY!!! Especially when all we wanted was a few milk shakes! NEVER GO HERE OR THEY MIGHT JUST TELL YOU TO LEAVE!!! LAZY LAZY LAZY!!!

Okay, I wouldn't normally give any fast food joint 5 stars but this place knocked it out of the park. 

From being greeted right as we walk through the door to check up service at our table. I was wowed!! 

Typical McDonald's food, nothing special there. But now they offer a Create Your Own burger option with a touch screen station. Lots of options there!

Saturday evening at 8:42 p.m. Only two tables were clean. And only four chairs were in their place the manager was leaning over the counter or talking to her friends. If you have time to lean you have time to clean. And my boyfriend use the men's room and he said it was deplorable
This is a crummy McDonalds and you have a better chance winning roulette in Vegas than you do picking the right drive-thru lane. There is no rhyme or reason to it. It's Thunderdome!
To everyone who is going to do a dollar menu do not get the fricken 20 piece chicken mc balls ( chicken mc nuggets )

I wish I can give them a 0 star terrible service no one in the Drive-Thru took us 7 minutes to get our food and it was wrong simple order two coffees has brown and oatmeal coffee was cold and no condiments were placed in the bag

This location like so many in the area are providing good and fast customer service. I'm not here to debate the the healthiness of fast food. McDonalds almost always provides quickly good product that is becoming more health conscious.

Whether I use their drive in or eat inside McDonalds employees are usually on top of everything and keep things moving. Stores are clean. Bathrooms could use more monitoring. I always feel they're a little dicey. 

Bring back the fried chicken!

1 patty on a double cheeseburger...a susage mcmuffin instead of a sausage egg and cheese on a buiscuit...and oreo frappe instead of chocolate chip..no apple pie. This was all 1 order. Luckily it was postmates so i got it all free..but come on guys, get it together. It's not a hard job.
It's McDonald's. You get what you expect. Mostly edible food cooked hours ago and kept in a warmer. The "benchmark" for fast food.

This is not the corporation it was when I was a child I can tell you that.

So as you can see after a prior entry for a different McDonald's, I'm not having the greatest success with this corporation. 

I have to write this one though as I never thought it could be as bad as the other.

I was wrong. Really wrong. 

Store # 23366 6/19/2016 Worst in Tucson for two years running.

I've had lots of issues from this location over the past two years from slow wait times to inaccurate orders. I've contacted them a couple of times with little satisfaction. Today though was too much. Food poisoning. As soon as I swallowed a bite from the Big Mac that I'd ordered, I tasted the spoilage. Too late.

I'll be contacting the Franchise and the corporation this time.

Seriously, enough is enough.

This is one of those odd instances when I know going in that nothing I write in this review will change a thing. The parent company will make money no matter what I write, this location will make money no matter what I write, so I will take solace in the idea that I will save at least a few drunk people. 

SO here's the sitch, as someone said in their review. I understand that the employees are underpaid and have to deal with the worse that humanity has to offer but good lord all I want is some food, and I'm ALWAYS sober when I come in (I've usually just finished making other people drunk)

I've come here before and the service is ungodly slow. I always order the same thing (breakfast for dinner) my average wait time for it to be made, 22 minutes. That's right it takes this place an entire episode of How I Met Your Mother to make a sausage mcmuffin with egg. Tonight I went in because I had 40 minutes before my next train. I ordered two sausage mcmuffins and 6 nuggets......Yep you guessed it, I missed my train.

Final thought: I know you're probably drunk when you go here but do yourself a favor walk the two blocks to Wawa or around the corner to Little Pete's

This McDonald's is convenient only because I seem to pass by this intersection along US-130 a lot. You can enter from US-130 northbound or from Farnsworth Avenue. There's a parking area with tree shade near the Farnsworth entrance. Anyway, this McDonald's is pretty average as far as this chain goes. I didn't encounter any problems with the service, the food, or the restroom.

This was such a dirty place! Every table was sticky and there were no customers in there when we arrived. A used cup just sat on an empty table collecting bugs. The trash was overflowing and some of it was even on the floor. I know that when fast food places get busy it's hard to stay on top of messes in the dining room but the employees were all playing around when we entered and no one bothered to do any side work during the downtime. I know the manager was aware of the the condition bc there was an interview finishing up when I entered. The bugs were the biggest nuisance...flies and gnats everywhere. I had to kill a flying ant on our table  stopped here bc it was right off the interstate but I'll make a point to avoid this location again! Visited 6/20/16 5:30pm

Worst location I've been to by far. They take forever to answer you in the drive-thru and they sound pissed or bored as Hell when talking. The buns are usually hard on the edges and they have repeatedly screwed up orders. Plain burgers covered in slop and the classic "ice cream machine is broken" remark. Most of these people need to get a kick in the butt and learn how to work and be nice in the service industry. 

They're slow, rude and accuracy is horrible. 

I will never go here again.

I was the only person in the drive thru line at the time and there were maybe two customers inside. The only thing I ordered was a vanilla shake. I was met at the window three times by two of the employees. At the first meeting, I was asked what I ordered and I told the first worker a vanilla milkshake. A second employee proceeds to come back to the window with a strawberry shake. I finally received what I originally ordered at the third meeting. I was the only person in line. My order was simple and yet it was butchered twice in the span of 5 minutes.

OMG!  Again waited 7 minutes for a cup of coffee while people after me got served if the cashier would not have stopped and made my coffee it would not have gotten done the chick by the drive up window was doing nothing but sipping her orange juice and standing around looking. Then every day the tables at 6:00am are filthy every single day it's a disgrace. While they are standing around doing nothing but chit chatting with each other clean the tables PLEASE!!!!!! 



4-11-16 a record breaking day it took them 10 minutes to make one iced coffee there were four people behind me that got food and drinks before I got my coffee this place SUCKS!!!!!! Where the hell is a manager they ignore you and worry about drive through they should have a timer on the counter so people behind the counter we get served as quickly as people at drive-through get served this is every day I wait 5 to 10 minutes for one cup of coffee and my father as well. 

Well today I paid for my coffee at 6:31am and stood there while all the people in the line after me was waited on the woman filling orders said I'll make you coffee however she never did once the cashier who has no clue how to make a iced coffee did at least make an effort and did it I swear this McDonald's is a joke with their customer service they are all about welcome to McDonald's but then they SUCK!!!!!!

5-4-16
Wow I though things were changing I got my coffee very speedy the other day but sadly. We are back to waiting on 4 customers or more behind me to get drinks and food and I have to ask where my ice coffee is and I get a very estranged look from counter chick and she says with an attitude I'm getting it now so I said yes but once again only after every customer behind me gets served food and drink and again I get that estranged look from counter chick.   

6/22/16 the female manager here today is a real ass does not have customer service unless your a male. She trips over herself to wait on them smiling and jumping through hoops I come daily and she is almost always got a nasty attitude. But karma is a bitch because she got pissy because my ice coffee was basically almost all cream and no coffee so she takes it bitching about me to a coworker loud enough so I could hear when she went to add more coffee to drink the hot coffee go all over her pants and shoes that's what she gets for being nasty.
Stopped here today and the service was fast. Each employee that I dealt with was extremely polite and professional...I was impressed.
Great service from Michael over there best person in the place. Kind and respectful. Food is timely and respectful.

The WMAC is locally famous for its crappy service and poorly prepared food.  As the other reviews say your best to avoid the drive through.  They are slow and when they inevitably get your order wrong you will be stuck in your car waiting forever as they decide if they feel like correcting it or just waiting you out.  Inside is marginally better. They get a bonus star for having a unique building and some radio themed decorations with plenty of comfortable seating.  Expect only one register open despite the lunch or breakfast crowd.  Most horrible of all, the all day breakfast menu features biscuits rather than the egg Mcmuffin. Most of the time I've found the food to be of marginal quality even comparing only to other fast food locations.  This place figures you to be a tourist so they don't really expect you back and there is not a ton of fast food joints nearby so I guess it works for them.  Still if you have even 10 extra minutes go to the waffle house across the Parkway and get your burger or breakfast fix there.

My husband and have gone a couple times on Sunday mornings and there is always something wrong when we are there. Example one morning a girl and a guy work argued who should take our order. They didn't want to work. Lazy employees. The girl had a hoodie that had no signs of being an employee she looked like a complete scrub. Another time an employee was cleaning the soda and ketchup area and after trying to get ketchup and nothing the lady said go to the counter. She then let another person try then told him it was out. She didn't refill. LAZY employees.
Horrible! Dirty. Garbage everywhere. Bad service. This is just a filthy place. No attention to detail in servicing or food prep

Probably one of the worst McDonald's I have been to. My order came out wrong, so I took it back to get it fixed - the person working at that time looked straight at me and said simply stated, "oh well". To be quite honest, I don't expect five star service at a McDonald's; however, I do expect there to be some decent service to the point where I can fix an order gone wrong. So to get a response as such, it really did bother me.
So much better than the one on Market Place that I drive the extra distance to eat here.

This McDonald's is a pad site (Ha! Wikipedia this term.) in front of First State Plaza. One annoyance I encountered is the pedestrian approach to the entrance was oriented in a strange direction. There is a fence all along the edge of the parking area, so one has to walk almost right up to the mall road and then back again to the door. That aside, this McDonald's seemed pretty much standard. The food was what one would expect. Service and food preparation didn't take too long, and they didn't forget anything in my order.

If you like to wait 30+ minutes for your order in the drive through and like to pay full price for half of your order, then this is the place for you. It's the only mcdonalds in Southside so I guess nobody cares.

This is the worst McDonald's in the world .  Incredibly slow.  Apparently there is zero training for new employees.  It's hard to believe McDonald's corporate let's this place continue to operate.   Terrible, terrible, terrible.  Employees have terrible attitudes.   Keep away at all cost
I will say I have stopped going here because they always forget something from my order, weather it's a burger or a straw. I see to many people in this place for it to be as slow as it always is.

Even for Spring Hill this place is terrible.  The food is typical McDonalds. But after the fiasco my husband and I went through on separate occasions this morning alone, we will not return to this location. I walked in to order breakfast, and the full breakfast menu was still up on the board, only to be told they quit serving FOUR minutes ago. 4 whole minutes. My husband went back 20 minutes later to order bacon, egg, and cheese biscuits, which according to McDonald's all day breakfast menu should have been available, only to be told they don't serve those all day at this location. And that he would have to wait 10 minutes for egg mcmuffins. So he came home with Big Macs. Personally, I would have walked out empty handed again and gone to Burger King. Which is exactly where we'll be going from now on.

This seams to be the main location for kids who are riding their bikes in town to go to. It has a great play place. The owners are very nice and help you out if something isn't right. This is one of the best in the treasure valley that's why it's so busy durning lunch and dinner!

Bad customer service, and rude staff. Make sure your order is correct and complete before you leave, because they are famous for getting orders wrong and or forgetting to add a fry or a burger or two. Also , be careful going to the drive through, it's not leveled and your cat jumps up and drops as you are entering it.
Crappy place dirty 4 out  5 times got old food or cooked wrong, Their  menu keeps going down hill, U think  they would know that they need to have a good product and make it the same every time
Slowest service in the world!!! Seriously do not come here thinking you are going to zip through the drive thru. I think they intentionally slow it up!

Passed through this joke of a town heading back east. Women's and men's bathrooms were DISGUSTING. Chewing tobacco all over the men's toilets, urine everywhere, stalls beyond atrocious, and the women's was just as bad.

The employees laugh at you when you say there's an issue with cleanliness. I can't imagine the sanitary regulations that are broke every day in this building. They must spit chewing tobacco in your burger meat on-top of probably a 1,000 other kitchen violations.

Like the other reviews, I wish I could put a zero star rating. It's pathetic management hasn't done or cared to do anything here. What a disgusting town that must be.
Awesome for kids,they have this gorgeous indoor playground that my daughter loves,Apparently the first of it's kind in the country.

So trife! We came to this McDonalds because we were meeting my husband here to exchange keys. I was worried we were going to be late to an outing so my mom suggested us getting dinner here. I was in extreme panic as I know deep down inside I HATE going to McDonalds because of the lack of healthy food choices. However, I swallowed my pride and decided to get food.

My sister in law had to use the restrooms and change my niece. Because of this locations track record, I didn't even want my niece anywhere in that building! So I changed her in the car and my sister in law went in to use the restrooms. When she came out, she was discussed. So I went into see the madness.

There were feminine products and blood everywhere! There was toilet paper all over the place. The mirrors, floor, and stalls were discussing. I just don't understand how a place can still be in business after having such awful and unsanitary bathrooms. 

We went to the drive thru and could NOT even order food. The lady asked what we wanted to order... We said absolutely nothing. 

A place that does not keep their bathrooms clean most likely does not keep anything clean. I will NEVER eat here... I'd rather starve.

The cashier had an attitude with me because I ordered a big mac and a fish filet individually instead of saying I want a mac pick 2 for 5. So yeah I generally hate McDonald's but this one in particular just rubbed me the wrong way after that pointless exchange. On top of that my food was cold so yeah never coming here again.

Curious how many hundreds of dollars this McDonalds has lost either A) screwing up my order and having to redo it or B) having me throw food away because it came with cheese on it and it was too melted to the bread to scrape off (which I have done dozens of times). 

Pop quiz. 

Q: How do you screw up when I order a hamburger? 
A: Put cheese on it. 

You even put them in the traditional gray wrappers plain burgers have come in for decades. Is your staff color blind because that would explain it. 

How many more cows have to die before this location gets my very simple order right... 

...no wonder so many cows work in the Billboard industry pushing ChikFilA products.

Awful McDonald's! Went through drive through and they completely screwed up my order. Ordered sweet tea and got unsweetened. Ordered two double cheeseburgers with extra cheese and no pickle and got one double cheeseburger with pickles and no extra cheese and didn't even get the other burger (although I paid for the other and paid for extra cheese). Fries were cold with no salt. Rather than driving back there, I attempted to call them. Either someone is on the phone for over 30 minutes or their phone is off the hook. Calling corporate.

This place sucks! Rude employees - EXTRA RUDE MANAGEMENT! Wrong order almost every time, half the time I try to order something and they are "out" or too lazy to cook it. Today was my last straw. STAY AWAY FROM THIS DUMP!
This McDonald's has always been fantastic! The wifi is the greatest I've ever experienced. Will definitely be back!

My family gets dinner from this McDonald's about twice a month. We also go through the drive thru because of the convenience. However, each time we get to the speaker box, we wait for someone to greet us. After waiting a few minutes, we have to ask if there's anyone there to take our order and right away the employee says, "Can I help you?" in a less than pleasant tone. This particular time after having to ask for someone to take my order, I had had it. I asked the employee if they no longer greet the customer and if I'm suppose to ask for help. She responded rudely, claiming that she was speaking to her manager and that was the cause of the delay. Highly unlikely since this had been our experience nearly every time we come. Then, we pulled up to get the food, the employee at the window (assuming it was the same rude girl who "took my order") didn't say anything to me, just stared at me rudely as she handed me my food. After giving me the last item, there was no "Thank you!", "Have a nice day!", no apology. So, I smiled and thanked her and left. Finally, after returning home, I pulled out the food from my daughters Happy Meal and her french fries were dumped in the bag, upside down. The employees that I've had contact with are just rude and very unmotivated. Just a frustrating experience overall.

Horrible service. It says 24 hour drive through on there signs, but they are rarely ever open. They'll lie directly to your face about why they are closed. No customer service skills. I've since stopped going there and hit the steak n shake across the street.

Dirty, understaffed, and unorganized this mcdonalds is very easily the most dysfunctional establishment I have ever been to. They touch the fries with their hands when they pick up the containers. I've witnessed countless times employees scratching their heads and making te fries without washing their hands! Cross contaminated to the max! McDonald's doesn't require them to wear gloves to make the fries. That needs to change! Fries should be handled like any other food ( with gloves) Manager said they wash their hands each time- I witnessed them NOT washing their hands at all!
Filthy, good quick service friendly and prompt but filthy , yes this is short but it says enough so post it already

I swing by the drive thru at this McDonald's when I'm in a rush to eat (either because I'm too busy to eat at home or I just forgot. Unfortunately the drive thru is usually very slow. I like the people who work here though! They just tend to get slammed in the middle of the day... Always!

As far as McDonald's go this is on the verge of the worst. They are never staffed. They have mostly rude or incompetent employees and have only one lane for drive through open during their busiest times, and can't complete the simplest of orders.

I have never been to a McDonald's where they bring you your food to where you're sitting at. 

Don't get me wrong. That is NOT their job to do that but I was just chilling with my phone and didn't notice that my food was ready so they brought it to me. At most McDonald's they would just have my food sit on the counter until I get it.

For the HASHBROWNS!!

Great service!

I went to the drive through and it really took a very long time to get through it.  I had a burger, fries and mocha frappe.  It was typical McDonalds food. Came to this McDonald's and it has a gas station as well but they don't have anytime breakfast. Isn't that a bummer? Slow order.

Sloppy, lousy, senile.
It takes a lot out of me to go out of my way to make a Yelp review.
They're so slow and sloppy. They're so miserable that they want to spread it. I have seriously contemplated whether to work here or not just so I can show these guys how they should work.
Worst McDonald's ever!!!! I wait forever in line and when I finally get up to the window what does she say we're only taking cash!!!!! Omg never agian

Hmmm, today for some reason they had NO drinks available. None. Okay, I'll go to the station, just give me my food. So, I get to the window and the guy says my order is most definitely not here. Really, it's not? Weird. Again, he said it wasn't there. We began pulling off, no longer to his window and he yells "OH HERE IT GO!!!!!!" Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?? No way. Shove that order, man! Also, no Red Box. What can you really expect from people making, maybe, $350 every two weeks?

If I could give this place zero stars, I would.  I was just there at 12:30, in other words, peak lunch time. This place always perverts the concept of "fast food." The line of cars snaked totally around the building as usual, so I went inside. They had one register open and the girl stationed there pretty much hung out in the back and only came out when she felt like it to wait on one person at a time, only to leave again for a few minutes. The floors were filthy, the trashcan behind the order counter overflowing onto the floor. Two out of three times that I come here, I'm told "Our shake machine be down." Today was no exception, and this has happened for the last five years. I even filed a report on this with McDonalds and the manager wrote back to say I was mistaken about the frequency of breakdown of the shake machine.  Today I said that this has happened the last three times I've been there, I asked why the shake machine was always down. Miss Motivated looked at me like I was stupid and I didn't think she was even going to answer me. After about five seconds, she said "I don't know." Probably the truth, to be fair. I guess they think I'm just trying to torment them. It's probably an act of God, I certainly don't need the calories. But I think if they routinely can't serve something that shows on the menu, they should probably take it off the menu. The bottom line here is: nobody cares. Certainly not the employees, not the manager, and not even corporate McDonald's. It's  certainly not what you expect from this brand. And I mean that not in a good way.
UPDATE: One week after my review. 9/1/16, "Our shake machine is down at the moment."  At the moment, right.

On our way out of town we decided to stop for some food. Got to the north side and realized they didn't give our two kids their milks or yogurt. If fast food employees want $15 an hour maybe they could try getting a simple order correct. Pathetic.

What idiots!!!! My wife and 6year old went there today at 10:58AM, I repeat 10:58AM! They wanted to order a happy meal for lunch. The cluck, sorry meant clerk said they are not serving lunch until 11AM, which she said is in 2 minutes!!!!! My wife drove out of the drive thru. I work for a service oriented company and we pride our self on service!!! Prices don't mean much if your service is poor!!!! In this case "POOR" would be an upgrade for this location! Stay away they are not service minded at all.

Mc Ds in the city filled with trees. The Santa Barbara Mc Donald's was great. Super clean, freidnly staff and easy to get to. No drive thru though. But I thought it was a perfect road stop for our family.

I bought two quarter pounders with cheese. They were dry and tasteless. They were flat like cardboard and there was not one drop of juice in the sandwich!  I asked for extra ketchup and some mayo on the side, which I didn't get. 
My burgers looked nothing like the burger pictures on tv!

But, we probably end up here once a week. Why? PLAY PLACE.

We inevitably drive by just about daily and so the kids whine and moan from the backseat about wanting to go. 

Is it clean? Nope. Is it sanitary? Not at all. Is there dried up food and grossness everywhere in the play place? MmmHmmm. And I'm totally not above just making sure it's a bath night after being there for an hour or two. The wifi is decent and they often have great deals on the McD app that land us free drinks and the occasional free fry for the kids. Otherwise, we get yogurts and apple slices and a cheap afternoon of playing with kids before going home and burning (I mean washing) our clothes. 

I sure wish this place didn't come with the ick factor, but it's so dang close to home that it's hard not to just indulge the kids in the germ-filled place every now and again.

I went to this McDonald's 5 times over the summer at lunch time and each time the food was the best I've ever had from a McDonald's. Very fresh and the time from ordering to getting the bag was maybe a minute at the most. I don't know what the lunchtime management at this location is doing but keep it up!
Clean and very nice customer service! We always stop to get an order of a large fry because who doesn't crave mc Donald's fries!
Your typical location open 24 hours. Except at 4:20 AM, they are getting ready for breakfast. Which means they are not serving any food, according to the drive thru attendant.

very fast and friendly service and they have the old school deep fried apple pies.
need i say more
I was in the drive threw when I never received my drink, when I went back threw the drive, the young lady was very disrespectful and rude. What can one expect from McDonald's :/

FAST FOOD?! Tell me what you can get in 20min? I can get a noodle soup sometimes!...This McDonald is not efficient at all, one of the staffs seems don't care the long line behind. The lettuce in my McWrap is bitter, wasn't that enjoyable...
Wow! Since our last review this place has definitely improved! The food has been fresh and tasty even late at night. The service has been amazing and orders are always right. Great job!

Seriously, do not buy the Southwest Salad with grilled chicken at this location.  I recently purchased this item twice.  First time I was disappointed at how small the salad was for the price.  Second purchase today, there was hardly any lettuce in the salad and it was even smaller than the first one.  I couldn't believe it.  My husband got it through the drive-through or I would have returned it.  Will not purchase this menu item again.
This is hands down the worst McDonalds that I have ever been to. Horrible service every time. Keep driving!

Wow.... Came in at 10 on a Sunday night, place looked like it hadn't been cleaned all day. I watched employees literally walk by piles of trash n just look at it. The person at the register acted like I was an inconvenience to her day just being there. Flies everywhere and food smeared on the counter where you get your condiments.... Never again... Place should be shut down.

How the hell can they stop taking orders 15 minutes before closing? And limited to a dollar menu? I wonder if the owner approves rhis or how would corporate feel about this? Something tells me losing money wouldn't be a good thing in their eyes.

Hey it's McDonalds I go here once and a while. It's been consistent and the labor force has been good.  I used to go inside when the kids were young enough to play in the gym on the inside.  It's fairly quick to grab a quick meal because it's so close to home.  I haven't had an issue here and the bathrooms are clean.

Not sure how thousands of people go through here and don't provide a good review.  

It's been consistent for me and my family when we go.  I haven't had one problem at this location.  I've been coming here for over 7 years.  I can't say I'm going to do a three page write up on this location ... Or take pictures of McDonalds food however I can say the bathroom is always clean, and it has the kids play room on this location.  If your tired of the food ... Get some for the kids then walk to the Starbucks next door for yourself.  Staff has always been nice and the floors are clean.

A year ago they would have received a 4 or 5, but today they get the lowest possible score.

Orders usually take too long, they tend to be wrong half the time, while the other half they're right but extremely old. Employees make it obvious they'd rather be anywhere else, they forget the receipt so you can't call and complain. I even had the manager argue with me when I complained about a fountain drink I received having no syrup and tasting awful on multiple consecutive visits. 

Do yourself a favor and go to the one on Gulf to Bay.

It's all good. Got here at 12:15pm. You know lunch time and no line. Uh wondering why but must just be a lucky moment in time. Came here today for the free chicken McNuggets offer on their app. Surprisingly they had improved. Now look like white meat chicken inside. A plus was the golden fried to perfection on the outside. Again this could be related to a warp in time considering there was no line at the counter. After I sat down in a quiet space (there are about 10 other people enjoying their lunch) I watched a steady stream of customers. One thing I wanted to note is the recent remodel of this location. It's very nice. Lots of seating for people with laptops needing power outlets. No kiss play area but I don't remember one before the remodel. Lots of parking. Including 10-12 spaces under shade trees. A bonus for the everlasting summers in Florida.

You know, it sucks that this is the only 1 nearby. Every other time I go here, my order is jacked up. Their service is terrible, they have no idea what they're doing. The owners need to get this in order, I mean look @ the average reviews for this location

Wow, I wish O had looked at the ratings. This is by far the worst McDonalds I have ever been to. Ghetto rudeness accompanied by attitude. Do not go here, don't waste the time you could spend going elsewhere...

Was just in line at the drive thru and never got any service, even as several cars in the other lane that pulled up after me were waited on. Finally just left. Sadly, this type of thing is typical of this McDonald's...cold fries, rude employees, and incorrect orders are what they serve here.

Sticking to the one on Bayless off of Hwy. 55.

I eat at McDonalds  (shamefully) quite often. I've been to almost every mcdonalds drive through in Edmonton and this is by far the worst service I've ever received in a drive thru. 
The first time I went to this specific McDonald's (june 2016) the young lady working the drive thru window seemed more focused on small talk with the male driving the vehicle then taking down our order. We ordered 2 coffee iced frappes both with 2 espresso shots. They had no problem charging us for this but after driving away and taking a sip we discovered neither had espresso in it. We went back inside and explained the situation and I asked for them to give us the drinks we ordered. The manager I spoke to was rude, condescending, and acted as if this were somehow our fault. She was hesitant to oblige and questioned us thoroughly about what we ordered. It took nearly 5 minutes to explain what was really a simple situation. This was incredibly frustrating considering we had to turn the car around just to get the drinks we paid for and especially so because the manager made it clear with her tone and body language that our request was impeding her day. 
About a month ago, I was eating in the restaurant. I ordered a large coffee with my meal and was given a drink cup. This typically wouldn't be a big deal for me and I let the crew member who was putting together my order know that I had actually ordered a coffee instead. The girl rolled her eyes, didn't say anything, and grabbed the cup. I was mildly annoyed with this not-so-great customer service, but let it go. 
Last week, I decided to get breakfast after an early morning appointment with my boyfriend. I ordered a bacon egg mcmuffin meal with a second sandwich on the side. He ordered a mcgriddle meal with a second sandwich on the side. We got to the last window and were handed a bag with 3 bacon egg mcmuffins, two coffees, and nothing else. We told the manager at the window that this was not what we ordered. She scowled, and told us this was indeed what we ordered. My boyfriend explained exactly what we had ordered over the intercom to her again and she again said no. She treated us as if we were lying and demanded, very harshly, to see our receipt. My boyfriend went to hand it to her and she grabbed it from his hand in a very aggressive manner. Once again, we were being treated as if it was our fault that they made a mistake with our order. She walked away and did not come back for what seemed like a very long time. Finally, she came back to the window and said "Give me the bag". So my boyfriend handed it to her and again she ripped the bag from his hand. She left for another period of 5 or so minutes. When she came back she mumbled "sorry" gave us a bag with 4 bacon egg mcmuffins and 2 hashbrowns. At this point, we were too frustrated with this woman's( a manager, at that) awful attitude and lack of basic customer service skills that we just drove away as it was not worth the trouble and this was very quickly ruining our morning. The worst part is that my boyfriend used to work at this McDonald's location and informed me that this manager has been working there for 5+ years.
This McDonald's location has the worst management(and team, quite frankly) I've ever come across. There is a severe lack of manners, complete disregard for customer satisfaction, and I am absolutely appalled by the attitude of "managers". 
McDonald's Belmont, here is a key tip - If you're not going to hire employees competent enough to take an order, you don't get to act offended when people ask for what they ordered. Simple. 
Worst. Mcdonald's. Ever.
This location is the worst! It really needs to be shut down.   Don't waste your time here the staff could care a less about you or your order. Give your time & money to someone else.

One day I was pining for a salad from Greece
With tomatoes, peppers, feta cheese
Onions, capsicum , cucumbers, oil
A treat to turn one into a Royal.

Than where you got your   burgers  and fries

Expecting  a  Mediterranean treat
With chunks  of chicken, to add some meat. 
McDonalds'  take, in sharp contrast  
I would not call a Greek repast:
A bowl with kale, some  lettuce leaves
Sprinklings of  quinoa with  feta cheese

Service was great --  as it was bionic. 
They served no bread, so with some regret
Three measly stars is all they will get.

Disappointed every time I come here. I don't know why I come back. Over 75% of the time my order is messed up. I would be ok with it, only if the workers weren't so rude.

I'll never go back there after that happened- being thrown out of a McDonald's traumatized me out of fast food- stay away too!

I seriously hate this McDonalds so much. Literally every time I go there, the staff is rude and seem annoyed that we're there. Like I understand being at work sucks but like why are you being nasty to me for? 

Also the quality of the food is pretty deplorable. I know McDonalds isn't the best quality anyway but this stuff comes out burnt, soggy, cold, etc. 

This McDonald's blows!

I come to this McDonalds to bring my little one to play in the play place.  Of course he loves to eat here too.  After reading all the horrible reviews I felt the need to defend this place at least a little.  It seems like the problem may be the drive up, which I've never used.  However, all the times I've been there, I've never had any problems.  I order, the food is brought to me in the play area shortly after.  My little man enjoys playing here and although I can't say the food is great...I mean it's the ultimate fast food right?.....but it fills his belly and hey, the apples are good!  I don't let him eat here a lot, but everything in moderation.

We don't eat at fast food a lot, only when traveling. We stopped for lunch at 2:30 p.m. and it was a horrible experience. People were waiting 30 minutes for their food!! I ordered a grilled chicken sandwich; after waiting 10 minutes they came over and said it would be another 7-10 minutes because it was not put on the grill (or something). I asked what chicken sandwiches they had ready and ended up with the spicy chicken sandwich. 

The young guy working the register had difficulties with communicating with customers and co-workers -- very unprofessional, even for a fast food restaurant. One of the employees was trying to help me and he kept interrupting her. Then when another worker came over, he asked her for something and they ended up getting into an argument right in front of about 10 customers waiting for food. It was a scene out of a soap opera!

When traveling through this area of the country, we will make sure to skip over this exit!

This McDonald's just opened near the Premium Outlets and is a nice alternative to food at the Premium Outlets if you want something cheap and fast. 

Since it's new its still very clean and the staff hasn't gotten rude and jaded yet-lol. However, they are still working the kinks out of the self ordering. When I did order, I got the meal. Naturally the meal would include a drink, right? 

When the server brought my meal she didn't bring a drink out with it. She looked at me with all the surprise of a baby deer lost in the woods and asked, "You ordered a drink?" I showed her the receipt and she then trotted back into the forest to get me one. She did apologize though. It wasn't a big deal. Just kinda funny. The food itself was McDonald's and what you expect.

This location is a joke. I've never complained formally until now. Today, ordered 20 piece nugget, large sprite, and large fries and a cheeseburger. That's exactly how i ordered. The screen was at first correct and rang up $9 and some change and then when she said is your order correct and I looked back it jumped to $12 and some change. I noticed she changed what I ordered to be a 20 price combo meal. And that made my order jump nearly $3. I asked her if she changed it and she said "yes because it will be cheaper for you." I told her to change it back because she was wrong and it was more expensive that way and that's not how I ordered.. She changed it and the price came down. Then at the window there was no acknowledgement that she tried to overcharge me no apology or nothing. I can only imagine how many people they do this to and they don't notice. I think it is so wrong and I will no visit that location anymore ever. And why it is so much more expensive to buy as a combo vs. a la cart. Robbing people of their hard earned money is a bad look. Plus their ice cream machine is ALWAYS broken. And those making the food etc do not always wear gloves.  They are also extremely slow.

97% of the time they mess my order up. 5/10 times when I go to the drive thru they don't have my order ready &I I have to pull over and they are supposed to "bring it to me". Well on several occasions they never came out and I had to get out of my car (in the rain - the reason why I went to the drive thru in the first place) and go inside and find out where my Big Mac meal is.. then they usually they mess my order up (I don't eat cheese so whatever I order I say no cheese) and if I don't check it before I get home and guess what??? THERES CHEESE. And a lot of it. Usually unmelted - yuck. Then there a 40-something year old "manager" (mean that in the loosest of terms) guy there "running things" and he has the audacity to get an attitude with me for having an attitude with them for fucking up my order - how rude *Stephanie Tanner voice. If it wasn't so close, I'd never go there. #MrProTip

Wow. Waited in line for 10 minutes and the employees laughed and sat on the counter. I understand no one wants to work 4am but clearly the crew working here should not be employed for this position. Will never come back here and make sure my friends and family don't support such a dis functional company.

I drive by here all the time. I can't remember the actual first time I came here but inside the restaurant is nice and clean. Good service along with nice and helpful workers. They got TVs in here with CNN to be informed on what's going on.

Update: Still the worst McDonalds I've ever been to, including once in Mexico. The employees don't care, the orders are usually wrong, and it hasn't gotten any better in the three years I've been working in this area. I know people don't look at Yelp reviews of McDonalds, but if the owner or manager is reading this, please look at your operation and make improvements or your building will likely become a Starbucks in the near future. You only get business because it's the only McDonalds around.

Wish I could give NO STAR. Horrible service or I should say no service. Stood at the counter, no one ever acknowledged me. There were about 5 people working, no one smiled all looked sullen. No one in line ahead of me. Maybe no one wanted to wait on me because I'm white.

Just trying to get a quick bite.... was not quick.. the training is not done well. So the service is well below par. Order was not even correct. Fries were burnt.  The oil at this location at one time was changed often.  But did not taste that way today.  If you see brown fries... throw them away and put some new ones down!  Don't give them out to customers.   When you have a line of 12 people inside.. you shouldn't have the trainee doing it solo.     Just disappointed. Makes me realize not to eat out and so called fast.

Went Saturday January 7, 2017. I thought it could not get worse but it has. The fries were hot this time but the Big Mac had no taste. The burger was dry and the lettuce kept falling off. Ketchup didn't help the flavor. McDonalds is going to have to improve their burger. The competition is just too good to go to McDonalds.

Nuggets were good. But the fries... oh Lord. It is January 8th and we just had a small snowstorm. The fries were colder than outside. They weren't crisp at all either. I dont know what kind of joke this is but these fries are piss poor.

I have a secret love of McDonald's - no matter how sophisticated your pallet, there is no denying that the McDouble is a great value or that the fries have the potential to be great (if they aren't 12 hours old and unsalted)... plus your options are limited when it's 4:30am on a Monday morning and you can't sleep. 

Generally, I've found that I can indulge in this guilty pleasure quickly and easily 24 hours per day - With the exception of most McDonald's having the conveniently "broken ice cream machine" certain hours. 

This McDonald's is different though - I think the employees are robbing the owner. Every time I go here between 3:30-4:30am they tell me "the system is down" and it's "cash only" - they also can't ring it up at the speaker - you need to pull up to the window to order. 

Why is the McDonald's in deptford always able to accept credit cards during this time? Why can they provide a receipt? Their system is never "down". It's simple, the make up the number and pocket the cash. 

If you own or manage this McDonald's, I urge you to do a mystery dining sting at around 4am on a week day. If you address this issue I'm certain you'll see a surprising spike in sales and cliff like drop off in food waste!

I got a chicken biscuit from here today and they gave me what appeared to be the size of a chicken nugget. When I questioned the size of the chicken I was told by the lady who worked here that she couldn't help me and that she didn't owe me any explanation when I asked why. Horrible customer service I'd say!

Service is always excellent and on point even though this is a busy location.  Staff is always super friendly and efficient.  Not to mention this location has the NICEST public restrooms I've seen in Indy!  Keep up the stellar work 10th st team, we appreciate you!!

Late night munchies after a concert and sometimes we want McDonald's so we will hit this one up.  We didn't go through the drive through but go inside and use a coupon from the app.  They usually have $3 off a meal deal and others such as 50% off a McChicken.  The last time it was close to midnight and the place was busier than I thought.  There was no one at the cash and I looked in the kitchen but couldn't see anyone.  Then I spotted a person but they didn't come up.  Then a staff person came from the back and apologized as it was shift change and he didn't see me.  He was really friendly and I was cool with it as it wasn't a long wait.  

I asked if I could use the coupon for $3 off and he said yes and he scanned my code on the app.  We ordered another Junior McChicken and small fries and our bill was less than $10.  Our food was ready pretty fast too so that was good and it was accurate.

The next visit we went to ask for a lid for our pop as there was none in the beverage area and the staff wasn't friendly and rude.  Guess it's hit or miss with the service but at least the food orders are accurate.  Next time we see a show/concert and get the munchies after, we will head here.

Literally the worst location I've ever been to.  The place literally smells like ass and is ALWAYS dirty.  The population surrounding it is poor so they never have any of the "fancier" items like lattes, smoothies, etc even though they have it on their menus and have the machines to make them.   It's really just burgers, fries and soda here.  I ordered a coffee here and they the woman gave me a sandwich bag with sugar and cream as they don't even have the modern machines where you push the buttons to add the condiments.  Those things were put into McD's over a decade ago.  Never go here.
Slowest service! They don't care about the customers inside! Definitely not fast food.. No manager to be found

If I could give it 0 stars I would.  I sat in line for 15 minutes at the drive thru only to be told they can't take "no more orders due to a shortage of people."  That's embarrassing. You're a business.  Unless there's a shortage of food I want my nuggets.
It is 6 o'clock in the morning I ordered a drink 10 minutes ago and they're just now coming out here to tell me that the machine's not working. Took my money and everything.

I drive through here every morning and every morning the line is 5 to 6 cars long while Julie performs her morning talk show routine  "Hi my name is Julie and I'll be taking your order this morning what can I get you?"  You can get me a new drive thru attendant cause I don't care who you are I just want my food so I can get to work on time!! She then takes your order and reads the items back to you , gives you the grand total, "Is that correct?" and asks you to "please drive around to the first window." When you get there she continues taking orders while you wait for her to take your money. She cannot obviously chew gum and walk at the same time. She then thanks you for coming in and wishes you a Merry Christmas, Happy Hanukkah, Lovely Wednesday, Thirsty Thursday- whatever before hoping you come again.  Well if you don't get rid of her I won't Not what anyone wants to hear at 7am or any time of day to be truthful. She's ridiculous

Yesterday will be the last time I frequent this McDonald's. I ordered the buttermilk fried chicken sandwich with fries and a large drink it was completely busy so I waited 15 minutes for my food. when I got home, after I completed the food, within two hours my stomach was killing me. I have had terrible stomach pains and have emptied my bowels at least 25 times. Frequent this McDonald's with caution

If you're looking for customer service you certainly won't find it here.  Employees were rude and somewhat abrasive.  Food was standard McDonald's fare (B) however customer service (F). It's a only if you have to spot

The counter girls are so sweet. It's the annoying short haired manager who spends more time yelling at her employees in front of all the customers embarrassing them than putting together the food I waited fifteen minutes for when I was watching people who came after me, leave before me.

Do not STOP here! Do not STOP here. They never fail to mess your order up all the time and the staff is extremely ignorant and rude! I literally had to tell the Drive thru boy to give me napkins. How hard is it to put napkins in a bag? His response to me was to get off my phone!? What does him doing his job have to do with me speaking to someone on the phone? I've been living around this area for more than 20 years. Nothing changes at this McDonalds. Not stopping again. Btw their ice cream machine is Always broken too!

You'll regret stopping here! Keep driving! Waited 30 mins after i paid...along with 5 other cars. They ask you to pull off to the side and just wait.  Eventually I  had to go in and ask "why's my food taking so long?!?" Finally got my bag, and drove away in frustration.  I got on the highway and dug into my bag-only to unwrap a very stale sausage egg biscuit that was hard as a rock! I tried to bite it while i was driving .... and couldnt even break off a piece!!  Further digging into my bag i found 2 Cold hashbrowns -probably fried 3x over and sitting around greasy and stale -it had no "meat" left to it, and then .... 2 Large cold stale fries!  Ughhhh, Nothing was hot. I mean how does anyone have the audacity to wrap such a hard stale biscuit up and then put it in my bag? Thinking that thats ok.  I bet you if anything fell on the floor in there, they would have no problem picking it up and putting it back in your sandwich .... Incompetent workers, ....filthy store ...Just look and observe everything while you wait to pay. ...I should have made a U-turn and got my money back, but i got too far driving and it was late at night.  This place needs to be investigated and then condemned by Mcdonalds.
Excellent quick service and pleasant workers. Ate a big mac every day for a month and after checking out a good amount of the McDonald's in the area, this may have been my favorite.
While completing my challenge of 31 big macs in 31 days, I was able to visit this restaurant a few times and was happy every time with my service. Wifi wasnt bad either!

Hands down consistently poor service. Today I sat in drive thru and was ignored in my lane while other customers in next lane were waited on. Went inside told the female manager  who gave me a blank look and didn't' say a word or apologize. Avoid this location as it is always poor service and the food is never hot.

Anita and Edwin were awesome, who would of thought McDonald's had class act service. I've been going to McDonald's for 36 plus years and never had service like this. Amanda at the register was perfect the way she payed attention to your order and made sure it came out the way I asked. I know it McDonald's but I wanted to share my experience. I will bring my grandbabies here.
The only reason I'm giving one star is that the woman at the window was friendly. My daughter's pancakes had not one but 2 pieces of hair in them. Disgusting.

Same ole crap, different day. Same crappy manager. Heads up Stacy. You can't ban a customer complaining about the service you provide and then try to change your tune so they don't contact corporate. Usually I turn back around when you are working. My mistake today. Too often you've made it obvious you don't want to wait on me. You will never admit you're wrong and eventually that's going to cost you a lot in life if it hasn't already. You are a PERFECT example of how one bad apple can ruin the whole bushel. You obviously didn't take the customer service personality test and your boss evidently hasn't witnessed your verbal abuse to customers or other employees who are afraid to say anything to you. Karma is a funny thing. When you least expect it, karma going to bite you in the ass.

I agree with some of the previous reviews, which are less than satisfactory.  The drive-through was defectively designed and constructed -  it is too narrow and too winding. It shouldn't be too hard to re-construct it to make it easier to get through. More importantly, the customer service needs to be improved.  I went there recently and ordered coffee, and clearly stated that I wanted it with no sugar.  The girl at the window handed me the coffee, which was loaded with sugar.  I went through again, and asked for what I ordered.  Another employee gave me another coffee, made as I originally ordered, but she made no apology, and seemed annoyed. This is at least the second time that I received an incorrect order at this location. The other three McDonald's locations I go to, in less prestigious neighborhoods, have much better customer service.

Always a disaster with orders for a family of 5 here. I appreciate that they try to pick what is cheaper for you when you initially ask for a combo but they miss the point of adding that drink to it and making it more expensive. How is it cheaper to tell me to get 2 cheeseburgers and a fry for 5.29 and I don't get a Coke with it? And for the love of God, can any McDonalds learn to put a fish filet in the MIDDLE of the bun?????? Rocket Science. 
Food was cold tonight, as well.

Never thought I'd decide to review a Mc Donald's, but they are always so nice here! Always friendly and they move quickly even when the line is long. I don't go to Mc Donald's that frequently, but I choose this one whenever I want something quick (I work close by) or for like a "cheat meal." (Side note: Is it a cheat meal if you do it often?)

Writing this review as I sit in a 15+ minute drive-thru line. Avoid this location if possible. They're consistently slow, mess up orders, and their shake machine is typically down. Also, rude staff. I'm expecting my order to be messed up, but I'm having an internal debate as to whether or not it's even worth bringing up, due to the fact I'd have to wait another 10 minutes for them to get it right.
Horrible every time always close the lobby early than supposed never have coffee never have ice cream. Total crud.

Every one knew in the 90s when junk food restaurant on The Hill was first proposed it would be a disgrace to this beautifull community. It's cheep rotten sign left  dangling from the wall  atop this ugly building for several years now really tells the whole story. When neighbors call to plead with a manager to do something, they are rudely left waiting on an un answers phone.

I work for McDonalds as well. And I love going to other McDonalds to see how I can improve the store I'm at. I went here this morning by drive dine. So many problems. The lady who took my order was just not happy. Was rude and I felt unwanted. I thought maybe at the second window people would be nicer. I was right. But one big problem I have here is THEY NEVER fill up the cup the right way. If you look inside the cup there is a line where they need to fill up the cup too. And they always, ALWAYS, do it a inch under. My order was right but guys. I had a big order and they stuffed everything into a 'A' bag that is the smallest bag. Be nicer, be honest with the cup filling, that one inch of coffee that i paid for is not going to make your food cost go up, and put everything in the right size bag. I didn't appreciate my hash browns becoming mashed potatoes.

Who doesn't love the GOLDEN ARCHES that illuminate the sky & makes your mouth water & call out for those golden FRENCH FRIES?

Pros:
-Swift transaction
-Pleasant order taker & cashier (two different people in the window; I saw)
-$1 any sized coffee... Winning... You get a coffee, you get a coffee, you get a coffee...
-Low cost items
-Vast menu
-Quick & fast over all processing
-ALL DAY BREAKFAST, yesssssssssss!!!!! 

Cons:

-I had to request specialty condiments ie jelly, who eats biscuits without STRAWBERRY JELLY??? Pshew, not this girl, I'll tell you that (not a deal breaker, but I just prefer being asked if I care for anything else)
-This location kinda gets lost in all the 'busyness' of the area; Tastee's here, electronics store there, Quizno's here, Sprint store there... 

All in all, if you know me, this was my FAVORITE KIND OF CAPER: #stickandmove #inandout #gonelicketysplit and this 'brings me joy'.  Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day & on this day, McDonald's met the order (pun not intended, but i'll take the credit for it).

Doesn't even deserve 1 star! If your reading this, and you have not been to this location, then there is still time. The expirience I had at this McDonalds was in worldly. The staff was completely rude and should not be allowed to be within 5 meters of any human. They constantly messed up my orders, even when I brought it to their attention that my order was wrong. The smell of the restaurant was disgusting, it seems they pay more attendion to cleaning the kitchen for the health inspector than their dinning tables. Every table was sticky, and had tons of trash laying on it. If I could I would rate this establishment -4 stars. You have been warned, never go to this McDonalds.

The manager at around 4:00 thought not everyone knows Spanish and was calling me a puto after I asked a simple question. Really crazy that there is a loitering limit of 30 minutes if your a paying customer but that's not why I'm rating it so low the employees are unprofessional laughing in the background snickering and saying remarks not knowing people can hear them. Hopefully soon they take out all employees and have the automated machines because these people need to have some respect as a paying customer you should never be treated that way. I have the whole incident recorded live her calling me names I stayed quite after they tried charging me I politely said thank you I am not going to purchase this food because I am not about to eat spit. Manager should be demoted for sure never going back

Wow...this restaurant gets some crappy reviews! 

Let me commence by saying I like McDonalds on occasion. I go to Maccas every month and I usually enjoy it. Mostly it is in South Florida, sometimes in Nashville, and also in foreign countries.

So, hungry and in a hurry, I went to this particular little bistro in Joelton. My first impression was formed by one of the staff who came in through a side door only to let out a lungful of cigarette smoke, presumably, following a smoke break. Let me jump ahead thirty minutes, and I have now formed the opinion that everyone on staff smokes, as there was a musical chairs style of arrangement going on with the gasper-squad spending more time outside than in.

A young girl who was a part of this came in and went directly to the counter to resume serving. Now, hand to mouth pursuits, when performed in a restaurant, need to be followed by the washing of ones hands...It didn't happen. 

So...to the fyude! I ordered a Big Mac, fries and a Coke. It came out fairly quickly, and I think the reason for this was, that it had been pre-prepared. The burger was on the cool side of warmish, the fries were limp and were a similar temperature, but, the Coke...well, that was was fine. Yay!!

This is all damned disappointing. I judge all burger joints that I review, according to the McDonalds Yummy Meter. When a franchise screws it up, it skews the figures on my meter. 

Let me re-affirm my belief in this chain. it is my opinion that there are many, many more good Maccas restaurants, than there are bad. So it all needs to be fixed up...someone needs a good hard boot in the nuts (and I'm not talking cashews).

I think Mr Mac needs to catch up with this establishment and give the owner a serious yakking to, along with a re-education campaign, to teach the local operators and staff about (1) cleanliness, (2) hygiene, (3) service, (4) quality of product and (5) the proud history of this genuine American flagship company.

I hate to give bad reviews and always think very carefully before I give a business a dirty mark. But, as you can see when it comes to bad reviews of Maccas in Joelton, I'm not Robinson Crusoe.
God this place sucks. The service is usually horrible. Tonight the service wasn't that bad, but I ordered a 20 piece nugget and got 2 BBQ sauces instead of 4. Get your act together guys.
I'm very picky when it comes to my coffee so when I can go through the drive through and it's right every time that's impressive

First off 1 star is the lowest score to give, should allow for zero stars. The worst McDonald's in the history of McDonald's. No one in this establishment knows what to do or pays any attention. Orders are incorrect about 4 out of times. Even having a quality check sticker on the sandwich does not fix the problem. The people taking the orders are fine, just the people making it and handing them out is the issue. The problem starts with management. The store GM Cayenne at this store is probably the worst person at any job. She obviously does care about customer service. Also when I call to complain to Dana at the number on the receipt who is the district manager still can't get anywhere, all she provides is a free meal by sending a card in the mail which is only good at this same location. She has to find people who are willing to work and have a good work ethic, unlike the person she hired Cayenne. Why would I or anyone want to go back to this establishment and have to deal with incompetent employees. I'd rather have my money back and go down the street to Burger King.
The tea at this McDonald's is almost always soured. Someone needs to show them how to clean their tea urns every evening so as to prevent this horrible travesty.
BEST MCDONALD'S EVER! Great staff. We all know what McDonald's tastes like. Food is always fresh.Way better than the other McDonald's in Mount Juliet.  nuff said!

I went around 9pm and ordered 2 mcdoubles and fries. While waiting over 15 minutes for the food in an empty McDonald's, I saw the woman expediting the food adjust her tongue ring for a good minute using her bare hands. She then stuck her hands in her pocket. I left.

Punk night manager accused me of being a drunk even though I live in st Louis. Called 4 times asking for a Corporate number and hung up on me. Last time said he would call pontoon PD. Lol . 15$ hour Really this is the piece Demanding this .  I will be calling till you no longer get work there bud. Worst customer service ever .

I've been to McDonald's before I always drive past here whenever I leave from Woodbury dermatology. Really clean inside, their grill area is kinda big. Service is ok, no complaints. I usually use coupons from the newspaper, coupons from the McDonald's app on my iPhone.

This place only gets one star because I couldn't choose zero. How hard is it to take a coffee order? Well, at this location I have to say it's impossible. We ordered a large regular tea with milk, and a large coffee one cream one sweetener.

Maybe hire staff who can speak English, or stop talking to their co-workers long enough to take a coffee order. I have never been so aggravated with customer service. This place is horrible!!!!!!!
I come here all the time. However, the employees are usually rude. Sometimes I would have to wait ten minutes at night because they would be out of fries. Not very convenient!
the best McDonald in Pasco！friendly staff and nice seating tables！
Always screw your order up and are very rude! Go to the one on gandy worth the extra 2 min drive!
