This is my local work Mcdonald's.  I've had so many issues with this place, from the wrong amount of nuggets, to an incorrect sandwich.  This McDonald's and the one up the streets made me give up on McDonald's all together.  It's probably for the best.  

The plus, is that this McDonald's appears to be open later or even 24/7.  I don't really remember.

Every single time I've come to this Mcdonald's, someone in our party had a major issue.  The last time I went here, the cashier was so incredibly out of it, that I just walked out.  I'm not sure if that cashier was even able to make it home that day, because I'm not quite sure if she knew where she lived.  I might have met the dumbest life form I've ever encountered.  If she is still there, she could be manager by now.  I walked out and haven't been back to any McDonald's since.  My body thanks this place.
Never go here worst customer service and long wait for a simple order!!! Really deserves half a star
Crispy nuggets and a quarter pounder on a French baguette. They even honored a 7:45pm reservation on a Saturday night. Great service and the restroom was immaculate.

Went in they said they had a limited menu so I figured I'll order cheeseburgers they didn't have cheeseburgers they had like two or three big Macs you were probably hours old but I will take a big Mac meal then they said no fries and so I figure they didn't have drinks either canceled my order avoid this one like the plague.

This place is only rated 2 stars for a reason. My fries are never fresh and when I ask for new ones, they give me even colder ones smh I'm over this mcdonalds and the red head working the cash register.

Lazy staff wouldn't serve any food at 330 in the morning
Definitely shouldn't be advertised as 24 hour !!!!

Full disclosure: all of my experiences here have been at about 2:05am (after the bar closes). I have literally never experienced a slower drive-thru in my life. I'm talking an average of 20 minutes, on a good day. Ask any SIUe student and they'll say the same. Even though it's a well known fact, I still find myself going there expecting better. Nope. Shocker. I'd like to be able to eat my cancer in a more timely manner. Oh and the only reason I gave it 2 stars is because it's one of the only places open at 2am, aside from Jack in the Box. But a guy can only eat so many 50cent tacos, know what I'm sayin?
Worst Ever. period.  Absolutely no quality control or management I cannot believe this place exists and never improves.

I am extremely disappointed in what has happened to our local McD's!!  I don't know if there's been a change of management or what, but the last several months this place has gone WAY downhill. I was there to try the new, larger Big Mac, the Grand Mac, something I've been saying they should introduce since the 1980s. In a sense, my life had been leading up to this moment.

If you're expecting a gourmet experience, McDonald's probably isn't the place for you. If you're expecting a squeaky clean fast food restaurant, McDonald's isn't for you. Sometimes they even have a large industrial fan out near the counter to do something (dry the floor? make it smell fresher?). I was happy and thinking maybe my fries would be quick so I could just be in and out despite the other people waiting. 15 minutes later, I learned that wasn't the case. I had even watched people that ordered after me get their full meals (including fries) before me. Nobody behind the counter seemed to be in charge and I watched as mistake after mistake was made. Once, they called out a number that wasn't on the ticket, so the wrong person got the food. Later, they brought out two bags at once, only to realize that they put parts of each order in the opposite bag. At this point, the growing throng of hungry customers was about to turn more into an angry mob. To top it off, an employee started handing out an order before being yelled at that they hadn't finished packing the order yet. Finally I got annoyed and asked where my fries were. I was promptly forgotten about. A minute later, the cashier who took my order asked what I needed. I told her I needed my fries and gave her my order number. Sure enough, the empty bag with my ticket was still sitting back there. She grabbed the fries and put them in the bag and I was on my way, after 15 minutes of standing around, smelling the smells, and watching a leaderless group of people flounder through even the most basic of fast food tasks. I can't definitively say this is the worst McDonald's in the country or world, but you find me a location that you think is worse and I challenge you to give 711 Canal a try.

Historically this was one of the best locations in Tampa regardless of the time of day, day of the week or amount of traffic.

But that is all lost. The latest redesign took far longer than it should have and wasn't much of an improvement. But the biggest issue as a whole is behind the counter.

The customer service has plummeted from the staff and especially the management. However the quality of the food has plummeted to the worst in its history with me.

Because of my history there I have given them a multitude of additional opportunities, but each resulted in equally bad or even worse experiences.

The upside is I eat less McDonald's now.

I normally wouldn't rate a McDonalds because, well, it's a McDonalds and you expect a certain baseline, entry level type of customer service at these establishments. First let me give you a lay of the land. Drive through had some activity but nothing earth shattering with regards to volume. The seating area was empty of actual customers. Yes - empty of customers. Two employees were off to the side eating. I'm greeted by some knucklehead who is speaking to another employee behind the counter, where he doesn't want to take my order because he has to put his own food order in. Hmmmm..ok. The woman semi-pushed him aside and took my order. I ordered what I thought was a fairly simple order - a double quarter pounder with cheese meal and a 10 piece McNugget. Yeah - I know - not the healthiest but was on a cheat day. While I'm waiting for my order, the two other employees who were eating finished their meals and headed back behind the counter. So now, including what I assume was a manager (because she was wearing a blue shirt), there are 9 people back there. 9 useless wonders back there. Another customer came in, his order was taken, and he got his almost immediately. Looked like a Big Mac and a small McNugget. Anyway, I'm still standing there waiting for my meal. The manager tells me they are waiting on the McNuggets. At this point it's close to 15 minutes of waiting. Another future rocket scientist asks me if I placed my order to which I replied "a while ago - a burger and some nuggets" to which she replied "it takes longer to make it fresh" and then said "they could have given you an older one but it wouldn't be fresh"

Ok - let's break this down:

1.  As of 10 minutes ago I was waiting on nuggets. Those are still reheated chunks of frozen chickenless chicken - right?
2. You're telling me getting an older, unfresh burger is actually an option?
3. It shouldn't take you longer to prepare something that is easily assembled because your cooks aren't actually cooking anything.
4. The blue shirted manager needs to understand the value of actually managing her people. When you hear some stupid garbage coming from an employees mouth, correct that then and there. 
5. Managers should explain to their employees that placing their meal orders doesn't necessarily take priority over an actual customer unless you are actually going to die from starvation.

In fairness, I chose not to write a review immediately after my experiences with this particular McDonalds in the hopes that things would change.  But, after a recent visit to this restaurant, I am disappointed to report that this particular location can and will consistently fall short of expectations.  

The interior of the restaurant has a modern design and layout, and features many of the elements that you would expect from a McDonalds.  But, I note the place is unkempt.  There are usually bits of food and other matter on the table surfaces and seats, and little effort is made to clean them.  

When I make my orders, I usually receive them in a reasonable amount of time.  But, I would avoid making any orders to do with gravy.  The staff have commented that they are either concerned that the gravy has run out for the day, or that they do not have any gravy at all.  Also, when you are provided the gravy, it is of an unusual color and texture, or so completely watered down that the water begins to separate.  The store will also consistently provide less gravy than other McDonalds.  

If I am asked to wait for my order through the drive-thru, I have learned that my fries are almost certainly going to be lukewarm or cool.  

I suggest that if you are looking for a regular McDonalds, you can continue your search down the road and elsewhere.  If you are desperate, then confine your order to something small to help speed you on your way to another store.

I am furious. You guys won't see me there again for a very long time.

Usually I get amazing snack wraps. But tonight I was served a ranch crispy chicken wrap but the ranch was bad. Good thing I have a sense of smell. 2/10 very disappointed after a long day of serving waterice.

The inside of this McDonald's was extremely dirty. The drink area was disgusting with soda and ketchup all over it. Floors were covered in crumbs and garbage. There was a huge coffee spill on one of the tables and on the floor was left for at least 30 min. Employees seemed like they didn't want to do there jobs. Mind you I went there at 6:30 in the morning so apparently they don't clean up before closing.

Where do I start? Every person in front of us order was wrong, cashier was very rude, my bf ordered a double quarter pounder cheese only, they gave him
Two patties on a bun with no cheese. It l came down to the very rude cashier ringing up everyone's orders wrong.

While currently receiving a facelift it is challenging getting around the building when work crews are blocking the drive thru. As of right now you order and pay at window number 1 and get food at window number 2. Very friendly service from both the young man and lady working the windows. Food was fast, faster then normal for here, and it was prepered correctly. I haven't had a Big Mac in months and it was so good.

This is the worst McDonald's in St. Louis. Was in drive-thru line for 30 minutes even though there were not that many cars in front of me. Cars in line behind me started honking out of frustration. I saw the person in front of me get part of her order, then wait ten whole minutes before they handed her a coffee. I got iced tea and fries. The fries were completely inedible. Somehow they were hot but hard as rocks.

This isn't a McDonald's that I visit often, but when I do everything is smooth and I am in and out of the drive thru within minutes.

They have the double drive thru at this location that nearly all McDonalds have nowadays as well as a newly renovated dining area that I recently discovered when I went inside to purchase lunch. The dining area offers multiple types of tables and chairs as well as a higher end play area for kids that features two touch screen TVs for kids to use while they are there. Inside feels very comfortable for a McDonald's. 

McDonald's is really adapting to technology by getting rid of their play spaces to add an extra drive thru line. By replacing the play area with two TVs inside, you are able to accommodate more people quicker via the drive thru. It makes tons of sense. Some locations aren't using it properly and still take a while. This location knows exactly what they are doing.

They will mess up your order almost every time, no matter how many times you emphasize or repeat your order. Lately, no matter what your receipt says (that the food they gave you doesn't match what the receipt says), they will refuse to remake your food. I'm not paying twice because you can't get my order right.

Not my favorite McDonalds. The service was slow and there was only two customers in this McDonalds at the time. No one seemed to know how to ring the orders and put the orders together. I felt bad for the customer in front of me because he ordered 12 cookies and when the cashier asked if they were made the back said they did not even do it yet and it was like 10 mins after I already ordered my meal. I had a big meal since I was picking up dinner for my family and mine came out in 20 mins which isn't bad but I felt really bad for the customer in front of me that he just wanted 12 cookies. 

Overall inside was clean for the most part and the cashiers were somewhat friendly but the service was why I only gave this review only two stars. I am unsure if they were still training but if they were training then the manager should have been there to help the cashiers.

Came by today to let my daughter burn out some energy while it's hot to play outside. I like the playplace it is separate enclosed area than the rest. Kids can go screaming without disturbing others not in the play area. The food were okay, not great but not bad either. The playplace needs tidying, there are dried up ketchup, crumbs everywhere. I hope they sanitize the playplace everyday. For a lot of kids come and play everyday, the management should look into sanitizing the playplace. I don't mind coming here often if it doesn't have an ick factor.

This McDonald's needs to hire more people at night .i only work at night 1 time  a week and for the past weeks I've had to wait for 30 minutes in the drive thru  just to get something. Horrible service they don't even ask you  to wait they just give you the silent treatment and take your order 15 minutes later.

Started to hand me 'Sweet Tea' when I told the order taker I wanted mostly unsweetened with about 1/3 sweet tea.  But the girl at the food window had to throw out the sweet tea and make me a mostly unsweet tea, as requested requested previously!  The new Pico and Guac burger was barely covered with only a small amount of it.  Lucky for me I had tried it at 2 different McD's before going to this location  off 267 in Plainfield last night or I would never have bought another.  (As it stands, I took a good look at this burger with its little bit of topping and decided I could make my own Pico and Guac mixture to top a plain burger and save lots of bucks over the next year!!  So this 'uncaring' lack of service has ultimately 'served' me!!)

Don't go to this McDonalds and leave with anything wrong.  They don't care.  They left out one small fry.  It wasn't mine.  It's just a fry, right?  But, it was someone's lunch and it did matter to them.   But, when I got back to work and saw it was missing, they told me to come back and get it.  I told her I was at work and couldn't come back.  She said come back later and get your fry. I asked for any compensation.  She said, 'you can get your fry'.  Very sarcastic.  Very inconsiderate, disrespectful, discourteous.  Corporate didn't care.  They were the same.   I called and a curt woman said all they're obligated to do is correct the order.  I explained it costs more gas than the fries cost to go back and forth to correct their mistake and get what I already paid for.  No difference.  She just acted as tho she didn't care.  I even took the time to write a letter and mail it to the 'executive' that owns several of these franchises.  He ignored.  Do yourself a favor.  Look up his franchises and ignore/avoid those McD's!!!  You can get the info on who the corporation is and the names thru an app from the library.  US Reference USA will give you the info.  There are plenty of other places to get fast food.

Last night 8-8-17, at around roughly 2200-2300. We had to get last mintue items. In doing so i did not want to fuss with dinner. Mcds was right in the walmart. I litterally watch the young, sassy cashier do this: grabs a small PLASTIC CLEAR cup, turns to the coffee maker and begins to fill the clear plastic cup up with hot water from the coffee pot system. It started to burn her finger tips. Which freaked her out. Then went to place it on the counter behind her to give to the customer. And the whole thing melted and got all over both of them. WTF... so then 35 mins later. No fresh sweet tea, asked was told it was made that morning. Really? Thats fresh? 
The manger, a lady with black hair, a friendly smile, were the only reason we didnt just get our money back and leave. 
That was a mistake
Our order was: 1 sweet tea with a double chesseburger for myself. A large big mac with tea for my husband. And since my double burger was on the 2 for $3. We got the 6pc chicken nugget to share. 
Heres what we got: the big mac had hardly any sauce, lettace anything for that matter. Nothing could stick with the amount of grease soaking the darn box!  The fries were good and hot.  The nuggets were cold, but ediable enough for me because my double chesseburger was not a double chesse burger. It was a double burger (forgot chesse maybe in the hot water fiasco) The top and bottom buns were litterally soaked with grease. Sloppy and not good teamwork. 
I felt bad for the manager, her team in the weeds and not giving a darn about anything but joking and laughing at the customers piling up. The manager, lady with black hair and nice smile, did a phenomenal job tring to keep her team going. This team Whom didnt care about how stupid they looked FAILING AT THEIR JOBS AT MCDONALDS. 
Lady, manager lady. I really hope you can get a good team in there... your doing great sweetie.

Wow I'm giving 5 stars to a Mickey D's??? But the customer service was the most courteous I've ever gotten from a fast food place in my life! I had gotten off the NJ transit bus from Philly (trying shave off the Lyft to my hotel), walked in to see not just a 2 Big Macs deal advertised but two types of meals: one with one fry and one drink and two fries and two drinks. 

Now mind you, the experience you get vastly depends on which manager is running the shift. The weekday dinner shift manager runs the place like a courteously well-oiled machine. 

Without request, the food arrived hot yet impressively quickly. My iced coffee arrived with extra cream and I didn't have to correct them afterwards. They gave me a generous cup for water. Families left with enormous dealboxes of food but I can't comment on how good those were, financially or gastronomically. 

Would I go here for a date? Probably not. But it is a welcome respite for the traveler.
Absolutely the worst McDonald's! 30 min ticket times , my order is always wrong and the workers are constantly playing around ! This place is a joke !!!

I found 6 ants in my drink    That is all I have to say

But just because I want to warn you. Don't drink the coke SPECIALLY THE SPRITE or just don't eat there.

As I said service sucked ordered my food got to drive thru the girl asked what did I order? That's never a good sign. Then I had to wait for my large sweet ice tea isn't that made first? 6 people in the drive thru not sure why I had to wait for my order m. I see one of the girls go up front I'm guessing to get the tea. Finally got my tea I'm on my way take a sip and it's regular ice tea. OMG! how hard is it to get a simple order right?
By far this is the worst McDonald's I have ever been to. The employees are horrible and the entire restaurant is filthy inside and out. Corporate needs to shut this place down!

A lot of people ask me how I'm going to give this Mickey D's four stars. Bear with me.

Sure, the first impression isn't so great. Once you push your way through the panhandlers to the front door, you're assaulted by a wee bit of a funky smell. That is the smell of grease, so toughen up, snowflake. That's what you came here to put in your body, so I don't want to hear any complaining.

Sure, the second impression isn't so great either. It's a wee bit messy, sometimes fights break out, and on occasion it's packed with inebriated white people and those two guys playing chess in the best booth. But you're not here for the ambiance, buster. And don't pretend like you were, because if that were the case you you wouldn't be reading Yelp reviews of a McDonald's franchise.

The third impression, however, will catch you so off guard that had this been D Day, you would have let the Allies take over the whole damned beach before you even realized what was going on! The staff are unbelievably friendly. I'm talking smiles, I'm talking accommodating weird orders, I'm talking making recommendations when you're overwhelmed by the menu. This is pure conjecture, but I'll bet you a four piece McNug that if you had a flat on the side of the highway, these are the suckers that pull over and make sure you're okay.

Here's the kicker. The food may not taste that great, no. But the calorie to dollar ratio is simply unbeatable. Download the app, and if you pick the right deal, you could be looking at 1200cal of protein and fat for less than five dollars. Try getting that kind of deal at Chipotle next door and they'll laugh in your face while you're being gurneyed out on account of norovirus. None of that at McDonald's, their meat is fortified with the best antibiotics money can buy.

At this point you're probably asking, well Jesus what does it take for this guy to give out five stars? Good question. I'll grace you with an answer. The ice cream machine is always broken.

Awful extremely salty food.  I order the same thing at every McDonald's I ever go to and for some reason the artisan chicken sandwich was extremely salty.  I asked called (which I almost never do with fast food joints), and spoke to a snippy female 'manager' and was told to stuff either bring the sandwich back - which I had fed to my dogs by this time.  No refund, no replacement.  The manager gave me 'corporate's' number to call.  I did and spoke to Dot.  After a lot of back and forth with Dot, who had said she was the owner, and then said she wasn't.  She claimed the manager was right, I said fine, keep the money I'll just write an online review.  Then she put me on hold to consult with the 'owner' and came back and offered me a refund if I could give her the precise time I could go back to the store.  I couldn't. So she offered coupons.  I said fine as long as they covered the artisan grilled chicken sandwich which is all I order from McDonald's.  Watch this space.  I will delete the review if I receive a satisfactory resolution.
Check your order before driving away. This McDonald's often forgets parts of your order. Food is okay, service is slow.

This is the worst McDonalds I have ever been to.
My Wife and I ordered 1 double cheeseburger, 1 Cpy Buttermilk Chicken, and I medium French Fry and after waiting for 15 minutes we still did not get any of our order. Finally the girl that took our order came to us and told us it would take 5 minutes more to cook the Cpy Buttermilk chicken and waiting for that would of had us waiting over 20 minutes to get this order to our table. So we went to the guy in charge and told him we wanted our money back, this Manager never asked us what the problem was or had any concern why we were asking for it back. We vacation a lot at Treasure Island but we will never visit this McDonalds again.

This is the second time in the last month that I've tried to get something from the drive-thru after 11pm. The first time they told me all that I could reorder was drinks or ice cream everything else will be 20 minutes.

I just  stopped again and they told me there were only 2 people working-class and it would be 10 minutes once I got to the window if I wanted  something...

I suggest if you want service I'd go to the burger king down the street.

Not a great park of town, this location is alright. They redid the outside a few years back and it looks better. There were a few homeless people milling around which is a bummer for me when I'm trying to eat, I don't think this is a mcdonalds problem as much as it is a 4th and keystone problem but either way it's not a lot of fun for me to be around. The food here is standard mcdonalds food which is not filled with a whole lot of substance or quality. They did have free wifi which worked well.... the bright and shiny reason to go to mcdonalds - the internet. ha

The staff here are great. I ordered French fries and they were given to me a little too salty, so I asked if I could get new ones and the manager said no problem. Three minutes later she brings me (to my table) a freshly made box of fries with no salt, then gives me my own salt to salt them to my liking, no questions asked and very polite. All of the staff are friendly and helpful. Good location.
The lady working the counter was terrible. She didn't say anything like can I take your order or good morning , just a blank stare! Wow I'll take my business elsewhere!!!

I picked up breakfast while waiting for flight. Food was hot. I asked for orange juice instead of coffee and charge a $1.29 up charge  for a small. I asked why didn't I receive a med for that price. Requested a refund and went to chic-fa-la. I hate a franchise tries to overcharge you and see no issue with it.

Most pathetic McDonalds I've ever been to. Back cash person had no idea what she was doing, whoever was doing table served the worst "burritos" I've ever seen. My ears are still ringing from the crunch those poor tortillas made in anguish and im still looking for any sausage or egg actually in this thing. As a former McDonalds manager I know the all day breakfast thing can make it hard on table but it takes like 30 secs to warm up 2 burritos so there's no reason this should ever happen. Absolutely never coming here again

Long lines, not enough registers open.
Bathroom is outdated and dirty. For a long time they had no napkin dispenser. You had to ask for napkins.

After my son opened his kids meal, we realized his milk was expired after he drank some. I showed it to an employee and she checked their milk bottles. They were all expired. We were offered no refund or even an apology. The other milk was not even removed from the fridge.
This McDonald's is under staffed.  The poor girl working the counter had to take orders and put them together by herself.  This is a management problem.  Someone should have come and helped her.

I normally don't like to review fast food places because people are still going to go to it no matter if it has a million 1 star reviews. This experience was just so terrible, I have no choice but to review it. The line was backed up two cash registers were open , but yet one employee was only taking the orders. Finally half an hour later, My order was taken, and all we just wanted was Ice cream. Another 30 minutes have elapsed, Still no ice cream . At this time, I have been noticing that people that were behind us are getting their orders. We then talked to the employee, they forgot to give us the Ice Cream when we first ordered it. They didn't even give anything to fix the situation not even an apology. So we wasted one hour of our lives, for Ice cream. I guess this is fine by McDonald's Standards,there's a good reason why I don't eat here a lot. This is the reason why!

This was one of the worst experiences at a McDonald's EVER!!! It took about 15 minutes to place our order, (not to mention the lady taking our order had attitude and said, "I was just making a suggestion!!" when we said no thank you we just want two coffees, and when we went to pay, we were told it would be 15 minutes. FOR TWO ICED COFFEES?! Wow...we immediately left and will NEVER be back!!

Terrible experience.  I can't choose zero stars or I would!  Employees were standing around chatting.  Twenty-two minutes for a cheeseburger.  Several beeping noises and no one attending to them.  Manager stood in the back on his cell phone.  I wish I could show how bad the experience was!

Don't ever, everrrrr pull away from their drive through window until you're sure your entire order has been fulfilled. I've been coming to this location for years (only because it's the closest), and four out of five times there's items missing from my order. It's paid for, but doesn't end up in the bag. Double check folks! Really frustrating...

This is still the worst McDonald's on the planet the service for fast food is disastrously slow. The staff needs to be completely fired. I can get in and out of Ruth's Chris Steak House faster than I can at this McDonald's

This is the best McDonalds in Pinellas County!  The food is always perfect and freshly prepared when I come here.  Tables are freshly wiped, and staff is the best!  Thank you!  This is the way it's suppose to be!

This McDonald's is not ready for prime time. Either their registers are not set up properly or the workers have no idea how to operate them. I am a big user of the McDonald's APP! By using the APP you can earn free McCafe drinks, every six McCafe purchase you get one free, coffee or shake. This is if you use the APP at the time of purchase. There is a code to enter if they cannot scan the APP but I was told their registers are not set up for that. REALLY? Two days a week I go to this McDonald's and there is always a problem with the register or they don't have the 'free' item offered by the APP such as the Peach Smoothie. 

I have contacted the corporate office who appeared willing to help with a resolution. I was wrong! Two weeks after my initial contact the corporate office followed up to ask if anyone contacted me. They had not, they offered another apology and stated they will contact the owner again. Two months later no one has called and the registers at times still do not work and for the third time they did not have Peach Smoothies. They don't care! Luckily on the way to work there is another McDonald's!

The only upside are the two female workers on the drive thru in the morning on Monday and Tuesday. The one taking the order is young 25 or younger and the other a mature woman, they are very nice!

I went to this location while their drive they was under construction, so I had to go in the lobby. After waiting for about 5 minutes, I ordered and they were out of two of their four mcflurry flavors. I went to fill up my cup, and the sweet tea was empty, so I asked them to fill up my cup with the one in the back, but since the drive thru was closed they just told me they were out. That was three items from my order they were out of. I picked up my order to find they gave my son 4 chicken nuggets after charging for 6, and forgot the barbecue sauce and side. When I went to ask for those things, two other customers were standing up front with complaints about their orders as well.

If you want the most violent case of food poisoning this is your place! I ate here on Friday 8/11/17 around 4:00. I will never eat at a McDonalds again after how sick I was. I got chicken nuggets, and clearly they weren't kept at the proper temperature. Eat at your own risk here. I tried called all day on Saturday to let them know so they can try to be safer in the future and never picked up the phone all day. I finally got through to a manager named Sarah on Sunday at 6pm and she was extremely rude and unapologetic, completely unprofessional. For the sake of everyone out there, avoid it!

I don't know what it is about this McDonald's but it seems like every time we go there our order is messed up.  They either forget something, or wrong items are sent out. Also sometimes the buns are stale. The drinks sometimes do not taste right or they are out of them. Where is the manager?

While visiting my mom in the hospital she wanted a chocolate milkshake. So I go to the McDonald's located inside. First we stand in line while 3 employees talk amongst each other and do "busy work". Then we finally get asked for our order. We pay and I watch the girl make the milkshake and it overpours and spills. She proceeds to grab the cup and gets it on her hands. Then she throws the cup away and licks the palm of her hand and her fingers. Needless to say my mom did not get a milkshake. It's a complete mess in this location. Before we gave our order I noticed there was only 4 employees. They take an order then have to make that order, so this process makes things even slower than they already are. Won't be back. I'll go to the cafe, or go to another location outside of the hospital.
Horrible ..... the worst chicken McNuggests I ever saw or tasted.  They looked like hockey pucks!!!!

Interesting visit to McDonalds. Hours on the door said they are open until 10pm but after entering and ordering, we were told we couldn't eat inside, we had to take our food to go because they decided they were closing early. Although none of the staff around the register were really sure what time that was. Staff was nice otherwise but a rather odd experience, especially for McDonalds! They're always open to stop by at and count on for food. I'm surprised such a namestay would not go by their hours posted.

I pretty much concur with all the other comments here.  Hygiene awareness was non-existent.  We watched a grown man suck his thumb then prepare our food without washing his hands.  I demanded a refund and we walked out.  Never in my life had I imagined a McDonalds could be so horrible at the basics of fast food service.

I don't eat meat - which yeah I get it McDonalds doesn't have vegetarian selections and I can always go somewhere more veggie friendly.  But I really love that mac sauce - so I usually come and get a big mac and get the meat substituted for tomatoes.  Sounds stupid I know, but gotta do what I gotta do to get my fix of that sweet mac sauce.  I don't even mind that I'm paying $4+ for some bread, cheese, and sauce.  Today the drive through girl argued with me over giving me the tomatoes for free instead of meat and said the managers already said they aren't going to do that anymore.  Seriously?  I've worked in restaurants for years and I can confidently say the food cost for a slice of tomato is significantly lower than two burger patties.  I'm not paying an extra 40 cents to have a decent veggie sandwich.  Taco bell does beans instead of meat - no charge.  Burger King takes money off for a whopper with no meat (or you can just get a veggie patty). But seriously, refusing to even not charge me an extra 40 cents to just get some tomatoes?

Cool, enjoy no longer getting $4 a trip for some bread.  I'll be hitting up Taco Bell who at least makes some effort to cater to all their guests.

I wish i could give 0 stars. Website says open til 2a.. pull up at the drive thru at 11p on a Saturday night and they say they're closed!! Don't even mention to try coming inside. Just we're closed, goodbye. And this isn't the 1st time this has happened to me here. And they have gotten my order wrong at this location, and I've received a hamburger with no actual burger. The staff is rude and they have the longest wait times ever! QUITE POSSIBLY THE WORST MCDONALDS IN INDIANAPOLIS!!!!!!

This is crazy we have been sitting here in the drive thru for 45 minutes and now are asking for a refund. People are honking there horns and no one is moving. Desire disappeared with our receipt and now we are waiting 15 mins for a refund. This is crazy! No explanation worse customer service EVER! Avoid at all cost!

Went to the drive through at 330 a.m. and they were cash only. What kind of junior league business is that? Just came from the Seffner location and no one responded to take my order at the drive through there. Need to get away from pretentious menu items and get back to what they do best. Following Wendy's failures. No wonder 5 Guys and in-n-out franchises are the places to dine.
The guy that work there in the morning he's friendly! We got wrong orders he fixed it immediately also refund I m impressed!

I love this location! I go here almost every morning for my latte which I love better than Starbucks! But they are so efficient at this location and all the employees in the am shift are all super nice!
Been coming here every since this location opened.Best in the area,Always on point never have been disappointed with service.EVEN WHEN MISTAKES WHERE MADE,IT WAS RECTIFIED!

The service is slow, can't get orders right, unmotivated employees, slow drive thru & lack of management. This location has no redeeming qualities. If you could train the employees how not to be, they'd send them here for training.

So I'm on the way to an appointment and am starving to death coz I've been running all day without taking a food break. In addition, I needed to charge my cell as my phone charger is still in my car being serviced its monthly gazillion dollars. All of this is why I decided on the McDonald's 6840 W. Washington. My first shock occurred when I was greeted at the door by a fellow whose uniform could pass military requirements. The young ladies at the counter accepted my order as though they were happy to see me. First time in a long time that I didn't have to shake excess salt off my fries. I believe if you blindfolded someone and took them inside this location, they wouldn't think it's McDonald's. Kudos to the owner, management and employees.

This place is literally the worst. My hopes were high when they renovated but unfortunately it's still the same old horrible service. They got my order wrong and when I called back I was hung up on. Followed with another call and no one answered. Not to mention my fries were still cold, To which I guess you could say was a step up from the last visit it was just old and stale. I'd advise you never to visit this McDonald's I know won't.

Agree with past post, used to be great service, not anymore.

Last week we went there to have lunch and enjoy the play palace, both of our happy meals were wrong, and all of our fries were undercooked and flat out disgusting.

Drive thru this time, both happy meals again messed up, (no apple slices at all. Luckily I noticed they messed up our drinks, was able to get those fixed). Also asked for strawberry and vanilla shake, got strawberry and chocolate. 

Glad there is a chick fil a that is on my way home as well when I'm needing that easy once in awhile dinner. Won't be going back.

Well if you are going to go to this McDonald's you might of just drive down the road to get service. When you go there at night the service is horrible. You can sit at the drive thru and never get service or when you do the staff is more worried about hanging out the window having a personal conversation. I have gone multiple times at different times of the day and it's always the night crew that is the worst. They don't care about customers and obviously the mangers are lacking customer service as well. Hopefully the store manager realizes this and eliminates these bad apples.

People will say "what do you expect its McDonald's" but when you pay for a meal no matter what it is you should expect what you order. Cheeseburgers are often cold (Cheese is not even melted) if you order no onion it should be no onion. Fries should not be soggy.
This place is the worst ever, get orders wrong drive thru never ready at 545 am to bad nothing closer

i hate every McDonald's in Santa Barbara Except this one ! This is the only one i will eat at Because there customer service is Really​ good . the cashier BLAKE is Super nice and does a really good job Super happy with this place  thanks for making every trip to McDonald's a good one

Gave it 2 tries.  The first time they shorted me a quarter pounder and the second time we ordered through the app and they lost the order. The manager, Corina, acted like it was our fault and was very rude.  Never eat there again...

Can't believe I waited for 30 minutes for cold nasty food. Chicken nuggets tasted like cardboard. Forgot sauces milk for a toddler what a waste of time and money. Worst part is I contacted corporate they send me gift cards to use only in Florida and I live in Ohio will never step foot in another McDonald's

Food is good but service is very disorganized.  Major mistakes on orders - check to see that your order is right before you leave the counter or drive thru window.  Are frequent order mistakes a way to run a McDonald's?  Again, check your order before you leave the counter.
They messed up my order and i found a hair in my pancakes. That's one way to lose your appetite.
Credit card machine down for days, your a McDonald's and with all the credit vendors these days someone could've set up a temporary account
There was a lady yelling at other employees and complaining. She rolled her eyes when I asked for my order.

I understand that this is a McDonald's and nobody is expecting five star service or high quality food, but every time I go to this particular McDonald's my order is never correct or they forget half of my food or give me someone else's order. I've learned not to leave the drive through until I have checked every single item in every bag. I don't know what it is about this location but it's the worst one in my opinion!

I came here for breakfast with 5 other people. Our wait time in line was not bad and the food we had was good, but the iced coffees were horrible. Myself and 3 of my friends ordered iced coffees and we all had the same issue. They were about 90% cream 7% ice and 3% coffee. The iced coffee literally just tasted like water and cream. I went up to the register and asked if they could dump some of it out and just add more coffee to it. She insisted on making a new one for me. I get my new coffee and it is literally the same thing. Very disappointing.

With this location however, not only must you specify that you want Caeser dressing and croutons in your Caeser salad, you MUST check your order before leaving. If you don't, something will be missing. Once they even forgot to give me the burger for my combo, and I didn't notice until I got home. 

Today's experience: I order a quarter pounder combo with Caeser salad. I specify that I need Caeser dressing and croutons. No problem. When I get to the window, the polite young man hands me my order, making sure to hand me the Caeser dressing I ask for. 

"And the croutons?" I ask. 
"You wanted croutons?"
"Yes. A Caeser salad always comes with croutons." 
He runs back, taking a few moments to find croutons, and gives me an extra pack for my wait.

I drive away, and go sit with my meal. Guess what? Two knives, no fork. 

ALWAYS check your order thoroughly. I added a star because the service is nice, and I can't bash them for good manners. But seriously, the orders must always be checked before driving away. Be vigilant.

Definitely would come back!  And, of course, with McDonalds, the prices are always reasonable.

Like most people, I grew up with McDonald's. The first one we visited was probably in 1963 on the Berlin Turnpike in Newington, CT. The novelty of cheap, fast food was thrilling to the Harris family; prior to McDonald's' arrival, we'd rarely eat out, and when we did, it was Howard Johnson's, or the luncheonette counter at Kresge's or Woolworth's 5-&-10¢ store. So the economical menu appealed to both of my Depression-era parents, and even though we all knew it wasn't exactly the most nutritious meal, it was such a treat!!  Long before the "you deserve a break today" jingle hit the airwaves, there was "McDonald's is our kind of place - it's such a happy place! A clean and snappy place!"  YOUR kind of place!

While I never made it a habit to eat at McDonald's, I generally enjoyed it when I did, remembering fun times with my dad and sisters (Dad loved their coffee and was a real fan of the Filet o'Fish). Over the years, it became more of a "road food" option, especially on long trips; I stopped at a lot of McDonald's on my cross-country road trips: FUTURE STREET tour ROUND TRIP tour. I did best ordering the "side salad", which could be consumed without dressing while driving. As one of the Dollar Menu items, I felt okay ordering 3 or 4 at a time and skipping the sandwich and/or fries... (tho I always had a weakness for their hot apple pies.)

A lot has changed at Mickey D's over the years - and not just higher prices and a more varied menu! I noticed the decor making a quantum shift from the familiar yellow/orange/red palette a while back when the corporation attempted to turn their outlets into "McCafes" complete with Wi-Fi.

And then the backboard menu "came alive" with a frantically changing video menu featuring huge photos of the food in fast rotation with the names and prices of same, which made it much more difficult for economy-minded folks like me to figure out what we wanted/could afford to order!

The latest wrinkle appears to be in response to the rising minimum wage paid to fast food workers; the closest McDonald's to our house has remodeled their outlet to a new design which apparently necessitates employing only half of the former staff. This remodel has an "industrial" look, to put it kindly; dark gray cinderblock walls interrupted by hyper-busy mostly black wallpaper surround the public area. There's no background music, only the mechanical hum, buzzing and clicks of unseen machines. Frankly, the ambiance is dystopian, unfriendly and feels like... McPrison.

Electronic kiosks shaped like giant iPhones stand like Stonehenge, available to take your order. In fact, this is the ONLY way you can order. Walk up to the counter and you'll be turned away, directed back to the kiosks by the attendants, whose forced-cheery greetings sound desperate and reminded me of the little waitresses working at Raisins on TV's "South Park" Since transactions cannot happen thru any other means than these kiosks, heaven forbid there's a glitch and the computer ever crashes?! (We all know that NEVER happens, but if it does... well, No Soup For You!)

McDonald's is probably not the first place most people think of when trying to lose weight, and yet the menus list the calorie counts for each food selection in large bold numbers, mostly obscuring the prices which don't show up until another few click-thrus on the kiosk. Said prices on the big board (if you're quick enough to actually see them while they flash around in a frenzy!?) don't always match the kiosk prices. And, as you might expect with all this technological "progress", ALL of the prices are substantially higher; a small hot fudge sundae that used to cost $1 is now close to $2.

The acoustics of the room are weird; while many customers were buried in their smart phones, the ones who spoke to one another were clearly audible to everyone - so much for privacy. Every conversation we overheard was about how much they didn't like these new, streamlined "improvements" to their McDonald's experience.

I have to agree. While it was never a substantial part of my diet, I didn't think that I would ever completely "age-out" of McDonald's. But apparently that day has come.

New wall signs now limit customers' visits to 30 minutes - then you'd darn well better vamoose! Lunch time is OVER! Back to your cell!

Meh.
Great food and service. Love the new tenders and am a big fan of the new signature sauce

What prompted me to review a McDonalds rather than my normal bougie brunch joint? Well... while the food was pretty run of the mill, there were a number of minor annoyances that made my overall experience less than enjoyable. I like to dip my McChicken in buffalo sauce, but upon arriving at the first window I was told they were all out. I said that was fine and said I would like just a signature sauce, so he told me to tell them at the next window. So Strike 1 = lack of communication and lack of my favorite sauce. Then, I am given 1 sauce, which is nowhere near enough, which I do not realize until I am left with the second half of my meal and no dipping sauce. Next, as I reach into the bag, I notice that both sandwiches are almost completely visible, due to a poor wrapping job. One of the buns is halfway off of my McChicken, and that and the McGriddle are just about touching, so strike 2 = carelessness. Lastly, I am parched, so as I go for my soda, I realize they forgot to give us a straw, and I am not going to return to the "restaurant" just to retrieve a straw, so I allow my salty mouth to be dry for the remainder of my drive home, which brings me to strike 3=forgetfulness. Luckily there is never a shortage of McDonalds locations, nor is this local, so I never have to go here again and run the risk of having an unimpressed experience.

Close to the college so that's probably the only reason why they are still open. Food is always greasy, gut wrenching, doesn't come close to standard. Don't expect a smile from the service. Just grab and go, and don't forget to wipe off the grease.

Won't be back.
They won't take your order at the counter anymore.
The computer system won't let you specify special requests like FRESH fries or a foam cup.

Went here over the weekend. Ordered 4 breakfast sandwiches. On each sandwiches  the put an half of egg.

When did this start happening? They always gave you the whole egg. They charged full price for all of them. 

They also messed up my order too.

Ended up coming to this location because the mcdonalds off Fairview had ice cream machine maintenance.  I come in with a friend to order mcflurries. Our order went through and as an employee named Bernie was beginning to make a mcflurry,  the cashier named Jonathan said, "don't make it. There's a mcflurry in the fridge, just give her that one." Bernie said,  "no, it's okay, that one is melted already."

Um...i was not about to accept an hour old, melted, error mcflurry when I paid for one to be made! Things like this you do NOT say in front of customer.  At all. You do not give customers mistake frozen dairy treats...especially when they have been refrigerated. Also, write off the mcflurry, keep the cup for inventory and let a manager know. Don't serve it if it was messed up.

I got my mcflurry,  ate it and was happy. Other than the tables needing to be wiped down, customer service was good, food was good. But the fact that I was going to be given a REFRIGERATED MCFLURRY...really dampened my experience,  I just do not want this to happen to another customer because they deserve to get what they pay for.

The past few times I've been into this mcdonalds I've had the same crew member on front counter and he always seems frazzled or overwhelmed and hardly gets the order right  and he'll just walk away.... I've just been very underwhelmed and this past time I just walked out and went to a different one (this was at 1pm)

Ordered food and told 3 times my order and when receipt came out it was 30 dollars so asked if it was the right order and he said yes. After checking, the guy put a totally different order than we made and we instantly demanded him to change are order. He then replied "I don't work up here" then after that another women came up and didn't apologize, so we demanded a refund and left. Poor customer service!!!!

I keep telling myself - don't. do. it.  It's not worth the affordable prices to watch underpaid, insufficiently trained employees trying to survive, yet understandably not particularly motivated or happy w/ circumstances.  Just downright depressing!  There are so many better options, even if you simply must have a burger.  And not all McDonalds are as poorly managed - find another one to get your fry fix -- just sad!!

The wait was  way longer than I have ever experienced at a McDonald's. Took about 10 minutes to get a burger and fries. The burger was only warm, the fries were hot. Everyone seemed to move really slowly. 

The staff was in full swearing  mode tonight. The guy cleaning the floor was tossing F-bombs every few seconds. Half the clientele appeared to be homeless. Panhandling seems to be  allowed in the restaurant. Even the cashier was asking for tips. 

OK, it was  an interesting McDonald's but I don't  think I would come here on a regular  basis.

This mcdons turnt the hell up when I went there I ordered a 20 piece nug, a chicken and ranch snack wrap, 2 large fries, 2 black and white milkshakes and they completely outdid the game. They gave my my order plus another milkshake plus another fry plus another snack wrap AnD a burger?! Absolutely astounding

Worst McDonald's in Tampa. The guy working mornings in the drive thru needs to spend less time singing and dancing and more time working. This dual drive thru is the craziest concept. Sat through 3 other people ordering b4 he finally tried to take mine. I left. Always something here.

I come here often for breakfast since it is on my way to work. There is always a smiling face when I pull up to the window. I have had nothing but great customer service. There have been times, just like any restaurant, where my order has been messed up, but they are quick to fix it! The line moves quick! Much better than the one on  Nissan. Nissan McDonald's has NASTY coffee, I thought maybe it was just that day, so I gave them another shot, nope it's always nasty! How do you mess up coffee?!!

I go thru the drive thru every morning to get a cup of coffee... when i got to the window,  the cashier asked if i wanted decaf... i said no.... she shut the window and i watched another employee fill the cup with decaf and then top off with the last bit of regular... she brought me the cup and i asked why it was decaf... she said it wasn't.. i told her i saw the other employee.. she said...oh... i demanded my money back... she took the cup back and brought me my money... i will never go there again,  for any reason.

Good comes out quick. Good customer service. I usually stop by this locations multiple times a week while in town bc it's on the way and easy. Only thing that annoys me is that when I ask for light ice I swear they fill that thing up even more with ice. Only get like 3 drinks. Oh well.
Drive thru in the mornings (5:00am) super slow. The drive thru on the way home(3:00pm) same super slow , avoid at all cost.

Very slow service. The restaurant is remodeled and kept clean. Multiple staff members standing outside the door smoking and joking. Inside manager running register, one person at drive thru, one person cooking. One employee eating at a table. Long line inside and out. 

Took the first bite of my egg m
cmuffin...shock, raw egg streaming down my face dripping off the wrapper and my hands. I have never experienced that in years of eating their breakfast sandwiches. Not just a little undercooked...but barely holding a shape n one bite let all the raw yellow and egg white escape. The manager had it remade, next one was barely done, but at least it held together.

Drive thru is the way to go at this location. It took 20 minutes for us to get 2 double cheeseburgers (just the sandwiches, not the meal). The employees didn't even acknowledge the wait time and didn't care.
Good...although sometimes slow. I just realized there's no dollar menu it's now called an everyday value menu. Those business guys sure know how to take advantage.

I am constantly frustrated with this location especially when I come here in the morning.  Even though it claims to be a 24 hour restaurant they are often closed if you come before 5 am because they are "updating" their system, which is all the time apparently.  When they are open they constantly get the order wrong even though I order a basic meal upsized with a coffee and orange juice; the screen is correct and the person taking the order repeated what I ordered exactly. Other times I got clear coffee; even had to explain what coffee is supposed to look like to a woman who thought the coffee was supposed to look that way.  The sad part is this location doesn't care and have done nothing to improve.

Normally if you visit a McDonald's, most of the people that work there are rude, or they put off the attitude that you are an inconvenience or at minimum they are short and snippy. I have gone to this McDonald's often for lunch because it's close to work. I want to give a shout out to the drive-through person who takes the money. The person at the second window give me his name... So Isaiah please keep up the great work!  He is always had a happy and caring attitude, he has extremely good customer service skills. He asks hows your day going, along with being fast and efficient at taking the payment. It is very rare nowadays to see any customer service skills that are nice, let alone go above and beyond

Update... This is the second time at the drive-through and no one answers. I don't know if there is a bell that rings or what but they will answer the car behind. You say hello ask them if they're ready nobody answers it's such a waste of time I just drove through after giving up. I won't be back I will go somewhere in town. Either get your radios fixed or a monitor to see if there is a car out there

Midnight to 5 AM... I am usually impressed by the workers patience & attitude being 24 hour 7 day a week drive-thru & dine-in establishment.

Constant business with people in the drive-thru is one thing, but add weird people coming inside to use Wi-Fi, get out of the weather or just relax for a minute in the middle of the night has to be stressful.

It is still a McDonalds- so the food isn't completely healthy or tasty, but it is cheap & fast.  Being available in the middle of the night when most places are not makes me grateful.

Terrible. Every time they get the order wrong in the drive thru. Today, 11/3 at 9am, I ordered 2 sausage egg mcmuffins with cheese and got ham instead of sausage. Why? Oh, and they were cold.  Why? Other times they repeat the order back and it is wrong. Why? This really isn't rocket-science. The only good thing is the very pleasant woman who works in the first pay window of the drive thru on weekday mornings.  She always is smiling. Not sure why but she makes my day....unlike the food and order takers and bag fillers in the drive thru.

I generally think it is ridiculous to post reviews for fast food restaurants but I am inspired. This is the WORST McDonald's you will ever go to as long as you live and breathe. If you are on a road trip that cuts through St. Louis, and your children are screaming in the backseat because they are hungry, and your belly is also growling furiously, and you see a sign offering McDonald's at the upcoming exit...keep driving. Wait it out. Don't do it.

I had to take my order back a record FOUR TIMES, people. FOUR. Ordered a sausage, egg, and cheese McGriddle which I realized in the car had only sausage and warm, partially-melted cheese on it. I went back in. The cashier went to the back window to let the doofuses in the back know she needed an egg on this. Ten minutes later, I receive a wrapped package. I smile and am halfway out the door with it when i take another peek and it is STILL a sausage and cheese only McGriddle. Took it back. By now, other people are coming in. The cashier is visibly flustered because the idiots on the grill in back can't seem to stop giggling and playing with each other long enough to actually do their orders. Eventually I get what I ordered for and get to leave. 

The manager on duty at the time clearly did not care that her workers couldn't get themselves together. I've worked fast food and I know what it's like. I also know that when someone has had to bring something back more than once, a decent manager would apologise at the very least. Not a single apology from any of the knuckle-dragging, half-witted boneheads working at this location. I will never, as long as I live, go back to this janky McDonald's. Just throw the whole McDonald's away and start from scratch.

I have been a regular breakfast customer at this McDonalds for years. So much so that I know the names of the employees that have been there for many years. I am not the easiest customer to satisfy especially when it comes to my eggs. But they have always cooked them the way that I request. They are a very friendly hardworking staff. Admittedly, they have staffing issues, but so do most fast food restaurants. But when they have a team that "stick and stay" and works together, they do a great job. If they run out of napkins, etc. its not the employees fault, nor is it their responsibility to go to Walmart to purchase those items. That responsibility lies on the franchise owner. The employees are doing the best that they can. And to me, they do a fantastic job!!
hair in my salad, fries were unsalted although we didn't ask for them that way, and the drive-through lady was rude/impatient. sticking to chick-fil-a next time!

Don't let the old reviews fool you, this is one of the WORST locations in the STL area. It doesn't matter if you drive through or walk inside, the employees are usually pretty rude or just plain don't know what they are doing. This includes the male, 50-something year old manager I've seen standing around, always with the same dumbfounded look on his face. If I order inside I never get a receipt, customers are standing around wondering where their orders are, and nine out of ten times it's wrong anyway. The line outside is usually ten cars deep regardless of what time it is because everyone inside works at such a slow pace. I come here for the fries and diet Coke because its the closest one to my work, but I should probably just cut my losses now and quit going here altogether because it's always a shit show. No offense to the people who actually do their jobs, I feel sorry that you have to work at such a crap location.

This is the second time I have visited this location and problems both times. See attached picture for their version of large fries. Hmm, maybe that's more like a medium. No extras in the bag either as I had hoped. My singular weekly cheat day thwarted by a lazy or uninformed employee.

Wow, after reading the other reviews below, I don't feel as bad. I believe the night shift is run on minimum amount of employees. Stopped there around 9pm. 3 cars ahead of me. On Tuesday the staff were fantastic, they let me order a burger and fries even though I didn't have a vehicle at 0100.  I live it one of the local hotels.  I work in the military.  I have strange working hours.  It was fabulous.

Sort your life out manager of McDonald's, try serving customers when it's dead and you're open.

Omg, at the window I order three meals all large, I get to the window and it's wrong, the guy put down medium meals, we say no, they are all supposed to be large, then we pay and go to the next window and they give us all mediums, then the managers barely speak any English and then argue with us and won't let us pay for large.. Since I have to rate it one star for the win...... first off, I contacted McDonald's about this place and haven't heard back at all. Kid at the end of the counter doesn't know what customer service is.  Hint:  When a customer asks a question about the menu, don't point to the menu.  Classic reason why people who work at McDonald's do not deserve $15.00 an hour.  This place could benefit from the hamburger vending machines.

Don't let their over-the-top Christmas lights fool you into thinking you'll have a positive experience at this McDonald's. Save yourself the trouble and head to the Wendy's across the street.

If you order a 6 piece nugget, you'll get 4 in a 6 piece box.  Just forget about cream and sweetner being added or stirred in your coffee. Only half the staff knows mighty kids meals get a small fry and small drink automatically so, you have to check this before you leave.  If you say no mayo, expect extra mayo. Stale buns, cold food.  If they ask you to pull forward for an item to finish cooking DON'T DO IT.  They'll forget about you and leave you sitting for 20 minutes.

ZERO STARS!!!!!!!!
Always slow.. i've been there 4 times..  they never have poutine  .. always out of stock..  terrible mc donalds !

Hands down, the worst service I've ever had at a McDonalds. I constantly wait 10-15 minutes in a drive thru when only 3-5 cars are in front of me. I avoid it when I can, but if I'm on the run, a snack maybe all the time I have.

It's a McDonald's. 

Usually I just chalk it up to a young kid new in the work world and go on with my day, but the past 2-3 times I stopped by for a fries, I receive them extremely under cooked/fried. To the point where there is zero color to them and so unpleasant, I throw them out.

If you check the bag in front of them, they give you dirty looks, if you give them a chance and wait until your home, you find a mix up or in my case, undercooked fries.
Takes way too many steps just to order a drink inside at the new automated ordering station.  Wastes time and it seems you still need as many employees.

I read a few reviews for this McDonald's recently and noticed a few people pointed out how some items are a little more expensive than at any other McDonald's. I hope the price increase came from this location wanting to pay their employees a little extra because they deserve it

I was here fore a quick pick up boy I was disappointed with the service let alone the hygiene factor behind the drink dispenser there was water all over the floor which is a fall risk for anyone so I had to walk to seat in the back one time f the staff members came out and open the door half way through and stood with the door half open and started smoking blowing the second hand smoke into the seating area I thought McDonalds was a smoke free zone or is the staff allowed to do whatever they want

Enzo

3 stars is about as good as I can go for any McDonald's because, well, it's McDonald's. But for this one specifically, it's as good as any other one and not nearly as bad as some. They have the app scanners, which is nice if you use the apps. All in all, it's hard to beat for a quick bite but keep in mind that quick bite is, well...McDonald's.

This location is close to work but service is incredibly slow and the latte machine is perpetually broken or being cleaned so out of service. They don't tell you this until you're at the pickup window then just offer you coffee instead and don't bother to refund the difference. I've stopped trying here which is unfortunate because the great location.

I've been to this Mc Donald's several time over the past year. The service is extremely slow. You expect that level of service when you first open but after a year things should be improving. I've seen now improvement. We have written off this location and don't plan on returning for a long while.
Just your basic McDonald's. it is just on the Pinellas bike path in a good place to stop for a rest.

Coming home from the shore on a rainy horrible day, my niece suddenly got hungry and wanted French fries. We went through the drive through.

Miserable workers. Like i am bothering them. Asked if they still had the mozzerella sticks or if it was just a limited time thing. She told me to look at the menu.....real nice.
The 86th st. location is great. This location may be the worst Mcdonalds I've ever been to. Employees are rude and poorly trained. Fries are always stale.

I usually don't complain about experiences at fast food restaurants. I know that orders can get backed up, employees can get busy, machines can break, and that sometimes, your order can get messed up. But tonight, my experience at this particular McDonald's location was downright uncomfortable.

I felt bad stopping at a fast food restaurant shortly before midnight on New Year's Eve, but I had worked a night shift the previous night and got off at noon, sleeping through most of the day.  Not a whole lot was open except McDonald's.  My usual McDonald's location at Tanque Verde and Grant was closed, so my closest 24-hour choices were the ones on Camino Seco and this location.  I settled on this location.

The restaurant wasn't too busy.  There were only a few people inside, but there were a few cars waiting in the drive thru line.  I ordered a sandwich combo and a chocolate milkshake from the kiosk.  I took my receipt and stood and waited near the counter.  After a few minutes, it was clear that things were backed up, so I took a seat at one of the booths closest to the counter.

As I was sitting there, I couldn't help but notice the sluggishness of the activity behind the counter.  An SUV at the drive thru window began frantically honking their horn.  "They want to see a manager," said an employee loading up some fries in a bag.  This was only the first of two times where someone from the drive thru requested to speak with a manager.

I brushed it off.  "They're just busier than they were expecting," I said to myself.  A minute later, the same employee told me that the shake machine was broken and asked if I wanted a frappe or smoothie instead.  I opted for a fountain drink, because my order was already taking a long time to complete and I didn't want to prolong the wait.  He handed me a cup and I went over to get a soda.  Unfortunately, the ice machine was out of ice, so I decided to wait for the rest of my order to ask for some ice.

At this point, I've been waiting about 20 minutes for my order.  Finally, the employee bagged my stuff and handed it to me.  I offered my cup and ask if I can get some ice because the ice machine is broken.  He looked at me and with an oddly enthusiastic breath of sarcasm, remarked something to the effect of "Oh! You mean the ice machine that's been broken all day?  Oh, that ice machine.  Yeah, I've got about ten orders to complete, but I can stop everything and get you some ice.  No problem." I don't know how it was my responsibility to know that the ice machine had been broken all day, but he certainly made it seem like I was supposed to do something about it myself.  He waltzed over to the ice machine behind the counter and completely fills my cup and handed it back to me.

Maybe it was because I was tired, hungry, or a combination of both, but I couldn't really muster any kind of response other than a brief expression of shock as I timidly took the cup from him, poured out the excess ice, got my drink and left.

I will not be returning to this location in the future.

So first we didn't recognize that the dining room closes at midnight, and we attempted to open the door, just to find it locked. Our mistake 100%, by no means was it anyone's fault but our own for trying to enter a closed dining room. Dang it. Back to the car, ready to pass through the drive thru with only maybe 2 cars in front of you TOTAL (and they've already ordered, nobody is behind you). I was planning on paying for one of my friends food, and the other one was on her own. We get to the ordering box and say, "Can we please have two separate orders?" and the woman just flat out says, "No." We all thought, 'this is a joke,' but you guessed it! No joke. You could hear her coworker saying "just tell them no" and she proceeded to tell us that they were "too busy." Too busy? With the two cars in front of me? I don't think so. Plus, it's not like we were holding up the line. So I said, "okay then I guess we're just going to have to come through twice," and started my order. I started by saying "Could I please get a  Grand Mac?" She said "We don't have the Grand Macs." Okay, fine. Maybe I was just uneducated about McDonalds' new menu, which was likely the case. So I just say, "Then could I have a Big Mac and a medium fry?" The Big Mac pops up on the little screen, no fry. I'll just repeat that later. "Could I also get a crispy chicken ranch snack wrap?" "We no longer sell the snack wraps." That's weird, because I was JUST at that same location no more than a week ago and ordered two of them. I said, "I was here last Friday and ordered them?" and she said "WELL THAT WAS LAST WEEK HONEY, THINGS CHANGE." OKAYYYYY GIRL. We work in fast food, and even on our bad days, customers are treated with the utmost respect. We know that it gets stressful, but you do not treat a customer with such blatant disregard. At this point, we're ready to go. Obviously you do not care for your customers or your job. Anyways, we ended up leaving and eating at the Taco Bell on E. Thompson Road. They were happy to have us and the woman was kind, allowed 2 separate orders, and not yelling through her microphone about the menu items we wanted. At the window, we got to talking about our experience at McDonalds, and she said "I just got a snack wrap today!" FUNNY. I attempted to call the store and speak to a manager, for them to never pick up, except once, but they hung up on me. I wasn't going to yell, I just wanted to have a conversation with the management about the situation. I'm sure they were "too busy" to talk to a customer who was trying to settle the McDonalds drive th incident, that ultimately, led to yhis review. Good going McDonalds, and your wonderfully staffed drive thru.

THE BAD SIDE:

I don't vary too much in my ordering, so it's either particular shifts of employees don't know how to follow assembly instructions, or they just don't care. The food quality at this location is almost always good. Other items come out fresh and juicy for the most part. I'd say about 7 out of 10 times I walk out with fresh and hot burgers with only a rare occasion getting the dried out patty. 

Customer service is pretty good too. I've never encountered a rude staffer at this location and there are a few really high-energy employees there that make the trip fun.

Speed is hit or miss. I'm going 5 out of 10 with this one. There have been a couple times where the wait was long but understandable due to short staffing or diner rush. However there have been a couple other instances where the wait just didn't seem to make sense. Of course I'm not back there so I really don't know if something is behind the scenes is causing the issues.

Juwan has been battling cancer since 2016. He is currently dealing with his 3rd relapse but he has done everything in his power to live life to the fullest. As if fighting cancer wasn't enough, Juwan juggles school, work, tutoring, band and various community service projects. In the past, Juwan has had issues with a manager named Tia M. scheduling him on his chemotherapy days despite being told he couldn't work. Documentation was submitted that remedied that however she began to cut his hours stating that she didn't want to work with him. Just as he was preparing to file a formal complaint, COVID-19 hit. Recently, Juwan returned to work and was pleasantly surprised to have a new store manager. Unfortunately, Tia was still the one responsible for creating the schedule. This week Juwan was again scheduled for a Wednesday despite the store being told that he sees his oncologist on that day. When he attempted to return to work yesterday, he was told that he was in trouble and needed an additional doctor's note before he would be allowed to work. Almost immediately his team at CHOP provided documentation AGAIN and the new store manager was notified that this was an ongoing issue with the scheduling manager. Juwan was allowed to work and was assured that this wouldn't happen again. 

Today, Juwan reported to work and began his shift. He worked for hours without having any issues. Around mid-day, Tia reports to work and immediately began to single Juwan out. Everything came to a head when she attempted to reprimand him for pulling his mask down and turning his hat out his face. This was done while he was washing dishes and so that he can catch his breath. This is important because Juwan's largest tumor is situated in his chest, right against his lungs and heart. Furthermore, he has lung damage due to the years of chemotherapy and radiation. Juwan explained to the manager why he did this and her response was to write him up. Once she was done writing him up, Juwan stepped outside and called me for advice. I instructed Juwan to go back inside and finish his shift. I further instructed him that we would handle a formal complaint with upper management once he was off. When Juwan returned to work the manager refused to allow him to finish his shift. At the exact same time, I happened to call his phone and heard what she said. I told him to get her full name and when she realized that I was on the phone she then disrespect both him and me. Once I got there she then called the police once I let her know that she was not getting away with treating my son this way. This is when she decided to call the APD (who handled this perfectly).

So here is my problem... you can't violate an employees rights. You can't retaliate against an employee for bringing the violation to management. You can't disrespect a hard working employee that shows up for work the day after chemotherapy and not complain. Juwan never uses his cancer as a crutch but he has rights under the law.
